Job Description

The American Express Travel & Lifestyle Services (TLS) Test Team validates travel-related products and capabilities across the TLS product suite.

The Quality Engineer II supports User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Quality Assurance (QA) by preparing test strategies, developing and executing test scripts, maintaining test data and environments, logging results, and supporting defect resolution. This role executes against the portfolio-level test and automation strategy and supports delivery in a Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) environment.

The Quality Engineer II partners with Product Managers, vendors, American Express developers, and technical teams to coordinate end-to-end testing across the TLS portfolio and ensure quality principles and processes are consistently applied throughout software delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinates and facilitates UAT/E2E testing activities across programs and large projects.
  • Creates and maintains comprehensive test data sets to support systems integration, regression, and customer journey testing, ensuring accurate and reliable results.
  • Monitors and tracks defect resolution, partnering with development teams to support timely and effective fixes.
  • Participates in design discussions to identify quality risks early and recommend refinements to user story requirements.
  • Defines, documents, and analyzes quality assurance metrics, including defect trends, test results, and test status, to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Supports core quality principles and promotes adherence to quality standards, engineering practices, and continuous improvement.
  • Develops, enhances, and maintains CI/CD automation processes, ensuring automated tests are integrated and executed effectively within delivery pipelines.
  • Collaborates with product and business teams to align quality engineering activities with business objectives.
  • Integrates agentic AI tools into test design, documentation, execution, and defect management workflows to improve testing efficiency and coverage across applications and systems
  • Uses agentic AI analysis capabilities to identify defect patterns, testing gaps, and quality risks, providing recommendations for process improvements
  • Applies agentic AI testing and automation capabilities within continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines to enhance quality and delivery outcomes
  • Applies responsible AI principles when using AI-enabled tools, including data privacy, bias awareness, human oversight, traceability, and validation of AI-generated outputs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or another technical discipline, or equivalent work experience required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in QA, UAT, or software testing.
  • Experience with Agile, Agile at scale (SAFe), and other iterative application development methods
  • Proficiency with Rally, JIRA, or similar development and defect tracking applications.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Able to work flexible hours with occasional overtime as needed.
  • Knowledge of testing methodologies, test data management tools, and at least one programming or scripting language.
  • Working knowledge of AI-enabled testing capabilities within quality engineering, automation, and defect management tools.
  • Understanding of AI use cases in software testing, including automated test generation, defect analysis, reporting, and test optimization techniques

Work Experience

  • Experience in writing test cases, running functional, automated, or performance tests, and managing and mitigating defects
  • Experience in Software Development Life Cycle (test, defect, reporting and metrics, etc.)
  • Experience in automation and testing in a continuous deployment/continuous integration environment
  • Experience in quality scanning tools, ability to baseline and measure on-going quality metrics, and display via Dashboards
  • Experience in working with the core tools used in the planning, analyzing, crafting, building, testing, configuring, and maintaining of assigned application(s)
  • Experience in application programming interface testing, accessibility testing, chaos testing, security testing, performance testing, user interface testing, disaster recovery and relevant frameworks
  • Desired skills/certification: Automation Frameworks, and Methodologies.
  • Software engineering and development experience or a related job, with a focus on quality engineering
  • Experience applying agentic AI capabilities within functional, automated, performance, or regression testing activities in software delivery environments
  • Experience validating AI agent-generated testing outputs and integrating AI agent-enabled practices into quality engineering and automation workflow.

Position Description & Qualifications

If you love high profile and challenging programing projects supporting the CMS- Serco has a great opportunity for you! This QA Test Engineer will be on a dynamic team, understandig the requirements, generating test cases, running the test cases on a large-scale federal eligibility program. This is a hands-on role where you will serve as a test engineer — expected not just to execute, but to challenge current practices, guide a growing team of engineers.

Serco supports CMS, a federal agency within the United States Department of Health and Human Services that administers the Medicare program and works in partnership with state governments to support eligibility determinations for consumers purchasing health insurance through the Federal Health Insurance Exchanges.

You will be part of a 15-member team that works closely with the customer and other Serco teams to deliver quality systems. Rakesh Vommi leads this team with over 20 years’ experience. The team has been recognized by the CMS and the industry for their outstanding contributions to the contract and program.

In This Role, You Will

  • Perform analysis of business requirements, identify gaps, and translate user requirements into desired test cases/scripts.
  • Create test scenarios, test cases, and test data, and identify candidates for regression automation.
  • Develop and maintain robust end-to-end (E2E) automated test scenarios across UI, API, and database layers.
  • Execute smoke tests prior to each code drop to confirm environment setup and readiness for testing.
  • Execute automated and manual test cases once code is deployed into the test environment.
  • Perform REST and SOAP API testing, along with DB validation, logging validation, and UI validation.
  • Build and run SQL scripts to create test data, validate test results, and support accurate test data requests.
  • Generate and maintain the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM).
  • Identify, document, log, re-test, and track defects through resolution in Jira.
  • Review release scope and provide effective Level of Effort (LOE) estimates.
  • Facilitate testing activities by proactively communicating with Project Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, and Scrum Masters.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to fellow testers and contribute to team growth.

To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Have

  • A Bachelors degree and 4 years of QA testing experience with demonstrated expertise in creating test cases/scripts.
    • Or High School diploma with 8 years of testing experience.
  • Hands-on experience developing and running automated test scripts using Selenium and Cucumber (BDD).
  • Strong experience with REST and SOAP API testing.
  • Solid SQL skills for creating test data, querying databases, and validating test results.
  • Experience performing testing on both front-end and back-end systems, including DB, logging, and UI validation.
  • Experience performing gap analysis on business requirements and system specifications.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS technologies such as S3, Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, AWS Batch, and CloudWatch.
  • Proficiency with Jira for defect logging, reporting, and tracking.
  • Experience working in an Agile or SAFe Agile environment with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work autonomously or collaboratively, providing guidance to other testers as needed.
  • Experience with test-driven development (TDD) and behavior-driven development (BDD) frameworks.
Additional Desired Experience And Skills

  • Deep understanding of Agile/SAFe methodologies.
  • Prior experience supporting federal healthcare or eligibility programs (CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, or Health Insurance Exchanges).
  • Experience modernizing or scaling cloud-based test automation frameworks.

Company Overview

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. In North America, Serco’s 9,000+ employees strive to make an impact every day across 100+ sites in the areas of Defense, Citizen Services, and Transportation. We help our clients deliver vital services more efficiently while increasing the satisfaction of their end customers. Serco serves every branch of the U.S. military, numerous U.S. Federal civilian agencies, the Intelligence Community, the Canadian government, state, provincial and local governments, and commercial clients. While your place may look a little different depending on your role, we know you will find yours here. Wherever you work and whatever you do, we invite you to discover your place in our world. Serco is a place you can count on and where you can make an impact because every contribution matters.

To review Serco benefits please visit: https://careers.serco-na.com/us/en/what-we-offer. If you require an accommodation with the application process please email: careers@serco-na.com or call the HR Service Desk at 800-628-6458, option 1. Please note, due to EEOC/OFCCP compliance, Serco is unable to accept resumes by email.

Candidates may be asked to present proof of identity during the selection process. If requested, this will require presentation of a government-issued I.D. (with photo) with name and address that match the information entered on the application. Serco will not take possession of or retain/store the information provided as proof of identity. For more information on how Serco uses your information, please see our Applicant Privacy Policy and Notice.

Serco does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies without being a contracted approved vendor. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Serco and will not be obligated to pay a placement or contract fee. If you are interested in becoming an approved vendor at Serco, please email Agencies@serco-na.com.

Serco is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

Pay Transparency

Our Total Rewards package includes competitive pay, performance-based incentives, and benefits that promote well-being and work-life balance—so you can thrive both professionally and personally. Eligible employees also gain access to a wide range of benefits from comprehensive health coverage and health savings accounts to retirement plans, life and disability insurance, and time-off programs that support work-life balance. Program availability may vary based on factors such as contract type, location, hire date, and applicable collective bargaining agreements.

Salary range: The range for this position can be found at the top of this posting. This range is provided as a general guideline and represents a good faith estimate across all experience levels. Actual base salary will be determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to, the scope of the role, relevant experience, job-related knowledge, education and training, key skills, and geographic market considerations. For roles available in multiple states, the range may vary to reflect differences in local labor markets. In addition to base salary, eligible positions may include other forms of compensation such as annual bonuses or long-term incentive opportunities. Benefits – Comprehensible benefits for full-time employees (part-time employees receive a limited package tailored to their role):

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Robust vacation and sick leave benefits, and flexible work arrangements where permitted by role or contract
  • 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds
  • Tuition reimbursement program
  • Life insurance and disability coverage
  • Optional coverages that can be purchased, including pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection
  • Birth, adoption, parental leave benefits
  • Employee Assistance Plan

To review all Serco benefits please visit: https://careers.serco-na.com/us/en/about-us.

Serco complies with all applicable state and local leave laws, including providing time off under the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act for eligible Colorado residents, in alignment with our policies and benefit plans. The application window for this position is for no more than 60 days. We encourage candidates to apply promptly after the posting date, as the position may close earlier if filled or if the application volume exceeds expectations. Please submit applications exclusively through Serco’s external (or internal) career site. If an applicant has any concerns with job posting compliance, please send an email to: careers@serco-na.com.

Job Requirements

Sweetwater, the nation’s #1 online retailer of pro audio equipment and music instruments, is seeking to hire a QA engineer to add to our growing software quality assurance team. As a QA engineer, you will be responsible for analyzing product quality of our software applications. You will be expected to independently design effective test plans for new features (including acceptance and exploratory testing methods), to set up and execute tests in a timely fashion, to collaborate with developers to resolve discovered quality issues, and to produce clear and actionable bug reports.

descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay And Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
  • Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
  • Pension / Retirement benefits
  • Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  • DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

Being a part of IT Ent Arch Data & Corp Tech team, The Enterprise Test Engineering ("ETE") family is responsible for ensuring that all applications and systems meet defined quality standards. The ETE family encompasses three major areas including (a) functional testing, (b) non-functional testing, and (c) test architecture and enablement. Other key focuses include: regression testing, browser testing, performance testing, capacity and stress testing, resiliency testing, environment management services, and infrastructure testing. Develops, conducts, and evaluates testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. The Test Engineering role is responsible for ensuring that all applications, system products, projects, and solutions meet defined enterprise quality standards. Provide centralized, independent quality assurance services across the firm, including functional and non-functional testing for all products, services, and applications across businesses. Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions, providing testing expertise, oversight, and direction to ensure the functionality of solutions and that design specifications are met.

Your Primary Responsibilities

  • Prepare, maintain and implement test cases based on user stories; present results and track defects to closure.
  • Prepare, maintain and implement automated test scripts.
  • Maintain traceability from business requirements through test cases to automated scripts
  • Review test cases / automation approach with collaborator to ensure comprehensive coverage and acquire feedback.
  • Track test execution milestones, report on issues and risks with the potential to affect project timelines.
  • Construct appropriate end-2-end business scenarios through the application of a broad understanding of business objectives and goals.
  • Responsible for Delivery Pipeline adoption
  • Identify dependencies for environmental and data requirements.
  • Contribute to standard framework of reusable functions.
  • Develop a basic understanding of the product being delivered.
  • Responsible for process compliance & associated documentation
  • Aligns risk and control processes into day-to-day responsibilities to supervise and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately.

**NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. **

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 4+ years of related experience
  • Bachelor's degree preferred and/or equivalent experience.

Talents Needed For Success

  • 4+ years of QA Testing experience with at least 3 years hands on Test Automation Experience
  • Develop, maintain, and implement functional and automated test scripts using Java and testing frameworks.
  • Hands-on Experience with JIRA, AQM, Bitbucket, Git, Jenkins, TestNG, JUnit, and Selenium
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum methodology through JIRA, Defect Triaging, Defect Status Reporting and Tracking
  • Knowledge of automation standard and best practices including experience with XPath axes and CSS selectors
  • In depth knowledge of common automation design patterns such as the page object model and software development methodologies
  • Sound knowledge of regression testing, Smoke & Sanity testing, compatibility testing, system functional testing, user acceptance testing etc.
  • Strong hands-on experience using Java for test automation, ability to develop, maintain, improve, and implement automated scripts.
  • Experience in API automation API testing (e.g. Rest Assured, Karate, Postman) and database testing (e.g. Oracle/ DB2/ Snowflake).
  • Ability to write simple to medium complexity SQL queries.
  • Ability to interpret technical designs and specifications and design automated solutions accordingly.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Positive relationship and collaboration skills.

The salary range is indicative for roles at the same level within DTCC across all US locations. Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

descriptionHtml:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We're hiring Associate Quality Engineers to work at Veeva, working on various products in the Life Sciences industry encompassing the fields of pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and medical devices.

As part of our Quality Assurance and Release Engineering team, you'll be responsible for functional and automation testing of software, ensuring customer success with every release.

Graduates or anyone curious about Quality Engineering can apply. Our onboarding program provides a dedicated buddy to guide you through the process, and our collaborative environment is the perfect place to enhance your skills alongside like-minded engineers.

What You'll Do

  • Create testing-related documentation, including test plans, test cases/scripts, and bug reports assessing quality and associated risk
  • Automate and work closely with the automation group to automate features for better regression coverage
  • Triage and/or assist with triaging of automation results
  • Develop deep expertise in the product
  • Conduct QA tests and verify outcomes within schedules/timelines
  • Work with software engineers, product managers, and other QA testers in an Agile team environment

Requirements

  • Experience coding in Java AND/OR mobile languages
  • Understanding of Software QA methodologies, tools, and approaches (black box and/or automated testing) in a software company with short-release cycles
  • Graduate or relevant work experience, including software development and/or software test automation
  • Curiosity and ability to quickly learn new technologies
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Must be located in the PST/MST timezone

Nice to Have

  • Experience with SQL
  • Knowledge of Java, Python, or other object-oriented programming language
  • Knowledge of Atlassian products like Jira, Greenhopper, and Clover is an advantage
  • Knowledge of modern best practices for software development
  • Knowledge of Mobile Testing and Automation –Appium, XCUI, Espresso, KIF
  • Knowledge of Mobile Apps Development (Android/iOS)

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    • A conversation with the hiring manager
    • A practical case exercise
    • A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

  • Base pay: $70,000 - $100,000 USD
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Job Purpose

The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE), a subsidiary of Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (ICE) presents an opportunity for a full-time Senior QA Engineer to join one of our Technology teams.

The individual will be responsible for functional testing, designing and developing comprehensive automated test strategies and test cases for the various applications that support our business needs. The candidate should understand modern testing tools and frameworks. We are looking for a methodical tester who is naturally curious, eager to learn new tools and technologies, and quick to pick up new testing methods.

Responsibilities

  • Review project business requirements to properly build, enhance and support related testing frameworks.
  • Design and develop comprehensive automated test strategies and test cases.

Location: Corporate

Department: Information Technology

  • Assist with end-to-end configuration, environment validation, and test data setup for digital, mobile, and other IT projects.
  • Track and report testing progress, automation results, and defect trends to help teams assess quality and readiness.

Essential Functions

  • Ability to work well individually and in a team environment
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently on assigned tasks with appropriate guidance and escalation
  • Detail oriented with strong organizational and time management skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and communicate risks or blockers in a timely manner
  • Ability to communicate technical information clearly with technical and non-technical peers
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and willingness to learn
  • Ability to follow established engineering and QA practices while contributing ideas for improvement
  • Enjoys working with partners, colleagues, and teams to solve software quality challenges
  • Passionate about QA, test automation, and continuous learning

Basic Qualifications

  • BS/BA degree preferred or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience writing test cases, executing software tests, documenting defects, and supporting test automation
  • 5+ years of experience with automated testing tools or frameworks
  • Familiarity with software development processes including Agile/Lean methodologies and DevOps concepts, particularly in a CI/CD environment
  • QA professional certifications preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver assigned work with quality and consistency
  • Experience using automation to support repeatable software testing
  • Experience creating and executing test cases for assigned features or applications
  • Experience with automated testing tools such as WebdriverIO, SmartBear, or similar platforms
  • Programming or scripting experience using TypeScript, JavaScript, or similar languages
  • Working knowledge of software development life cycle practices, including coding standards, code reviews, source control, build and release processes, CI/CD, and test suite maintenance

Job Description

It’s about putting our best to the test.

Are you described as someone with an inquisitive mind and an innovative personality? Are you never satisfied with good enough? Does solving complex problems and ensuring top-quality applications excite you? If so, being a Quality Automation Engineer I with Frost could be for you.

At Frost, it’s about more than a job. It’s about having a flourishing career where you can thrive, both in and out of work. At Frost, we’re committed to fostering an environment that reflects our values and encourages team members to be the best they can be. In joining our adaptable, integrity-driven team, you’ll become part of Frost’s over 150-year legacy of providing unparalleled banking services.

Who You Are

As a Quality Automation Engineer I - Enterprise Payments - Global Trade Systems, you are our quality control, ensuring every application is stable and built with integrity, caring and excellence. You’ll play an important role in the design, creation, and testing of applications to ensure the quality and stability in every system. You’ll use your strong problem-solving skills to ensure that the applications are performing optimally and meet our high standards. You are not afraid to ask the question why and thrive in a collaborative environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and deploy automated test scripts for an assigned system to ensure the quality and stability of software applications
  • Assist with troubleshooting and triaging script and system issues with project teams to identify the root causes and resolve issues
  • Document, track, and escalate issues with application changes or test scripts
  • Communicate with product management, project management and development teams to develop a strong understanding of the project, product, and testing objectives
  • Write and execute functional test cases as needed
  • Always take action using Integrity, Caring, and Excellence to achieve all-win outcomes

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent technical experience
  • Proficiency in Java or scripting languages like Ruby or Python
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented programming concepts
  • Knowledge of SQL queries

Additional Preferred Skills

  • Experience in processing Wires Payments (Domestic, International, FX, Global trade systems), knowing ISO 20022 standards
  • Experience with identifying technical issues including misconfigurations and defects in code
  • Knowledge of developing functional, load, or batch test automation solutions
  • Knowledge of testing methodologies and processes
  • Knowledge of Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, API - Postman/Karate
  • Experience using automated testing tools like Junit, TestNG, Appium, JMeter, XCUITest, and/or Expresso
  • Experience with a distributed version-control system like GIT

Our Benefits

At Frost, we care about your health, your family, and your future and strive to have our benefits reflect that. This includes:

  • Medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and life insurance
  • 401(k) matching
  • Generous holiday and paid time off schedule
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Extensive health and wellness programs, including our Employee Assistance Program
  • Referral bonus program + more!

Since 1868, Frost has dedicated their expertise to provide exceptional banking, investment, and insurance services to businesses and individuals throughout Texas. Frost is one of the 50 largest U.S. banks by asset size and is a leader in banking customer satisfaction. At Frost, it’s about being part of something bigger. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply and see what’s possible at Frost.

descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Software Quality Engineer at vCluster Labs, you aren't just writing test cases; you are the architect of how we know our product works. You'll own test strategy end-to-end across a fast-moving codebase, build the automation frameworks that give engineering the confidence to ship daily, and be the voice for testability and reliability in every design conversation you're part of.

As a Senior Software Quality Engineer, your role will include:

  • Test framework ownership: Lead the design, development, and maintenance of automated test frameworks spanning backend services and UI, built to scale with a fast-growing product.
  • Test strategy: Own and drive test strategy across services and features, ensuring coverage is thorough and tied directly to product goals, not just ticket checkboxes.
  • Cross-functional influence: Work closely with engineering and product to shape features early, advocate for testability, and align the team on what "quality" means for this product.
  • Architectural input: Sit in on architecture and design discussions, bringing a testability and reliability lens before code gets written, not after.
  • CI/CD integration: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.) so engineers get fast, high-confidence feedback on every change.
  • Exploratory testing: Run exploratory testing to catch usability issues, edge cases, and regressions that automation won't find on its own.
  • Parallel execution: Move across multiple projects at once in a startup environment where priorities shift, without losing rigor.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Experience depth: 7+ years in QA or software testing, including 2+ years operating at a senior or staff level.
  • Programming ability: Strong hands-on skills in at least one of Go, Python, or JavaScript, used for building automation and tooling, not just scripting one-off checks.
  • AI-assisted QA workflow: Daily use of AI tools for reviewing PRs and design docs, writing test plans, and automating test cases, paired with the judgment to know when to trust the output and when to verify it yourself.
  • Ownership mindset: You spot what needs to happen and drive it forward without waiting to be told.
  • Startup fluency: Proven ability to stay calm under ambiguity and juggle competing priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal skills, with the ability to advocate for quality across engineering and product.
  • CI/CD depth: Deep understanding of CI/CD systems and hands-on experience integrating automated test suites into pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar).
  • Kubernetes fluency: Working knowledge of Kubernetes environments and distributed systems, or a strong aptitude and willingness to learn quickly.
  • Debugging skill: Excellent analytical and debugging ability, particularly for backend and infrastructure-related issues.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience testing in tenant cluster or Tenant Isolation environments.
  • Prior experience owning QA at a startup through a period of rapid product growth.

About VCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.
  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).
  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.
  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At VCluster Labs, We Value And Stand For

  • Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.
  • Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.
  • Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.
  • Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.
  • Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Compensation Range: €65K - €110K

4208 Six Forks Rd #1700 | Raleigh, NC 27609

Job Description

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) will be responsible for advancing software quality across the Post Production Automation platform through a combination of manual validation, test automation, performance testing, and quality engineering practices. The role will partner closely with Development, DevOps, Architecture, and operational teams to improve test coverage, shorten feedback loops, and establish repeatable quality practices throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated UI, API, integration, performance, and regression tests for the Post Production Automation platform.
  • Develop and maintain reusable test frameworks, fixtures, utilities, test data, and automation standards to support scalable testing.
  • Create and maintain test cases for critical user workflows, including functional, negative, regression, integration, and edge-case scenarios.
  • Partner with Development and DevOps to identify high-value manual validation scenarios and convert appropriate scenarios into repeatable automated tests.
  • Partner with Development early in the delivery lifecycle to review requirements and acceptance criteria for testability, completeness, business risk, adjacent workflow impact, and potential defects.
  • Perform exploratory and manual testing when automation is not appropriate or additional investigation is required.
  • Troubleshoot test failures and application issues to distinguish between software defects, automation defects, test data issues, and environment-related failures.
  • Support root cause analysis for significant defects and production issues and develop regression coverage to help prevent recurrence.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and establish practical quality gates for software delivery.
  • Develop and maintain test reporting, dashboards, and quality metrics that provide visibility into test results, coverage, defects, and application quality.
  • Ability to provide off-hours operational support, including nightly deployments and incident response.
  • Collaborate with DevOps on release readiness, deployment validation, and production issues requiring additional test coverage or defect reproduction.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve test reliability, execution time, automation coverage, and overall quality engineering practices.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 3+ years of experience in hybrid QA, SDET, Software Quality Engineering, or similar roles combining manual testing and test automation.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience with test management tools such as QMetry, TestRail, or similar platforms.
  • Strong experience designing and maintaining automated UI, API, integration, regression, and performance test suites.
  • Experience with modern test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with REST API and performance testing, including analysis of application behavior under load.
  • Experience creating and maintaining reusable test cases, test data, fixtures, and regression coverage for business-critical workflows.
  • Strong systems-level troubleshooting and debugging skills, with the ability to trace failures across UI, API, application services, test automation, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated critical-thinking skills and the ability to analyze complex problems, identify risk, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Experience performing root cause analysis and converting production defects into preventative regression coverage.
  • Experience with source control management, preferably Git.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and software build and deployment processes.
  • Ability to read and understand application code, logs, API responses, and system behavior to support defect investigation.
  • Strong cross-team collaboration skills with experience working across Development, DevOps, Architecture, Product, and operational teams.
  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or similar iterative software development environments.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with Production Asset Management and Media Asset Management systems.
  • Experience mentoring developers on unit testing, testability, and quality-engineering practices.
  • Experience testing applications deployed across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, or similar infrastructure and deployment technologies.
  • Experience testing complex integrations, asynchronous workflows, file movement, databases, messaging, and distributed application components.
  • Familiarity with observability tools, logging, monitoring, dashboards, and test reporting platforms.
  • Ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.
  • Ability to adapt to changing requirements, priorities, release schedules, and production needs.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build effective relationships across technical and operational teams

Additional Requirements:

Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Iridium's subscriber growth has been driven by increasing demand for reliable, secure, global communications. Iridium serves commercial markets through a worldwide network of hundreds of partners, and provides services to the U.S. Department of Defense, and other U.S. and international government agencies. 

The company's worldwide customer base represent a broad spectrum of industry, including maritime, aeronautical, government/defense, public safety, utilities, oil/gas, mining, forestry, heavy equipment and transportation.

Iridium has been a profitable company since 2004. Business is growing at an impressive rate with the constant acquisition of new customers and partners both domestically and abroad in some of the furthest reaches of the planet. These individuals recognize the value of a system that is global, secure and reliable.

descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Iridium is an award-winning satellite communications company operating the world's only truly global voice and data network, delivering reliable connectivity anywhere on Earth. For more than 20 years, Iridium has powered mission-critical communications for governments, businesses, aviation, maritime, and the rapidly expanding Internet of Things.

Now part of Iridium, Aireon is the world’s only space-based air traffic surveillance system, providing real-time visibility of aircraft over oceans, the poles, and remote regions. Together, Iridium and Aireon are helping build a safer, more connected, and more efficient future for global aviation.

Join our team and help shape how the world stays connected. We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture where employees are empowered to innovate, grow professionally, and make a meaningful impact.

What We’re Looking For:

As a Test Engineer III, you will independently plan and execute verification activities across the software development and operations lifecycle, with an emphasis on end-to-end and integration testing for complex systems. You will design and implement manual and automated test approaches (including AI-assisted techniques where appropriate), drive testing deliverables to completion, and partner with Engineering, Product, and Program stakeholders to assess risk and readiness. You will strengthen quality outcomes by reviewing test artifacts, escalating issues, and continuously improving verification processes based on results and defect trends.

What You’ll Do:

  • Participate in requirements and design discussions to define verification scope, risks, and acceptance criteria for assigned initiatives.
  • Develop test plans, estimates, and traceability for end-to-end, integration, and user acceptance testing across multiple applications and integration points.
  • Design, implement, and maintain manual and automated test cases; leverage AI-assisted tooling to accelerate test design and automation with appropriate validation and review.
  • Execute testing in Agile and/or Waterfall environments, accurately tracking progress, results, and defects, and proactively communicating status, risks, and mitigations.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for testing matters, helping remove blockers and coordinating with cross-functional teams to drive timely issue resolution.
  • Review and improve test artifacts produced by others (test cases, plans, reports) and coordinate signoff workflows with Product Owners and other stakeholders.
  • Monitor verification effectiveness (e.g., defect leakage, root cause analysis) and implement targeted process and tooling improvements to improve quality and efficiency.

Job Description

Flexjet is currently seeking a QA Automation Engineer. The QA Automation Engineer analyzes the functionality of applications and designs automated tests to validate their performance and reliability. Completes development, execution, and documentation of test plans and scripts. Assists non-QA resources in the planning and execution of user acceptance testing.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Maintain, design, and implement test automation frameworks for a continuous integration and execution model.

  • Create automation tests by analyzing user stories, acceptance criteria, creating initial test designs, writing scripts, installing the automation testing tools, and reporting results.

  • Conduct tests, document, and analyze test results, and present findings to development teams.
  • Preparing reports on all aspects related to software testing.
  • Participating in project meetings including Agile/Scrum grooming, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and daily stand-ups.
  • Collaborate within an agile software development process with software engineers, subject matter experts and stakeholders.

Education & Experience

  • Understanding and knowledge of software engineering concepts and methodologies.
  • Understanding of test cases and negative, positive and regression testing.
  • Understanding of automation testing and experience writing automation tests for REST APIs and UI.
  • Experience with writing automation tests using one or more of the following: Postman, Playwright, SpecFlow, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, ect.
  • Extremely proficient in one or more development languages (i.e. C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc.).
  • Knowledge of industry best practices for manual, automation and performance testing.
  • Experience with deployments and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience gathering, refining, and validating business/technical requirements, interdependencies, cross-functional dependencies & risks/issues.
  • Knowledge of application functions, bug fixing, and testing practices.
  • Experience with system/platform integrations and the ability to work cross-functionally.

  • Strong communication skills (oral and written); ability to communicate technical information to non-technical people.
  • Strong interpersonal, collaboration and consultative skills.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem solving.
  • Strong attention to detail and committed to a high level of accuracy & quality.

You will leverage Claude AI, Playwright, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) to design and execute comprehensive functional tests to reduce manual effort while maintaining rigorous quality standards.

As the last line of defense before production releases, you will ensure our Trading Platforms and related products function according to requirements by using AI to intelligently generate tests, analyze defects, and optimize test execution.   • Collaborate with team members to develop effective strategies and test plans

  • Apply MCP to connect Claude with requirements systems, defect trackers, and test execution logs for full-context analysis
  • Conduct post-release/ post-implementation testing
  • Troubleshoot system issues within QA, development and product management

  • BSc/BA in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field
  • 5+ years in Quality Assurance or software testing roles
  • Proven ability to design comprehensive test cases and test plans
  • Strong experience in functional, regression, and integration testing
  • Hands-on experience with SQL for database validation and test data queries
  • Experience in project management and QA methodology
  • Working knowledge of test management software (e.g. Jira and ALM)
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Analytical mind and problem-solving aptitude
  • Strong organizational skills

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Fixed Income and/or Derivative Trading Platforms, a big plus
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks and regression testing is a plus

Title: QA Engineer III Location: Orlando, FL

Reports To: QA Manager FLS Status: Exempt

About The Role

ANDOR Health is seeking an experienced QA Engineer III to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our healthcare technology solutions. This role leads quality assurance across web applications, APIs, databases, and healthcare integrations, combining hands-on testing, automation, healthcare interoperability expertise, and mentorship. You will work with Engineering, Product, Implementation, and Support to deliver software supporting critical clinical workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead QA strategy, test planning, and execution for complex features, integrations, and releases.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, and cross-browser testing.
  • Validate HL7 v2.x messages, interface mappings, and EHR integration workflows.
  • Test REST APIs using Postman or similar tools; use SQL to validate data and investigate defects.
  • Build and maintain automated UI and API tests using Selenium, Playwright, or similar frameworks; contribute to CI/CD integration.
  • Document and track defects in Azure DevOps or comparable tools; assess quality risks and release readiness.
  • Mentor junior engineers and strengthen QA processes, security practices, and HIPAA-aligned handling of patient data.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of hands-on software QA experience, including 3+ years in healthcare technology.
  • Experience with HL7 v2.x interfaces, web application testing, REST APIs, and SQL.
  • Hands-on API testing with Postman and test automation with Selenium, Playwright, or similar tools.
  • Scripting or programming in C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python.
  • Knowledge of Agile, SDLC/STLC, and defect management tools such as Azure DevOps.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • FHIR APIs; Mirth Connect or other healthcare interface engines.
  • Integration experience with Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner, Meditech, or similar EHR systems.
  • CI/CD automation, virtual care or telehealth testing, mobile testing, or AI-enabled healthcare solutions.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and improving testing practices.

What We’re Looking For

A quality-focused engineer who takes ownership, thinks critically, and balances technical testing with collaboration, mentorship, and continuous improvement. Occasional evening or weekend support may be needed for releases, deployments, and critical issues.

descriptionHtml:
About CoreSite:

CoreSite is a leading colocation data center company providing the space, power, cooling and connectivity that businesses rely on to operate and grow. Our data centers bring dozens of organizations together under one roof, supporting the technology and services that keep our world connected. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, bringing the expertise, ideas and commitment that power our business and help our customers succeed. With a culture built on collaboration, ownership, and operational excellence, CoreSite is a place to make an impact.

 

Quality Assurance Engineer:

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented QA Engineer to join our dynamic development team. In this role, you will be responsible for defining test strategies, writing comprehensive test plans, and driving both manual and automated testing efforts. The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of QA methodologies, hands-on experience with modern automation frameworks, and the ability to bridge the gap between technical execution and business requirements. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the delivery of high-quality, scalable software solutions.

 

Duties:

  • QA Strategy & Planning: Define, design, and implement comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scenarios across the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Test Automation: Build, maintain, and scale robust automated testing frameworks for web applications.
  • Agile Collaboration: Participate actively in sprint planning, refinement, and daily stand-ups, advocating for TDD/BDD practices to ensure quality is integrated from the start.
  • Defect Management: Identify, log, track, and manage defects using test management tools, collaborating closely with developers to ensure swift resolution.
  • CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites into continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines.
  • API & Platform Verification: Perform rigorous API testing and validate core platform functionalities, including specific enterprise CRM ecosystems.
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Effectively communicate complex technical issues, risks, and test coverage status to both technical engineering teams and non-technical business stakeholders.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

Technical Expertise

  • Automation Frameworks: Strong, hands-on experience in test automation using Selenium and Java.
  • Methodologies: Deep understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) paradigms.
  • Test Management: Proficiency with industry-standard tools such as Jira and TestRail for requirement traceability and defect tracking.
  • API Testing: Solid experience testing RESTful/SOAP APIs using tools like Postman or Parasoft SOATest.
  • CI/CD Tools: Practical knowledge of Continuous Integration environments, specifically Jenkins, to execute automated nightly or regression builds.
  • Enterprise Platforms: Strong working knowledge or foundational experience testing within the Salesforce ecosystem.

Professional Skills

  • QA Fundamentals: Strong core knowledge of manual QA processes, regression testing, and test design techniques.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Problem Solving: Exceptional analytical skills with a sharp eye for detail and edge-case scenarios.

Education/Experience:

  • Experience in SalesForce Testing.
  • Familiarity with version control systems like Git.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

 

Compensation: Compensation for this role includes a base salary between $86,200.00 and $99,400.00. This role is also eligible for an annual bonus and equity, based upon individual and company performance.

Job Post Timeline: This position is expected to be open for applications for 30 days.

 

Benefits: Not only does CoreSite have a fun, team-focused work environment, but we also offer great benefits to all employees regularly scheduled to work more than 20 hours a week!

  • Medical coverage starting day one, plus dental, vision, telemedicine, HSA/FSA options.
  • 401(k) with a 5% company match, plus bonus and equity opportunities.
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).
  • Starting 16 days of PTO, 11 paid company holidays, floating holidays and additional paid time for volunteering, family care, parental leave and other life events.
  • Free parking or public transportation support.

Additional Perks:

  • Up to $800 annually in wellness reimbursements and up to $450 in wellness incentives.
  • $100 monthly technology stipend.
  • Up to $5,250 annually in educational reimbursement plus LinkedIn Learning.
  • Up to $5,000 annually in charitable donation matching.
  • Financial coaching and student loan support.
  • Family planning, mental health, and caregiving support.
  • Pet insurance, employee discounts and cash back offers.

General Statements:

  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. The employer will not sponsor applicants for work visas.
  • Please note that all offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and, where permitted by law, a 5-panel drug test conducted after the offer letter is signed, which will screen for THC, opiates, PCP, cocaine, and amphetamines. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

Applicant Privacy Notice:

  • CoreSite is committed to protecting the privacy and security of personal information submitted by applicants. The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) requires us to provide you information about our personal information handling practices. As a result, we’re providing this Privacy Notice that describes how we collect, use, share, and update personal information from individuals who wish to be considered for employment with CoreSite. To read the Applicant Privacy Notice, please go to https://www.coresite.com/applicant-privacy-notice.
  • Unauthorized reproduction or distribution of this job posting on external sites is prohibited without prior written consent from CoreSite. We are not responsible for any postings or offers not originating from our official channels or approved partners.

descriptionHtml:
Who we are:

At SpotHero, we work as a team to empower people to get everywhere, easier! We’re rapidly growing with the mission of bringing the parking industry into the future through technology. Drivers across the nation use the SpotHero mobile app and website to reserve convenient, affordable parking in advance, on-the-go or through their connected cars, and parking companies rely on us to help them reach new customers while optimizing their business. We connect the dots with cutting-edge technology, delivering value to both sides of this exciting, evolving marketplace. We’ve been quite busy, take a peek at some of our recent announcements.

Automation Engineer at SpotHero:

SpotHero is seeking an Automation Engineer to join one of our engineering teams within the Quality Guild. This role blends hands-on manual testing with the writing and long-term maintenance of automated test suites, working shoulder-to-shoulder with backend, frontend, and mobile engineers to keep our releases fast and reliable as SpotHero scales.

As an Automation Engineer, you'll be embedded in a team, participating in all of its ceremonies and reporting into that teams’ structure, while also staying closely connected to our central Automation team and the broader Quality Guild. You'll split your time between manual testing and building/maintaining automated coverage.

What You'll Do

  • Own and maintain all automated tests belonging to your team, keeping them consistently green and remediating failures quickly in collaboration with team members.
  • Identify automation opportunities as new functionality ships, and write new end-to-end and integration tests in Playwright to cover it.
  • Perform manual QA testing alongside automation work; exploratory testing, edge-case discovery, and release validation with backend and frontend engineers.
  • Represent automation work as planned work in Jira/Scrum, keeping it visible alongside the rest of the team's sprint commitments.
  • Communicate the state of your team's test coverage regularly to your team, the Quality Guild, and the Automation team, with a documented, historical view of progress.
  • Contribute to our shared automation dashboards and monthly Automation Test Review, helping track test-suite growth, flaky/failing tests, and coverage trends over time.
  • Give feedback to the central Automation team on the platforms, tooling, and processes SDETs maintain, surfacing bottlenecks you hit in day-to-day work.
  • Partner with the Automation team on emerging tooling, such as CI-integrated continuous testing pipelines and AI-assisted test maintenance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Test Automation
    • Write, run, and maintain automated tests in Playwright (migrating legacy web tests where applicable).
    • Keep test suites healthy. Failing tests should not sit red for more than a sprint, trending toward no more than a week as you grow in the role.
    • Contribute to observability tooling (e.g., Grafana dashboards) that gives the team and Quality Guild visibility into automation health.
  • Manual QA
    • Execute manual test plans for new features and releases, especially where automated coverage doesn't yet exist.
    • Identify edge cases and collaborate with engineers to resolve them before release.
  • Collaboration & Communication
    • Participate fully in your team's ceremonies (planning, refinement, retros, stand-ups) as a core member.
    • Maintain a rolling roadmap of what areas of functionality you plan to automate, feeding into your team's quarterly planning.
    • Represent your team in Quality Guild and Automation team forums, including the monthly Automation Test Review.
What you bring:

You might demonstrate the capabilities below through any combination of relevant professional experience, or a transition from a manual QA background.

  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests with Playwright (or a comparable framework such as Cypress, Selenium, or WebdriverIO).
  • Working proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript or Python.
  • Hands-on manual QA experience including functional, regression, exploratory, and/or black-box testing.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub and collaborating through pull requests and code review.
  • Familiarity with Jira/Confluence-based Scrum workflows.
  • Strong communication skills. You can clearly represent the state of testing to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A collaborative mindset: this role sits at the intersection of a team, the Quality Guild, and the central Automation team, and success depends on strong relationships across all three.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (we use Concourse) and integrating automated tests into them.
  • Experience with TestRail or similar test-management/reporting integrations.
  • Experience with backend testing against a Django/Python monolith or Go/Kotlin services.
  • Interest in AI-assisted testing tooling (e.g., self-healing tests, LLM-assisted authoring).
  • Prior experience as a QA Analyst or SDET.

Technology we use:

  • Our Automation Stack is: Playwright for end-to-end and integration testing, with results tracked on Grafana dashboards; Concourse for CI/CD; Jira and Confluence for planning and documentation; GitHub for version control and code review; AWS (including S3) for supporting test infrastructure and reporting.

Seeking Candidates in:

  • Chicago, Illinois

What we are offering:

  • Career game changer – A truly unique experience to work for a fast-growing company in a role with unlimited growth potential.
  • Excellent benefits
    • We cover a generous portion of Medical Premiums, 50% of Dental and Vision Premiums, company-sponsored Life Insurance, STD, and AD&D coverage, a 401(k) with match and immediate vesting, and comprehensive leave policies to meet your needs in creating space for life.
  • Flexible PTO policy and outstanding work/life balance – We value and support each individual team member.
  • UberEats weekly lunch stipend for in-office days
  • Udemy License and Personal Learning Budget – We support the professional and personal growth of our people by providing everyone with learning resources and development opportunities.
  • Annual parking stipend – Duh. We help people park!
  • The opportunity to collaborate with fun, innovative, and passionate people in a casual yet highly productive atmosphere.
  • Our commitment to allyship has been a central driver of how we Respect Fellow Drivers. You’ll have the opportunity to be part of Employee Resource Groups, access allyship learning resources, and actively contribute to our ongoing effort of making SpotHero inclusive for all.
  • Employee programs to grow and support our people such as Discovery Days for Product and Engineering, Gearing up for Aspiring Leaders, and Mentorship Program.
  • Wellness program – a workplace that actively supports your physical and mental wellbeing through ongoing events, initiatives, resources, and thoughtful perks and benefits.
  • A workplace recognized as CityLights award winner by 1871, 2026 Best Places To Work by BuiltIn, Most Loved Workplace Certified by the Best Practice Institute, and recipient of multiple Comparably awards, including Best Company Culture, Best Company for Women, and Best Company for Diversity.

Compensation in Illinois:

  • Depending on your skillset and experience, you can expect your base salary to be between $88,000 - $110,000 as well as a discretionary bonus, and leading total rewards package.

At SpotHero, we Respect Fellow Drivers by providing an inclusive interview experience for everyone, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process. Please let our team know of your need when you apply or as you begin interviewing with our team.

SpotHero is an equal opportunity employer. We know that a diverse workforce is the strongest workforce, and are committed to building and supporting an inclusive environment for all.Additionally, because we want to Remember to Signal, if you choose to provide us personal information in connection with a job application, please review our Applicant Privacy Notice which provides details about what information we collect and process about you in order to consider your candidacy.

PLEASE NOTE: This position is ineligible for visa sponsorship. To be considered for this role, you must be legally authorized to work in the US and not require sponsorship for employment now or in the future.

Description

Do you want to shape the quality of a product that connects customers to the internet across the globe? Amazon's Leo ecommerce team is looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer II to own the frontend quality of the Leo website — the destination where customers discover, purchase, and manage their internet service. In this role, you will build test strategies and Playwright automation for a product that is actively expanding into new countries, giving you the chance to define scalable testing practices from the ground up. You will work closely with product managers, UX designers, and software developers to catch issues early, surface missed use cases during grooming, and raise the quality bar so that every feature meets customer expectations before it ever reaches production.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end testing of the Leo ecommerce frontend experience, creating and executing test plans that cover functional, integration, and regression scenarios across multiple country launches.
  • Build and maintain automated test suites in Playwright, evaluate coverage ROI, and define strategies for when and what to automate — partnering with the development team to expand automation over time.
  • Participate in product grooming sessions alongside product managers and UX designers, providing the QA perspective to identify edge cases, clarify acceptance criteria, and flag risks before development begins.
  • Triage and prioritize bugs, perform root cause analysis, and drive defect resolution to reduce the number of issues that reach production.
  • Own testing runbooks and QA documentation for the team, ensuring processes are repeatable and scalable as the product grows into new markets.

A day in the life

You will start many mornings reviewing incoming bug tickets and prioritizing what needs attention, then shift into proactive work — writing test plans for upcoming features or extending Playwright automation. Expect to spend a good portion of your week in collaborative sessions with UX designers, developers, and product managers during grooming and sprint ceremonies, where your input directly shapes what gets built and how. Between those sessions, you will have heads-down time to execute tests, refine runbooks, and analyze quality metrics. This is an independent, self-directed role where you decide where your attention has the most impact.

About The Team

The Leo ecommerce team builds and operates the website where customers learn about, purchase, and manage their Amazon internet service. As Leo expands into new countries, the team is investing in scalable processes and automation to keep pace with growth. You will join a collaborative group of developers, product managers, and UX designers who value clear communication and a shared commitment to getting the details right. This is a great opportunity to build expertise in commerce at scale, international expansion, and modern test automation in the age of AI.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
  • Experience in automation testing
  • Experience in manual testing
  • Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
  • +2 years working with modern test automation frameworks like Playwright

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
  • Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
  • Experience with performance and scalability testing
  • Experience working closely with development and business teams to communicate problem impacts and to understand business requirements
