descriptionHtml:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We're hiring experienced Software Engineers in Test to work on Site Vault, a rapidly growing SaaS platform product in the Life Sciences industry encompassing the fields of pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and medical devices.

As part of our Quality Assurance and Release Engineering team, you'll be responsible for functional and automation testing to deliver a top-quality SaaS product. This is a hands-on position playing a vital role in ensuring customer success with each new release.

If you are an experienced Quality Engineering professional ready to make an impact and take your career to the next level, we want to hear from you. In our fast-paced environment, you'll be involved in the product development process, taking pride in building great software. You'll collaborate with like-minded engineers in a high-energy setting and leverage your existing skills to learn and grow with us.

What You'll Do

  • Create testing-related documentation, including test plans, test cases/scripts, and bug reports assessing quality and associated risk
  • Automate features for better regression coverage
  • Triage and/or assist with triaging of automation results
  • Develop deep expertise in the product
  • Conduct QA tests and verify outcomes within schedules/timelines
  • Work with software engineers, product managers, and other quality engineers in an Agile team environment
  • Operate at architecture and code level, driving technical discussions during design/implementation reviews
  • Be the technical quality expert in functional areas and influencing decisions that will help build quality into the product
  • Be comfortable providing technical leadership to junior teammates, enabling them to achieve targeted goals
  • Conduct POCs and make recommendations that would help raise the quality bar
  • Enhance your knowledge of code coverage tools and metrics
  • Work with quality management to come up with new processes and roll them out across the organization
  • Become a technical contributor, a product expert, and a team project manager and support your QA manager as and when you work on the product

Requirements

  • 2+ years relevant work experience, including software development and/or software test automation
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Understanding of Software QA methodologies, tools, and approaches (black box and/or automated testing) in a software company with short release cycles
  • Experience in writing test cases and automating them, covering both sanity and in-depth testing including and not limited to boundary, negative, compatibility, and concurrency tests
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Bachelor's / Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • Must be located in the Eastern Time Zone.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in JavaScript, Java, Python, or other object-oriented programming language.
  • Experience with Atlassian products like Jira, Confluence
  • Experience with TestRail or similar test case management software
  • Experience authoring automated tests in standard functional test automation frameworks. e.g., Cucumber/Selenium/TestNg. Playwright is preferred.
  • Knowledge of modern best practices for software development
  • Experience in a SaaS environment that has an agile development process is a huge plus
  • Experience working with remote teams
  • Experience working in the Health Sciences and Life Sciences industry

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    • A conversation with the hiring manager
    • A practical case exercise
    • A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

  • Base pay: $75,000 - $150,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. Our people. It’s the curiosity, dedication, and innovation that drive our success and help us anticipate the future.

Position Description

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows. You will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability. You will also collaborate closely with software development partners to define test strategies, expand automation, and responsibly use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support test creation, code review, documentation, and regression analysis while maintaining strong human oversight.

Responsibilities

  • Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with TypeScript, Selenium, and related API-testing tools.
  • End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products.
  • Set up cloud and on-premises environments to verify supported solution scenarios, including LDAP, database, and network configurations.
  • Some possible Dev Ops work to automate creating different environments including single and distributed deployment.
  • Execute product testing focusing on end-to-end, performance and load testing.
  • Create and report test-cycle metrics, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements that reduce cycle time.
  • Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
  • Create reusable automation workflows and prompts that connect product requirements, code changes, Jira or Azure DevOps issues, test results, logs, and documentation into repeatable QA processes.
  • Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.
  • Improve automated test coverage, regression readiness, and feedback speed by identifying repeatable QA workflows and reducing manual effort across release cycles.
  • Document how AI-assisted outputs were reviewed, validated, and incorporated into automation assets when those outputs influence test coverage, quality decisions, or product release readiness.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
  • 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
  • Programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Powershell and/or C#.
  • Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
  • Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
  • Cryptography knowledge including Key Management.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization in the U.S.

Preferred Qualifications

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Ansible experience scripting deployments from development to test to production.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Bitbucket for source code control.
  • Experience with Jira and/or Microsoft Azure DevOps Server for user-story coordination, test-case management, build integration, and issue tracking.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted QA workflows with pull requests, design documentation, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, logs, virtual machines, or test reporting.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including approved-tool usage, sensitive-data handling, intellectual-property awareness, secure coding guardrails, and review of AI-generated automation before reuse.

About Entrust

Responsibilities



- Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with TypeScript, Selenium, and related API-testing tools.
- End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products.

- Create and report test-cycle metrics, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements that reduce cycle time.
- Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
- Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
- Create reusable automation workflows and prompts that connect product requirements, code changes, Jira or Azure DevOps issues, test results, logs, and documentation into repeatable QA processes.
- Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.
- Improve automated test coverage, regression readiness, and feedback speed by identifying repeatable QA workflows and reducing manual effort across release cycles.
- Document how AI-assisted outputs were reviewed, validated, and incorporated into automation assets when those outputs influence test coverage, quality decisions, or product release readiness.

Basic Qualifications



- 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
- 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
- Programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Powershell and/or C#.
- Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
- Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
- Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
- Cryptography knowledge including Key Management.
- Must have unrestricted work authorization in the U.S.

- BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
- Ansible experience scripting deployments from development to test to production.
- Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Bitbucket for source code control.
- Experience with Jira and/or Microsoft Azure DevOps Server for user-story coordination, test-case management, build integration, and issue tracking.
- Experience integrating AI-assisted QA workflows with pull requests, design documentation, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, logs, virtual machines, or test reporting.

As part of IPRO’s Technology Solutions Department, the Sr. Quality Assurance Engineer supports projects under the general direction of the Sr. Director. In the Sr. Quality Assurance Engineer role, you will be responsible for defining, implementing, and continuously improving quality practices across applications and systems. This role goes beyond test execution to drive quality strategy, prevent defects, and ensure releases meet functional, performance, security, and compliance standards. The Sr. QA Engineer partners closely with Product, DevOps, and business stakeholders to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

The Sr. QA Engineer designs and executes complex test scenarios including functional, integration, and regression to validate end-to-end workflows across integrated systems. They will have a leadership role in creating the foundation of our quality assurance standards and documentation including designing, building and maintaining scalable test automation frameworks.

This position is office based at our Jericho, NY office.

Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, test planning, test design, and defect management, including the ability to select and apply appropriate testing approaches based on technical and business risk
  • Hands‑on experience with automated testing frameworks for UI, API, and/or backend services, including designing maintainable test suites and contributing automation that improves coverage and reliability
  • Proven experience designing and executing functional, integration, regression, and end‑to‑end tests to validate business requirements, system workflows, and cross‑system interactions with an understanding of dependencies, data flows, and potential points of failure
  • Solid familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and SDLC best practices, with the ability to actively participate in sprint planning, grooming, and retrospectives to influence quality earlier in the delivery process
  • Proficiency with defect tracking and test management tools (such as Jira), including documenting clear, actionable defects and maintaining accurate test artifacts and traceability
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and test integration within DevOps environments, including executing or triggering automated tests as part of build and release workflows

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems
  • Five (5) years experience in Quality Assurance / Software testing required, eight (8) years experience is preferred OR ten (10) years of equivalent education and experience is required.
  • Experience in healthcare or government regulated environments is preferred.
  • QA or Agile certifications (ISTOQB, CSTE, Scrum), preferred.

For over a century, the Workers' Compensation Insurance Rating Bureau of California (WCIRB) has been California's trusted, objective provider of actuarially based information and research, advisory pure premium rates and educational services integral to a healthy workers' compensation system.   • Knowledge of modern development principles such as SOLID, Occam's Razor, TDD, iterative lifecycle process, etc.

  • Experience in SQL to conduct database testing and data validation

  • Social activities

descriptionHtml:
Grow With Us

Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry.


Stay Awesome

Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com


A Day In The Life

The Systems Software Test Engineer contributes to developing, executing, and documenting automated tests that verify end-to-end system functionality, robustness, and reliability in accordance with approved test plans, procedures, and defined metrics. The role supports system verification through test-case development, test automation and execution, analysis of data and results, and defect tracking and investigation. Working with Systems Test, Systems Engineering, Development, Test Tools, and Quality teams, the engineer contributes to verification and automation initiatives, supports CI/CD test workflows, and builds an understanding of system architecture and interfaces to support evaluation of the impact of software changes across the system.

Software Test Engineer 1's at Tandem are also responsible for:

  • Collaborates with Systems Test and Systems Engineering to review product requirements, feature designs, system robustness and reliability metrics, and system configurations, and develops test cases for system verification with appropriate guidance.
  • Develops and maintains automated test suites using established test automation frameworks and approved verification procedures.
  • Executes and monitors automated test suites through CI/CD pipelines; reviews test results, metrics, logs, and artifacts; investigates failures using established procedures; and escalates suspected product defects.
  • Participates in automation code reviews and follows established source control, branching, and documentation practices.
  • Stays current with industry trends and best practices in software testing and automation.
  • Assists development engineers in the diagnosis and replication of product failures.
  • Efficiently manages own time to complete work by assigned completion dates.
  • Records and compiles data for documentation of test procedures and prepares reports.
  • Assists with estimating test effort for project deliverables.
  • Works as a contributing member of cross-functional teams as needed, working closely with R&D engineering and Quality Engineers to match software test scope with documented specification requirements.


When & Where You’ll Work

Hybrid: This role will be a mix of in-office work at our corporate headquarters in Del Mar, CA and remote work. This position is expected to be in office 2-3 days per week but may require on-site attendance up to five days per week depending on business demands.


What You’ll Need

  • Foundational knowledge of TypeScript required; experience with additional programming or scripting languages such as C++, C#, JavaScript, or Python is preferred.
  • Familiarity with test frameworks used for automated testing, such as Cucumber, Jasmine, or similar technologies.
  • Exposure to test automation tools used for web and mobile such as Appium, WebdriverIO, Selenium, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with source control concepts and CI/CD pipelines used to support automated testing workflows.
  • Ability to read and follow procedures and flow diagrams.
  • Able to effectively share information and ideas within and outside of department in written or verbal form; able to put forth own ideas and gain understanding from others.
  • Ability to support effective interactions between team members and cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize assigned tasks, manage competing priorities, meet established deadlines, and produce high-quality work with appropriate guidance.
  • Experience with MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).


Extra Awesome

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or computer science or related field or equivalent combination of education and applicable job experience.
  • Relevant internship, academic, project, or hands-on experience in software testing, software development, or test automation is preferred.
  • Exposure to developing and executing software test cases and documenting test results and defects, preferred.
  • Exposure to automated software testing and software verification activities.
  • Exposure to using test automation tools, source control systems, or CI/CD workflows is preferred.
  • Experience following detailed procedures, troubleshooting technical issues, and applying critical thinking to resolve problems within established guidelines.
  • Experience in mobile, cloud, or integrated software systems is preferred.


Compensation & Benefits

The starting base pay range for this position is $39.23 - $49 per hour. Base pay will vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes bonus and a robust benefits package.

Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, a minimum of 20 days of paid time off (with accrual starting on day 1) and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here!


You Should Know

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local Fair Chance laws and regulations. A conditional offer of employment from Tandem is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment screening process comprised of a drug test (excluding marijuana) and background check, which includes a review of criminal history information.

Tandem has good cause to conduct a review of criminal history information of candidates for this position, as this role may involve access to proprietary, sensitive and/or confidential information, including customer protected health information. This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders.


Sponsorship

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome! Explore the benefits and reasons to love Tandem at https://www.tandemdiabetes.com/careers.


BE YOU, WITH US!

We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us.

Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organization, and we welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone.


Referrals

We love a good referral! If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share!


Application Deadline

The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications.

Make a move that matters. Join Tandem Diabetes Care, where we're turning challenges into triumphs every day and where your talents will help shape a healthier, happier tomorrow.

What We Offer

At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.

Group Summary

Magna New Mobility is a business unit inside Magna International leveraging Magna’s technology building blocks, developing new capabilities, and entering new markets and use cases. Our products include advanced solutions for urban markets, industrial intralogistics, commercial and autonomous vehicles.

Magna New Mobility is also creating advanced software solutions that integrate with next-generation hardware. Our software is a core driver - turning our hardware into smart, integrated platforms for partners eager to advance the mobility sector.

Magna's New Mobility group is not just about building individual technologies; we aim to create integrated solutions that address the complex challenges of moving people efficiently and cost effectively in the 21st century. Join us in advancing and shaping the future of mobility.

Job Responsibilities

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer at Magna New Mobility, you will play a key role in setting up the testing strategy and tools for testing cloud software systems and features from the ground up.

Responsibilities

  • Test a wide range of cloud technologies both in isolation and within the larger product ecosystem.
  • Focused on finding and categorizing bugs, ensuring feature completeness and assessing reliability and performance of cloud systems.
  • Focus on automation to perform repetitive testing tasks as well as regression testing covering various versions of end user client software.
  • Testing expertise for our team and be a constant advocate for our customers.
  • High level of coding aptitude combined with a demonstrated passion for Quality Assurance and be responsible to own and drive complex projects.

Qualifications

  • B.S. Degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience
  • 5-7 years of experience working as a Quality Assurance Engineer
  • 3+ years’ experience in automation testing
  • 3+ years’ experience in manual testing
  • Strong experience in API and Backend testing of cloud technologies
  • Strong coding experience with automated testing frameworks, tools and services
  • Experience in at least one modern programming language such as Go or Python
  • Has excellent troubleshooting skills.
  • Robotics background

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong experience in API and Backend testing of cloud technologies.
  • Fluency in programmatic-level testing, user-level automation and API level testing.
  • Experienced in Agile or Scrum software development methodologies.
  • Experience working in a lab environment.

Awareness, Unity, Empowerment

At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.

Quality Assurance Engineer II

UDR, Inc. | Highlands Ranch, CO | Full-Time | Hybrid

About UDR, Inc.

UDR, Inc. (NYSE: UDR), an S&P 500 company, is a leading multifamily real estate investment trust with a demonstrated history of delivering long-term value through the management, acquisition, development, and redevelopment of apartment communities across some of the nation’s most desirable markets.

At UDR, technology plays an important role in how we operate, make decisions, and continue evolving our business. Our teams are modernizing the way data is structured, tested, and used across the organization — and we’re looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer II who wants to be part of building what comes next.

About The Role

As a Quality Assurance Engineer II, you’ll play an important role in the testing phase of our software development process, helping ensure our products are functional, reliable, and aligned with both business requirements and the expectations of our end users.

This role will have meaningful exposure to UDR’s evolving data environment, including Snowflake, backend data validation, APIs, integrations, and test automation. You’ll partner closely with developers, product owners, business analysts, project managers, and other stakeholders while taking increasing ownership of testing strategy for the features and projects you support.

We’re looking for someone who brings strong technical fundamentals, curiosity, attention to detail, and the ability to independently move work forward while remaining a collaborative member of the team.

What You’ll Do

  • Interface with business analysts, product owners, or stakeholders to understand the underlying business problem being solved, the product feature being delivered, and the individual stories/requirements involved.
  • Develop procedures and test software features. Provide a specification for any data required to create necessary scenarios.
  • Record the outcomes of tests in Zephyr and include relevant evidence to support the story or requirement.
  • Create software bugs when necessary. Identify and develop the steps, expected behavior, observed behavior, and any supporting documentation.
  • Prepare and present findings and recommendations to project team(s), including developers, scrum masters, and/or project managers, both in summary and detailed forms depending on the needed level of detail.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with other internal teams and coordinate with third-party contractors or vendors as needed, establishing and maintaining effective working relationships utilizing strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Design and execute SQL queries to validate backend data integrity and consistency, including within cloud-native data warehouse platforms such as Snowflake.
  • Validate data movement and integrity across ETL/ELT pipelines feeding into or out of Snowflake, performing source-to-target reconciliation between upstream systems and the warehouse.
  • Apply working knowledge of Snowflake concepts, including virtual warehouses, roles/RBAC, schemas, and compute vs. storage separation, to test data access controls and query behavior.
  • Perform API testing using tools like Postman or similar tools to verify backend services and integrations, including REST/JSON payload and schema/contract validation.
  • Develop and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts for backend validation.
  • Create and manage more complex tasks and test plans with little need for support from senior team members and management.
  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright or similar frameworks to expand regression coverage and reduce manual testing effort.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate test case generation, automation script development, and test data pipeline work.
  • Participate in grooming ceremonies, giving feedback on requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Design test plans, anticipate potential scenarios, and develop effective strategies for new feature implementations.
  • Design, develop, and implement test strategies using UiPath to optimize software testing processes.
  • Identify roadblocks, issues, or challenges that arise during the project and work with the project team to remediate and resolve those issues and challenges.
  • Identify key testing scenarios and automation candidates that contribute to regression test planning and successful software releases.
  • Perform other duties as assigned or as necessary.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems Management, Computer Science, Technology Management, Business Administration, or related discipline is preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
  • Minimum of four to five years of related experience is required.
  • Prior experience within the real estate or hospitality industry is preferred, or equivalent combination of experience within industry and emerging technologies.
  • Experience working in both Agile and Waterfall environments is required.
  • Provides guidance and support to other team members.
  • Excellent experience with MS Office skills, especially Excel.
  • Intermediate understanding of SQL databases and API development; demonstrated work experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud-native data platform required.
  • Demonstrated work experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright or similar frameworks, including Cypress or Selenium, is required.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development/testing tools is required.

Compensation & Benefits

The anticipated salary range for this position is $85,879.00-$101,034.00. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity.

There is eligibility for a 10% annual bonus.

UDR associates are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and company holidays
  • Associate apartment discounts
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities
  • Employee assistance and wellness resources
  • Additional company-sponsored benefits and programs

This position follows a flexible hybrid schedule based out of UDR's Highlands Ranch, Colorado corporate office

Equal Opportunity Employer

Description

Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

As a member of the SMGS Planning Tools team, you will shape the AWS business's direction as a whole. You will build greenfield solutions from the ground up while using native AWS services and frameworks. The right candidate will have a robust system delivery background, well-rounded technical knowledge, and demonstrated experience working on large scale projects. The candidate must be customer-obsessed, have strong analytical and communication skills, and passionate about learning new technologies.

You will work with software development engineers to understand features and technical implementation. You will also work with groups such as product management, UX designers to understand customer usage models and develop test plans and suites that approximate real-world environments and regression tests driving the software development process toward quality-centric methodologies. You will develop automated tests to help fasten testing cycles and release faster to our customers. In this role, you will be responsible to deliver manual/automated solutions to test customer facing features.

This position may be based in Seattle (WA), Dallas (TX), or Herndon (VA). Relocation offered for US residents only.

Key job responsibilities

Test Planning and Strategy: Developing comprehensive test plans and strategies based on project requirements, ensuring all aspects of the application are covered.

Test Case Development: Designing, writing, and maintaining detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test cases.

Test Execution: Executing test cases (both manual and automated) and ensuring software quality across various stages of the software development lifecycle.

Defect Identification and Reporting: Identifying, documenting, and tracking defects using bug tracking tools, and working closely with the development team to resolve them.

Automation Development: Writing and maintaining automated test scripts using appropriate tools and frameworks to increase test coverage and efficiency.

Continuous Improvement: Continuously identifying and implementing process improvements to enhance the testing process and improve product quality.

Collaboration and Communication: Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and other stakeholders, to ensure quality standards are met.

Performance and Load Testing: Conducting performance, scalability, and load testing to ensure the application can handle the expected load.

Test Environment Management: Setting up, maintaining, and managing test environments to ensure they reflect production environments as closely as possible.

Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Assessing risks associated with releases and working on strategies to mitigate them, ensuring minimal impact on production environments.

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

At Entrust, we’re shaping the future of identity centric security solutions. From our comprehensive portfolio of solutions to our flexible, global workplace, we empower careers, foster collaboration, and build solutions that help keep the world moving safely. 

Entrust's values are a cornerstone of who we are, our future business growth and how our people grow through it. We model our values by demonstrating that Customer Trust Is Earned, moving with purpose because Speed Is Intentional, taking accountability because We Own the Outcome, and building a collaborative culture where One Entrust Wins Together.

Get to Know Us 

Headquartered in Minnesota, Entrust is an industry leader in identity-centric security solutions, serving over 150 countries with cutting-edge, scalable technologies. But our secret weapon? Our people. It’s the curiosity, dedication, and innovation that drive our success and help us anticipate the future. 

Position Description

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows. You will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability. You will also collaborate closely with software development partners to define test strategies, expand automation, and responsibly use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support test creation, code review, documentation, and regression analysis while maintaining strong human oversight.

Responsibilities

  • Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with TypeScript, Selenium, and related API-testing tools.
  • End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products.
  • Set up cloud and on-premises environments to verify supported solution scenarios, including LDAP, database, and network configurations.
  • Some possible Dev Ops work to automate creating different environments including single and distributed deployment.
  • Execute product testing focusing on end-to-end, performance and load testing.
  • Create and report test-cycle metrics, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements that reduce cycle time.
  • Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
  • Create reusable automation workflows and prompts that connect product requirements, code changes, Jira or Azure DevOps issues, test results, logs, and documentation into repeatable QA processes.
  • Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.
  • Improve automated test coverage, regression readiness, and feedback speed by identifying repeatable QA workflows and reducing manual effort across release cycles.
  • Document how AI-assisted outputs were reviewed, validated, and incorporated into automation assets when those outputs influence test coverage, quality decisions, or product release readiness.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
  • 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
  • Programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Powershell and/or C#.
  • Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
  • Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
  • Cryptography knowledge including Key Management.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization in the U.S.

Preferred Qualifications

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Ansible experience scripting deployments from development to test to production.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Bitbucket for source code control.
  • Experience with Jira and/or Microsoft Azure DevOps Server for user-story coordination, test-case management, build integration, and issue tracking.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted QA workflows with pull requests, design documentation, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, logs, virtual machines, or test reporting.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including approved-tool usage, sensitive-data handling, intellectual-property awareness, secure coding guardrails, and review of AI-generated automation before reuse.

Where you will be: This is a hybrid role requiring three days per week in our Shakopee, MN headquarters office.

Position Description

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows. You will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability. You will also collaborate closely with software development partners to define test strategies, expand automation, and responsibly use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support test creation, code review, documentation, and regression analysis while maintaining strong human oversight.

Responsibilities



- Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with TypeScript, Selenium, and related API-testing tools.
- End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products. 
- Set up cloud and on-premises environments to verify supported solution scenarios, including LDAP, database, and network configurations.
- Some possible Dev Ops work to automate creating different environments including single and distributed deployment.
- Execute product testing focusing on end-to-end, performance and load testing.
- Create and report test-cycle metrics, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements that reduce cycle time.
- Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
- Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
- Create reusable automation workflows and prompts that connect product requirements, code changes, Jira or Azure DevOps issues, test results, logs, and documentation into repeatable QA processes.
- Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.
- Improve automated test coverage, regression readiness, and feedback speed by identifying repeatable QA workflows and reducing manual effort across release cycles.
- Document how AI-assisted outputs were reviewed, validated, and incorporated into automation assets when those outputs influence test coverage, quality decisions, or product release readiness.

Basic Qualifications



- 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
- 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
- Programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Powershell and/or C#.
- Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
- Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
-  Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
- Cryptography knowledge including Key Management.
- Must have unrestricted work authorization in the U.S.

Preferred Qualifications



- BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
- Ansible experience scripting deployments from development to test to production.
- Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Bitbucket for source code control.
- Experience with Jira and/or Microsoft Azure DevOps Server for user-story coordination, test-case management, build integration, and issue tracking.
- Experience integrating AI-assisted QA workflows with pull requests, design documentation, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, logs, virtual machines, or test reporting.
- Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including approved-tool usage, sensitive-data handling, intellectual-property awareness, secure coding guardrails, and review of AI-generated automation before reuse.

  • Validate the correct implementation of design specifications.
  • Identify, document, and track software defects.
  • Collaborate with developers to resolve issues and retest fixes.
  • Work closely with development, product management, and other teams to ensure a unified approach to software quality.
  • Provide feedback to the development team on quality and collaborate on continuous improvement initiatives.

  • 3+ years of experience in software testing or quality assurance.
  • Hands-on experience with mobile app automated testing tools and frameworks
  • Experience in mobile gaming industry a plus
  • Proficiency in writing and executing test cases and test scripts.
  • Understanding of software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum).

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field; or a combination of education and equivalent work experience in a related role

Must be able to routinely perform work on computer for an average of 6-8 hours per day, when necessary. Must be able to work extended hours or travel off site whenever required or requested by management. Must be capable of regular, reliable and timely attendance.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Must be able to routinely perform work indoors in climate-controlled shared work area with minimal noise.

Mental And/Or Emotional Requirements

Must be able to perform job functions independently or with limited supervision and work effectively either on own or as part of a team. Must be able to read and carry out various written instructions and follow oral instructions. Must be able to complete basic mathematical calculations, spell accurately, and understand computer basics. Must be able to speak clearly and deliver information in a logical and understandable sequence. Must be capable of dealing calmly and professionally with numerous different personalities from diverse cultures at various levels within and outside of the organization and demonstrate highest levels of customer service and discretion when dealing with the public. Must be able to perform responsibilities with composure under the stress of deadlines / requirements for extreme accuracy and quality and/or fast pace. Must be able to effectively handle multiple, simultaneous, and changing priorities. Must be capable of exercising highest level of discretion on both internal and external confidential matters.

  • Must be authorized to work in the US **

Description

Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

As a member of the SMGS Planning Tools team, you will shape the AWS business's direction as a whole. You will build greenfield solutions from the ground up while using native AWS services and frameworks. The right candidate will have a robust system delivery background, well-rounded technical knowledge, and demonstrated experience working on large scale projects. The candidate must be customer-obsessed, have strong analytical and communication skills, and passionate about learning new technologies.

You will work with software development engineers to understand features and technical implementation. You will also work with groups such as product management, UX designers to understand customer usage models and develop test plans and suites that approximate real-world environments and regression tests driving the software development process toward quality-centric methodologies. You will develop automated tests to help fasten testing cycles and release faster to our customers. In this role, you will be responsible to deliver manual/automated solutions to test customer facing features.

This position may be based in Seattle (WA), Dallas (TX), or Herndon (VA). Relocation offered for US residents only.

Key job responsibilities

Test Planning and Strategy: Developing comprehensive test plans and strategies based on project requirements, ensuring all aspects of the application are covered.

Test Case Development: Designing, writing, and maintaining detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test cases.

Test Execution: Executing test cases (both manual and automated) and ensuring software quality across various stages of the software development lifecycle.

Defect Identification and Reporting: Identifying, documenting, and tracking defects using bug tracking tools, and working closely with the development team to resolve them.

Automation Development: Writing and maintaining automated test scripts using appropriate tools and frameworks to increase test coverage and efficiency.

Continuous Improvement: Continuously identifying and implementing process improvements to enhance the testing process and improve product quality.

Collaboration and Communication: Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and other stakeholders, to ensure quality standards are met.

Performance and Load Testing: Conducting performance, scalability, and load testing to ensure the application can handle the expected load.

Test Environment Management: Setting up, maintaining, and managing test environments to ensure they reflect production environments as closely as possible.

Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Assessing risks associated with releases and working on strategies to mitigate them, ensuring minimal impact on production environments.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Preferences:

This is a hybrid position with an expectation to be in our Lisle, IL office a minimum of two days per week. This position does not qualify for relocation assistance or employment-based sponsorship. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Position Summary

The Software QA Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of DMA’s software solutions through the design, development, and execution of manual and automated testing processes. This role collaborates with development teams and stakeholders to validate functionality, performance, and compliance with business requirements. The QA Engineer contributes to continuous improvement efforts and supports agile delivery practices.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Design, execute, and maintain test cases, test data, and test scripts for manual and automated testing.
  • Perform functional, non-functional, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Participate in sprint planning, QA reviews, and project meetings.
  • Assist with documenting and reporting defects and enhancements using Jira or similar issue tracking tools.
  • Collaborate with developers and business analysts to understand requirements and create targeted test scenarios.
  • Assist in risk analysis and quality assessments for project releases.
  • Assist with establishing realistic estimates for tasks.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to team members.
  • Assist with diagnosing and triage of software issues; determine and document root causes.
  • Support the generation and accuracy of QA documentation and reporting.
  • Ensure adherence to approved development and testing methodologies.
  • Contribute to QA documentation and process improvement initiatives.
  • Support the implementation and maintenance of automation tools such as Selenium and Playwright.
  • Provide oversight to ensure quality standards and best practices are followed across projects.

Education And Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 2–5 years of experience in QA, testing web-based applications, or programming.
  • Experience with Jira, Selenium, and Playwright with TypeScript is highly preferred
  • Familiarity with financial or business process applications is a plus.
  • Intermediate understanding of the software development life cycle (SDLC).
  • Experience with automated testing tools.
  • Basic familiarity with Agile development and QA methodologies.
  • Experience with GitLab and Chrome.
  • Basic understanding of relational databases, object-relational mapping, and distributed systems.
  • Basic understanding of web development and related technologies.
  • Intermediate attention to detail and analytical thinking.
  • Intermediate verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and work effectively in a team environment.
  • Intermediate time management and organizational abilities.
  • Intermediate listening skills.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

  • Work Schedule: Regular, 40 hours/week
  • Environment: Hybrid (2 days in-office), environmentally controlled
  • Travel: Less than 10%
  • Physical Activity:
    • Prolonged periods of sitting and computer use
    • Frequent repetitive hand motions
    • Ability to hear, understand, and distinguish speech and sounds

descriptionHtml:
Please note this posting is to advertise potential job opportunities. This exact role may not be open today but could open in the near future. When you apply, a Cisco representative may contact you directly if a relevant position opens.

Applications accepted until further notice.

Meet The Team

The Cisco Wireless team ensures the quality, reliability, and performance of next-generation wireless products. We work closely with development, platform, and system teams to validate features, automate test coverage, and reproduce real-world customer scenarios at scale. Our work directly impacts the experience of millions of users relying on Cisco wireless infrastructure.

Your Impact

Role

As a QA / Automation Engineer, you will contribute to validating Cisco’s wireless platforms by writing test plans, developing automation, and analyzing system behavior. You will gain hands-on experience with real networking environments, lab setups, and modern AI-assisted development tools. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy breaking systems, understanding how they work, and ensuring high-quality product delivery. In This Role, You Will:

  • Write and execute test plans and test cases for wireless features and systems
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts using Python or similar languages
  • Analyze test results and identify issues, inconsistencies, or performance gaps
  • Reproduce customer and system issues in controlled lab environments
  • Assist in setting up and maintaining testbeds and lab environments (routers, switches, access points)
  • Collaborate with development and platform teams to debug and resolve issues
  • Learn and apply AI-assisted tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor) to improve testing efficiency and automation

Minimum Qualification

  • Meet one of the following (completed within the past 3 years or expected to be completed within the next 12 months):
  • A Master's degree with 0 years of work experience; or
  • A Bachelor's degree with 2 years of work experience.
  • Qualifying education and work experience should be in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Information Systems, Network Engineering or a related field.
  • Strong programming fundamentals, preferably in Python or a similar scripting language, with a basic understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, and routing.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills with a detail-oriented approach to troubleshooting system behavior.
  • Curious and interested in AI-enabled engineering practices, including using AI tools to improve productivity.

Preferred Qualification

  • Exposure to networking devices (routers, switches, access points) through coursework, labs, or internships
  • Familiarity with setting up small network environments
  • Basic understanding of wireless technologies (Wi-Fi / 802.11)
  • Certifications such as CCNA (or working toward it)

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees
  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco
  • Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees
  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)
  • 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next
  • Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members
  • Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees On Sales Plans Earn Performance-based Incentive Pay On Top Of Their Base Salary, Which Is Split Between Quota And Non-quota Components, Subject To The Applicable Cisco Plan. For Quota-based Incentive Pay, Cisco Typically Pays As Follows

  • .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

  • 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and
  • Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

descriptionHtml:
Looking for a job to get you out of bed?

We're looking for a QA Engineer to join our Quality Engineering team and own functional and end‑to‑end testing across our systems. We want someone genuinely passionate about testing - eager to hunt down the bug nobody else found, think outside the box, and take real ownership and accountability for the quality of what ships. You'll report directly to the QA Manager and help ensure consistent, reliable quality across our systems.

Casper (Casper.com) believes everyone should sleep better. That’s why we obsess over designing sleep products that actually make a difference—from the littlest dreamers and beyond. Including mattresses, pillows, and bedding, our entire collection is dreamed up and engineered in-house by our product and design teams. Sleepers can shop online, visit one of our 40+ retail locations across the United States, or find us through a growing network of trusted retail partners.

This is a hybrid role, requiring that you work 4 days per week from our Richmond, VA office.

When youʼre not catching zzzʼs, this is what youʼll do...

  • Design and execute functional and end‑to‑end test cases across web and back‑end systems, covering happy paths, edge cases, and negative scenarios
  • Own test planning for features and releases - clear, traceable test plans and test cases tied to requirements
  • Perform exploratory testing to surface issues that scripted cases miss
  • Validate complex, cross‑system workflows across multiple interconnected platforms
  • Test and validate workflows across SaaS applications commonly used in e‑commerce, Shopify, OMS, Salesforce, and ERP environments
  • Detect, isolate, reproduce, and document defects with clarity and insight
  • Contribute to our existing Playwright + TypeScript automation framework, starting with the most repetitive or highest‑risk manual cases
  • Write and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright and TypeScript, following our existing Page Object Model patterns
  • Get hands-on with our automation suite — running, debugging, and extending existing Playwright tests as you build up your automation skill set
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and stakeholders to understand requirements and ensure proper test coverage
  • Write documentation for test cases and workflows to support long‑term scalability
  • Provide regular updates to the QA Manager on progress, risks, and opportunities for improvement

Our dream candidate is/has…

  • Strong in functional and end‑to‑end testing, with some hands‑on exposure to automation using Playwright and TypeScript
  • Experience testing an e‑commerce or SaaS product - you understand order lifecycles, payment or fulfillment flows, and how integrations between systems break in non‑obvious ways
  • Strong test case design and bug reporting skills - clear repro steps, good judgment on severity and priority
  • A creative problem‑solver who thinks outside the box - not satisfied testing only what's written in the ticket
  • Organized - able to juggle multiple test cycles and keep documentation current without letting anything slip
  • Passionate about testing - you find real satisfaction in catching the thing nobody else caught, and it shows
  • Comfortable with bug/task/test management tools such as JIRA and Coda
  • Comfortable working across multiple interconnected systems and validating end‑to‑end workflows
  • A clear communicator who collaborates closely with engineering, product, and DevOps

Nice to have…

  • Experience with API testing tools such as Postman
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and how automated tests fit into them
  • Familiarity with AWS resources
  • Familiarity with AI‑driven workflows and tools like Copilot, Claude, Kiro, and Amazon Q Developer
  • B.S. in Computer Science or a related field

Targeted Annual Base Salary Range: $90,000-110,000 USD

Casper’s compensation philosophy ensures that the actual base salary is based on factors including but not limited to skills, education, experience, special training, time in position, and/or years of service.

Benefits

We recognize that annual base salary is just one part of a total rewards package. In addition, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, wellbeing resources, and other perks including:

  • Medical, vision, and dental insurance to help you with those coughs or cavities (too many waffles)...
  • Paid Time Off. We believe in the power of rest so take the time you need to recharge.
  • Employee Discount to use on whatever you like (with a few exceptions) and product discounts for friends and family!
  • Dreaming of your next degree? After one year of service, we’ll help make that dream a little easier with tuition reimbursement.
  • … and more!

If you dream about this stuff this job is probably right for you. We look forward to learning more about you!

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer-sponsored visa support.

As part of our hiring process, employment offers are contingent on the successful completion of a background check and drug screening, where permitted by law.

descriptionHtml:
About Hone

Hone is an online medical clinic at the forefront of transforming healthcare and enhancing longevity. We use cutting-edge scientific advancements to empower men and women to take control of their health and unlock their full potential. Our people are the heart of everything we do and drive our success. We approach every project through our brand values:

  • Fight for the Customer
  • Execute Ruthlessly
  • Communicate Candidly, Clearly, and Kindly
  • Collaborate Selflessly
  • Practice Calculated Risk-Taking
  • Maximize Joy and Gratitude

Hone has been fully virtual from day one and will continue to be a remote-first employer.

Our Ideal Candidate

Our ideal candidate is a mission-driven, motivated multi-tasker who is invested in work that is fulfilling and impactful. They embrace change and tackle challenges with enthusiasm. They have an "all-in" disposition towards work, understanding that we are a fast-paced, high-growth organization with evolving priorities. They can excel at both independent tasks and collaborative work, leading with clear and candid communication. They exhibit humble leadership—the ability to drive initiatives forward while remaining excited about continuous learning and development opportunities. They feel strongly about being part of a team that advocates for people to live longer and better lives.

The Role

Hone is looking for a Quality Engineer II to join our Engineering team. This is an early-career role for someone who has a year or two of testing under their belt and is ready to own the quality of their own features. You will report to the Director of QA and work alongside senior quality and software engineers who will help you keep growing.

At Hone, there is one Quality Engineer track. You will both test and automate, and you will use AI to do both faster. You will handle small features and bugs with little supervision, deliver scoped work on time, and build the judgment that carries you toward Quality Engineer III and beyond. This is not a manual-only or a script-running role - it is a real engineering career on a clear path.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Write and maintain test cases for your own features with little guidance, covering the happy path and the obvious edge cases, and raise risks when you spot them
  • Own testing for the small features and bugs assigned to you, delivering scoped work on time without much hand-holding
  • Write reliable automated tests for your features on your own (end-to-end tests in Playwright and API-level tests) following the team's conventions
  • Chase down flaky tests and keep your part of the suite stable, asking for help when you need it
  • Run exploratory checks and write clear, reproducible bug reports that anyone on the team can act on
  • Work with AI tools day to day to draft cases, automation, and selectors - and spot and fix output that is wrong or unsafe, following the team's AI conventions
  • Apply patient-data guardrails consistently: keep test data synthetic and never put real patient data in test cases, bug reports, or any other test artifact
  • Give short, useful code and test reviews, talk through the direction of your own work, and give teammates helpful feedback

Qualifications

  • Roughly 1-2 years of experience in software quality, testing, or test automation
  • Working programming or scripting ability in at least one language (TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or C#)
  • Comfortable writing automated tests and maintaining them, ideally with Playwright or comparable UI and API testing frameworks
  • Comfortable with version control (Git), running a test suite, and basic debugging on your own
  • Works with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) as part of a daily workflow, and reviews their output rather than trusting it blindly
  • Dependable communication: clear bug reports, useful reviews, and the habit of talking through your own work
  • A track record of finishing scoped work on time with little supervision
  • A genuine interest in healthcare and in protecting the patients who rely on our platform

We do not expect you to meet every line above. If you are an early-career quality engineer and most of this resonates, please apply.

Compensation

$80,000 - $105,000 annual salary

Benefits*

Hone wants our team to be in the best condition of their lives, so we offer a range of benefits including:

  • A remote-first work environment
  • Competitive compensation and equity options
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance coverage
  • Short-term disability and basic life coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
  • Lifestyle Spending Accounts (LSAs)
  • We follow federal holidays and have uncapped time off for exempt employees
  • Budget for the technology tools you need (laptop, monitor, and/or special software)
  • A focus on company-sponsored activities to foster engagement (both virtual and in-person)
  • Waived membership fees for any Hone team members utilizing Hone products
  • These benefits are available to full-time, regular employees, and not to independent contractors, part-time employees, temporary employees, or interns.

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace committed to building a team culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions. Please contact us to request accommodation.
