Our ideal candidate is a mission-driven, motivated multi-tasker who is invested in work that is fulfilling and impactful. They embrace change and tackle challenges with enthusiasm. They have an "all-in" disposition towards work, understanding that we are a fast-paced, high-growth organization with evolving priorities. They can excel at both independent tasks and collaborative work, leading with clear and candid communication. They exhibit humble leadership—the ability to drive initiatives forward while remaining excited about continuous learning and development opportunities. They feel strongly about being part of a team that advocates for people to live longer and better lives.

The Role

Hone is looking for a Quality Engineer II to join our Engineering team. This is an early-career role for someone who has a year or two of testing under their belt and is ready to own the quality of their own features. You will report to the Director of QA and work alongside senior quality and software engineers who will help you keep growing.

At Hone, there is one Quality Engineer track. You will both test and automate, and you will use AI to do both faster. You will handle small features and bugs with little supervision, deliver scoped work on time, and build the judgment that carries you toward Quality Engineer III and beyond. This is not a manual-only or a script-running role - it is a real engineering career on a clear path.

Primary Responsibilities



- Write and maintain test cases for your own features with little guidance, covering the happy path and the obvious edge cases, and raise risks when you spot them
- Own testing for the small features and bugs assigned to you, delivering scoped work on time without much hand-holding
- Write reliable automated tests for your features on your own (end-to-end tests in Playwright and API-level tests) following the team's conventions
- Chase down flaky tests and keep your part of the suite stable, asking for help when you need it
- Run exploratory checks and write clear, reproducible bug reports that anyone on the team can act on
- Work with AI tools day to day to draft cases, automation, and selectors - and spot and fix output that is wrong or unsafe, following the team's AI conventions
- Apply patient-data guardrails consistently: keep test data synthetic and never put real patient data in test cases, bug reports, or any other test artifact
- Give short, useful code and test reviews, talk through the direction of your own work, and give teammates helpful feedback

Qualifications



- Roughly 1-2 years of experience in software quality, testing, or test automation
- Working programming or scripting ability in at least one language (TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or C#)
- Comfortable writing automated tests and maintaining them, ideally with Playwright or comparable UI and API testing frameworks
- Comfortable with version control (Git), running a test suite, and basic debugging on your own
- Works with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) as part of a daily workflow, and reviews their output rather than trusting it blindly
- Dependable communication: clear bug reports, useful reviews, and the habit of talking through your own work
- A track record of finishing scoped work on time with little supervision
- A genuine interest in healthcare and in protecting the patients who rely on our platform

We do not expect you to meet every line above. If you are an early-career quality engineer and most of this resonates, please apply.

Compensation

$80,000 - $105,000 annual salary

Benefits*

Hone wants our team to be in the best condition of their lives, so we offer a range of benefits including:



- A remote-first work environment
- Competitive compensation and equity options
- Health, dental, and vision insurance coverage
- Short-term disability and basic life coverage
- Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
- Lifestyle Spending Accounts (LSAs)
- We follow federal holidays and have uncapped time off for exempt employees
- Budget for the technology tools you need (laptop, monitor, and/or special software)
- A focus on company-sponsored activities to foster engagement (both virtual and in-person)
- Waived membership fees for any Hone team members utilizing Hone products
- These benefits are available to full-time, regular employees, and not to independent contractors, part-time employees, temporary employees, or interns.

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace committed to building a team culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions. Please contact us to request accommodation.

descriptionHtml:
Applicants must be US based Only. All Applicants must have a valid/current LinkedIn Profile URL within their resume, in order to be considered for the position.

About Us

We are a well established custom software development agency working on client projects in health care, education, environmental engineering, insurance and other industries. Our teams design, develop, test and deploy web, mobile and cloud applications. You will work closely with developers, business analysts, designers, project managers and clients throughout the process.

Our QA Engineers are involved throughout the project, not just before a release. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, asks good questions and wants to help the team deliver a quality product.

WHY JOIN US?

We offer top notch company culture, employee benefits, career growth, and have a trusted brand in our market.

  • Competitive base salary + bonus
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage on day 1 of employment
  • Generous 401(k) match and employer contribution
  • Generous PTO + 8 company paid holidays
  • Strong emphasis on work life balance , 40 hour weeks
  • Remote work opportunities and flexible working hours
  • Extensive training and career development opportunities

JOB DETAILS

We are looking for a QA Engineer with a strong understanding of software testing and experience using modern QA tools. In this role, you will create and execute test plans, maintain regression test suites, investigate issues and work with the project team to ensure that applications meet client requirements. You will work on multiple projects and be expected to manage your testing activities independently.

Candidates should have practical experience using AI tools, preferably Anthropic Claude or Claude Code, to assist with test case creation, regression testing and automated testing. You must be able to review the results, understand any test code produced, correct issues and explain how the tests work. We are not looking for someone who relies on AI to write tests without understanding or validating them.

We would ideally like someone willing to work hybrid onsite at our Cohoes, NY office, but we are willing to consider US based remote workers who are available for EST work day hours.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of software testing experience, primarily with software applications, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • Strong understanding of QA fundamentals, including test planning, test case design, exploratory testing, regression testing, integration testing and user acceptance testing.
  • Ability to review requirements and acceptance criteria and develop test cases with clear steps, expected results and appropriate test data.
  • Experience with an automated testing framework. Playwright using JavaScript or TypeScript is preferred. Candidates must be able to read, troubleshoot and maintain the tests they create.
  • Experience using AI tools, preferably Anthropic Claude or Claude Code, to create and maintain test cases, regression suites and automation, with the ability to independently verify the results.
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript sufficient to understand automation code, locators, assertions and basic debugging.
  • Experience testing REST APIs using Postman or a comparable tool.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, HTML, CSS and browser developer tools.
  • Experience documenting defects with reproducible steps, expected and actual results, and supporting evidence.
  • Experience working with Git, Agile / Scrum teams and test management tools such as Azure DevOps or TestRail.
  • Experience with responsive design, browser compatibility and mobile application testing.
  • Strong communication skills, attention to detail, independent troubleshooting and the ability to work directly with team members and clients.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and perform QA activities on multiple client projects, from requirements review through release.
  • Create, execute and maintain test plans, test cases, regression suites, test results and requirements traceability documentation.
  • Perform functional, exploratory, integration, API, browser compatibility and release testing as required by the project.
  • Create, execute, troubleshoot and maintain automated regression tests using established testing standards and good coding practices.
  • Use AI tooling to assist with test design, documentation and automation. Review and validate generated work for accuracy, appropriate coverage and maintainability.
  • Investigate issues, determine whether failures are caused by the application, test code or environment, and document defects clearly.
  • Work with Business Analysts, Designers, Developers and Project Managers to review requirements, identify gaps and establish appropriate test coverage.
  • Communicate test results, outstanding defects, risks and release readiness to the project team and clients.
  • Actively participate in Agile team activities and help maintain QA best practices and project documentation.
  • Perform quality checks on software releases and other client deliverables as required. Accurately track work activities and meet established project budgets and timelines.

Optional / Nice To Have

  • Experience running automated tests through Azure Pipelines, GitHub Actions or similar tools.
  • Experience with accessibility testing, performance testing, security testing or mobile automation using Appium or comparative tools.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure, cloud applications or service oriented architectures.
  • Experience assisting and mentoring other team members.

Description

Amazon Leo is Amazon's Low Earth Orbit satellite network, with a mission to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will connect people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

The Leo Network Observability, Visibility & Analytics team builds the systems that provide deep, end-to-end insight into the health, performance, and reliability of this global telecom network. Our systems span the full Leo service, from satellites and customer terminals to ground gateways, cloud services, and terrestrial network infrastructure, and help engineers understand network behavior, detect failures quickly, and diagnose complex issues.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer to help ensure the network health metrics, dashboards, and APIs our engineers and leaders rely on are accurate, reliable, and ready for release. You will test systems that turn network telemetry and events into answers to critical questions: Is the network healthy? Where is a failure occurring? What is its customer impact?

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities

  • Create and execute test plans and test cases for new and existing features across our network health services, data pipelines, APIs, and dashboards, ensuring thorough functional, integration, and end-to-end coverage across straightforward and moderately complex scenarios.
  • Develop, maintain, and extend automated tests for APIs, UI, and data pipelines using languages such as Python, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines to reduce manual testing effort.
  • Validate the accuracy of network health metrics (such as availability, latency, and packet loss) against source data and expected results.
  • Troubleshoot and isolate defects from test and pipeline failures, file clear and actionable bug reports, and work with developers to drive root cause analysis and resolution.
  • Review requirements, designs, and change requests with engineers and product managers to identify risks and test gaps early, and recommend changes that improve quality and the customer experience.
  • Participate in defect triage, test planning, and prioritization discussions, helping the team balance time constraints with test coverage goals.
  • Use AI tools to help generate test cases, expand coverage, and speed up defect investigation.
  • Track quality metrics and share release readiness status with the team.

A day in the life

As a QAE on the Network Observability team, you'll work with software engineers, network engineers, and product managers to review new features, identify risks, and plan how to test them. You might validate that a new availability metric matches the underlying telemetry one day, and build API automation for a new service the next. You'll write and run automated tests, triage failures in CI/CD pipelines, and partner with developers to reproduce and fix defects. You'll take part in sprint ceremonies and design reviews, and help make sure the data engineers and leaders use to operate the Leo network is right.

About The Team

The Leo Network Observability, Visibility & Analytics team is responsible for making a highly distributed global telecom network understandable and operable at scale. We build the visibility layer that connects network signals across satellites, customer terminals, gateways, cloud services, and terrestrial infrastructure, turning individual telemetry signals into an end-to-end view of network health so issues can be detected, diagnosed, and resolved faster.

The problems we solve are inherently distributed and combine software engineering with networking and data science. We are building new capabilities rather than applying existing observability patterns to a conventional cloud service. If you enjoy ambiguous problems, care about getting the details right, and want to help build foundational systems for Amazon Leo, this team is a great place to grow.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
  • Experience in automation testing
  • Experience in manual testing
  • Experience in UI and API automation testing (Selenium/SOAPUI)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in API & Mobile testing
  • Experience designing and planning test conditions, test scripts, and test data sets to ensure appropriate and adequate coverage and control

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Our systems span the full Leo service, from satellites and customer terminals to ground gateways, cloud services, and terrestrial network infrastructure, and help engineers understand network behavior, detect failures quickly, and diagnose complex issues.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer to help ensure the network health metrics, dashboards, and APIs our engineers and leaders rely on are accurate, reliable, and ready for release. You will test systems that turn network telemetry and events into answers to critical questions: Is the network healthy? Where is a failure occurring? What is its customer impact?

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities



-  Create and execute test plans and test cases for new and existing features across our network health services, data pipelines, APIs, and dashboards, ensuring thorough functional, integration, and end-to-end coverage across straightforward and moderately complex scenarios.
-  Develop, maintain, and extend automated tests for APIs, UI, and data pipelines using languages such as Python, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines to reduce manual testing effort.
-  Validate the accuracy of network health metrics (such as availability, latency, and packet loss) against source data and expected results.
-  Troubleshoot and isolate defects from test and pipeline failures, file clear and actionable bug reports, and work with developers to drive root cause analysis and resolution.
-  Review requirements, designs, and change requests with engineers and product managers to identify risks and test gaps early, and recommend changes that improve quality and the customer experience.
-  Participate in defect triage, test planning, and prioritization discussions, helping the team balance time constraints with test coverage goals.
-  Use AI tools to help generate test cases, expand coverage, and speed up defect investigation.
-  Track quality metrics and share release readiness status with the team.

A day in the life

As a QAE on the Network Observability team, you'll work with software engineers, network engineers, and product managers to review new features, identify risks, and plan how to test them. You might validate that a new availability metric matches the underlying telemetry one day, and build API automation for a new service the next. You'll write and run automated tests, triage failures in CI/CD pipelines, and partner with developers to reproduce and fix defects. You'll take part in sprint ceremonies and design reviews, and help make sure the data engineers and leaders use to operate the Leo network is right.

About The Team

The Leo Network Observability, Visibility & Analytics team is responsible for making a highly distributed global telecom network understandable and operable at scale. We build the visibility layer that connects network signals across satellites, customer terminals, gateways, cloud services, and terrestrial infrastructure, turning individual telemetry signals into an end-to-end view of network health so issues can be detected, diagnosed, and resolved faster.

The problems we solve are inherently distributed and combine software engineering with networking and data science. We are building new capabilities rather than applying existing observability patterns to a conventional cloud service. If you enjoy ambiguous problems, care about getting the details right, and want to help build foundational systems for Amazon Leo, this team is a great place to grow.

Basic Qualifications



-  2+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
-  Experience in automation testing
-  Experience in manual testing
-  Experience in UI and API automation testing (Selenium/SOAPUI)

Preferred Qualifications



-  Experience in API & Mobile testing
-  Experience designing and planning test conditions, test scripts, and test data sets to ensure appropriate and adequate coverage and control

Position Overview:

Alarm.com is seeking a Quality Engineer with an interest in Software Development in Test (SDET) to join our Quality Engineering team. In this role, you will support the quality, performance, and reliability of our web and mobile applications through a combination of manual testing, test automation, and modern quality practices.

You will work closely with Product Management, Software Engineering, UX Design, DevOps, and Support while learning how quality is built into Alarm.com products throughout the development lifecycle. The ideal candidate has 0–1 years of experience in quality engineering, software testing, internships, or academic projects; is eager to grow automation skills; and is curious about emerging tools and techniques—including AI‑assisted testing solutions—to improve test coverage and efficiency.

This role is well‑suited for a motivated engineer at the start of their career who enjoys learning, collaborating with others, and developing a strong foundation in quality engineering.

Responsibilities:

  • Learn and develop an understanding of Alarm.com’s products, customer workflows, and system architecture.
  • Execute manual test cases, identify and document defects, and help track issues through resolution and verification.
  • Assist in the development, execution, and maintenance of automated UI and API tests with guidance from more experienced team members.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers and Software Engineers to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, and expected behavior.
  • Participate in design and technical discussions to learn about testability, quality, and automation best practices.
  • Help maintain test frameworks, tools, test data, and test environments.
  • Support issue investigation by reviewing logs, validating data, and learning to read and understand code.
  • Perform functional, regression, smoke, and sanity testing to support releases.
  • Learn how automated tests are integrated into CI/CD pipelines and release workflows.
  • Gain exposure to AI‑assisted testing tools and techniques as part of continuous improvement and skill development.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 0–1 years of experience in software testing, quality engineering, internships, co‑ops, or relevant academic projects.
  • Basic programming or scripting experience in Java, Python, or JavaScript.
  • Foundational understanding of software testing concepts such as functional and regression testing.
  • Exposure to UI or API test automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Postman) through coursework, projects, or internships.
  • Basic familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
  • Strong attention to detail, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Internship, academic, or personal project experience related to QA, automation, or software development.
  • Exposure to Agile/Scrum development environments.
  • Basic knowledge of SQL or data validation concepts.
  • Interest in test automation, CI/CD pipelines, and modern quality engineering practices.
  • Curiosity about AI‑driven or intelligent testing tools and how they can support software quality.


WHY WORK FOR ALARM.COM?

  • Collaborate with outstanding people: We hire only the best. Our standards are high and our employees enjoy working alongside other high achievers.
  • Make an immediate impact: New employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the Alarm.com team!
  • Gain well rounded experience: Alarm.com offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business.
  • Work with the latest technologies: You’ll gain exposure to a broad spectrum of IoT, SaaS and M2M technologies including wireless communication, video monitoring, smart home automation, web development, and backend application development and hosting.
  • Focus on fun: Alarm.com places high value on our team culture. We even have a committee dedicated to hosting a stand-out holiday party, happy hours, and other fun corporate events.


Company Info

Alarm.com is the leading cloud-based platform for smart security and the Internet of Things. More than 6 million home and business owners depend on our solutions every day to make their properties safer, smarter, and more efficient. And every day, we’re innovating new technologies in rapidly evolving spaces including AI, video analytics, facial recognition, machine learning, energy analytics, and more. Alarm.com earned the Top Workplace™ award for our employee culture and the meaningful work we do to give property owners peace of mind, help them conserve energy and water, and stay connected to loved ones. We’re seeking those who are passionate about creating change through technology and who want to make a lasting impact on the world around them.

For more information, please visit www.alarm.com.

Alarm.com offers competitive pay and benefits including a wide choice of healthcare options with generous company subsidy, a health savings account option with company contribution, 401(k) with employer match, paid holidays and paid time off increasing with tenure, paid maternity and paternity leave, company paid STD/LTD and life insurance, flexible spending accounts, and a casual dress work environment.      

Alarm.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer

In connection with your application, we collect information that identifies, reasonably relates to or describes you (“Personal Information”). The categories of Personal Information that we may collect include your name, government-issued identification number(s), email address, mailing address, other contact information, emergency contact information, employment history, educational history, criminal record, and demographic information.  We collect and use those categories of Personal Information about you for human resources and other business management purposes, including identifying and evaluating you as a candidate for potential or future employment or future contract positions, record keeping in relation to recruiting and hiring, conducting criminal background checks as permitted by law, conducting analytics, and ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements and Company policies.

In the event we receive a resume or candidate referral for this position from a third-party recruiter or agency without a previously signed agreement, we reserve the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to you. If you are interested in working with Alarm.com, please email your company information and standard agreement to RecruitingPartnerships@Alarm.com.

The base salary range of this opportunity is listed below and is determined within a range based on factors including qualifications, location and experience. This allows opportunity for growth and development within the role. The base salary offered is part of a total compensation package.

Base Salary Range

$85,000—$85,000 USD

descriptionHtml:
About Digital Harbor

Digital Harbor is a technology company developing innovative software products that transform how people communicate, collaborate, and create.


Our Business Media portfolio includes four products: Byte, Dot, Matee, and Yoodle. Each is designed to solve different challenges in modern communication and productivity.

We operate in a fast-moving, collaborative environment where engineers are encouraged to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and contribute directly to the quality and success of the products they help build.


About the Opportunity

Digital Harbor is seeking a Quality Assurance Engineer to help ensure the reliability, performance, and usability of our growing Business Media product portfolio.


We're looking for a hands-on engineer who combines strong manual testing skills with practical test automation experience. This individual will work closely with software engineers, product leaders, and designers to identify defects, improve testing processes, and help deliver high-quality software.


The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, technically curious, and comfortable taking ownership of testing activities throughout the development lifecycle.


As our products continue to expand across web, desktop, and mobile platforms, this position will play an important role in establishing repeatable testing practices and improving release confidence.


Our Products: Business Media

Byte: Video Communication Without Another Meeting

Byte enables asynchronous video communication through browser-based screen and camera recordings.

  • Record and share video messages instantly.
  • Provide feedback through time-specific comments, reactions, and annotations.
  • Catch up quickly with transcripts, AI-generated chapters, and summaries.
  • Continue conversations through video replies and Dot integration.

Value Proposition: Reduce unnecessary meetings while making communication more personal, efficient, and accessible.


Dot: Collaborative Content and Conversations

Dot makes files, screenshots, and everyday content interactive and collaborative.

  • Capture, annotate, and discuss content together.
  • Collaborate using reactions, stickers, Magic Markers, and feeds.
  • Organize communication through threads, mentions, and private conversations.
  • Stay informed through Catch-Me-Up and notifications.

Value Proposition: Make collaboration feel natural by connecting conversations directly to the content people work with.


Matee: Intelligent Writing Technology

Matee is an embeddable rich-text platform designed to make writing and communication smarter.

  • Enhance written communication using natural language understanding and generation.
  • Transform text into clearer, more actionable information.
  • Integrate intelligent writing capabilities into existing applications.
  • Deliver a consistent writing experience across multiple platforms.

Value Proposition: Help users communicate more effectively while enabling applications to offer intelligent, integrated writing experiences.


Yoodle: Connected Messaging and Collaboration

Yoodle brings messaging, meetings, and scheduling into a unified communication experience.

  • Share files, voice, video, and reactions within conversations.
  • Make video meetings more engaging and collaborative.
  • Organize conversations through threads, reminders, and calendars.
  • Connect chat, meetings, and scheduling across web, desktop, and mobile.

Value Proposition: Bring communication and collaboration together in one connected workspace.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and execute manual and automated test cases for web and mobile applications.
  • Perform functional, regression, smoke, integration, and acceptance testing throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts to improve test coverage and reduce repetitive manual testing.
  • Identify, document, reproduce, and prioritize software defects in collaboration with engineering and product teams.
  • Validate new features against functional requirements, acceptance criteria, and expected user experiences.
  • Test REST APIs, backend integrations, and data consistency across applications.
  • Conduct cross-browser, cross-device, and mobile compatibility testing.
  • Collaborate with developers to investigate complex defects, identify root causes, and verify fixes.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, refinement, and release readiness discussions.
  • Contribute to testing standards, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD workflows and support reliable software releases.
  • Identify opportunities to improve product stability, performance, and overall user experience.
  • Advocate for quality throughout the development process, with an emphasis on preventing defects before production.


Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in software quality assurance, testing, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with both manual and automated software testing.
  • Experience developing and maintaining automated test cases using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or comparable frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of functional, regression, smoke, integration, and acceptance testing.
  • Experience with defect tracking, test case management, and issue prioritization.
  • Familiarity with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another programming language used for test automation.
  • Experience testing REST APIs using tools such as Postman or comparable solutions.
  • Understanding of web technologies, including HTML, CSS, HTTP, and modern JavaScript applications.
  • Familiarity with Git, developer tools, and CI/CD processes.
  • Experience working within Agile software development teams.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical issues clearly and collaborate effectively with engineers and nontechnical stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Playwright or Cypress using JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Experience testing Angular, React, or Vue applications.
  • Familiarity with Node.js and backend application testing.
  • Experience with SQL databases and data validation.
  • Experience with mobile application testing on iOS and Android.
  • Familiarity with Capacitor or other cross-platform mobile technologies.
  • Experience testing real-time communication, WebSockets, notifications, or collaborative applications.
  • Experience with performance, load, accessibility, or security testing.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or other CI/CD platforms.
  • Familiarity with AWS or other cloud environments.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools to support test generation, debugging, and test coverage analysis.
  • Previous experience testing SaaS products or working within a growing software product organization.


What Success Looks Like

Successful QA Engineers at Digital Harbor:

  • Develop reliable, repeatable testing processes that improve product quality.
  • Increase automated regression test coverage across critical product features.
  • Identify high-impact defects early in the development lifecycle.
  • Help reduce production defects and improve release confidence.
  • Collaborate effectively with developers and product leaders to resolve quality issues.
  • Take ownership of testing activities with minimal supervision.
  • Improve the efficiency and consistency of testing across web and mobile applications.
  • Advocate for the customer experience while maintaining high technical standards.


What Makes Someone Successful Here?

We're looking for problem-solvers, critical thinkers, and quality-minded engineers.

Our strongest QA Engineers don't simply follow test scripts. They think critically about how products are used, anticipate potential failure points, challenge assumptions, and proactively investigate issues before they impact customers.


We value individuals who are curious about how software works, comfortable exploring unfamiliar systems, and motivated to improve both the product and the processes used to build it.


Equal Employment Opportunity

Digital Harbor is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

This individual is responsible for supporting the quality and reliability of Wellabe’s platform products through hands-on test automation and quality assurance practices. This role executes automated and manual testing across UI, API, and integration layers, contributing to the ongoing growth of automation coverage.

This position works closely with Engineering and Product teams to validate quality throughout the delivery lifecycle. The QA Automation Engineer 2 builds and maintains automated test scripts, participates in CI/CD testing processes, and applies established quality assurance standards and tools to improve test coverage and release confidence, escalating complex issues to senior QA team members as needed.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design and implement automated test scripts for UI, API, and integration testing using established frameworks and tools such as Playwright.

  • Collaborate with developers to identify, document, and track defects through resolution, contributing to improved test coverage and reliability.
  • Perform backend data validation by developing and executing SQL queries to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
  • Contribute to test plans, including test case development, estimates, and test environment coordination.
  • Follow established quality assurance standards, processes, and best practices set by senior QA team members.
  • Support the integration of automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions.
  • Assist with the adoption of AI-driven and intelligent testing tools, such as self-healing automation and test prioritization, under the guidance of senior team members.

  • Experience in automation or manual testing, with a growing focus on automation as a primary responsibility.
  • Experience contributing to automation efforts across one or more test layers.

descriptionHtml:
About FacilityOS

FacilityOS is a fast-growing company redefining how facilities operate—bringing safety, security, and daily operations into one unified platform used by organizations around the world.

As we continue to scale globally, we’re building a team of driven, curious people who want to make an impact. You’ll be part of a dynamic, collaborative culture where individuals are trusted to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and grow in their careers. Our team comes together in-office twice a week to connect, collaborate, and build momentum.

If you’re looking to do your best work alongside a great team in a high-growth environment, FacilityOS is the place to build your career.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer to own the quality of our web, desktop, and mobile products. You'll combine hands-on manual testing with building and maintaining automated test suites, working closely with developers and product managers from requirements through release. You'll also play an important part in triaging and investigating issues reported by customers and Support.

Our product suite includes an ASP.NET / Angular web platform, Windows desktop applications, backend services, and Android/iOS mobile apps. You'll work across all of them, and grow our automation from web and desktop into mobile.

This is a hybrid position. You'll be required to come into our Annapolis, Maryland office three times a week.

Duties And Responsibilities

Manual testing

  • Review requirements, specifications, and designs, and give timely, meaningful feedback.
  • Plan and run functional, exploratory, regression, integration, permission, and user acceptance testing across web, desktop, and mobile applications.
  • Write clear test plans, test cases, and checklists using appropriate test design techniques.
  • Test APIs and data: validate requests and responses with API tools and check results in the database with SQL.
  • Find, reproduce, and document defects with clear steps and evidence, and work with developers to understand the root cause and verify fixes.

Test automation

  • Design, build, and maintain automated test suites:
    • Web: Playwright with C#, and SmartBear Reflect, an AI-assisted test automation tool.
    • Desktop: FlaUI and Playwright for Windows desktop applications.
    • Mobile: Help evaluate and introduce Android (and potentially iOS) test automation.
  • Integrate automated tests into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, and keep them reliable, fast, and maintainable.
  • Build reusable test environments and test data, e.g. virtual machine snapshots and seeded test accounts.
Release quality and testing

  • Support product releases: identify changes and risk areas, plan and run regression testing.
  • Track quality metrics, such as defect counts and automation coverage, and use them to improve the process.

Issue triage and investigation

  • Investigate root causes of customers’ issues with developers using logs, database queries, browser and API tools, and recent code changes; distinguish configuration, data, and environment issues from code defects.
  • Verify fixes and add regression tests so resolved issues stay resolved.

Collaboration and leadership

  • Work closely with developers, product managers, support, and DevOps to deliver high-quality software.
  • Mentor other QA team members, and share knowledge of products, tools, and testing practices.
  • Keep up with new testing tools, including AI-assisted testing, and continuously improve team efficiency.

Requirements

Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software quality assurance experience, including at least 2 years building and maintaining automated tests.
  • Strong manual testing skills: test design, exploratory and regression testing, and reproducing and isolating defects.
  • Experience triaging and investigating reported issues, including root-cause analysis with developers.
  • Hands-on test automation experience with Playwright (C# preferred) or similar frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of C# / .NET, enough to read code, review pull requests, and write test code.
  • Strong SQL skills (SQL Server preferred) for data validation and investigation.
  • Experience testing web APIs with tools such as Postman or Swagger. Comfortable with browser developer tools (network, console).
  • Experience testing web and desktop applications. Mobile testing is a plus.
  • Solid knowledge of Jira, Confluence, a test management system (e.g. Zephyr), and Git / Azure DevOps.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and written communication skills. You write bug reports developers can act on right away.
  • A high level of ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities.

Nice To Haves

  • Security testing experience is preferred, e.g. authentication and authorization checks and OWASP concepts.
  • Experience with FlaUI or other Windows desktop UI automation.
  • Experience with SmartBear Reflect or other AI-assisted or low-code test tools.
  • Introduce mobile test automation for our Android apps: evaluate tools, then set up and grow a test suite, starting with Appium, on emulators and real scanner devices (e.g. Zebra, Honeywell). Experience with Espresso / UI Automator, XCUITest, or Maestro is a plus.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), virtual machines, and test environment management.
  • Familiarity with ASP.NET MVC / Web API, Angular, and multi-tenant SaaS applications.
  • Experience with logging and monitoring tools such as Datadog or Application Insights.
  • Relevant testing certifications (e.g. ISTQB).

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Why work at FacilityOS?

We Work Hard And Play Hard And We Do Both With Passion And Respect For One Another. Our Company Promotes a Fast-paced, Fun, Friendly, And Highly Collaborative Work Environment That Provides

🩺Comprehensive health coverage

🏠A Hybrid work environment

💡Opportunity for advancement and growth

🍕 Catered Events, Snacks, Drinks – You won’t go Hungry!

🥳 Birthday and Life Celebrations

🎉 Two annual parties in a year

FacilityOS Commitment

We believe that a diverse team is the key to innovation and growth. We are an equal opportunity employer that value diversity at our company and encourage all candidates to apply. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

FacilityOS will accommodate individuals with disabilities through each stage of the recruitment and selection process. Please advise us of any needs when your interview is booked, and we will do our best to meet your needs.

Please note that all candidates must be legally eligible to work in the location in which you applied.

Background and Reference Checks

Any offer of employment may be conditional upon full background checks including a criminal record check, a credit check and employment and educational verifications. A reference check will also be conducted.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process such as reviewing applications. These tools assist the recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. All advancement and hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us or click here.

descriptionHtml:
Join us at Entrust 

At Entrust, we’re shaping the future of identity centric security solutions. From our comprehensive portfolio of solutions to our flexible, global workplace, we empower careers, foster collaboration, and build solutions that help keep the world moving safely. 

Entrust's values are a cornerstone of who we are, our future business growth and how our people grow through it. We model our values by demonstrating that Customer Trust Is Earned, moving with purpose because Speed Is Intentional, taking accountability because We Own the Outcome, and building a collaborative culture where One Entrust Wins Together.

Get to Know Us 

Headquartered in Minnesota, Entrust is an industry leader in identity-centric security solutions, serving over 150 countries with cutting-edge, scalable technologies. But our secret weapon? Our people. It’s the curiosity, dedication, and innovation that drive our success and help us anticipate the future. 

Position Description

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows.

This role will have an emphasis on managing performance/load testing within our current K6 environment.

In addition, you will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability. You will also collaborate closely with software development partners to define test strategies, expand automation, and responsibly use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support test creation, code review, documentation, and regression analysis while maintaining strong human oversight.

Responsibilities

  • Manage, troubleshoot and report on performance/load testing of web sites and components using our K6 environment. It measures the throughput and resilience of thousands of printers hitting a site for the purpose of issuing credit, debit and ID cards.
  • Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with C# and API-testing tools such as RestSharp and Playwright.
  • End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products.
  • Set up cloud and on-premises environments to verify supported solution scenarios, including LDAP, database, and network configurations.
  • Some possible Dev Ops work to automate creating different environments including single and distributed deployment.
  • Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
  • Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
  • 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
  • Performance/Load testing
  • Programming experience in C#. JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Powershell.
  • Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
  • Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization in the U.S.

Preferred Qualifications

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with K6 performance testing tool
  • Ansible experience scripting deployments from development to test to production.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Bitbucket for source code control.
  • Experience with Jira and/or Microsoft Azure DevOps Server for user-story coordination, test-case management, build integration, and issue tracking.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted QA workflows with pull requests, design documentation, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, logs, virtual machines, or test reporting.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including approved-tool usage, sensitive-data handling, intellectual-property awareness, secure coding guardrails, and review of AI-generated automation before reuse.

Where you will be: This is a hybrid role requiring three days per week in our Shakopee, MN headquarters office.

About Entrust

Our growing company relies on curious, dedicated and innovative colleagues to anticipate the future and provide solutions for a more connected, mobile and secure world. Entrust technologies and expertise help government agencies, enterprises and financial institutions in more than 150 countries, serve and safeguard citizens, employees and consumers. Headquartered in the United States, TP-Link Systems Inc. is a global provider of reliable networking devices and smart home products, consistently ranked as the world’s top provider of Wi-Fi devices. With a commitment to excellence, TP-Link serves customers in over 170 countries and continues to grow its global footprint.

We believe technology changes the world for the better! At TP-Link Systems Inc, we are committed to crafting dependable, high-performance products to connect users worldwide with the wonders of technology.

Embracing professionalism, innovation, excellence, and simplicity, we aim to assist our clients in achieving remarkable global performance and enable consumers to enjoy a seamless, effortless lifestyle.

TP-Link is seeking a Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Cloud Web Platforms Quality Engineering team. In this role, you will help ensure the quality of TP-Link's global websites, web applications, and AI-powered customer experiences, which reach millions of users across dozens of countries and languages.

You will drive quality throughout the development lifecycle—from reviewing requirements and identifying risks to designing tests, expanding automation coverage, investigating failures, and supporting release decisions. The work ranges from product pages and content-management platforms to AI-powered search and support assistants. You also have the opportunity to contribute to testing the cloud services and APIs behind these experiences. Throughout, you'll work closely with software engineers, product managers, designers, and senior quality engineers.

This role is ideal for a quality engineer who enjoys both breadth and depth: someone comfortable moving between browser-based UI testing, backend API validation, and automation, and who wants to grow expertise across web and cloud technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Develop risk-based test strategies and execute functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing for websites, web applications, content-management systems, APIs, and supporting cloud services.
  • Participate in requirements reviews and design discussions to clarify acceptance criteria, identify risks early, and improve product testability.
  • Build and maintain automated UI and API tests using Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript and frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or equivalent tools. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Validate backend APIs, service integrations, database behavior, and data integrity using API tools, code-based test frameworks, and SQL.
  • Investigate failures and isolate root causes using browser developer tools, network traces, application logs, system telemetry, and database queries.
  • Perform release validation across browsers, devices, and screen sizes, including responsive UI, visual regression, functional, and end-to-end testing to ensure seamless product rollouts.
  • Conduct web performance, load, and accessibility testing, monitoring metrics like Core Web Vitals and ensuring compliance with WCAG guidelines.
  • Produce clear test reports, defect analyses, and go/no-go risk assessments to support release decisions.
  • Advocate for QA best practices, test-code quality, and continuous improvement, using AI-assisted tools where appropriate to improve engineering productivity.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of experience in software quality engineering, with significant experience testing web applications.
  • Solid understanding of software testing principles, test design techniques, and the software development lifecycle.
  • Hands-on experience testing web applications across browsers, devices, and screen sizes, using browser developer tools to inspect network requests, console errors, and page behavior.
  • Experience developing and maintaining automated UI and API tests in Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs with tools such as Postman or code-based test frameworks, and validating data using SQL.
  • Working knowledge of how websites are built and delivered, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, HTTP, redirects, caching, and content-management systems.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and Jira or similar defect-tracking tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain quality risks and test results clearly to engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience owning quality for a web product, website migration, or CMS platform from planning through release.
  • Experience testing SEO elements, structured data (Schema.org), analytics and tag implementations, or localized content across many locales.
  • Experience testing AI or LLM-powered features such as chatbots, search, or recommendations, including approaches for evaluating non-deterministic output.
  • Experience with web performance and accessibility testing tools such as Lighthouse, WebPageTest, or axe.
  • Experience testing applications deployed on AWS or other public cloud platforms, or backend services built on microservices.
  • Familiarity with visual regression testing tools such as Percy, Applitools, or Chromatic.
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered tools such as GitHub Copilot or other AI-assisted testing solutions to improve testing efficiency and engineering productivity.
  • Experience with networking products, smart home technologies, connected device ecosystems, or e-commerce websites.

Why Join TP-Link

  • Shape the quality of TP-Link’s global websites and web experiences, used by customers in over 170 countries.
  • Work across web and cloud technologies, from browser-based applications to the APIs and services behind them.
  • Help define how the team tests emerging AI-powered features such as conversational assistants and intelligent search.
  • Build scalable automation using modern frameworks and AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Collaborate with talented engineering, product, and design teams across global locations.
  • Grow your career with broad ownership and visible impact on TP-Link’s next generation of web and cloud experiences.

TP-Link is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive.

Benefits

Salary Range:

$100,000 - 130,000

Benefits:

  • Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance (partial coverage for dependents)
  • Contributions to 401k funds
  • Over four weeks of PTO per year
  • Bi-annual pay increases
  • Health and wellness benefits, including free gym membership
  • Quarterly team-building events

At TP-Link Systems Inc., we are continually searching for ambitious individuals who are passionate about their work. We believe that diversity fuels innovation, collaboration, and drives our entrepreneurial spirit. As a global company, we highly value diverse perspectives and are committed to cultivating an environment where all voices are heard, respected, and valued. We are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants, and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Beyond compliance, we strive to create a supportive and growth-oriented workplace for everyone. If you share our passion and connection to this mission, we welcome you to apply and join us in building a vibrant and inclusive team at TP-Link Systems Inc.

Please, no third-party agency inquiries, and we are unable to offer visa sponsorships at this time.

At Aderant, the “A” is more than just a letter. It is a representation of how we fulfill our foundational purpose, serving our clients. We encourage our diverse teams to bring their whole selves to work – ideas, experience, and passion – to drive our mission forward. Our people are our strength.

As a QA Engineer, you will help ensure the quality of Aderant’s suite of legal software, spanning our practice of law products. You will be responsible for testing within your assigned product areas – including manual verification and exploratory testing, automation and gated tests, test plans, performance and load testing, product integration testing, and production feature flag testing. In this role, you will be a key part of the quality gate for new releases, helping determine when a version is ready to roll out and when more time is needed, so our clients receive the quality they expect from Aderant. You will work closely with developers, architects, QA engineers, product owners, and support staff.

What You’ll Do In This Role

  • Plan testing for features and releases: turn requirements and user stories into test cases, identify risks and edge cases, and recommend what should be automated and what should remain manual.
  • Build and maintain automated tests across layers:
  • Web end-to-end tests (e.g., Playwright)
  • API, contract, and unit-level tests, alongside developers
  • Run manual and exploratory testing, including release checklists, regression passes, and structured test sessions on QA environments.
  • Test integrations across databases, connectors, identity/SSO, and other Aderant products, verifying data flows, contracts, and failure behavior – not just screens.
  • Contribute to non-functional testing, including performance, load, and resilience scenarios with measurable pass criteria.
  • Keep automation reliable: fix flaky tests, keep tests independent of shared accounts and pre-set configuration, and manage test data so runs do not interfere with each other.
  • Help integrate tests into CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) so the right suites run on every pull request, nightly, and before release.
  • Report clearly: log reproducible defects with evidence, track test cases and results in Azure DevOps, and summarize coverage, results, and risks for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Work across environments (dev, QA, staging), coordinating with developers and operations on environment setup, backend support, test accounts, and configuration.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 3 months: You know our products, environments, and existing test suites; you run release manual verification independently; and you have shipped your first automated tests and fixes for flaky ones.
  • First 6 months: You are the primary tester for a product area, working with limited guidance; you have added automated coverage for paths that were previously manual-only; and your tests run reliably in CI without ongoing support.
  • First year: You are contributing improvements to integration, database, or performance testing, and sharing what you learn with newer QA engineers.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5 years of experience in software QA, including at least 2 years writing automated tests.
  • Hands-on experience with a modern UI automation framework, ideally Playwright.
  • Experience testing REST APIs (Postman, Playwright request, or code-based tests) and reading request/response payloads in browser DevTools.
  • Working knowledge of SQL for checking data and setting up test conditions.
  • Experience with Git, pull requests, and running tests in CI pipelines.
  • A solid grasp of test design: equivalence partitioning, boundary values, state transitions, and risk-based prioritization.
  • Comfort with both manual and exploratory testing, and sound judgment about when each approach is the right one.
  • Clear written communication: bug reports a developer can act on and summaries a manager can read.
  • A working habit of using AI coding assistants to speed up test creation and investigation.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Jest or similar unit-test frameworks, and with mocking or stubbing backends.
  • Knowledge of C# scripting and TypeScript for writing and maintaining test automation.
  • Contract testing (consumer-driven contracts, schema validation) or testing third-party integrations.
  • Performance or load testing (k6, JMeter, or similar).
  • Azure DevOps Boards and Test Cases, and Azure-hosted environments.
  • Experience with SSO / OAuth / OIDC login flows and multi-tenant SaaS configuration.
  • Familiarity with legal or professional-services software.

At Aderant, the “A” is more than just a letter. It is a representation of how we fulfill our foundational purpose, serving our clients. It embodies our core values and reminds us that to achieve success, every day must start with the “A”. We bring the “A” to life by fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and personal growth. We encourage our diverse teams to bring their whole selves to work – ideas, experience, and passion – to drive our mission forward. Our people are our strength.

As a QA Engineer, you will help ensure the quality of Aderant’s suite of legal software, spanning our practice of law products. You will be responsible for testing within your assigned product areas – including manual verification and exploratory testing, automation and gated tests, test plans, performance and load testing, product integration testing, and production feature flag testing. In this role, you will be a key part of the quality gate for new releases, helping determine when a version is ready to roll out and when more time is needed, so our clients receive the quality they expect from Aderant. You will work closely with developers, architects, QA engineers, product owners, and support staff.

What You’ll Do In This Role



- Plan testing for features and releases: turn requirements and user stories into test cases, identify risks and edge cases, and recommend what should be automated and what should remain manual.
- Build and maintain automated tests across layers:
- Web end-to-end tests (e.g., Playwright)
- API, contract, and unit-level tests, alongside developers
- Run manual and exploratory testing, including release checklists, regression passes, and structured test sessions on QA environments.
- Test integrations across databases, connectors, identity/SSO, and other Aderant products, verifying data flows, contracts, and failure behavior – not just screens.
- Contribute to non-functional testing, including performance, load, and resilience scenarios with measurable pass criteria.
- Keep automation reliable: fix flaky tests, keep tests independent of shared accounts and pre-set configuration, and manage test data so runs do not interfere with each other.
- Help integrate tests into CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) so the right suites run on every pull request, nightly, and before release.
- Report clearly: log reproducible defects with evidence, track test cases and results in Azure DevOps, and summarize coverage, results, and risks for both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Work across environments (dev, QA, staging), coordinating with developers and operations on environment setup, backend support, test accounts, and configuration.

What Success Looks Like



- First 3 months: You know our products, environments, and existing test suites; you run release manual verification independently; and you have shipped your first automated tests and fixes for flaky ones.
- First 6 months: You are the primary tester for a product area, working with limited guidance; you have added automated coverage for paths that were previously manual-only; and your tests run reliably in CI without ongoing support.
- First year: You are contributing improvements to integration, database, or performance testing, and sharing what you learn with newer QA engineers.

What We’re Looking For



- 3–5 years of experience in software QA, including at least 2 years writing automated tests.
- Hands-on experience with a modern UI automation framework, ideally Playwright.
- Experience testing REST APIs (Postman, Playwright request, or code-based tests) and reading request/response payloads in browser DevTools.
- Working knowledge of SQL for checking data and setting up test conditions.
- Experience with Git, pull requests, and running tests in CI pipelines.
- A solid grasp of test design: equivalence partitioning, boundary values, state transitions, and risk-based prioritization.
- Comfort with both manual and exploratory testing, and sound judgment about when each approach is the right one.
- Clear written communication: bug reports a developer can act on and summaries a manager can read.
- A working habit of using AI coding assistants to speed up test creation and investigation.

Preferred Experience



- Experience with Jest or similar unit-test frameworks, and with mocking or stubbing backends.
- Knowledge of C# scripting and TypeScript for writing and maintaining test automation.
- Contract testing (consumer-driven contracts, schema validation) or testing third-party integrations.
- Performance or load testing (k6, JMeter, or similar). 
- Azure DevOps Boards and Test Cases, and Azure-hosted environments. 
- Experience with SSO / OAuth / OIDC login flows and multi-tenant SaaS configuration. 
- Familiarity with legal or professional-services software.

descriptionHtml:
RLDatix is on a mission to transform care delivery worldwide, ensuring every patient receives the safest, highest-quality care. Through our innovative Healthcare Operations Platform, we’re connecting data to unlock trusted insights that enable improved decision-making and help deliver safer healthcare for all.

Job Description

RLDatix (RLD) is on a mission to help raise the standard of care…everywhere. Trusted by over 10,000 healthcare organizations around the world, our solutions help improve health and care. Our applications ensure that patients receive the best and safest care while supporting the providers who deliver it.

Joining TeamRLD means being part of a global effort of over 2,000 team members in making a difference in healthcare…every day.

As a Quality Engineer, you will play a hands-on role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of RLDatix applications that support critical healthcare workflows. You will design and execute comprehensive test plans using both manual and automated methods, validate new features throughout the sprint, identify defects, maintain automation coverage, and support release readiness across a fast-moving product environment.

This role is part of a Quality Engineering team that supports multiple applications on a regular release cycle. You’ll balance manual testing with automation, contribute to regression efforts, and use AI tools responsibly to improve productivity, test coverage, and quality outcomes, while growing toward deeper technical contribution over time.

How You’ll Spend Your Time

  • Test development items throughout each sprint, plan and execute manual and automated regression testing before releases, and validate new features against functional requirements, user workflows, and customer expectations
  • Document defects clearly, partner with developers to resolve issues, verify fixes through release, and participate in release readiness activities including regression cycles, code-freeze validation, and release-night support when needed
  • Create, maintain, and expand automated tests using Playwright, validate JSON payloads, API requests and responses, and error handling, and use MySQL and MS SQL Server queries to troubleshoot issues and validate data
  • Use AI tools responsibly to support test case creation, test maintenance, and automation productivity, while reviewing and validating AI-assisted outputs for accuracy and alignment with product behavior
  • Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other quality engineers, provide user support and case management as needed, and communicate testing status, risks, blockers, and defects clearly

What Kind of Things We’re Most Interested in You Having

  • Ideally 5+ years of experience in software quality engineering, software testing, software development, or related software delivery roles, with strong hands-on proficiency in Playwright
  • A working understanding of manual and automated testing practices, including regression testing, functional testing, unit-level concepts, and API-level testing, with experience designing, executing, and maintaining test cases and test plans
  • The ability to use SQL queries, preferably MySQL and/or MS SQL Server, to troubleshoot and validate application behavior, and to document defects clearly and validate fixes through the release lifecycle
  • A strong commitment to documentation, clean test design, and maintainable testing practices, with the ability to work independently on moderately complex assignments and collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and support teams
  • Ability to commute to our Lehi, Utah office four days a week, with remote Wednesdays
  • Sincere interest in building software that improves healthcare outcomes
  • Familiar with AI-assisted development or test automation workflows
  • Nice to have: Python, React or front-end development, Selenium or other automation frameworks, API testing tools such as Postman, and healthcare or regulated software experience.

By enabling flexibility in how we work and prioritizing employee wellness, we empower our team to do and be their best. This is an in-office role based in Lehi, Utah, with remote Wednesdays. Our benefits package includes health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance, 401K, paid time off, and paid holidays.

RLDatix is an equal opportunity employer, and our employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, age, gender, national origin, disability, handicap, marital status or any other status or condition protected by Federal and/or State laws.

As part of RLDatix’s commitment to the inclusion of all qualified individuals, we ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation in the job application and interview process. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in either step, please don’t hesitate to send a note to accessibility@rldatix.com.

Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including location, relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, licensure or certifications obtained. Market and organizational factors are also taken into consideration.

Quality Assurance Engineer  - RF-SMART for NetSuite

US East Office (Jacksonville, FL)We exist to transform our customers and change lives 

 

 

Who We're Looking For        

RF-SMART is seeking a QA Engineer to test enterprise grade software in a fast-paced scrum development team at our US East Office in Jacksonville, FL. The QA Engineer job description encompasses two main roles: testing and documentation. After Software Developers complete their development tasks, Quality Assurance Engineers test them. They use a variety of tools, testing applications and reports to compare the software to user requirements. They ensure that the software functions according to those requirements. After testing, Quality Assurance Engineers recommend changes and improvements for software. They work with developers to make the appropriate changes and then test everything all over again.

What You'll Do:

Quality Assurance Engineers document the entire quality testing process. They describe the program, evaluation, testing methods, and any improvements made to the software. Because Quality Assurance Engineers work so closely with the software, they often create training materials and instruct users how to use the software properly. The QA Engineer will be responsible for creating an end-to-end test plan, executing the plan, and managing all activities in the plan to ensure that all the objectives are met, and that the solution works as expected. The solution should be tested in terms of functionality, performance, reliability and stability.

  • Developing and executing software test plans
  • Identifying and facilitating issue resolution with functional and technical groups
  • Documenting and communicating test results
  • Testing alongside DevOps initiatives to shift-left in testing approach
  • NetSuite and Supply Chain/Warehousing knowledge would be a big plus

What You Bring:

  • BS in Computer Science or related field or equivalent professional experience
  • 3-5 years’ experience testing in an Agile environment
  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail
  • Jira and X-ray experience or similar technology
  • Able to run and debug automation tests in JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Able to write automation tests with training
  • Understanding of Playwright, Puppeteer, and/or Jasmine testing frameworks
  • Experience with NetSuite and Supply Chain/ Warehousing knowledge, or other WMS systems

What To Expect: 

  • Initial Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 
  • Hiring Manager Interview with Sr QA Manager 
  • QA Team Panel Interview 
  • Cross Functional Team Panel Interview with Agile Delivery Specialist, Developers, Product Owner 
  • Executive Interview with AVP of Product Engineering 

 

Why You’ll Love It Here: Working at RF-SMART means joining a culture that values growth, collaboration, and innovation. As a Quality Assurance Engineer II, you'll work alongside a passionate team dedicated to making a difference—both for our customers and our employees.

 Employer does not sponsor applicants for employment visa status (e.g. H-1B visa status).General Information:  The above noted job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities that may be assigned, but rather to give a general sense of the responsibilities and expectations of the job. As the nature of business demands change so, too, may the essential functions of this specific position and/or the skills and abilities required. RF-SMART is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer.
