descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer with a functional focus, you specialize in designing and executing testing for applications and systems built using custom technologies. Your expertise spans across all levels of testing, including functional, system integration, and end-to-end testing.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Design Test Scenarios: Create optimized test scenarios, plan testing activities, estimate work efforts, and identify test environment and data requirements to ensure thorough testing of applications and systems.
  • Execute Testing: Perform manual and automation testing, execute test cases, report test status, and address defects through creation, triage, and resolution to ensure high-quality deliverables.
  • Analyze Test Outcomes: Apply analytical and cognitive techniques to analyze test outcomes, driving continuous improvements in testing processes and overall quality.
  • Utilize Testing Tools: Leverage various testing tools, BDD/TDD approaches, and test accelerators to enhance test efficiency and quality, ensuring optimal testing outcomes.
  • Report Defects: Identify, document, and report defects, collaborating with teams to resolve issues and improve overall product quality.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Exposure to Testing Methodologies: Experience working with various testing methodologies, including functional, system integration, and end-to-end testing, with the ability to design and execute testing for applications and systems built using custom technologies.
  • Core Testing Skills: Exposure to core testing, technical testing, and business domain/processes, enabling the creation of optimized test scenarios, planning testing activities, estimating work efforts, and identifying test environment and data requirements.
  • Testing Tools and Techniques: Experience working with various testing tools, BDD/TDD approaches, and test accelerators to enhance test efficiency and quality.
  • Manual and Automation Testing: Exposure to both manual and automation testing, including executing test cases, reporting test status, and addressing defects through creation, triage, and resolution.
  • Analytical and Cognitive Techniques: Experience applying analytical and cognitive techniques to analyze test outcomes, driving continuous improvements in testing processes and overall quality.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Proficiency in BDD/TDD: Experience working with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD) approaches to enhance test efficiency and quality, ensuring optimal testing outcomes.
  • Familiarity with Test Accelerators: Exposure to test accelerators, leveraging them to streamline testing processes and improve overall quality.
  • Knowledge of Testing Tools: Experience working with various testing tools, utilizing them to enhance test efficiency and quality, and ensuring thorough testing of applications and systems.
  • Preferred Skills: BigData developer, PySpark, Hive, Google Cloud, Python, ETL, Testing

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Flexjet is currently seeking a QA Automation Engineer. The QA Automation Engineer analyzes the functionality of applications and designs automated tests to validate their performance and reliability. Completes development, execution, and documentation of test plans and scripts. Assists non-QA resources in the planning and execution of user acceptance testing.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Maintain, design, and implement test automation frameworks for a continuous integration and execution model.
  • Create and design the testing approach (Unit, Functional, Integration, System, User).
  • Create automation tests by analyzing user stories, acceptance criteria, creating initial test designs, writing scripts, installing the automation testing tools, and reporting results.
  • Develop a repeatable process for designing, developing, and executing scripts.
  • Conduct tests, document, and analyze test results, and present findings to development teams.
  • Preparing reports on all aspects related to software testing.
  • Participating in project meetings including Agile/Scrum grooming, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and daily stand-ups.
  • Collaborate within an agile software development process with software engineers, subject matter experts and stakeholders.

Education & Experience

  • Understanding and knowledge of software engineering concepts and methodologies.
  • Understanding of test cases and negative, positive and regression testing.
  • Understanding of automation testing and experience writing automation tests for REST APIs and UI.
  • Experience with writing automation tests using one or more of the following: Postman, Playwright, SpecFlow, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, ect.
  • Extremely proficient in one or more development languages (i.e. C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc.).
  • Knowledge of industry best practices for manual, automation and performance testing.
  • Experience with deployments and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience gathering, refining, and validating business/technical requirements, interdependencies, cross-functional dependencies & risks/issues.
  • Knowledge of application functions, bug fixing, and testing practices.
  • Experience with system/platform integrations and the ability to work cross-functionally.
  • Shows initiative and is motivated to learn.
  • Strong communication skills (oral and written); ability to communicate technical information to non-technical people.
  • Strong interpersonal, collaboration and consultative skills.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem solving.
  • Strong attention to detail and committed to a high level of accuracy & quality.

descriptionHtml:

As a QA/Test Engineer within IBM Infrastructure, you will ensure the quality, reliability, performance, and security of enterprise software solutions. You will work closely with developers, architects, product managers, and support teams to design and execute comprehensive testing strategies, automate test coverage, identify defects, and drive continuous quality improvements throughout the software development lifecycle.

Your Role And Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and execute functional, integration, system, regression, performance, and end-to-end test plans.
  • Develop and maintain automated test frameworks, scripts, and test suites to improve test coverage and efficiency.
  • Collaborate with software developers and product teams to understand requirements and ensure quality is built into the development process.
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects through resolution.
  • Validate new features, enhancements, and bug fixes to ensure they meet functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Participate in code reviews, design reviews, sprint planning, and agile development activities.
  • Perform root cause analysis of product defects and work with engineering teams to drive corrective actions.
  • Contribute to continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines by integrating automated testing and quality gates.
  • Monitor product quality metrics and recommend improvements to testing processes, tools, and methodologies.
  • Create and maintain test documentation, validation reports, and quality assurance standards.

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Understanding of software testing methodologies, test design techniques, and quality assurance principles.
  • Experience developing and executing manual and automated test cases.

  • Familiarity with test automation frameworks and tools.
  • Knowledge of defect tracking and test management tools.
  • Experience with Linux/Unix operating systems and command-line environments.
  • Understanding of REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems testing.
  • Knowledge of source control systems such as Git.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Experience building and maintaining enterprise-scale test automation frameworks.
  • Knowledge of cloud-native technologies including Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, and containerized applications.
  • Experience testing storage, backup, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, or infrastructure management solutions.
  • Familiarity with performance, scalability, reliability, and security testing.
  • Experience with API automation, UI automation, and service virtualization tools.
  • Knowledge of observability, monitoring, logging, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) concepts.
  • Experience with AI-assisted testing, test analytics, or intelligent automation solutions.
  • Familiarity with IBM Infrastructure technologies, Red Hat OpenShift, hybrid cloud platforms, and enterprise software environments.

descriptionHtml:
Description

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Do you want to invent, disrupt and redefine what entertainment means for fans, creators, and communities all around the globe?

As part of the Prime Video team, you’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. Also, you’ll get to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented creatives, technologists, marketing professionals and so much more, you can decide where a career with Prime Video takes you!

Join Amazon's Prime Video Ads QA team, where we ensure seamless ad delivery across millions of customers worldwide and deliver high-quality advertising experiences at scale.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for Prime Video Ads platform, ensuring high coverage across functional, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Participate in org-level quality initiatives and define QA strategy & test plans across multiple concurrent projects, collaborating with engineering, product, and data science teams.
  • Leverage AI in test automation to generate test cases, predict risk areas, detect anomalies, and accelerate defect resolution.
  • Drive shift-left testing practices by embedding quality early in the software development lifecycle, including requirements review and design validation.
  • Track quality metrics and KPIs, providing data-driven insights to stakeholders on release readiness.
  • Identify gaps in test coverage and proactively drive improvements to reduce customer-impacting defects.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, ensuring automated tests are integrated and executed efficiently across build and deployment workflows.

A day in the life

As a QAE on the Prime Video Ads team, your day involves collaborating with engineers, program and product managers to review requirements, identify risks early, and define test strategies. You'll write and review automation scripts, triage failures in CI/CD pipelines, and leverage AI tools to improve test coverage. You will optimize QA processes using AI adoption. You'll participate in sprint ceremonies, contribute to design reviews, and mentor junior QA engineers. You'll also partner with development teams to validate ad delivery and measurement accuracy, and present quality metrics to stakeholders to drive release readiness decisions.

About The Team

The Prime Video Ads QA team is at the forefront of ensuring seamless and high-quality advertising experiences for millions of customers worldwide. We are a passionate group of quality engineers who thrive on innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Our team works closely with engineering, product, and data science teams to deliver reliable and impactful advertising solutions at scale. We embrace a culture of ownership, where every team member is empowered to drive quality initiatives and make a meaningful impact. We are committed to leveraging AI tools and automation to stay ahead in a fast-paced, ever-evolving landscape.

Basic Qualifications

  • 1+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience in manual testing
  • Experience in automation testing
  • Experience in UI and API automation testing (Selenium/SOAPUI)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in API & Mobile testing
  • Experience designing and planning test conditions, test scripts, and test data sets to ensure appropriate and adequate coverage and control

Licenses and Certifications

Conducts research to define problems and prepares responses to anticipated questions. Prioritizes multiple issues and opportunities. Identifies relationships and linkages within several information sources. Anticipates issues that are not readily apparent on the surface. Identifies root causes and effects. Defines priorities within performance objectives. Reports and identifies areas that need guidance in order to resolve complex issues. Anticipates the possible outcome of potential solutions
  • Business Function Knowledge: Involves the key players in identifying operating needs, issues and solutions. Proposes technical plans that are aligned with business objectives and technical requirements. Takes and leads actions to enhance business function standards and performance with the participation of business and technical partners
  • Consulting: Conducts investigations and interprets issues within operational and professional contexts. Provides guidance and counsel. Suggests caution to impacted areas as appropriate in relation to matters of policy interpretation and implementation of operational improvement. Conducts discussions that share information and trigger solutions and improvements

Understands client’s expectations and takes initiatives to meet and exceed them. Monitors progress and updates client and management as to status. Educates clients in ways of using products and services. Quickly and effectively solves customer problems. Develops trust and credibility with the customer
  • Information Seeking: Utilizes a variety of information and data sources pertaining to organizational and professional trends. Checks the source for omission and accuracy. Relates and manipulates data from various sources to create a fuller picture. Analyzes multiple alternatives, risks and benefits for a range of potential solutions. Recommends resource requirements and collaborates with impacted stakeholders

Overview

Good things are happening at Berkshire Hathaway GUARD Insurance Companies —an A+ (Superior) rated, nationwide Property & Casualty insurer backed by Berkshire Hathaway. With supportive leadership, collaborative teams, and opportunities to grow, GUARD is a place where people build meaningful, long‑term careers.

Good Things You Can Count On.

  • Hybrid schedule: 2 days remote / 3 in‑office
  • Predictable hours (no nights, weekends, or holidays)
  • Competitive pay + generous PTO
  • Medical, dental & vision starting day one
  • 401(k), tuition reimbursement & longevity bonuses

Responsibilities

We are seeking a skilled and experienced QA Automation Engineer to design, develop, and maintain robust automated testing solutions. This role requires a deeper understanding of automation frameworks and the ability to lead testing efforts for complex features and systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement scalable and maintainable automated test frameworks using Tricentis Tosca and other tools.
  • Analyze business and functional requirements related to P&C insurance systems and translate them into effective automated test strategies and plans.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, API testing, accessibility testing across web and backend systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business analysts, developers, and product owners to ensure test coverage and quality.
  • Execute automated test cases, log defects, and track them to closure using Azure DevOps.
  • Develop automated tests for APIs, UI, and backend systems.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and review their test scripts.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Analyze test results, identify trends, and provide actionable insights.
  • Maintain test documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing across QA teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in software testing, preferably in the P&C insurance domain
  • 3–5 years of experience in test automation.
  • Proficiency in test automation tools, with a strong emphasis on Tricentis Tosca and Playwright; experience with Selenium, Cypress, or similar automation frameworks is also preferred.
  • Proficiency in SQL for backend/database testing.
  • Experience with API testing using tools like Postman or REST Assured.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Strong understanding of Agile QA methodologies, test planning, and defect management.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills.

Optional Certifications (Preferred But Not Required):

  • Tricentis Tosca Automation Specialist Level 1 & 2
  • ISTQB Certified Tester – Advanced Level Test Automation Engineer
  • Certified Agile Tester (CAT)
  • Certified Jenkins Engineer (CJE)
  • Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional

Salary Range $56,000.00 - $130,000.00

In accordance with applicable pay transparency laws, this range represents a good-faith estimate. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, credentials, geographic location, and other considerations permitted by law.

This role may be based out of any of our office locations, including:

Parsippany, NJ; Conshohocken, PA; Wilkes ‑ Barre, PA; Alpharetta, GA; Scottsdale, AZ

Interview Integrity Notice: Berkshire Hathaway GUARD is committed to a fair and consistent hiring process. Candidates are expected to participate independently in interviews. Unauthorized recording, transcription, AI note-taking, or AI interview assistance tools may not be used during interviews without prior approval.

  • Lead defect triage sessions, quality reviews, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Integrate automated testing within CI/CD pipelines to enable efficient and reliable continuous delivery.
  • Define quality metrics, reporting standards, and testing governance across modernization programs.

  • Medication fulfillment
  • Inventory management

  • API & Backend Testing: Postman, REST APIs, API Validation
  • Service Integration Testing
  • Data Validation: SQL, ETL Testing, Big Data Validation, Spark, Hadoop
  • DevOps & Tools: CI/CD Pipelines, Git, JIRA. Test Management Tools

  • 3+ years of Pharmacy/Retail domain testing experience preferred.

  • Proven experience in end-to-end and integration testing of enterprise applications.
  • Knowledge of:

Software Quality Assurance Engineer

Seeking a Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Application Development QA team. This position is ideal for a hands-on QA professional with strong manual testing experience and exposure to test automation. We are looking for someone who enjoys finding defects, validating business requirements, and ensuring software quality throughout the development lifecycle.



What You'll Do

  • Create, maintain, and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scripts for web, desktop, and API applications.
  • Perform hands-on manual testing, including functional, regression, smoke, integration, and exploratory testing.
  • Design and maintain automated test scripts using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, WebDriverIO, or similar technologies.
  • Validate applications against business requirements, user stories, and technical specifications.
  • Document, prioritize, and track defects through resolution using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
  • Partner closely with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to ensure software quality throughout the SDLC.
  • Execute regression testing activities prior to production releases.
  • Provide testing status, quality metrics, and risk assessments to leadership and project teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on Software QA experience.
  • Strong background in manual testing with proven experience creating and executing test cases.
  • Experience performing functional, regression, smoke, integration, and exploratory testing.
  • At least 1 year of hands-on automation experience using Playwright, Cypress, WebDriverIO, or similar tools.
  • Ability to write and maintain automation scripts using JavaScript, TypeScript, or Node.js-based technologies.
  • Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar defect management platforms.
  • Strong understanding of testing methodologies, SDLC, and Agile development practices.
  • Experience testing web-based applications; desktop and API testing experience is a plus.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a genuine hands-on tester who has spent the majority of their career performing manual QA while developing some automation capabilities along the way. We are seeking someone who can confidently discuss testing methodologies, test case design, defect management, and automation tools they have personally used in production environments. This is not a role for a pure automation engineer, framework architect, or QA manager. It is a hands-on testing position requiring strength in both manual QA fundamentals and automation scripting.

Support the Product Development team by providing Quality Assurance with for software development, maintenance, and support. Job Description

The American Express Travel & Lifestyle Services (TLS) Test Team validates travel-related products and capabilities across the TLS product suite.

The Quality Engineer II supports User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Quality Assurance (QA) by preparing test strategies, developing and executing test scripts, maintaining test data and environments, logging results, and supporting defect resolution. This role executes against the portfolio-level test and automation strategy and supports delivery in a Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) environment.

The Quality Engineer II partners with Product Managers, vendors, American Express developers, and technical teams to coordinate end-to-end testing across the TLS portfolio and ensure quality principles and processes are consistently applied throughout software delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinates and facilitates UAT/E2E testing activities across programs and large projects.
  • Creates and maintains comprehensive test data sets to support systems integration, regression, and customer journey testing, ensuring accurate and reliable results.
  • Monitors and tracks defect resolution, partnering with development teams to support timely and effective fixes.
  • Participates in design discussions to identify quality risks early and recommend refinements to user story requirements.
  • Defines, documents, and analyzes quality assurance metrics, including defect trends, test results, and test status, to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Supports core quality principles and promotes adherence to quality standards, engineering practices, and continuous improvement.
  • Develops, enhances, and maintains CI/CD automation processes, ensuring automated tests are integrated and executed effectively within delivery pipelines.
  • Collaborates with product and business teams to align quality engineering activities with business objectives.
  • Integrates agentic AI tools into test design, documentation, execution, and defect management workflows to improve testing efficiency and coverage across applications and systems
  • Uses agentic AI analysis capabilities to identify defect patterns, testing gaps, and quality risks, providing recommendations for process improvements
  • Applies agentic AI testing and automation capabilities within continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines to enhance quality and delivery outcomes
  • Applies responsible AI principles when using AI-enabled tools, including data privacy, bias awareness, human oversight, traceability, and validation of AI-generated outputs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or another technical discipline, or equivalent work experience required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in QA, UAT, or software testing.
  • Experience with Agile, Agile at scale (SAFe), and other iterative application development methods
  • Proficiency with Rally, JIRA, or similar development and defect tracking applications.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Able to work flexible hours with occasional overtime as needed.
  • Knowledge of testing methodologies, test data management tools, and at least one programming or scripting language.
  • Working knowledge of AI-enabled testing capabilities within quality engineering, automation, and defect management tools.
  • Understanding of AI use cases in software testing, including automated test generation, defect analysis, reporting, and test optimization techniques

Work Experience

  • Experience in writing test cases, running functional, automated, or performance tests, and managing and mitigating defects
  • Experience in Software Development Life Cycle (test, defect, reporting and metrics, etc.)
  • Experience in automation and testing in a continuous deployment/continuous integration environment
  • Experience in quality scanning tools, ability to baseline and measure on-going quality metrics, and display via Dashboards
  • Experience in working with the core tools used in the planning, analyzing, crafting, building, testing, configuring, and maintaining of assigned application(s)
  • Experience in application programming interface testing, accessibility testing, chaos testing, security testing, performance testing, user interface testing, disaster recovery and relevant frameworks
  • Desired skills/certification: Automation Frameworks, and Methodologies.
  • Software engineering and development experience or a related job, with a focus on quality engineering
  • Experience applying agentic AI capabilities within functional, automated, performance, or regression testing activities in software delivery environments
  • Experience validating AI agent-generated testing outputs and integrating AI agent-enabled practices into quality engineering and automation workflows

descriptionHtml:
Description

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Do you want to invent, disrupt and redefine what entertainment means for fans, creators, and communities all around the globe?

As part of the Prime Video team, you’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. Also, you’ll get to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented creatives, technologists, marketing professionals and so much more, you can decide where a career with Prime Video takes you!

Join Amazon's Prime Video Ads QA team, where we ensure seamless ad delivery across millions of customers worldwide and deliver high-quality advertising experiences at scale.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for Prime Video Ads platform, ensuring high coverage across functional, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Participate in org-level quality initiatives and define QA strategy & test plans across multiple concurrent projects, collaborating with engineering, product, and data science teams.
  • Leverage AI in test automation to generate test cases, predict risk areas, detect anomalies, and accelerate defect resolution.
  • Drive shift-left testing practices by embedding quality early in the software development lifecycle, including requirements review and design validation.
  • Track quality metrics and KPIs, providing data-driven insights to stakeholders on release readiness.
  • Identify gaps in test coverage and proactively drive improvements to reduce customer-impacting defects.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, ensuring automated tests are integrated and executed efficiently across build and deployment workflows.

A day in the life

As a QAE on the Prime Video Ads team, your day involves collaborating with engineers, program and product managers to review requirements, identify risks early, and define test strategies. You'll write and review automation scripts, triage failures in CI/CD pipelines, and leverage AI tools to improve test coverage. You will optimize QA processes using AI adoption. You'll participate in sprint ceremonies, contribute to design reviews, and mentor junior QA engineers. You'll also partner with development teams to validate ad delivery and measurement accuracy, and present quality metrics to stakeholders to drive release readiness decisions.

About The Team

The Prime Video Ads QA team is at the forefront of ensuring seamless and high-quality advertising experiences for millions of customers worldwide. We are a passionate group of quality engineers who thrive on innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Our team works closely with engineering, product, and data science teams to deliver reliable and impactful advertising solutions at scale. We embrace a culture of ownership, where every team member is empowered to drive quality initiatives and make a meaningful impact. We are committed to leveraging AI tools and automation to stay ahead in a fast-paced, ever-evolving landscape.

Basic Qualifications

  • 1+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience in manual testing
  • Experience in automation testing
  • Experience in UI and API automation testing (Selenium/SOAPUI)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in API & Mobile testing
  • Experience designing and planning test conditions, test scripts, and test data sets to ensure appropriate and adequate coverage and control

descriptionHtml:
Join us at Sparksoft, where we're not just another tech company—we're a catalyst for change. Our mission isn't just to offer IT solutions; it's to revolutionize the way you work. Here, passion isn't just a buzzword; it's the fuel behind groundbreaking ideas and transformative technologies. We serve a wide range of government clients, delivering impact that's felt across the nation.

Our true strength lies in our people. They're the problem-solvers and innovators consistently delivering extraordinary outcomes. With Sparksoft, you're not stepping into a routine job; you're joining a team committed to innovation and excellence. Our innovation extends beyond just delivering projects. Through our specialized Innovation Centers, we continuously refine our methods, ensuring we remain industry leaders.

We are Sparksoft!

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and implement testing frameworks, test processes, and approaches.
  • Design, develop, and execute test plans and test cases to ensure the quality of software products.
  • Maintain test artifacts, including test data, and perform data verification.
  • Execute and evaluate functional, integration, performance, and regression test cases to ensure software products meet requirements, specifications, and standards; report test results.
  • Identify and report defects and issues and track them to closure.
  • Set up, configure, and maintain test suites, with a focus on continuous testing and DevOps processes.
  • Analyze requirements and technical design documents for use cases and user stories, create test cases, and perform impact analysis.
  • Prepare and present testing activity reports to customers and senior management.
  • Analyze and resolve problems in coordination with the Scrum team.
  • Identify, document, and track defects effectively.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Strong understanding of software development, testing principles, and methodologies, with proficiency in a range of testing techniques and tools.
  • Strong technical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Experience working with Jira, Confluence, and TestRail.
  • Stay up to date with the latest testing trends and tools to enhance testing efficiency and coverage.
  • Hands-on experience with API testing and tools such as Protractor, Postman, Selenium, TestNG, JMeter, PactumJS, and Playwright.
  • Participate in developing test plans and strategies to ensure effective testing of EPS applications.
  • Identify and prioritize test cases based on risk and impact.
  • Ensure testing activities align with project timelines and deliverables.
  • Execute automated test cases and analyze results to identify defects and issues.
  • Document and report defects; work closely with the development team to resolve and retest them.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and integration of automated tests using tools such as Jenkins.
  • Collaborate with developers to establish and maintain robust unit and integration testing strategies.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and strong debugging skills.
  • Perform end-to-end testing to ensure application workflows meet business and technical requirements.
  • Work with development and DevOps teams to integrate test automation into DevOps pipelines.
  • Candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
  • Candidates must have lived in the United States 3 out of the past 5 years.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience working on federal projects (preferably CMS).
  • Familiarity with AWS, AI concepts to automate testing scenarios, databases and SQL for testing applications that rely on data storage and retrieval.
  • Experience with automation and core Java to support the team as needed.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in an IT- related field
  • Five years of experience establishing comprehensive testing practices and methodologies.

WHAT WE OFFER:

At Sparksoft, we know that people do their best work when they feel supported, inspired, and connected. That’s why we’ve built a workplace that balances comprehensive benefits with a culture of collaboration and innovation. From flexible time off to professional growth opportunities, we’re committed to helping you thrive both inside and outside of work. When you join Sparksoft, you’ll enjoy:

  • Competitive compensation and a 401(k) with employer contributions to help you plan for the future
  • Flexible paid time off and hybrid ways of working that support true work-life balance
  • Comprehensive health coverage—including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • A curated in-office experience designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Opportunities to give back through Sparksoft Cares, including annual company-wide fundraising events
  • Training and development programs that build new skills and prepare you for leadership roles
  • A collaborative, transparent, and fun culture—recognized as a Great Place to Work®

Accessibility and Accommodations: Sparksoft Corporation is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at Sparksoft.Accommodations@sparksoftcorp.com or call 410-424-7700. Requests are reviewed and fulfilled on a case-by-case basis.

Security Notice: Your privacy and data security are important to us. Sparksoft Corporation will never request sensitive personal information via email. If you receive any suspicious communication claiming to be from Sparksoft, please report it immediately to our security team at abuse@sparksoftcorp.com.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) Policy: While Sparksoft values the appropriate use of artificial intelligence in the workplace, candidates must complete interviews and independent assessments using their own knowledge and abilities. Unless expressly permitted by Sparksoft, the use of AI during interviews and assessments is strictly prohibited. Violations may result in disqualification. descriptionHtml:
At Fastbreak AI, we're here to change how sports operations are managed. With the power of artificial intelligence, we deliver precision scheduling, seamless league and tournament management, group travel, and smarter sponsorship activation for professional, college, and amateur sports organizations. Our platforms support everything from the pro league office to the weekend youth tournament. As our footprint grows, we need a product-led marketing leader who can turn that reach into a pipeline.

We're seeking a QA Engineer who brings both creative problem-solving and rock-solid testing fundamentals to our team. You'll be the detective who uncovers edge cases others miss, the strategist who designs comprehensive test plans, and the technician who builds elegant automation frameworks. This role blends manual exploratory testing with modern automation practices, and you'll have the opportunity to pioneer AI-assisted testing approaches as the field evolves. You'll work closely with product and development teams to ensure our web and mobile applications deliver exceptional user experiences. This is a hands-on role for a self-starter who thrives in fast-paced environments and can balance multiple priorities.

Requirements

  • Apply exploratory testing techniques and user-centric thinking to find bugs that automated tests might miss; challenge assumptions and discover edge cases
  • Learn and implement emerging AI-assisted testing tools and frameworks to optimize testing efficiency and effectiveness
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for web (Next.js, Node.js) and mobile applications using modern frameworks
  • Create comprehensive test plans, write clear test cases, execute thorough manual testing when needed, and ensure proper test coverage across features
  • Take ownership of the testing process, identify gaps, and proactively propose improvements to testing strategies and methodologies
  • Partner with developers, product managers, and stakeholders to define testing strategies, reproduce issues, and advocate for quality
  • Track defects in JIRA, maintain test documentation, use Git for version control, and contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes

Requirements

  • 3+ years of QA engineering experience, preferably in a SaaS or technology company
  • Strong testing fundamentals - deep understanding of test methodologies, test case design, boundary testing, regression testing, and quality assurance principles
  • Creative bug-finding skills - demonstrated ability to think outside the box, anticipate user behavior, and discover non-obvious issues
  • Hands-on automation experience with web and mobile applications (experience with tools like Selenium, Appium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar)
  • Manual testing expertise - comfort with exploratory testing and knowing when manual testing is the right approach
  • Technical aptitude - ability to read code, understand technical architecture, and work effectively with development teams
  • Self-starter mindset - proactive, autonomous, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Curiosity about AI tools - eagerness to explore and adopt AI-assisted testing frameworks as they emerge
  • Proficiency with JIRA for bug tracking and test case management

Location

  • We're based in Charlotte, NC and looking for a team member to work in our offices 4 days a week

Why Join Us?

  • Work with repeat exit founders who have successfully built and scaled startups
  • Work with cutting-edge technology and make a direct impact on product innovation
  • Be part of a fast-growing startup with an agile and dynamic environment
  • Collaborate with top talent across engineering, product, and marketing teams
  • Gain exposure to customer interactions and shape product experiences based on real-world feedback

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits
  • 4-1 Hybrid work schedule.
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance to keep you covered
  • A 401(k) plan with employer contributions to invest in your future
  • The opportunity to shape the future of a rapidly growing and well-funded company and make your mark

descriptionHtml:
About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Quality Engineer with 10+ years of experience in functional and automation testing. The role requires strong functional testing skills, a thorough understanding of quality processes, and hands-on experience with Playwright and Selenium.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, works independently, and learns new technologies quickly. They should bring practical ideas for improving quality, reporting, and testing efficiency through automation and AI-assisted tools.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own test planning, test design, and execution for functional, regression, smoke, integration, API, and end-to-end testing.
  • Review requirements, identify gaps and risks, and ensure coverage of business workflows, edge cases, and negative scenarios.
  • Develop and maintain reliable automated tests using Playwright, Selenium, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and troubleshoot test failures, environment issues, and test data problems.
  • Perform root cause analysis and analyze historical defect trends to identify recurring patterns and recommend preventive improvements.
  • Provide clear quality reports covering test results, coverage, defects, risks, and release readiness.
  • Improve quality dashboards, reporting, and testing efficiency by automating repetitive tasks and streamlining QA processes.
  • Use AI-assisted tools for test design, automation development, maintenance, and defect investigation. Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and reliability.
  • Develop testing approaches for new products built using AI, including validation of functionality, business workflows, and expected behavior.
  • Strengthen quality practices throughout the development lifecycle and mentor junior team members.


Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of software quality engineering experience spanning functional and automation testing.
  • Strong functional testing expertise and knowledge of QA processes, defect management, and the software development lifecycle.
  • Hands-on experience with both Playwright and Selenium, including proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience with API testing using Postman or similar tools.

descriptionHtml:
Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes.

Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. To succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients.

Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise.

Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

As a Senior QA Test Engineer, you will be a key contributor in ensuring the quality of Huron’s enterprise applications. The successful candidate will help define and ensure that Huron’s applications meet high standards for reliability, usability, and performance. You will work closely with the Product Management and Engineering teams in the design, implementation, release, and maintenance of multi-user, dynamic, web-based, and analytics applications. This role requires a passion for delivering exceptional products, the curiosity and drive to understand client application usage patterns and behaviors, the technical skills to develop reusable and automated tests to ensure a high-quality user experience, and the independence and persistence to own and drive quality throughout the product lifecycle. The role requires strong expertise in AWS and Performance Testing using JMeter, Selenium Automation Framework with Java, basic database concepts including SQL queries and data validation, troubleshooting and debugging, and experience working in Agile development environments. The successful candidate must also possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

Under general direction, this individual is responsible for carrying out procedures to ensure that all software, hardware, applications and services meet the standards of the organization and end-user requirements, analyzing and testing software and application configuration to ensure that products meet design specifications and are within total quality management limits and standards. This individual is expected to participate actively in Agile testing methodology including helping to develop quality standards, test cases, software/hardware and application testing, and documenting process and test outcomes. They are responsible for developing, modifying and executing test plans and suites and communicating with product developers and technical support specialists on software issues. In addition, they are expected to perform tests to ensure proper operation and freedom from defects. They may create test data to ensure thorough evaluation, documents and work to resolve basic problems and report progress on problem resolution to management.

The Senior QA Test Engineer applies company policies and procedures to address a variety of issues. They are also responsible for assisting in the development of policies and standards and ensuring adherence to company procedures and best practices.

Position Responsibilities

  • Own and execute manual and automated testing activities across the complete software development lifecycle, ensuring releases meet quality objectives and timelines.
  • Design, develop, execute, and performance test scripts using JMeter, including workload modeling, test execution, results analysis, and performance reporting.
  • Analyze test and performance results, troubleshoot issues, perform root-cause analysis, and work closely with development teams to drive defects through resolution.
  • Develop and maintain UI automation using Selenium with Java, creating reliable and reusable automation scripts for functional and regression testing.
  • Review technical design documents and participate in design and architecture discussions, providing QA perspectives on testability, reliability, scalability, and performance.
  • Estimate QA effort for user stories and defects and develop test plans, test scenarios, and test cases.
  • Generate and maintain appropriate test data to address testing requirements and data gaps.
  • Perform database validation using SQL queries and validate data integrity across application and backend systems.
  • Conduct performance testing to identify performance bottlenecks, capacity limitations, scalability concerns, potential performance debt, communicate performance issues to engineering teams.
  • Identify and communicate release risks, quality concerns, and potential production-impacting issues to QA and project leadership.
  • Participate in bug scrub meetings, release readiness discussion.
  • Evaluate and recommend new tools, techniques, and automation approaches to improve testing efficiency and product quality.
  • Review QA deliverables and provide technical guidance and feedback to other QA team members.
  • Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, and QA teams members to ensure requirements are testable and comprehensive test coverage is achieved.
  • Support QA/UAT/PROD environments and understand the build and deployment process.
  • Support test execution during release cycles and provide quality status, risks, and defect updates to stakeholders.
  • Ensure testing activities align with Huron’s quality standards and contribute to delivering a reliable, usable, and high-performing product.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of QA practices, automation frameworks, performance testing capabilities, and release processes.

Qualifications

Required / Must Have

  • 5+ years of professional QA/Test Engineering experience with strong experience in both manual and automation testing.
  • Good understanding of SQL and database validation.
  • Familiar with AWS services: CloudWatch, EventBridge, QuickSight, Batch Jobs, Lambda, S3, Redshift, Glue, Bedrock.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Performance Testing using JMeter
  • Demonstrated ability to develop, execute, analyze, and troubleshoot JMeter performance tests.
  • Strong hands-on experience developing Selenium automation using Java.
  • Experience designing and maintaining reusable automation frameworks and automated regression suites.
  • Demonstrated experience with data lake, data warehouse, ETL/ELT, or data pipeline testing.
  • Strong troubleshooting, debugging, analytical, and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Experience with functional, regression, integration, system, API, and end-to-end testing.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, JIRA, or similar tools.
  • Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of QA activities, identify risks proactively, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Preferred / Good To Have

  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline integration of automated and performance tests.
  • Experience with Python for test automation, data validation, or test utilities.
  • Experience testing AI-powered applications and workflows.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted testing tools and Responsible AI practices.
  • Exposure to AWS Bedrock, Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.
  • Knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, and Prompt Engineering.
  • Experience working with offshore/distributed teams.
  • Experience in new product development environments.
  • Experience in the Healthcare domain.
  • Experience working with PHI/PII and healthcare data, including applicable data privacy and security requirements.

The estimated base salary for this job is $95,000 - $130,000 USD. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay for performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $109,250 - $149,500 USD. The job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. The salary range information provided is in accordance with applicable state and local laws regarding salary transparency that are currently in effect and may be implemented in the future.

descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're seeking an experienced, automation-focused Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to join our North American Sports product team. This team develops insightful analytics and Recruit products for American Football, helping high-level coaches and analysts make faster, data-driven decisions on player performance and talent acquisition.

As the testing expert within your cross-functional squad, you'll own quality end-to-end — building the strategies and automation that ensure we're shipping software our users love. You'll drive quality discussions, challenge the team to maintain high standards, and be the advocate for reliability and performance at every stage of delivery.

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, You'll

  • Lead quality initiatives. Build risk-based testing strategies tailored to your squad's architecture, drive quality discussions in scrum ceremonies, challenge defect priorities, and continuously look for ways to improve practices and keep your squad's quality processes ahead of the curve.
  • Test across the stack. Design and execute tests spanning front-end UI, APIs, backend services, and data pipelines — validating transformations, service outputs, and complex logic at scale.
  • Automate with intent. Make informed decisions about what, when, and how to automate. Use Playwright and scripting to build reliable, maintainable automated checks that keep pace with development.
  • Mentor and grow others. Use your technical depth and quality instincts to coach teammates, raise the bar for quality standards across the team, and influence how the whole squad thinks about quality.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally. Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Design, contribute to hiring, and invest in your own professional development.

Location

While local candidates in Lincoln and Omaha, Nebraska are prioritized, we're open to remote applicants who reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, North Carolina, Nevada, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

Must-Haves

  • Quality focus. You see the big picture and use it to drive improvements in both quality and velocity.
  • Technical depth. 4+ years of software testing experience with hands-on expertise across the full stack — API testing, backend and data-heavy systems, and front-end validation — plus proficiency in automation frameworks like Playwright and languages like Python or TypeScript.
  • A track record of leadership. You've owned quality for a squad, led testing initiatives end-to-end, defined success criteria, and designed approaches that measurably reduce risk in production.
  • Investigative rigour. You dig to root causes of complex problems, back your findings with data, and measure outcomes.
  • User focus. You think critically about the user experience and let that understanding shape your testing approach.
  • AI-powered working. You actively use AI tools in your day-to-day workflow — for test case creation, failure diagnosis, documentation, and beyond — and look for new ways to apply them to raise the team's efficiency.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Performance testing exposure. Familiarity with load, stress, and scalability testing concepts and tools (e.g. JMeter) for validating API and backend performance.
  • Sports knowledge. Passion for or experience in Basketball, American Football or Ice Hockey — whether as an athlete, coach, or fan — and an appreciation for the unique challenges of sports technology.

About the company

Biorce is a pioneering Healthtech company dedicated to revolutionizing drug development through the power of AI. We are passionate about accelerating medical advancements and improving patient outcomes.

Our team comprises seasoned clinical research professionals, data scientists, and AI experts, working collaboratively to bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and real-world clinical needs.

With an unwavering commitment to revolutionize healthcare, we envision a world where all patients benefit from accelerated and cost-effective access to treatments. Biorce is poised to redefine the landscape of healthcare, shaping a future where innovation and accessibility converge for the betterment of humanity.

About the role

Following our successful expansion into the U.S. and continued growth across Europe, we are seeking a Quality Engineer to help drive our Engineering function from our Austin, Texas hub.

This person will play a critical role in making sure our platforms are as reliable as the science they serve, building confidence into every line of code across our data and AI systems.

Make Precision Possible. At Biorce, AI and biotech meet to change how clinical trials are run, and quality is at the core of that mission.


Who We're Looking For

Someone with a solid background in QA engineering and test automation who notices what others miss. This person should be able to own quality from planning through delivery, building and maintaining the testing frameworks and metrics that keep our platforms at regulatory-grade reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated testing frameworks
  • Plan, run, and track functional and automated tests to catch product misalignments early
  • Collaborate with development and product teams to deliver flawless user experiences
  • Drive quality metrics and continuous improvement in product delivery
  • Ensure regulatory-grade reliability across complex data and AI systems


✅ Must-haves

  • 5+ years in QA engineering, test automation, or software quality
  • Hands-on experience working within teams alongside software engineers
  • Hands-on experience with modern testing frameworks
  • Proven experience planning, testing, and tracking product misalignments through functional and/or automated testing
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and agile practices
  • A detail-oriented mindset


✨ Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with stress or platform performance testing
  • Experience in healthcare, biotech, or data platforms


Why Join Us?

  • A dynamic work environment with an international team, where collaboration and diversity thrive.
  • Work alongside top talent, united by a shared purpose and committed to making a real impact.
  • Get equipped with a MacBook to enhance your productivity and work experience.
  • Benefits package designed to support you and your family's overall well-being.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance options beginning on the first of the month following hire.
  • Hybrid work model offering flexibility to balance your professional and personal life.
  • Company events to celebrate achievements and enjoy time together.
  • Our office is pet-friendly! You'll likely be greeted by a few wagging tails upon arrival.

descriptionHtml:
About NCR VOYIX

NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a results driven Software Quality Engineer with 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance, preferably within the retail industry. The ideal candidate will lead end-to-end quality engineering efforts, including manual and automated testing, API and database validation, defect management, and test strategy execution across enterprise and distributed applications. Working on-site in Irving, TX, this role will collaborate closely with vendors, customers, project managers, program managers, developers, DevOps teams, and QE leadership to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test strategies, test plans, and test cases aligned with functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Perform end-to-end system validation, including functional, integration, system, and regression testing across distributed applications.
  • Develop and execute test scenarios for applications deployed on Kubernetes clusters, validating scalability, resiliency, and fault tolerance under dynamic workloads
  • Implement and drive Behavior Driven Development (BDD) practices and contribute to quality engineering culture.
  • Validate application behavior and performance in edge computing environments, ensuring reliability under constrained network, latency, and offline scenarios
  • Manage the defect lifecycle, including identification, logging, prioritization, tracking, and closure using standard tools.
  • Conduct detailed root cause analysis (RCA) of defects using logs [java, xml, json etc.], monitoring tools, and data analysis techniques to ensure effective resolution.
  • Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, DevOps, and cross-functional teams to resolve issues and improve product quality.
  • Validate APIs, databases, and system integrations, ensuring contract compliance and data integrity across services.
  • Participate actively in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives) and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure adherence to quality standards, testing best practices, and CI/CD processes, while continuously enhancing test coverage and efficiency.

Job Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field with 3–5 years of QA experience in enterprise environments.
  • Strong experience in manual and automated testing methodologies and tools.
  • Proficiency in test automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with API testing (REST/SOAP) and database validation (SQL/NoSQL).
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum and DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira, PractiTest, or HP QC.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including defect triaging and root cause analysis.
  • Working knowledge of object-oriented programming (Java, Python, or similar) for test automation development.
  • Experience in retail domain applications, including POS systems and transaction flows (preferred but highly valued).
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams and stakeholders

This job description outlines the primary duties and responsibilities of the role and is not intended to be exhaustive. The employee may be required to undertake additional duties and projects that are consistent with their skills, capabilities, and the overall purpose of the position

Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job

EEO Statement

Integrated into our shared values is NCR Voyix’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. NCR Voyix is committed to being a globally inclusive company where all people are treated fairly, recognized for their individuality, promoted based on performance and encouraged to strive to reach their full potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at NCR Voyix has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.

Statement to Third Party Agencies

To ALL recruitment agencies: NCR Voyix only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, NCR Voyix employees, or any NCR Voyix facility. NCR Voyix is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Sr. Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our engineering team. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of software products through comprehensive testing activities, process improvements, and collaboration with cross-functional teams.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills with a passion for quality and customer satisfaction, helping to deliver high-quality software products that meet business and user requirements.

Collaboration

Process Improvement

  • Support root cause analysis activities for production issues.

  • Customer Focus with Willingness to travel

  • Continuous Improvement Mindset

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are…

Verra Mobility is a global leader in smart mobility. Verra Mobility Commercial Services creates smart roadways, serving the world's largest commercial fleets and rental car companies to manage tolling transactions and violations for more than 8.5 million vehicles. Verra Mobility is a leading provider of connected systems, processing nearly 165 million transactions each year through connectivity with more than 50 individual tolling authorities and more than 400 issuing authorities. Arizona-based Verra Mobility Corp. currently operates in 15 countries and in 22 languages.

The company is constantly looking toward the future, ensuring it creates relevant solutions today that will work tomorrow. Seeking to understand new customers, regions, and businesses that will shape tomorrow’s smart mobility experiences, Verra Mobility strives to ensure more people around the world reach their destination safely and easily. Keeping its core principles front and center, Verra Mobility is fueled by relationships, driven by impact, guided by what’s right, and energized by what’s next.

Culture

Verra Mobility Corporation is a rapidly growing, entrepreneurial company that operates with a people-first philosophy and approach. The company lives by its core values—Do What’s Right, Lead with Grace, Win Together, and Own It—in everything it does for its customers and team members. The company seeks to grow aggressively, both organically and through acquisition, to continue to be the undisputed market leader with these five core competencies: bias for action, customer focus, teamwork, drive for results, and commitment to excellence.

Position Overview

Verra Mobility is seeking an experienced Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to ensure end-to-end quality of modern cloud-based and legacy enterprise applications through a combination of test design, manual testing, exploratory testing, and automated testing. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Playwright, Selenium, TypeScript, C#, API testing, microservices testing, and micro frontends testing. This role requires the ability to analyze requirements, design comprehensive test scenarios and test cases, determine what should be automated versus manually tested, execute hands-on testing when appropriate, leverage AI-assisted testing/code-generation tools, and mentor other testers.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Analyze business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, technical designs, and system integrations to identify test scenarios, risks, dependencies, and coverage needs.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, test data, traceability, and regression test suites covering positive, negative, boundary, exception, integration, and end-to-end business scenarios.
  • Perform hands-on functional, exploratory, integration, regression, end-to-end, and production-validation testing where manual testing provides appropriate value.
  • Partner with Product Managers, Tech Leads, Developers, Architects, and QA team members early in the SDLC to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, architecture, integrations, risks, and testability.
  • Determine the appropriate testing approach for each capability, including what should be automated, what should remain manual, and the appropriate testing layer.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated UI, API, integration, and end-to-end tests using Playwright, Selenium, TypeScript, and related technologies.
  • Build reusable, scalable, and maintainable automation frameworks, components, fixtures, utilities, and test-data capabilities using sound software engineering principles.
  • Test modern applications built with React, micro frontends, C#/.NET APIs, microservices, and cloud technologies, as well as legacy applications built with .NET Framework and ASP.NET.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and establish appropriate quality gates and automated feedback during development and deployment.
  • Design automation that supports parallel execution, cross-browser testing, test-data management, environment configuration, retries where appropriate, and reliable unattended execution.
  • Analyze escaped production defects and recurring issues to identify requirements gaps, test coverage gaps, automation opportunities, and preventive improvements.
  • Effectively use generative AI/code-generation tools for requirement analysis, test scenario/test-case generation, automation development, test-data generation, debugging, defect analysis, documentation, and automation code review, while validating AI-generated outputs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering (or equivalent experience).
  • 8+ years of software testing/quality engineering experience, including significant hands-on automation experience.
  • Proven ability to independently analyze requirements and create comprehensive, high-quality test scenarios and test cases.
  • Strong hands-on experience performing both manual/exploratory testing and automated testing.
  • Experience testing modern applications involving React, APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud technologies.
  • Excellent communication (written & verbal), knowledge sharing, analytical, debugging, problem-solving, collaboration, and ownership skills.
  • Experience within team environments and Agile project methodologies is a must.

Technical Expertise

  • Strong hands-on expertise with Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, TypeScript/JavaScript, reusable automation frameworks, test fixtures, assertions, test-data management, parallel execution, and cross-browser testing.
  • Strong ability to analyze requirements and independently create and execute functional, exploratory, regression, integration, negative, boundary, exception, and end-to-end test scenarios and test cases.
  • Strong experience testing REST APIs, JSON/HTTP services, microservices, backend integrations, databases, and asynchronous/event-driven workflows.
  • Working knowledge of C#, .NET/.NET Core, ASP.NET Core, React, microservices, micro frontends, REST APIs, and legacy .NET Framework/ASP.NET applications.
  • Strong SQL/SQL Server skills for test-data preparation, backend validation, reconciliation, and defect investigation.
  • Ability to develop maintainable automation using SOLID principles, object-oriented concepts, separation of concerns, reusable components, clean code, and appropriate design patterns.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure, and CI/CD technologies such as Azure DevOps, including automated execution, pipelines, environments, reporting, logging, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong knowledge of risk-based testing, test pyramid, shift-left testing, regression strategy, defect management, root-cause analysis, traceability, test coverage, release readiness, and continuous quality improvement.
  • Strong ability to leverage generative AI tools to accelerate requirement analysis, test design, automation development, test-data generation, debugging, code review, and documentation without compromising engineering judgment or quality.

Aligned With Verra Mobility Values

  • Do What’s Right – We’re committed to doing the right thing for each other and for our customers – integrity is our DNA.
  • Lead With Grace – We embrace the importance of our colleagues and customers and always treat them with kindness and grace.
  • Own It – We foster a culture of accountability and excellence, where going the extra mile is standard practice.
  • Win Together – We are ambitious and like to win, but we know we win more when we include others and work together.

Verra Mobility Values

An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values:

  • Own It. We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation.
  • Do What’s Right. We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous.
  • Choose Courage Over Comfort. We lean into the conversations, decisions and actions that move the business forward, even when they feel uncomfortable. We challenge assumptions, address issues early and prioritize progress over ease.
  • Win Together. We believe in growing and inspiring people together. We seek people who collaborate, value differences, think and act globally, foster an engaging work environment, and recognize and develop others.
