About This Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior QA Engineer to lead quality assurance efforts for our software products. This role involves designing and executing comprehensive test strategies, ensuring product reliability, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to maintain the highest standards of quality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain test plans to ensure full coverage of product requirements.
  • Design, create, and execute automated and manual test scripts to meet quality goals.
  • Prepare and manage traceability matrices to verify test coverage.
  • Generate detailed testing reports and communicate findings to stakeholders.
  • Monitor software changes and update test cases and plans accordingly.
  • Maintain a comprehensive database of software defects and track resolutions.
  • Collaborate with team members and assist colleagues in achieving optimal results.
  • Perform additional tasks assigned by management within the scope of expertise.

Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of software development principles and various software types.
  • Proficiency in formal programming languages, primarily Python and SQL.
  • Knowledge of automated processing technologies and QA methodologies.
  • Familiarity with technical documentation standards and best practices.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Solid understanding of client-server architecture.
  • Commitment to continuous professional development and learning.

Requirements & Professional Experience

  • Minimum 6+ years of professional software testing experience.
  • Extensive experience with QA tools, including defect-tracking systems.
  • Prior programming experience is highly desirable.

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Additional QA certifications or training preferred.

For Chicago, IL Only the salary range for this position is USD$140,000.00 - USD$195,000.00 . Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance.

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. descriptionHtml:
Voted a Top Cincinnati Workplace for 4 years running, Medpace is growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a full-time, office-based Software QA Engineer to join our Information Technology (IT) team. The Medpace IT department creates custom software solutions for our internal and external business users. The Software QA Engineer is responsible for the planning and execution of software testing for one or more of these web-based applications. They will work with developers and end users to understand requirements and write test plans, execute manual and automated tests, and create summary reports.

Responsibilities

  • Review and analyze functional requirements specifications to provide feedback and ensure requirements are testable;
  • Create test plans and test cases per documented requirements;
  • Participate in constructive peer review of test cases;
  • Execute functional test cases to ensure the system is robust and fit for purpose;
  • Report defects and work with the development team toward resolution of the defects;
  • Write test summary reports;
  • Help facilitate execution of acceptance test scripts by end users;
  • Attend regular project meetings (daily stand-ups, refinement meetings, etc.); and
  • Work closely with developers and end users throughout the software life cycle to ensure that applications meet the needs of the users.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT or related field;
  • Excellent computer skills;
  • Excellent analytical thinking skills; and
  • Excellent written, and oral communication skills.

Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Purpose-Driven Work

    • Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence
Collaborative Culture

    • Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
    • Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable
Continuous Growth & Development

    • Office based environment with on-site mentors
    • Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
    • Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
    • Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
    • An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

    • Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
    • Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
    • Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
    • Company-sponsored social events and intramural sports
Cincinnati Headquarters Experience

    • A modern corporate campus designed to support collaboration and productivity
    • Multiple on-site dining options in the heart of Madison Square
    • Free on-site parking
    • Convenient access to on-site 24-7 fitness and wellness facilities

What To Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

LOCATION: Onsite at LSI Solutions in Victor, NY

JOB SUMMARY: Perform quality engineering tasks for new & existing product and process development and improvement initiatives. Quality Engineers are specialized in either Supplier Quality Engineering, Design Quality Engineering, Metrology Quality Engineering or Finished Goods Quality Engineering. Quality Engineers interface with other functions within an organization and with internal and external customers and suppliers on quality-related issues.






REPORTS TO: Quality Manager


 


SUPERVISES: N/A 


 


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:


Quality Engineer I:



  • Assist in the development of Quality Management System (QMS) processes and procedures to ensure compliance with applicable regulations. 

  • Coordinate and disposition non-conforming product.

  • Perform data analysis, and develop, monitor, and oversee metrics reporting.

  • Lead and/or support continuous improvement activities.

  • Support and participate in internal and external audits and inspections.

  • Generate and maintain procedures, work instructions, inspection plans, forms, and templates.

  • Lead and/or participate on Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) investigations.

  • Review/approve verification & validation protocols and reports.






Quality Engineer II:



  • Demonstrate knowledge in the Quality Engineering functions listed above, plus:

  • Lead Activities for the development of the QMS.

  • Responsibility and ownership for product line and/or process Quality Engineering deliverables.

  • Lead continuous improvement activities.

  • Lead Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) investigations.

  • Work independently as a self-starter with minimal direction.






Senior Quality Engineer:



  • Demonstrate advanced knowledge in the Quality Engineering functions listed above, plus:

  • Act as a team lead for Quality Engineers or subject matter expert in a critical field of the Quality Management System (QMS).

  • Identify areas for improvement within the QMS and lead/implement activities for improvement.

  • Able to teach and mentor Quality Engineers in the use of key Quality concepts.


 


DIFFERENTIATING ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:


Quality Engineers each report through a particular focus of the Quality Management System. While most of the essential functions are universal, the following responsibilities are driven by this difference in reporting structure.


 


Finished Goods:



  • Conduct finished goods health risk assessments.

  • Maintain sterilization validations, and act as sterilization subject matter expert for new product development. 

  • Maintain and improve environmental monitoring program. 

  • Develop and maintain process monitoring of Finished Goods team QMS processes.

  • Develop and maintain product/process monitoring of LSIs finished goods products and processes. 

  • Analyze product and process monitoring data to identify opportunities for improvement. Coordinate improvements in finished goods work centers.

  • Provide input to the maintenance of pFMEA, PFD, control plans.






ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBLITIES:



  • All other duties as assigned.


 


EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE: 


Quality Engineer I:



  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in a technical discipline required.

  • 0-3 years of relevant Engineering experience in medical device or other regulated industry preferred.


Quality Engineer II:



  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in a technical discipline with 3 or more years of relevant experience in medical device or other regulated industry required.


Senior Quality Engineer:



  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in a technical discipline with 7 or more years of relevant Quality experience in medical device or other regulated industry required.

  • Master’s degree in a technical discipline with 5 or more years as a Quality Engineer.


 


 


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES: 


The following apply to all Quality Engineer levels:



  • Knowledge and application of ISO 13485.

  • Strong problem solving, root cause analysis and analytics skills.

  • Familiarity with quality engineering concepts and tools, e.g. Statistical Process Control (SPC), Capability Analyses, Design of Experiments (DOE’s), and Process Control Plans (PCP).

  • Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T) Fundamentals.

  • Familiarity with Gauge Repeatability and Reproducibility (R&R) for gauging and fixturing.

  • Strong proficiency in MS Word, Excel, and Outlook.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.






DIFFERENTIATING KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:


Quality Engineers each report through a particular focus of the Quality Management System. All of the knowledge, skills, and abilities listed above are required for all focus areas. The following additional KSAs are required based on specific focus areas.






Finished Goods:



  • Experience in documenting and reviewing risk assessments.

  • Experience in terminal sterilization.

  • Experience in cleanroom environmental monitoring.

  • A strong working knowledge of ISO 11135 and/or ISO 14644.

  • Experience in technical transfer of product to manufacturing preferred.






 


PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT:


The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 



  • Frequently required to lift, carry, push and/or pull from 10-20 lbs.

  • Ability to periodically bend or kneel and use color vision/depth perception.

  • Sitting, standing and/or walking for up to eight (8) hours per day.



  • Routine use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.



  • Regularly required to talk and/or hear.

  • Ability to travel to suppliers on average 25% to support responsibilities defined above (for external Supplier function only).






LSI SOLUTIONS® BENEFITS INCLUDE:



  • Bonus Plan, 401(k) plan with company match, Tuition Assistance, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Product Discounts

  • 15 Paid Holidays, PTO, Sick Time

  • Medical, Dental, Vision effective first day of employment






LSI SOLUTIONS® is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on any legally protected status or characteristic.

Job Summary

Senior Quality Assurance Engineer will play an integral role in the development of our enterprise technology platform. They will be responsible for ensuring that our software products meet and exceed quality standards through the implementation and execution of effective testing strategies. This position requires an individual with exceptional attention to detail, a commitment to product excellence, and a passion for staying ahead of the latest industry trends and technologies.


Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement effective testing strategies that ensure software products meet and exceed quality standards.
  • Design and implement test plans, test cases, and test scripts for Goosehead’s software products to ensure high quality, reliability and efficient test coverage.
  • Conduct functional, regression, performance, and security testing of web applications, mobile applications and APIs.
  • Perform manual and automated test execution to ensure applications meet business requirements.
  • Analyze requirements, identify gaps, and provide feedback to development teams for improvements and bug fixes.
  • Focus on early bug detection, working with developers to apply requirements analysis and the refining of acceptance criteria
  • Provide feedback to the development team on the quality of the product, and advocate for quality improvements and best practices.
  • Monitor the software development process to ensure compliance with standards, guidelines, and regulations.
  • Continuously review and improve QA processes to increase efficiency, effectiveness, and quality of product releases.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior QA team members.


Experience and Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance.
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks, test tools, and scripting languages such as Selenium.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Highly developed software troubleshooting and debugging skills.
  • Excellent bug reporting ability and experience with bug tracking system.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies.
  • Strong attention to detail and a passion for delivering high-quality software products.
  • Track and report on key quality metrics.
  • Experience with performance testing, security testing, and cross-browser/cross-platform testing.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Ability to mentor and train junior team members.
  • Stays up to date on industry trends and technologies.
  • Familiarity with continuous integration/continuous delivery tools and practices.


Preferred Experience

  • Web and Mobile testing experience.
  • Salesforce platform testing experience.
  • Experience with writing and/or executing test Automation.
  • Experience in an Agile environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and an unwavering commitment to ensuring the highest level of quality.


Required Skills and Abilities

  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools such as Playwright, Selenium and AI automation.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Highly developed software troubleshooting and debugging skills.
  • Excellent bug reporting skills and familiarity with bug tracking systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and a passion for delivering high-quality software products.
  • Ability to track and report on key quality metrics.
  • Experience with performance testing, security testing, and cross-browser/cross-platform testing.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Ability to mentor and train junior team members.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of industry trends and technologies.
  • Familiarity with continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) tools and practices.
  • Strong critical thinking and an unwavering commitment to quality (preferred).


Benefits Summary

  • High-quality voluntary health, vision, disability, life, and dental insurance programs

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave
  • Corporate-sponsored programs to enhance employee physical, financial, mental, and emotional wellness

Rockwell is looking for a Senior Software Test Engineer to join an agile team. This team is building and validating FactoryTalk Optix, a modern industrial visualization and HMI platform. The platform is used by customers to design, deploy, and maintain applications for manufacturing environments.

Position Summary

The Senior Software Test Engineer will help ensure the quality of FactoryTalk Optix by creating and executing manual and automated tests for new and existing product functionality. This role will work closely with product owners, developers, and other test engineers to understand requirements, validate features, reproduce and document defects, and support regression and release testing activities. The scope of work is focused on developing solid test engineering practices, learning the product and industrial automation domain, and contributing to a high-quality customer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Create, maintain, and execute manual and automated tests for FactoryTalk Optix features.
  • Validate design-time and runtime workflows to help ensure a reliable customer experience.
  • Lead test planning, estimation, execution, and defect triage as part of an Agile team.
  • Reproduce, document, and track defects with clear titles, descriptions, steps, and supporting details.
  • Collaborate with developers, product owners, and other test engineers to understand requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support regression, release, and exploratory testing activities.
  • Contribute to test documentation, quality procedures, and continuous improvement of test practices.
  • Use tools such as JIRA, QTest, Confluence, GitHub, and Jenkins to support testing and quality tracking.
  • Learn FT Optix product functionality and relevant industrial automation concepts over time.
  • Collaborate effectively with geographically distributed teams.

The Essentials - You Will Have

  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Legal authorization to work in the US is required.

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

  • Typically requires a minimum of 2 years of experience in software testing, software development, test automation, or a related technical role.
  • Experience creating, executing, and documenting manual or automated test cases.
  • Experience developing or maintaining automated tests using Python, C#, or similar programming or scripting languages.
  • Experience with Squish and Selenium test frameworks
  • Experience creating or updating GitHub Actions
  • Familiarity with Linux
  • Experience with C# scripting
  • Familiarity with test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and tools such as GitHub, Jenkins, JIRA, Confluence, or QTest.
  • Exposure to performance, reliability, longevity, or regression testing.
  • Experience with industrial automation, HMI software, PLCs, and protocols such as CIP or OP-CUA

What We Offer

  • Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision
  • 401k
  • Paid Time off
  • Parental and Caregiver Leave
  • Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
  • To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com.

descriptionHtml:
Description

Keeper Security is hiring a Lead QA Engineer to join our Keeper Connection Manager team and help ensure the quality, reliability and security of our secure remote access capabilities. This is a 100% remote position, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the El Dorado Hills, CA metro area.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help deliver secure, reliable remote access experiences for enterprise customers worldwide.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About The Role

As the Lead QA Engineer for Self-Managed Keeper (SMK), you will lead testing for Keeper’s customer-installable deployment, which includes KeeperApp, Vault, Admin Console and the PAM routing stack. You’ll validate installation, upgrades, integrations and secure remote access workflows across enterprise environments, including on-premises and air-gapped deployments. This role is highly hands-on and technical, with a focus on functional, integration, regression and system-level testing. You’ll work closely with Software Engineering, DevOps and Product teams to identify defects, expand automated test coverage and ensure SMK remains secure, reliable and performant across complex deployment scenarios.

Responsibilities

  • Own and continuously evolve the end-to-end test strategy for Self-Managed Keeper (SMK), Keeper’s self-
  • contained, customer-installable deployment of KeeperApp, Vault, Admin Console and the PAM routing stack
  • Design and execute test plans covering install, backup/restore, and cross-version upgrade/migration
  • workflows, ensuring customer data and configuration integrity across releases
  • Lead functional, integration, regression, system and exploratory testing across SMK components, including
  • licensing enforcement, TLS/certificate management, and mail/SIEM/audit integrations
  • Validate secure remote access workflows — PAM Connections, Tunnels and Remote Browser Isolation —including authentication, authorization, session recording/playback, encrypted communication and role-based access controls
  • Drive and expand automated test coverage for the Vault and Admin Console web applications, partnering with front-end engineering on browser-based (Playwright) test suites
  • Build, maintain and mentor the team on the shared test harness and the CI gating strategy that runs it
  • Partner with DevOps/Release engineering on CI/CD pipelines, container image and bundle builds, and multi-distro host preflight checks
  • Test SMK behavior across different operating systems, network conditions, and enterprise/air-gapped environments
  • Reproduce, document and track defects with clear technical detail, logs and steps to reproduce across containerized, multi-service deployments
  • Work closely with Engineering to troubleshoot complex issues involving networking, connectivity, container orchestration, performance and system behavior
  • Lead sprint planning, requirement reviews and release validation activities, and provide technical QA
  • mentorship to other QA engineers
  • Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or similar platforms to support test design, troubleshooting,defect analysis and documentation

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in software quality assurance, QA engineering, or a related testing role, including prior experience leading QA efforts or mentoring other engineers
  • Experience testing complex enterprise software, infrastructure products, or security-sensitive applications
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts, client-server communication, and TLS/PKI fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Docker Compose, and working knowledge of Kubernetes or similar container orchestration platforms
  • Experience testing modern web front ends (e.g., React/TypeScript single-page applications), including cross-
  • browser functional testing and browser automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress
  • Experience with functional, integration, regression and system-level testing
  • Strong troubleshooting skills, including the ability to analyze logs across multi-service/containerized deployments, reproduce complex defects and isolate root causes
  • Experience testing across Windows, Linux and/or macOS environments
  • Familiarity with cloud environments, virtualization and DevOps workflows (CI/CD pipelines, shell scripting, build tooling)
  • Experience working with APIs, databases or backend services as part of end-to-end testing

In addition, the position will be responsible for the creation of automated test cases using Playwright with Typescript or C#.   • 2+ years of experience in developing and using automated testing frameworks
  • 2+ years of experience with .NET test automation frameworks like NUnit
  • Experience in manual and automated testing of REST/SOAP/JSON API using Postman, SoapUI, and Rest API automation libraries
  • Experience in using Microsoft Azure Dev Ops Test plans, Repos, and Pipelines and integrating test automation frameworks into CI/CD pipeline

  • Experience in using DevOps tools like Docker, GIT, Jenkins, and developing test automation frameworks for Azure cloud deployments

  • An opportunity to purchase additional shares of our privately-held stock
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Group health, dental and vision plans
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Short- and long-term disability insurance
  • Tuition reimbursement

  • Visit our website to see all of our benefits: https://jobs-beta.publix.com/benefits/

As a year-end bonus to associates, Publix issues one month’s extra pay (pro-rated in the first year) each year if associate remains employed through issue date of the bonus check that year. This is calculated as a 13th month of pay in the Potential Annual Pay with Bonus line above.

Your application may have additional steps that you will need to complete in order to remain eligible for consideration. Please be sure to monitor your email, including your spam folder, on a daily basis for critical, time-sensitive emails that could require action within 24-48 hours. Please do not use your Publix email address when applying. Once your application has been successfully submitted you will receive a confirmation email.

For this position, Publix does not and will not file a petition or application with the USCIS or Department of State on behalf of any noncitizen for any immigration-related benefit to work and/or to continue to work in the United States, e.g., an H-1B or TN petition or permanent residence.

About PrePass

PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We're transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It's what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.

That's why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to drive software quality, strengthen test automation, and improve testing practices throughout the software development lifecycle. In this role, you'll take ownership of designing, developing, and maintaining scalable automated testing solutions for web, API, and mobile applications while helping ensure reliable software releases. You'll collaborate closely with developers, product owners, DevOps, and the test lead to identify risks early, improve testability, and promote quality engineering best practices across the team. This position offers the opportunity to influence automation strategy, leverage emerging AI technologies, and contribute to continuous improvement in a hybrid work environment.

Our technology stack is Microsoft-centered, including .NET, MVC, WCF, MS SQL, and Visual Studio, with CI/CD pipelines supported by Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.

descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Automation QA Engineer on the Resupply team, you will play a key role in defining, implementing, and evolving our quality assurance and test automation strategy. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you'll partner closely with Engineering Managers, Software Engineers, Product Managers, and other stakeholders to ensure quality is built into every stage of the software development lifecycle.

You will drive the adoption of scalable automation frameworks, establish testing best practices, and provide technical guidance across teams. In addition to developing automated test solutions, you'll be expected to perform manual testing when needed, helping the team maintain high-quality releases while balancing speed and reliability.

This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about modern test automation, enjoys influencing engineering practices, and is comfortable operating both strategically and tactically.

What You'll Do

  • Define and help execute the overall test automation strategy for the SNAP platform.
  • Partner with Engineering Managers and development teams to establish quality goals, testing standards, and automation best practices.
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable end-to-end, integration, API, and UI automation frameworks using Playwright.
  • Identify opportunities to increase automation coverage and improve testing efficiency across multiple applications and services.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and ensure quality gates are implemented throughout the release process.
  • Collaborate with developers to improve testability, observability, and overall product quality.
  • Participate in architecture and design discussions to ensure quality considerations are incorporated early in the development process.
  • Analyze testing metrics and provide recommendations to improve release confidence and reduce defects.
  • Lead root cause analysis efforts for quality issues and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Execute manual testing and exploratory testing activities when automation is not practical or during critical release periods.
  • Mentor other QA engineers and developers on automation techniques, testing strategies, and quality engineering practices.
  • Work closely with Product, Support, and Customer-facing teams to understand business requirements and customer workflows.


What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in software quality assurance and test automation.
  • Extensive experience designing and implementing automation frameworks using Playwright.
  • Programming experience with C#/.NET.
  • Experience testing modern web applications, REST APIs, and distributed systems.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and quality engineering principles.
  • Experience developing and executing automation strategies across multiple teams or products.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and influence engineering teams without direct authority.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and driving adoption of quality best practices.


Nice to have

  • Experience with Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code testing practices.
  • Experience validating infrastructure deployments and DevOps pipelines.
  • Experience with test data management and environment management strategies.
  • Knowledge of performance testing, security testing, and observability platforms.
  • Experience working in highly regulated healthcare or SaaS environments.
  • Previous experience serving as a Test Automation Lead, QA Lead, or Quality Engineering Lead.


What Success Looks Like

  • Establishes and drives a scalable automation strategy across multiple engineering teams.
  • Significantly increases automated test coverage while reducing manual regression effort.
  • Improves release quality and confidence through effective quality engineering practices.
  • Acts as a trusted advisor to engineering leadership on testing and quality strategy.
  • Creates a culture where quality is a shared responsibility across the organization.


Why Join Resmed


At Resmed, our mission is to help people breathe better and live healthier, longer lives. By bringing together technology, innovation, and deep customer understanding, we create solutions that make a meaningful difference. As part of the Brightree team, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to products that support customers while working alongside talented colleagues in a collaborative and purpose-driven environment.

Location: Atlanta, Georgia (Hybrid)

This is a hybrid position and is not a remote role. Team members are expected to be based in the Atlanta area and available to work on-site regularly to support collaboration, planning, and innovation.

At Resmed, your work has a direct impact on people's lives. We develop technology that helps millions of people around the world sleep better, breathe better, and live healthier lives. You'll join a collaborative team where learning is encouraged, innovation is valued, and your contributions matter. This is an opportunity to build your career alongside talented colleagues while helping shape the next generation of digital health experiences.

We are shaping the future at Resmed, and we recognize the need to build on and broaden our existing skills and continue to attract and retain the world’s best talent. We work hard to offer holistic benefits packages, provide flexible work arrangements, cultivate a workforce culture that allows employees to grow personally and professionally, and deliver competitive salaries to our team members. Employees scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week are eligible for benefits. This position qualifies for the following benefits package: comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and life, AD&D, short-term and long-term disability insurance, sleep care management, Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), commuter benefits, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and tuition assistance. Employees receive Flexible Time Off (FTO), 11 paid holidays plus 3 floating days and are eligible for 14 weeks of primary caregiver or two weeks of secondary caregiver leave when welcoming new family members.

Individual pay decisions are based on a variety of factors, such as the candidate’s geographic work location, relevant qualifications, work experience, and skills.

Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

descriptionHtml:
About NCR VOYIX

NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Senior Software Quality Engineer to lead quality engineering efforts for enterprise-scale retail solutions. This role will be responsible for developing and executing quality strategies that ensure the delivery of reliable, scalable, and high-performing software solutions supporting critical business initiatives within CFR space.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with a continuous improvement mindset, leveraging experience in test automation, API and database validation, defect analysis, and Agile methodologies to elevate product quality. They will work cross-functionally with business and technology teams to identify quality risks early, improve delivery outcomes, and ensure confidence in product releases.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute quality engineering strategies, test plans, and validation approaches that align with business objectives, product requirements, and release goals.
  • Lead end-to-end testing activities across distributed enterprise applications, including functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end validation.
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks and reusable test assets, while driving the adoption of Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) practices to improve collaboration, testability, and requirement traceability.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous validation, rapid feedback, and increased delivery confidence.
  • Validate REST/SOAP APIs, system integrations, and SQL/NoSQL databases to ensure contract compliance, data integrity, and seamless interoperability across platforms.
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and manage defects through resolution, performing detailed root cause analysis using logs, monitoring tools, and system diagnostics.
  • Evaluate product quality and release readiness by proactively identifying risks, assessing gaps, and providing data-driven recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Validate application functionality, reliability, scalability, and resiliency across cloud-native, Kubernetes-based, and retail store operating environments.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, Program Management, vendors, and business stakeholders to resolve issues and drive quality improvements throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Champion quality engineering best practices, Agile delivery processes, test automation adoption, and continuous improvement initiatives while mentoring junior Quality Engineers and contributing to quality metrics and release reporting.

Job Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, with 10+ years of Quality Engineering experience supporting enterprise software applications.
  • Strong experience in both manual and automated testing methodologies, including test planning, execution, defect management, and quality assurance best practices.
  • Hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining test automation frameworks using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, or similar automation technologies.
  • Proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language such as JavaScript (preferred), or Java used in test automation and software development.
  • Experience in API, integration, and service validation testing, including REST and SOAP services, with the ability to troubleshoot interface and data exchange issues.
  • Strong expertise in database validation and data testing, including SQL and NoSQL databases, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and consistency across systems.
  • Experience working within Agile, Scrum, and DevOps environments, including integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including defect triage, root cause analysis, performance investigation, and the use of monitoring and observability tools to diagnose issues.
  • Experience supporting retail, fuel retail, hospitality, POS, or other enterprise transaction-based platforms, including validation of payment processing, loyalty integrations, transaction flows, and store operations workflows.
  • Experience testing cloud-native and Kubernetes-based applications, with knowledge of BDD frameworks and practices, scalability, resiliency, and reliability testing, and participation in large-scale enterprise transformation or modernization initiatives

Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job

EEO Statement

Integrated into our shared values is NCR Voyix’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. NCR Voyix is committed to being a globally inclusive company where all people are treated fairly, recognized for their individuality, promoted based on performance and encouraged to strive to reach their full potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at NCR Voyix has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.

Statement to Third Party Agencies

To ALL recruitment agencies: NCR Voyix only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, NCR Voyix employees, or any NCR Voyix facility. NCR Voyix is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes

“When applying for a job, please make sure to only open emails that you will receive during your application process that come from a @ncrvoyix.com email domain.”

descriptionHtml:
About Throne

Throne is a fast growing Series C startup transforming local communities by delivering clean, safe, accessible restrooms to cities, transit agencies, and public spaces. With flagship customers in Los Angeles, the San Francisco Bay Area, Ann Arbor, and Washington DC, and recent launches in New York City, Atlanta, and Seattle, we're rapidly scaling into new markets in 2027 and beyond.

We recognize an unspoken problem: that better bathroom accommodations are sorely needed in most cities. Public and retail bathrooms are neither positioned to meet demand, nor incentivized to provide the quality experience people deserve.

Our mission is to provide peace of mind to the millions of people who set out on an adventure on any given day. That adventure may be big or small. It may involve taking your toddler to the park, driving a stranger to the airport, running a half marathon, or exploring a new city for the first time.

About The Role

Throne is looking for a full-time Software Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer to be a crucial member of the Software and R&D Engineering Teams. Thrones are proprietary technology which include mechanical components, smart plumbing, smart HVAC, various sensors, actuators, and on-board processing systems, cellular connectivity and a solar/battery driven power system. Software QA Engineer will be contributing into establishing QA/QC processes, improving time-to-market and maintaining high quality of our custom firmware and software solutions for internal Staff, and external Users and Partners.

You will work closely with Throne's extended team, consisting of start-up veterans, creative innovators, and portable sanitation experts. We are passionate about defining Throne as the reliably clean option at some of life's most stressful moments. We are ruthless about results, relentless about improvement, and we value diversity, inclusion, and having fun.

The person hired in this role will work a hybrid schedule, and will be expected to work onsite about 3 days a week from either Brentwood, MD (right outside of Washington, D.C.) or Seattle, WA (Industrial District).

The base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $135,000. Actual compensation will depend on a candidate's applicable experience, skills, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including equity.

At Throne You Will

  • Work closely with the product and engineering teams to understand business requirements.
  • Participate in test efforts estimation.
  • Design test cases, checklists and scenarios for different test levels and types using test design techniques.
  • Conduct manual testing of firmware and software to ensure products and features perform according to the requirements and contribute to a lovable user experience.
  • Perform integration testing of hardware/firmware/software components and communicate issues to the relevant teams, ensuring seamless collaboration across departments.
  • Investigate logs, identify and localize issues on production and QA environments.
  • Provide traceability/test coverage information, contribute to the Test Plan.
  • Setup/maintain QA test environment.
  • Optimize testing, considering different contexts and different constraints, by applying various testing practices, utilizing AI and other tools for test and process automation.
  • Contribute to technical and testing documentation creation and maintenance.

We Are Looking For

  • Solid knowledge in software quality assurance with a minimum 4 years of relevant commercial experience.
  • Experience with back-end (API, database testing), web and mobile testing.
  • Understanding of cloud-based architecture and hands-on experience with AWS tools and services (e.g. Lambda, CloudWatch).
  • Understanding of specifics of micro-services and serverless architecture.
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools (e.g. Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, OpenSearch, or similar).
  • Experience with test automation (JavaScript, TypeScript or Python).
  • Willingness to work in a startup lab environment in an active R&D phase.
  • Tolerance to changing requirements and priorities, and context switching between different products.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with on-site and remote teams, and explain technical concepts and issues to less tech savvy colleagues.
  • Proactiveness in giving feedback and improving existing processes.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools for test case generation, log analysis, or automation (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Testim, or similar).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Awareness of security testing fundamentals and/or accessibility standards (WCAG) is a plus.
  • Experience with performance testing is a plus.
  • Experience with testing of IoT and hardware products is a plus.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance, with medical options that are 100% employer-paid
  • Equity for all US-based positions, so you share in Throne's growth
  • Daily access to earned wages
  • 401(k) plan
  • Paid time off that grows with tenure, in addition to paid sick time and paid parental leave
  • Life insurance, AD&D coverage, and short and long-term disability insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Benefits offered to full-time and part-time employees may vary by State.

Throne is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer, and we are committed to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce. We believe that every person has a right to equal employment opportunities without discrimination, and that diversity contributes to the overall health of the organization. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, religion, sex, sexual stereotyping, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, pregnancy (which includes pregnancy, childbirth, and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth, or breastfeeding), or any other protected characteristic. Employment may be contingent upon Throne's receipt of an acceptable and job-related drug test, motor vehicle report, and/or background check, as applicable and permissible by law.

Throne provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs, as applicable by law. If you require an accommodation, please contact us at careers[at]thronelabs.co

descriptionHtml:
The Associate Systems Engineer will be responsible for creating, executing & continuously enhancing manual test scripts within a highly robust, maintainable, and efficient testing framework.

You will be able to analyze the application and testing assets to create robust and effective tests for in-sprint functional, non-functional, regression and deployment testing.

The Testing Specialist will primarily employ manual test strategies but will be expected to begin building a skillset geared towards automation development and execution.

  • Find, track, and prioritize defects and work toward their resolution

  • Participate in release production validation

  • 2 to 4 Years of Testing experience in functional and automation testing
  • Hands-on experience on Jira, Selenium web driver, git, and RestAssured tools/software
  • QT automation using Squish will be added advantage
  • Java, Python, SQL query, Unix
  • Experience in test data management and exposure to test data management tools.
  • Experience in web service testing and automation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Exposure to Agile methodology

descriptionHtml:
QA Engineer

Job Summary

Americo is looking for a QA Engineer to join their team.The Quality Engineer plays a critical role in safeguarding the integrity and performance of Americo’s technology solutions. This role exists to proactively prevent software defects through the design and execution of effective testing strategies, the introduction of innovative QA practices, and close collaboration with technical teams. By ensuring rigorous testing processes and leveraging automation, the Quality Engineer supports delivery of high-quality software that meets regulatory standards, business requirements, and user expectations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and execute structured test plans and test cases to validate system functionality
  • Review business and technical requirements to ensure clarity, completeness, and testability
  • Partner with test automation teams to identify automation candidates and improve test coverage
  • Implement new testing processes and methodologies to improve QA effectiveness
  • Stay current with testing tools, strategies, and industry trends to enhance quality practices

Experience & Qualifications

  • Advanced knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes
  • Experience in writing clear, detailed, and comprehensive test plans and test cases
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and organizational skills
  • Proficiency in SQL, scripting, and hands-on testing (manual and automated)
  • Familiarity with testing automation tools and frameworks
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally
  • Demonstrated ability to introduce and champion QA process improvements
  • Strong commitment to quality, accuracy, and operational excellence
  • Relative experience in the insurance industry preferred

Education: Four-year college education

About Us

Americo: We’re in this for life!

The roots of the Americo family of companies date back more than 100 years. Americo is a life insurance and annuity company providing innovative products to our customers. At Americo, it’s the people who make things work, so we hope you join us!

Compensation

What You’ll Love About Working at Americo:

Our competitive pay and robust bonus program, offered to all associates, will make you feel valued.

Learning and development

We prepare you for success with a comprehensive, paid training program. Additionally, our Talent Development team creates various development opportunities for associates at every stage of their careers.

Work-life balance

We value work-life balance with our generous paid time off; you begin accruing hours every month, and they increase with tenure. All new hires earn over three weeks of paid time off annually, plus 11 paid company holidays! We also support new parents with a maternity and parental leave program, along with paid STD and LTD.

Health and well-being

We are committed to your health and are pleased to offer flexible benefits designed to support you and your family, with high quality coverage and meaningful company contributions.

Benefits include PPO and HDHP medical plan options with HSA and FSA eligibility, along with dental and vision coverage. Additionally, we provide company paid life insurance, disability coverage, a confidential EAP, a wellness program, comprehensive health resources, corporate fitness discounts, and a 401(k) plan with employer matching.

Future planning

Americo offers a 401(k) with a company match. We also have tuition reimbursement programs to further your education.

Giving back

We support several local organizations, such as Ronald McDonald House, Hope Lodge, the American Red Cross, Harvesters, and many more. Our associates volunteer their time and donate money alongside the company to make a difference in our community.

The fun stuff

Americo participates in the Kansas City Corporate Challenge, a great way to connect with coworkers. Additionally, we host events like a Royals Party at the K, a legendary Holiday Party, and in-office events with local vendors to allow associates to step away from work and enjoy each other’s company.

Bustling environment

Our newly renovated offices are conveniently located in downtown Kansas City, within walking distance of your favorite restaurants and attractions. Plus, you’ll receive complimentary paid parking near our Americo offices – downtown parking is a premium, but we’ve got you covered.

BMT Aerospace International provides global companies solutions to meet the deflationary cost demands and delivery expectations in today's business environment. descriptionHtml:
BMT Aerospace specializes in the development and production of precision gears, transmissions and actuators for the aerospace industry.

BMT Aerospace division is firmly focused on international growth being active in 3 locations worldwide: the USA, Romania and Belgium, and has an impressive portfolio of clients such as Boeing, Airbus, Bombardier, Asco and Rolls Royce.

Our mission is to stay market leader by working only with products of the highest quality and by maintaining long term relations with the partners and by showing genuine commitment to the projects of the customers.

Our Quality Engineer is responsible for determining production standards for a company’s products by establishing quality control systems and setting product requirement rules.1. Develops and establishes quality system procedures and supporting documented information in compliance with AS13100, AS9100, AS9102, ISO and customer requirement.

  • Develops and establishes quality system procedures and supporting documented information in compliance with AS13100, AS9100, AS9102, ISO and customer requirement.
  • Ensures the promotion of awareness of Quality Management System throughout the organization.
  • You will host and conduct internal and external Quality Management System audits, responsible for related activities including closing out audit findings, creating audit finding reports and determining proper corrective/preventive actions, as well as, perform follow up and effectiveness of these actions.
  • Provide technical support and maintain a strong working relationship with the operations team.
  • Providing technical support to Purchasing department and Receiving Inspection by reviewing procedures, specifications, instructions, and processes to ensure compliance to applicable drawing, specifications and standards in an effort to resolve Quality and Delivery concerns.
  • Participates in management and improvement of the quality performance of our sub-tiers via on-site audits, root cause/corrective action effectiveness review.
  • Generate, maintain and provide quality metrics to the BMT Management team to drive quality improvement programs.
  • Serve as a liaison to customer representatives for the Quality discipline as needed.
  • Conduct Gage R&R studies.
  • Support FAI activities IAW AS9102 and customer requirements.
  • Other duties applied.
  • Requirements:
  • Understand internal and external customer requirements with high attention to detail in resolving findings.
  • Ability to understand and interpret engineering technical data, such as manufacturing or part drawings, to provide guidance to cross functional teams.
  • Must have excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • Knowledge of aerospace quality standards including AS9100, AS9102 and ISO.
  • Ability to process and communicate information using MS PowerPoint, Excel and Word.
  • Demonstrated ability to interface with all levels of management, as well as, internal and external customers.
  • Organization, planning and project management and decision-making skills
  • Bachelor Degree preferred but not required or 5 years of experience in a quality role.

Language Skills: Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals in English. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence in English.

Reasoning Ability: Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form

Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand. The employee is frequently required to walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 40 pounds

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, weight, height, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, genetic medical information, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Salary: $75,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

  • Prior experience working in the human resources or payroll industries is preferred.
  • Proficiency in test automation tools and frameworks, as well as source control tools.
  • Strong knowledge of software development methodologies.
  • Familiarity with bug tracking and test management tools.
  • Attention to detail and a commitment to quality standards.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
  • Proven leadership abilities with a self-starter mentality.
  • Familiarity with one or more of the following: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, Git, Selenium, Agile methodology, C#, or Java.

descriptionHtml:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Peraton is seeking a Test Engineer to join our team of qualified, diverse individuals. This position is located in Herndon, VA. The qualified applicant will become part of Peraton's Department of State (DOS) Consular Systems Modernization (CSM) Program, for the Diplomatic Technology (DT). This initiative is intended to modernize and consolidate the operational environment under a common technology framework to better support the services provided to CA's customers.

This role requires excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively within a large, diverse program. As part of your responsibilities, you will build and execute manual test steps, automated test scripts, contribute to Agile development efforts and help ensure high-quality software delivery. This position is ideal for early career engineers who are eager to learn, grow, and make an impact.

Work Location: This is a hybrid position with a requirement to work on-site three days per week in Herndon, VA

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Using acceptance criteria, create and execute test steps and conduct manual testing on software applications
  • Work within an Agile Team to plan and develop automated test scripts to support the integration testing requirements of the teams you support.
  • Create, execute, and maintain automated tests using modern frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar tools.
  • Collaborate with developers and testers to validate APIs, web services, and system integrations.

#DOSCSM

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree and 2 years of experience, or a Masters Degree and 0 years of experience.
  • Good knowledge of functional, environmental, operational, and performance testing.
  • Problem-solving skills to isolate and document issues and defects.
  • Ability to program in text-based languages and object-oriented languages (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript).
  • Experience in an agile testing environment including Test-Driven Development (TDD).
  • Exposure to software engineering principles and basic test automation concepts.
  • U.S. Citizenship required with the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active Secret Clearance (or higher). Interim clearances acceptable.
  • Automation Test experience.
  • Familiarity with using AI-assisted development or testing tools.
  • Experience with Selenium WebDriver and Gauge a plus.
  • Experience writing SQL scripts for Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, etc.
  • Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

Details

Target Salary Range: $51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

EEO:Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

descriptionHtml:
Location: Raleigh and Dallas

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

We are a professional services firm with a business unit dedicated to the financial services marketplace. Our teams have been at the forefront of every event that has reshaped and redefined the financial services industry. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic team!

We help our clients transform. Together we are changing the way they interact with their Customers, Employees and Partners alike. We are modernizing their applications, creating new ones and driving business efficiency across their ever-changing platform and channel infrastructures. Everything we do centers around this simple story.

The opportunity

As a Technology Service Delivery Senior, you’ll be based in our Service Delivery Center, which is made up of high-performing US-based colleagues who work closely with our experienced advisory professionals. We deliver Technology project-based work and managed services to our clients. Here, you’ll work as part of a project team and will be responsible for the design, build/configuration, testing, analysis, delivery and support of Technology solutions. This position is fast-paced and ever-changing, which means you’ll need to be a flexible self-starter and be able to manage changing priorities and learning new and rapidly changing technology solutions.

We are looking for Test/Quality Engineers who will ensure quality through test planning, functional testing, automation, API and data validation, and release readiness for our financial services clients. The team leverages test automation frameworks such as JUnit, Selenium, Cucumber, ReadyAPI, and REST Assured, alongside SQL for data validation and CI/CD pipelines to deliver reliable, high-quality software. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role that spans the full testing lifecycle.

Your Key Responsibilities

The goal is to help clients solve complex business problems by ensuring software quality from planning through release readiness. You will define test scenarios and maintain test evidence, execute functional, API, integration, regression, and data testing, track defects and support root-cause analysis, and own assigned workstreams independently from design through production support.

Skills And Attributes For Success

  • Working knowledge and hands-on experience in software testing, quality assurance, and test automation across functional, regression, integration, and API testing.
  • Working knowledge and hands-on experience building automated tests using JUnit, Selenium, Cucumber, ReadyAPI, and REST Assured.
  • Working knowledge of Java/J2EE and Unix/Linux shell scripting in support of test automation.
  • Working knowledge of SQL for data validation and back-end verification.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, quality gates, and Jenkins.
  • Define test scenarios, maintain test evidence, and execute functional, API, integration, regression, and data testing.
  • Track defects, support root-cause analysis, and own assigned workstreams independently from design through production support.
  • Collaborate across product, engineering, testing, and operations teams, and mentor less-experienced team members where appropriate.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 30% of the time.

To qualify for the role you must have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in software testing and quality assurance.
  • Hands-on experience in software testing, quality assurance, and test automation.
  • Working knowledge of Java/J2EE and Unix/Linux shell scripting for test automation.
  • Experience with SQL for data validation.
  • Hands-on experience with JUnit, Selenium, Cucumber, ReadyAPI, and REST Assured.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, quality gates, and Jenkins.
  • Experience across functional, regression, integration, and API testing.
  • Comfortable working in Agile environments and collaborating with business and technical stakeholders.

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Experience with the following technologies
  • Software testing, quality assurance, and test automation
  • JUnit, Selenium, Cucumber, ReadyAPI, and REST Assured
  • Java/J2EE, Unix/Linux shell, JavaScript, Spring, web services, and Angular
  • SQL for data validation
  • CI/CD pipelines, quality gates, and Jenkins
  • Functional, regression, integration, API, and performance testing

What We Look For

We’re interested in intellectually curious people with a passion for finding new and innovative ways to make things better. You’ll also need to be a self-starter and quick learner with a strong background in computer science from both theoretical and practical points of view. If you’re ready to be the future of the group and make your mark in a growing business, this role is for you.

About The Organization

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. So that whenever you join, however long you stay, the experience you gain lasts a lifetime.

Join us in building a better working world.

Apply now.

We are an equal employment opportunity employer (Females/Minorities/Protected Veterans/Disabled) and value the diversity of our workforce and the knowledge of our people.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $80,300 to $149,100
    • Bay Area California offices – $83,700 to $155,300
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $67,000 to $136,800
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
  • Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  • To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
  • EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
  • For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
  • At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

All in to shape the future with confidence.

Description

Publix Super Markets, Inc., the largest employee-owned company in the U.S., is driven by a dynamic technology team of 2,300+ professionals delivering innovative solutions to 1,400+ stores and 260,000+ associates across 8 states.   • Own testing activities, including identifying testing scope, creating testing related documentation, and managing testing resources.

  • Review project documentation to identify test scenarios
  • Convert requirements into clear test cases
  • Document test designs, procedures, and defects
  • Oversee test script execution and validating results
  • Manage defect tracking and issue resolution throughout the lifecycle

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related analytical field, or equivalent experience
  • 4+ years of experience leading testing efforts for hardware and software in an infrastructure environment, including Windows, mobile, Apple, applications, and interfaces
  • Ability to create test plans, test schedules, and test summaries
  • Ability to facilitate defects tracking and problem determination throughout the hardware/software development life cycle
  • Ability to manage several large testing efforts simultaneously
  • Strong leadership, communication, organization, and planning skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with test automation
  • Experience with Azure DevOps

Benefits Information

  • Employee stock ownership plan that contributes Publix stock to associates each year at no cost
  • An opportunity to purchase additional shares of our privately-held stock
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Group health, dental and vision plans
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Short- and long-term disability insurance
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Free hot lunches (buffet-style) at facilities with a cafeteria
  • Visit our website to see all of our benefits: Benefits - Jobs (publix.com)

As a year-end bonus to associates, Publix issues one month’s extra pay (pro-rated in the first year) each year if associate remains employed through issue date of the bonus check that year. This is calculated as a 13th month of pay in the Potential Annual Pay with Bonus line above.

Additional Information

Your application may have additional steps that you will need to complete in order to remain eligible for consideration. Please be sure to monitor your email, including your spam folder, on a daily basis for critical, time-sensitive emails that could require action within 24-48 hours. Please do not use your Publix email address when applying. Once your application has been successfully submitted you will receive a confirmation email.
