About the Role:

As a Software Test Automation Engineer, you will perform a wider range of testing tasks with greater autonomy. You will help design test cases, execute them, and report on their effectiveness. Your contributions will directly impact our ability to deliver high-quality software solutions, making you an invaluable team member in our quality assurance efforts.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement automated test cases based on software requirements.
  • Execute and analyze automated test results, logging defects as necessary.
  • Collaborate with developers and QA team members to refine testing strategies.
  • Maintain and update existing test scripts for improved accuracy and coverage.
  • Assist in integrating automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline.
  • Participate in test case reviews and provide constructive feedback.
  • Conduct basic performance and load testing activities.
  • Support troubleshooting and resolution of automation issues.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of test plans and test cases.
  • Provide input on improving test automation frameworks and tools.


Skills:

  • Intermediate Programming: Proficient in programming languages like Java or Python.
  • Test Automation Frameworks: Knowledgeable in frameworks such as Selenium, TestNG, or JUnit.
  • CI/CD Integration: Understanding of integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins).
  • Performance Testing: Basic skills in conducting performance tests.
  • Defect Management: Effective use of bug tracking and management tools (e.g., JIRA).
  • Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to analyze and interpret test results.
  • Communication: Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Team Collaboration: Proven ability to work well in team settings.


Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Compensation:

$57,400.00 - $98,350.00 USD

This role is eligible for Bonus.

Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.

Additional Information:

Wolters Kluwer offers a wide variety of competitive benefits and programs to help meet your needs and balance your work and personal life, including but not limited to: Medical, Dental, & Vision Plans, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Commuter Benefits, Tuition Assistance Plan, Vacation and Sick Time, and Paid Parental Leave. Full details of our benefits are available upon request.

HII works within our nation’s intelligence and cyber operations communities to defend our interests in cyberspace and anticipate emerging threats. Our capabilities in cybersecurity, network architecture, reverse engineering, software and hardware development uniquely enable us to support sensitive missions for the U.S. military and federal agency partners.

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies

Role

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

  • Know & Grow Your People – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
  • Build Relationships – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
  • Take Ownership – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
  • Customer First – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
  • Shape the Future – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  • Act with Urgency – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Job Description

Mission Technologies, a division of HII, is seeking a highly motivated Software Test Engineer, Associate to join our team. The role operates in our Columbia, MD location and supports critical national security missions.

The software test team is responsible for ensuring the reliability, security and meeting the requirements for customer of the Minotaur Mission Processor.

The Minotaur Mission Processor (or Minotaur Mission System/Suite) is a cutting-edge, government-owned mission management software suite and system architecture. Its core function is to integrate and fuse multiple sensor and data sources—including radar, cameras, and communications equipment—to create a single, common operating picture (COP).

The Software Test Engineer will execute responsibilities across the software development life cycle such as:

  • Test Planning
  • Writing Test Cases
  • Automation Scripting
  • Test Data Management
  • Test Execution
  • Bug Reporting
  • Regression Testing
  • Userability Testing

Why Mission Technologies?

  • Competitive Salary
  • Generous 401K Match Program
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Floating Holidays
  • Parental Leave
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage
  • Wellness Programs
  • Student Loan Repayment
  • Mentorship and Coaching
  • Tuition Assistance Program
  • Collaborative and supportive work environment that promotes a healthy climate

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Devise and apply testing procedures for both HII’s Minotaur product and from outside vendors.
  • Review software requirements and prepare test scenarios.
  • Participate in design reviews and provide input on requirements, product design, and potential problems.
  • Test creation, development, execution, and closure.
  • Analyze test results on database impacts, errors or bugs, and usability.
  • Perform moderately complex analysis and troubleshooting.
  • Design of both manual and automated test procedures.
  • Prepare reports on all aspects related to software testing carried out and reporting to the design team.
  • Support system integration events on various aircraft during ground/flight tests.
  • Potential to fly on aircraft to support system integration, test, and operator training
  • Willing to travel between 10-20% of the time.
  • Application of the principles, practices, and procedures used in test engineering.

Minimum Qualifications

0 years experience with Bachelors in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 4 years relevant experience.

Technical Skills And Additional Requirements

  • Bachelors Degree in Software, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline
  • Demonstrated experience working within a Linux environment
  • Scripting experience in Python, Bash or a related language
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a US level Secret clearance

Preferred Requirements

  • An active US level Secret clearance

Physical Requirements

May require working in an office, industrial, shipboard, or laboratory environment. Capable of climbing ladders and tolerating confined spaces and extreme temperature variances.

The listed salary range for this role is intended as a good faith estimate based on the role's location, expectations, and responsibilities. When extending an offer, HII's Mission Technologies division takes a variety of factors into consideration which include, but are not limited to, the role's function and a candidate's education or training, work experience, and key skills.

Meet HII’s Mission Technologies Division

Our team of more than 7,000 professionals worldwide delivers all-domain expertise and advanced technologies in service of mission partners across the globe. Mission Technologies is leading the next evolution of national defense – the data evolution - by accelerating a breadth of national security solutions for government and commercial customers. Our capabilities range from C5ISR, AI and Big Data, cyber operations and synthetic training environments to fleet sustainment, environmental remediation and the largest family of unmanned underwater vehicles in every class. Find the role that’s right for you. Apply today. We look forward to meeting you.

To learn more about Mission Technologies, click here for a short video: https://vimeo.com/732533072

HII is more than a job - it’s an opportunity to build a new future. Bonus/other non-recurrent compensation is occasionally offered for qualified positions, and if applicable to this role will be addressed by the recruiter at the screening phase of application.

Why HII

We build the world’s most powerful, survivable naval ships and defense technology solutions that safeguard our seas, sky, land, space and cyber. Our workforce includes skilled tradespeople; artificial intelligence, machine learning (AI/ML) experts; engineers; technologists; scientists; logistics experts; and business administration professionals.

Recognized as one of America’s top large company employers, we are a values and ethics driven organization that puts people’s safety and well-being first. descriptionHtml:
TOMZ in Big Lake is looking for a Quality Engineer to join our team!! Reporting to the Quality Engineering Manager, this position will be responsible for the activities associated with Quality Design & Development (QD&D) Control and Assurance during Product Development Process (PDP) activities as well as continuation design & development support for sustaining manufacturing and product distribution.

Essential Functions

  • Develop and execute Quality Plans for Quality Product Design and Development projects.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to initiate and support the development and updates of Risk Management documentation in accordance with project requirements.
  • Establish severity and risk-based Process Master Validation Plan strategies with appropriate V&V rationales.
  • Support operational and process qualifications for customer manufacturing processes in collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Drive Test Method development with Operational and Business considerations and execution of Test Method Validations to measure effectiveness.
  • Implement inspection plans for Incoming, In-Process and Final Product.
  • Develop and justify appropriate sampling plans with characterization of test and inspection methods.
  • Represent Quality Engineering in design reviews.
  • Support initial qualification audit activities for Customer and Regulatory Agencies.
  • Support qualification activities related to supplier and vendor design characterization requirements for projects, including conducting audits and assessments.
  • Support Quality Best Practices and contribute to continuous improvement in GDP/GMP.
  • Apply sound, systematic problem-solving methods in identifying, prioritizing, communicating, and resolving quality issues.
  • Ensure that all site personnel comply with the site-level Quality Management System and training requirements.
  • Support the development of Quality Agreements for external customers.
  • Adhere to the TOMZ Quality Management System.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Advanced Post-Secondary Education, Training or Certification coursework.
  • Knowledge of statistical techniques to analyze process capability.
  • Quality certification(s) (e.g., ASQ CQE, QCI, etc.).
  • Skilled in First Article Inspections and Component Qualifications.
  • Knowledge and experience with external standards: ISO 900/9001, ISO 13485, and 21CFR 820, EU MDR, pertaining to product development, design controls, good manufacturing practices, supplier qualification, auditing, quality control (GD&T, Nonconforming Materials, MRB), Corrective and Preventive Actions, and customer complaints).
  • Experience in effectively supporting audits by customers and external regulatory agencies.
  • Strong verbal and written English language communication skills.
  • Successfully meet TOMZ-specific positional and functional on-the-job training requirements.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • A self-starter capable of working independently and as part of a team, with the ability to collaborate across various functional areas, including R&D, Manufacturing, and QA, to achieve results.

Education

  • Minimum 4-Year degree or equivalent of directly transferrable industry work experience (Engineering or Quality discipline preferred).

Experience

  • Minimum of 2-5 years’ experience in a regulated manufacturing environment.
  • Experience in Class I, II, and/or III medical device manufacturing within a regulated environment (e.g., Aerospace, Defense, Pharmaceutical, etc.).

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to bend, stoop, squat, kneel, and lift up to 50 pounds. Team lift or mechanical assistance required for objects over 50 pounds.
  • Ability to sit for prolonged periods.
  • Exposure to oil, grease, occupational noise, cleaning solvents, dust, metal particles, sparks, coolant, and sharp-edged materials. Personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety glasses, dust masks, ear plugs, cut-resistant or chemical-resistant gloves, and engineering controls may be required.
  • Perform keyboard entries with frequent operation of a computer.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

The Burn-in Test Development Department develops Burn-in test programs to support Burn-in test/QC test, which supports all products ready for release and shipping. This department also develops test programs for NPI (New Product Introduction) test, which is used for testing new platform designs, prior to production.

  • QA test on Burn-in test program itself, make sure test program is stable/functional, maintenance test doc.
  • Setting up environment, performing debug testing, reproducing and verification with different product model R&D developer team.
  • Perform NPI QC testing on FGT model with Burn-in test program.
  • Designing and writing new test case, test specification, for new NPI device model, to confirm whatever hardware/software/firmware of product are good.
  • Support on Burn-in test program maintenance for various model and different team.

Requirements:

  • Experience with Linux and shell script programming,
  • Experience with programming or scripting skills (Python, VB Script, Robot Framework, etc.)
  • Good knowledge of TCP/IP, routing and switching protocols
  • Familiar with databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL).
  • Familiar with front-end languages and libraries (JavaScript, Vue, etc.) is a plus
  • With hardworking spirit and teamwork skill, ability to multitask and quickly react to system/service issues.
  • Highly motivated and responsible, quick learner and self-starter.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

Education:

  • B.S. in EE/CS/CE

The Sr. Automation Engineer is responsible for implementing and maintaining automated UI and API testing frameworks and scenarios. This role will work closely with Automation Architects, Sr. Quality Engineers, other QA Engineers and Developers to ensure that all aspects of the applications have proper testing coverage and overall system reliability, performance and quality.

Deliver effective and efficient technical solutions by meeting key project milestones and overall project deliverables on-time and adhering to development and quality standards. Create, review and approve test plans, scenarios, scripts or procedures that contribute to the overall testing framework. Collaborate and interact with other application teams for integration testing efforts.

Responsibilities

  • Accountable for developing and the effective and timely completion of UI and API automation test activities performed on multiple projects, including driving tasks and milestones to complete within the timeframes of a well-defined project plan and/or sprint that includes planning, design, build and execution tasks, while providing guidance to resolve problems as issues arise.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of current test automation process, procedures and best practices to ensure that all QE work is being performed accordingly. Ability to think outside the box and adjust to IT and business needs collaboratively in order to meet project objectives.
  • Adheres to all organizational standards and best practices.
  • Provide Rough Order of Magnitude Estimates (ROMs) and forecast resource needs for automation projects.
  • Establish and maintain metrics which measure resource productivity, test progress and automation effectiveness.
  • Identify potential improvements, best practices and efficiency to test automation process, implement and/or communicate solutions.
  • Demonstrates strong analytical, problem solving and time management skills.
  • Provide QE input into root cause analysis and conduct lessons learned sessions with IT/BA/QA following each release.
  • Provide transparency into automation activities and defect management to project / program leadership.
  • Should be able to perform setting up frameworks on multiple application platforms for building robust, scalable, and high–quality test automation solutions for functional, regression and In-sprint testing.
  • Work with QE team members, software developers and system and database administrators to trouble-shoot test failures in the various test environments. This may include trouble-shooting database issues using SQL queries, reviewing web server and application server logs, etc.
  • Partner with Automation Architect/Sr. Automation Engineer/Lead on all automation activities to ensure alignment with the organizational strategy and approach.

Qualifications

Knowledge and Requirements

  • College Degree preferred in Computer Science, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 8+ years of hands-on Software Testing, Development and/or Test Management experience, including experience in advanced test automation strategies.
  • Experience with BDD and TDD a plus. Experience with Azure DevOps and Azure cloud testing platforms a plus.
  • Experienced with C#, Java, .NET, SQL or other software languages.
  • Experienced with both UI and Rest API automation.
  • Experienced with Object-Oriented Design and Patterns.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and time management skills.
  • Experienced in working with AGILE, DevOps CI/CD process administration methodology.
  • Knowledge of different test methods/tools such as MS Test, TestNG, JUnit/NUnit, GIT, Selenium WebDriver, and so forth. Knowledge of current trends in automation and ability to quickly pick up and learn new technologies and concepts independently, e.g., AI, ML, IoT,.

AI & Advanced QE Capabilities (Must Have)

  • Ability to create and work with AI agents for testing/automation
  • Use AI tools (Copilot etc.) for test generation, script creation, and debugging
  • Validate and test AI-generated code and outputs
  • Understand prompting and AI guardrails

Total Rewards

Selective Insurance offers a total rewards package that includes a competitive base salary, incentive plan eligibility at all levels, and a wide array of benefits designed to help you and your family stay healthy, achieve your financial goals, and balance the demands of your work and personal life. These benefits include comprehensive health care plans, retirement savings plan with company match, discounted Employee Stock Purchase Program, tuition assistance and reimbursement programs, and 20 days of paid time off. Additional details about our total rewards package can be found by visiting our benefits page.

The actual base salary is based on geographic location, and the range is representative of salaries for this role throughout Selective's footprint. Additional considerations include relevant education, qualifications, experience, skills, performance, and business needs.

Pay Range

USD $101,000.00 - USD $137,000.00 /Yr.

descriptionHtml:
Trilogy Federal drives innovative solutions for complex business challenges across financial management, healthcare, and government industries. Our collaborative, client-first service approach, combined with our commitment to the rapid implementation of pragmatic solutions, has earned Trilogy an unparalleled reputation for delivering transformative results.

Trilogy Federal seeks an experienced Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Summit Advanced Tooling, Lakehouse, and Artificial Intelligence Services (Summit ATLAS) program. The QA Engineer will develop and execute testing strategies to ensure the reliability, functionality, performance, and security of enterprise data platform services, applications, and customer-facing capabilities.

This position will work with engineering, product, and customer enablement teams to validate new functionality, verify system integrations, and support the delivery of production-ready solutions that meet Government-approved requirements and acceptance criteria.

Please note, this position is contingent upon award (anticipated early 2027). This role will also require 1-2 domestic business trips per year.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain test plans, test cases, and automated testing frameworks for Summit platform services, applications, integrations, and customer-facing functionality.
  • Perform functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing to verify that solutions meet documented requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute automated tests for application programming interfaces (APIs), data services, user interfaces, and platform workflows.
  • Validate system integrations and data exchanges across Microsoft Azure services, Azure Databricks, and other Summit platform components.
  • Collaborate with developers, data engineers, and product teams to identify test requirements, establish acceptance criteria, and incorporate testing throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Execute performance, scalability, and reliability testing to identify potential issues before production deployment.
  • Document defects, assess severity and operational impact, and coordinate resolution and retesting with responsible technical teams.
  • Support release readiness assessments by verifying test coverage, documenting results, and identifying unresolved defects and associated risks.
  • Integrate automated testing into Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to support consistent validation of application and platform changes.
  • Verify that implemented solutions comply with applicable Government-approved technical, security, accessibility, and operational requirements.
  • Develop and maintain testing documentation, including test procedures, traceability records, defect reports, and test execution summaries.
  • Analyze recurring defects and testing trends to recommend improvements to development practices, test coverage, and overall solution quality.


Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Five or more years of professional experience in software quality assurance, test engineering, or automated software testing.
  • Experience developing and executing functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end test cases for enterprise applications or platforms.
  • Hands-on experience developing automated tests using Python, JavaScript, or comparable programming languages.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks such as pytest, Selenium, Playwright, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience testing APIs, web applications, and integrated enterprise systems.
  • Proficiency in Structured Query Language (SQL) for validating application data, system integrations, and test results.
  • Experience using defect tracking and test management tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or comparable platforms.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based applications, distributed systems, and modern software development practices.
  • Experience supporting Agile development teams and incorporating testing into CI/CD workflows.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to meet VA personnel vetting, background investigation, and system access requirements.
  • The ability to travel for 1-2 domestic business trips per year.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting VA or other federal agency information technology modernization initiatives.
  • Experience testing solutions deployed within Microsoft Azure Government cloud environments.
  • Experience validating Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or other enterprise data platform services.
  • Experience conducting automated performance and load testing using tools such as JMeter, Locust, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience testing role-based access controls, authentication workflows, and other security-sensitive application functionality.
  • Knowledge of Section 508 accessibility requirements and experience conducting accessibility testing for federal applications.
  • Experience working with sensitive healthcare data and federal privacy and security requirements.
  • International Software Testing Qualifications Board (ISTQB) certification or comparable software testing credential.


Benefits (including but not limited to):

  • Health, dental, and vision plans
  • Optional FSA
  • Paid parental leave
  • Safe Harbor 401(k) with employer contributions 100% vested from day 1
  • Paid time off and 11 paid holidays
  • No cost group term life/AD&D plan, and optional supplemental coverage
  • Pet insurance
  • Monthly phone and internet stipend
  • Tuition and training reimbursement


To cut down on falsified applications and to avoid subjecting real candidates to screening by AI assistants, phone interviews at Trilogy require either a landline or a cellphone number backed by a physical SIM. We cannot conduct interviews with candidates who provide VOIP contact numbers (including Google Voice).

This range is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as Trilogy Federal conducts an individual equity review for every candidate based on experience, location, education, industry experience, and comparisons to internal pay bands. In addition to salary, Trilogy offers robust benefits including medical/dental/vision insurance coverage, 401(k) match, paid holidays, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and a very supportive work/life balance.

Zipliens is a specialized lien resolution partner designed to maximize productivity and profitability for personal injury law firms. By shifting the burden of subrogation and lien management away from firm resources, Zipliens frees up legal teams to focus on revenue-generating tasks and trial preparation.

The company's team of experts handles a wide variety of healthcare and insurance liens, including Medicare Parts A, B, C, and D, Medicaid across all 50 states, VA/Champva, Tricare, private health insurance (ERISA, Non-ERISA, FEHBA), hospital liens, and outstanding medical provider bills. Combining speed with high-quality reductions, Zipliens offers complete process transparency through a dedicated customer portal where firms can easily monitor real-time case progress and communicate directly with the handling attorney or analyst.

Trusted by top US law firms, Zipliens makes subrogation simple, ensuring optimal outcomes and putting more money back into clients' pockets.
companySlogan: Your Total Solution for Lien Resolution
descriptionHtml:
Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms. Our work helps law firms operate more efficiently and helps the injured people they serve access settlement funds more quickly and accurately. We are looking for a quality engineer who is passionate about building the testing and evaluation that keeps complex, data-heavy products working correctly at scale.

Zipliens is looking for a Quality Engineer to join our team and own quality for a product area within the applications we build for the legal industry. After several years of high growth, Zipliens has become a leader in lien resolution, a process required in most personal injury settlements. The software we build supports that work, so the quality of what we ship has a clear, real-world impact on law firms and the people they represent.

We're scaling engineering significantly this year, and quality engineering is growing along with it. QA at Zipliens is embedded in the engineering teams and combines exploratory testing with automation. You'd own quality for a feature or product area, including the test strategy, the automation behind it, and the release sign-off for that area. You'll have established patterns and existing test suites to work from, and you'll help improve them as the team grows.

We also build with AI as a first-class part of the workflow, and that applies to testing as much as to development. Our product uses LLMs to extract structure from medical records and lien correspondence, so evaluating non-deterministic output is a regular part of the job. We also use agentic coding tools and internal skills and harnesses we've written ourselves to build and maintain automation, and you'd be expected to use those tools well, review what they produce, and help improve them.

Requirements

Responsibilities:

  • Own quality for a feature or product area, including the risk-based test strategy, the regression scope, and the release sign-off for that area
  • Build and maintain the automated test suites for your area and keep them integrated with CI. When tests fail or become flaky, you'll troubleshoot them and fix the underlying cause
  • Run exploratory testing against the lien workflow and develop a detailed understanding of the applications your team owns, including their risk areas and failure modes
  • Test our LLM-based features. This includes building the evaluation suite for a feature, setting acceptance thresholds with product (for example, precision and recall targets for extraction), checking LLM-judge agreement against human labels, and adding adversarial and prompt-injection cases
  • Use agentic coding tools to build and maintain automation, and review AI-generated tests before they merge
  • Join refinement early enough to shape Acceptance Criteria with the Product Owner, flag testability gaps before development starts, and recommend coverage and risk priorities for your area
  • Shepherd defects for your area from triage through resolution, writing clear, reproducible reports that engineers can act on
  • Work directly with the engineers on your team day to day. QA at Zipliens is embedded in the engineering teams rather than run as a separate function

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years on a QA or software development team, including experience owning test coverage for a feature or product area
  • Strong skills in at least one of exploratory testing and test design, test automation and infrastructure, or AI/LLM evaluation, with working proficiency in a second. We don't expect the same depth in all three
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated test suites in a modern framework (Playwright, Cypress, pytest, or similar), including diagnosing flaky tests and fixing their root causes
  • Comfortable reading and writing code. Our backend is Python/Django and our frontend is React, and you should be able to read a change in either and understand what it affects and what it puts at risk
  • Experience integrating tests into CI pipelines and deciding which checks should gate a merge or a deploy
  • Strong SQL. Much of what we test lives in PostgreSQL, and verifying a workflow often means verifying the data it produced as well as what the UI shows
  • Hands-on experience testing LLM or ML features, whether in production or through prototypes and experimentation: building golden datasets, measuring output quality, and understanding how these systems fail
  • Experience using or experimenting with agentic coding tools, and good judgment about when their output needs a closer look
  • Clear written communication. You'll be writing defect reports, test plans, and release sign-offs for engineers and product, and explaining risk to non-technical stakeholders

Nice to Have:

  • Experience testing document processing or extraction from unstructured data
  • Experience testing third-party integrations, especially where the counterparty's documentation isn't solid and you need contract tests, sandboxes, or recorded fixtures to work around it
  • Familiarity with AWS and Kubernetes. We have an SRE who owns the cluster - you won't be running it, but you'll be reading logs and working out where a failure happened in it
  • Experience handling sensitive data such as PHI, or working under HIPAA-style requirements

Benefits

  • Private Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Company HSA contributions for HDHP participants
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (Health & Dependent Care)
  • Company-Paid Short-Term Disability Coverage
  • Voluntary Long-Term Disability, Life, AD&D, and Supplemental Coverage Options
  • 401(k) Plan with Company Match
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick Time & 10 paid Holidays)
  • Parental Leave

Pay Disclosure: The total base salary range for this role is $77,000 - $104,000 annually with an opportunity to earn a discretionary quarterly bonus. Final compensation will be determined based on skills and experience.

Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer-sponsored visa support now or in the future.

descriptionHtml:
Umain is a leading product and technology company expanding in the U.S. market. We’re seeking an experienced Senior Quality Engineer to join our product and technology group in Chicago.

At Umain, you’ll be embedded in cross-functional teams that design, build, and ship high-performing digital products for global brands, bringing a quality-first mindset to every stage of delivery. You’re comfortable running thorough manual and exploratory testing, but your north star is automation: building the frameworks, pipelines, and culture that deliver quality consistently. If you believe quality is everyone’s responsibility, and that the best time to catch a bug is before it’s written, then please keep reading.

This full-time role is based in Chicago at our West Loop office. As part of Umain’s expanding U.S. footprint, you’ll help establish our reputation for engineering excellence, strategy, and delivery in the American market. You must be in Chicago or willing to relocate to be considered for this role, as we require a minimum of 3 days in-office per week. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.

What you'll do

AI & Agentic Quality

  • Bring quality into agentic development pipelines, making sure test strategy and acceptance criteria are part of the plan that AI agents build from.
  • Work closely with developers early in the lifecycle to shape and challenge agentic plans before execution, so issues are caught at the plan stage rather than in the output.
  • Design test approaches for non-deterministic applications, such as LLM-powered features, using techniques like evaluation datasets, acceptance thresholds, model-graded evaluation, and regression testing for prompts and model changes.
  • Use AI-assisted tooling for test generation, visual regression, and intelligent test selection.

Client & Team Leadership

  • Partner with clients, product managers, and engineers to define test strategies, test plans, and acceptance criteria that reflect what matters to the business.
  • Champion a shift-left approach, engaging from requirements and design onward, so quality is built into the plan before a line of code is written, by a person or an agent.
  • Bring the quality voice to agile ceremonies and explain risk, coverage, and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Shape Umain’s quality engineering capability in the U.S., and collaborate with our global QA capability to help evolve how we work across Umain.

Testing & Automation

  • Build, maintain, and scale automated test suites using modern frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium, writing clean, maintainable test code in TypeScript or Python.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing on every build.
  • Advocate for a testing pyramid approach, prioritizing fast, reliable unit and integration tests alongside end-to-end coverage.
  • Test web applications and APIs built on modern stacks such as React/Next.js and Node.js/NestJS, using tools like Postman for API testing.
  • Run exploratory testing for new features and edge cases across web and mobile platforms, especially where behavior is hard to script.
  • Design and maintain reusable test cases in tools like TestRail or Zephyr, and log and manage defects in Jira with clear reproduction steps and impact assessments.
  • Include security in your test approach, from common web and API vulnerabilities (such as the OWASP Top 10) to AI-specific risks like prompt injection and data leakage.

Quality Insight & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with Web, iOS, Android, and Back-end engineers to identify testability gaps early and design features that are easier to verify and automate.
  • Monitor test coverage, defect trends, and pipeline health, connecting quality metrics to real client and business outcomes.
  • Proactively identify process improvements and share learnings across teams.

Who you are

  • 5+ years of professional experience in software quality engineering, with automation as a core part of how you work.
  • Experience testing non-deterministic systems, such as AI or LLM-powered applications, and a point of view on how to define “correct” when outputs vary.
  • Hands-on experience testing both web and native mobile applications (iOS and Android).
  • Already working with AI agents in the development lifecycle, or eager to start.
  • Proficient with at least one automation framework (Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium) and comfortable writing test code in TypeScript or Python.
  • Experienced with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into developer workflows.
  • Solid understanding of agile methodologies and a genuine shift-left mindset.
  • A collaborative team player with a client-focused mindset who sees quality as a shared responsibility, not a gate at the end.
  • Curious, methodical, and energized by complex systems and the challenge of finding what others miss.

Bonus experience

  • Hands-on experience with security testing tools such as OWASP ZAP or Burp Suite.
  • BDD frameworks (Cucumber, Gherkin).
  • Performance or load testing (k6, JMeter, or similar).
  • Cloud environments, ideally GCP.
  • Docker and containerized test environments.
  • Observability and monitoring tools.

What we offer

  • Work with global brands on diverse, high-impact digital projects.
  • A personal coach and a development plan you build together.

Compensation: $135,000.00–$165,000.00 USD annually based on experience

Umain North America offers a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits that reflect our Nordic heritage, including fully subsidized health insurance premiums for employees and their families. Our flexible time-off policy requires at least 3 weeks off per year, and we encourage taking time in 2-week blocks so you can truly disconnect and recharge. Our culture is built on inclusive decision-making, collaboration, continuous learning, transparency, and trust.

Umain North America is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.

Umain is a digital product consultancy. We shape, ship and scale digital products at speed. Founded in Stockholm in 2001, we are a growing team of 100+ experts in digital product strategy, design, and technology.

We are a part of Eidra, a group of top-notch companies specializing in strategy, creativity, and engineering. As a collective we guide leaders in making meaningful and lasting change.

descriptionHtml:
Location: Raleigh and Dallas

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

We are a professional services firm with a business unit dedicated to the financial services marketplace. Our teams have been at the forefront of every event that has reshaped and redefined the financial services industry. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic team!

We help our clients transform. Together we are changing the way they interact with their Customers, Employees and Partners alike. We are modernizing their applications, creating new ones and driving business efficiency across their ever-changing platform and channel infrastructures. Everything we do centers around this simple story.

The opportunity

As a Technology Service Delivery Senior, you’ll be based in our Service Delivery Center, which is made up of high-performing US-based colleagues who work closely with our experienced advisory professionals. We deliver Technology project-based work and managed services to our clients. Here, you’ll work as part of a project team and will be responsible for the design, build/configuration, testing, analysis, delivery and support of Technology solutions. This position is fast-paced and ever-changing, which means you’ll need to be a flexible self-starter and be able to manage changing priorities and learning new and rapidly changing technology solutions.

We are looking for Test/Quality Engineers who will ensure quality through test planning, functional testing, automation, API and data validation, and release readiness for our financial services clients. The team leverages test automation frameworks such as JUnit, Selenium, Cucumber, ReadyAPI, and REST Assured, alongside SQL for data validation and CI/CD pipelines to deliver reliable, high-quality software. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role that spans the full testing lifecycle.

Your Key Responsibilities

The goal is to help clients solve complex business problems by ensuring software quality from planning through release readiness. You will define test scenarios and maintain test evidence, execute functional, API, integration, regression, and data testing, track defects and support root-cause analysis, and own assigned workstreams independently from design through production support.

Skills And Attributes For Success

  • Working knowledge and hands-on experience in software testing, quality assurance, and test automation across functional, regression, integration, and API testing.
  • Working knowledge and hands-on experience building automated tests using JUnit, Selenium, Cucumber, ReadyAPI, and REST Assured.
  • Working knowledge of Java/J2EE and Unix/Linux shell scripting in support of test automation.
  • Working knowledge of SQL for data validation and back-end verification.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, quality gates, and Jenkins.
  • Define test scenarios, maintain test evidence, and execute functional, API, integration, regression, and data testing.
  • Track defects, support root-cause analysis, and own assigned workstreams independently from design through production support.
  • Collaborate across product, engineering, testing, and operations teams, and mentor less-experienced team members where appropriate.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 30% of the time.

To qualify for the role you must have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in software testing and quality assurance.
  • Hands-on experience in software testing, quality assurance, and test automation.
  • Working knowledge of Java/J2EE and Unix/Linux shell scripting for test automation.
  • Experience with SQL for data validation.
  • Hands-on experience with JUnit, Selenium, Cucumber, ReadyAPI, and REST Assured.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, quality gates, and Jenkins.
  • Experience across functional, regression, integration, and API testing.
  • Comfortable working in Agile environments and collaborating with business and technical stakeholders.

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Experience with the following technologies
  • Software testing, quality assurance, and test automation
  • JUnit, Selenium, Cucumber, ReadyAPI, and REST Assured
  • Java/J2EE, Unix/Linux shell, JavaScript, Spring, web services, and Angular
  • SQL for data validation
  • CI/CD pipelines, quality gates, and Jenkins
  • Functional, regression, integration, API, and performance testing

What We Look For

We’re interested in intellectually curious people with a passion for finding new and innovative ways to make things better. You’ll also need to be a self-starter and quick learner with a strong background in computer science from both theoretical and practical points of view. If you’re ready to be the future of the group and make your mark in a growing business, this role is for you.

About The Organization

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. So that whenever you join, however long you stay, the experience you gain lasts a lifetime.

Join us in building a better working world.

Apply now.

We are an equal employment opportunity employer (Females/Minorities/Protected Veterans/Disabled) and value the diversity of our workforce and the knowledge of our people.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $80,300 to $149,100
    • Bay Area California offices – $83,700 to $155,300
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $67,000 to $136,800
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
  • Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  • To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
  • EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
  • For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
  • At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

All in to shape the future with confidence.

EY provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law. 

EY is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities including veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and either need assistance applying online or need to request an accommodation during any part of the application process, please call 1-800-EY-HELP3, select Option 2 for candidate related inquiries, then select Option 1 for candidate queries and finally select Option 2 for candidates with an inquiry which will route you to EY’s Talent Shared Services Team (TSS) or email the TSS at ssc.customersupport@ey.com.

descriptionHtml:
The Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer is responsible for validating the functionality, reliability, security, and performance of a federal client's systems and applications. The role develops and executes functional, integration, regression, and release testing; identifies and tracks defects through resolution; validates data and system interfaces; and works closely with development, DevSecOps, and business teams to ensure system changes are thoroughly tested and ready for production deployment.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts using relevant testing frameworks to validate application functionality across multiple user roles and workflows.
  • Design and implement UI automation using tools such as Playwright, ensuring automated test coverage is reliable, maintainable, and aligned with release objectives.
  • Lead test automation initiatives, including the integration of automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps processes.
  • Conduct manual testing of individual features, stress testing the system in order to ensure high-quality deployments
  • Create and organize testing suites in TestRails or a similar tool
  • Periodically run full manual test suite to perform regression testing
  • Conduct peer reviews of test automation code to promote quality, consistency, and adherence to engineering best practices.
  • Communicate test execution results, defects, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders during each release cycle.

Requirements

  • U.S. citizenship is required, along with the ability to obtain a public trust clearance.
  • Minimum of four (4) years of experience in quality assurance, software testing, or application development for enterprise systems.
  • At least two (2) years of experience providing quality assurance and testing support for AWS-based workloads.
  • Bachelor’s degree or four (4) additional years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Demonstrated experience performing manual and automated testing, including defect documentation, issue reproduction, regression testing, and validation.
  • Strong experience developing test automation using Playwright with JavaScript or TypeScript, along with API testing, performance testing, Swagger, and Postman.
  • Experience designing, maintaining, and integrating CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions with AWS services such as Systems Manager and PostgreSQL.
  • Proficiency testing applications and workloads built with AWS services and technologies, including Vue.js, Python, Django, and Amazon S3.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment while collaborating with, mentoring, and supporting team members to resolve complex technical issues.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments, including planning, testing, and supporting iterative software releases.
  • Ability to test and validate workloads against AWS Well-Architected Framework principles and related quality standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting or testing Python/Django-based web applications.
  • Experience conducting penetration, performance, or load testing for applications hosted in AWS cloud environments.
  • Experience configuring and validating application monitoring, alerting, and error tracking using Sentry or similar tools.
  • Knowledge of Section 508 accessibility testing standards, requirements, and validation practices.

Preference may be extended to qualified Native American Indian candidates in accordance with applicable federal law and PCI Federal policy.

Responsibilities
The USDS Core Business Quality Team owns end-to-end quality across TikTok's core products and services in the US. We are looking for a forward-thinking Quality Engineer who takes deep ownership of product quality and engineering efficiency. In this role, you will partner closely with cross-functional teams to identify quality risks, drive continuous improvements, build scalable quality solutions, and leverage AI-driven technologies to enhance product quality and engineering practices.

Responsibilities
- Have a deep understanding of business logic, and product functionality.
- Champion end-to-end quality practices and management across project testing, regression suites, and app validation. Drive production issue triage, defect pattern and root-cause analysis to proactively mitigate risk and continuously improve release stability
- Develop scalable automation tests, CI/CD validation pipelines, and internal engineering tools to increase test coverage, and elevate product reliability
- Apply LLMs and AI agents to real-world engineering challenges, such as automated test generation, self-healing scripts, root-cause analysis, and triaging to transform quality engineering practices

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- BS in Computer Science or related fields
- Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Java, etc.).
- Experience with web and mobile tests
- Proven experience building scalable test automation, or productivity tools.
- Experience with AI tools, with an understanding of practical use to improve testing efficiency
- Strong problem solving skills and self-driven mindset with effective collaboration skills

Preferred Qualifications
- Strong grasp of complex business logic and workflows, with the ability to design precise and comprehensive test strategies and use cases
- Experience with integrating AI agents into testing workflow or engineering pipelines
- Background in benchmarking and evaluating AI agents for effectiveness, reliability, and output quality
- Experience with building AI testing frameworks, autonomous testing agents or intelligent automation solutions
- Working knowledge of large-scale distributed systems architecture

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. 3. Exercising sound judgment.​

JOB DESCRIPTION


Department: Quality Assurance


 Job Title: Quality Engineer


 Reports To: Quality Leadership


 


 Location: Vista, CA (onsite position)


 Status: Full-Time


 


SUMMARY


VQ OrthoCare provides noninvasive medical products focused on orthopedic bracing and electrotherapy. The Quality Engineer is responsible for applying quality engineering principles and analytical methods to support product and process quality through investigation, analysis, auditing, controlled change and cross-functional quality activities.


The position evaluates product and process issues, supports corrective action and continual improvement and develops subject-matter expertise in assigned areas of the Quality Management System.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


The Quality Engineer independently performs assigned Quality activities and works collaboratively with Quality, Manufacturing, Product Development and other functional areas to support effective Quality System and product quality outcomes.


  • Apply Quality System principles and requirements in accordance with Company procedures, ISO 13485 and applicable FDA medical device requirements.

  • Serve as an internal QMS auditor, independently planning and performing assigned audits of Quality System processes and applicable business functions against ISO 13485, Company procedures and other applicable requirements; evaluate objective evidence, document findings and support appropriate follow-up.

  • Develop and maintain extensive knowledge of Company products, components, specifications, manufacturing processes, inspection requirements and known failure modes to support effective Quality evaluation and decision-making.

  • Investigate product defects and failures, including evaluation of returned product and relevant product, manufacturing, complaint and Quality history, to characterize failure modes, determine contributing factors and identify recurring or potentially systemic conditions.

  • Collect, analyze and interpret product and Quality data to identify trends, variation, recurring conditions and potential quality signals and contribute to the development of meaningful data collection, analysis and reporting methods.

  • Lead assigned corrective action, nonconformance, root-cause investigation and Quality improvement activities or participate as an active member of cross-functional teams responsible for evaluating and resolving Quality issues.

  • Prepare and update controlled documents as assigned, including initiating change documentation, developing required revisions, obtaining appropriate technical and functional input, verifying proposed changes, evaluating impacts and related downstream activities and completing applicable requirements through the Company's self-service documentation process.

  • Support maintenance of Device Master Record (DMR), technical file and other applicable product documentation by completing assigned updates, verifying current and applicable documentation and supporting alignment of affected records and repositories following approved changes.

  • Work cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Inspection, Product Development and other applicable functions to address product and process quality issues and support implementation of appropriate corrective and improvement actions.

  • Support development and revision of inspection plans, acceptance criteria, sampling methods and other product quality controls associated with product, process, specification and controlled-document changes.

  • Provide backup support for Quality Inspection and other Quality workflows as needed, performing assigned activities in accordance with established procedures, specifications and acceptance requirements.

  • Develop subject-matter expertise and assume responsibility for assigned Quality System areas as knowledge, proficiency and organizational needs evolve.

    • QUALIFICATIONS


  • Five to seven years of progressive Quality experience in a medical device or other regulated manufacturing environment. 

  • Working knowledge of ISO 13485, FDA medical device Quality System requirements, and Quality assurance and Quality engineering principles. 

  • Demonstrated experience with product and process investigations, root-cause analysis, corrective action and Quality improvement. 

  • Demonstrated experience independently performing internal QMS audits and evaluating objective evidence against established requirements. 

  • Experience analyzing Quality and manufacturing data and applying specifications, inspection requirements, acceptance criteria, sampling methods and other product quality controls. 

  • Experience with controlled change in a regulated Quality Management System and working cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Inspection, Engineering, Product Development and other operational functions. 

    • Preferred: Experience with Class I and Class II medical devices.


    CERTIFICATIONS


    ISO 13485 Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor training/certification preferred. Evidence of completed auditor training should be provided.


    ASQ certification or demonstrated professional development in Quality auditing, Quality engineering, Quality improvement or related Quality disciplines is preferred.


    COMPETENCIES


  • Ability to interpret and apply Quality System procedures, standards, specifications and applicable requirements. 

  • Strong analytical and investigative skills with the ability to evaluate evidence, identify patterns, determine broader Quality implications, and reach supportable conclusions. 

  • Working knowledge of root-cause analysis, corrective action, risk-based thinking and continual improvement principles. 

  • Ability to understand established processes and current-state requirements before recommending or implementing change. 

  • Ability to independently plan and execute assigned work, exercise sound professional judgment, and recognize when additional expertise or escalation is required. 

  • Strong cross-functional communication, collaboration, organization, documentation and follow-through.

    • SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES


    This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.


    PHYSICAL AND MENTAL DEMANDS


  • Regularly required to sit, stand, walk, type, read, review records and use computer systems.

  • Ability to work within office, manufacturing, warehouse and inspection environments.

  • Ability to examine products and components and review specifications, processes, records, data and other technical information.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, conduct investigations and exercise professional judgment within a regulated environment.

    • WORK ENVIRONMENT


    Reasonable accommodations may be provided to allow qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties and responsibilities.


    The work environment may include office, manufacturing, warehouse, inspection, supplier, customer and audit settings consistent with assigned Quality responsibilities.

Vimo® started as the “Expedia” of health insurance and has evolved into a leader in transforming government IT infrastructure with its proven SaaS and AI technology. With our cutting-edge technology, we are helping agencies serve more people, faster, and transforming healthcare service delivery as we know it.


Job Title : QA Automation Engineer (SDET) AI-Enhanced Testing:

We are seeking a highly analytical and technically strong QA Engineer with an SDET background to join our team responsible for validating a complex web-based health insurance marketplace. This role combines hands-on manual testing, test automation development, and the use of AI tools in the SDLC. You will contribute to building reliable test coverage, improving automation, and ensuring overall product quality.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyze requirements and workflows to design effective manual and automated test cases, prioritizing automation where appropriate
  • Perform comprehensive manual and automated testing, including exploratory, functional, regression, and end-to-end testing
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks for high-value and repeatable scenarios
  • Contribute to test coverage across UI, API, and integration layers
  • Identify, document, and triage defects with clear reproduction steps and root cause insights
  • Use AI tools to enhance testing, including test case generation, defect analysis, automated test development, and test optimization
  • Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps teams to ensure quality throughout the SDLC
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and faster feedback cycles
  • Continuously evaluate and improve what should be tested manually vs. automated


Required Basic Qualifications:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
  • Proven experience in manual testing of web applications
  • Solid understanding of QA methodologies, processes, and best practices
  • Strong experience with SQL and data validation
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., JavaScript, Python, Java)
  • Experience testing APIs and data-driven systems
  • Experience working with modern CI/CD pipelines
  • Comfort using AI tools within the software development lifecycle (e.g., AI-assisted test creation, code generation, debugging, or analysis tools)


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience testing complex, data-driven web applications
  • Familiarity with healthcare or health insurance or Medicaid domains
  • Experience with modern automation tools (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar)
  • Exposure to cloud-based environments and microservices architectures
  • Experience with performance or load testing


Compensation and Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation - All In range of ($120,000-$140,000). (Please note that salary and compensation may vary based on factors such as skills, experience, performance and location.)
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including but not limited to:
  • Health, Dental, Life, Disability, and Vision insurance
  • Healthcare spending or reimbursement accounts (HSA/FSA)
  • Retirement benefits (401k)
  • Paid time off
  • Holidays: 13 paid days per year
  • Education assistance or tuition reimbursement
  • Employee discounts for Gym memberships & commuting/travel assistance


Our Vaues:

  • We believe that working hard, when it is imbued with purpose, can and should be fun.
  • You’ll find we are a “can do” place where people work together and roll up their sleeves to get the job done.
  • Everyone has a voice; everyone’s ideas count, and everyone is respected.
  • We have built a company, as well as a community of friends and colleagues, with respect for each other.


Information Security & Data Protection:

  • This role may involve access to sensitive or regulated information. The candidate is expected to handle all data in accordance with company security, privacy, and data protection policies.
  • Compliance with access control, data classification, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements is required.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to lead the design, development, and execution of testing solutions that ensure the quality, reliability, and scalability of our software products. This role requires expertise in testing the underlying platform and technologies, a proactive quality mindset, and the ability to collaborate closely with engineering and product teams in an Agile environment.


Roles & Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:


Certify applications built on modern tech stacks like Java, spring boot, Tomcat, Kafka, openshift/EKS, oracle, cockroach.

Validate platform changes, ensuring compliance with change control, incident, and problem management processes.

Develop comprehensive test plans and test cases to validate platform architecture and design.

Lead API testing, including functional, integration, and regression testing for platform components and integrations.

Ensure adherence to security, compliance, and infrastructure standards during validation.

Support continuous integration and deployment by automating test scenarios and verifying automated test suite execution as part of CI/CD process.

Ensure optimal test coverage by collaborating with platform engineers to understand implemented changes that need to be tested.

Proficient in testing applications developed on On-prem, Cloud, and Hybrid architectures.

Identify opportunities for improving test processes and tools to enhance validation efficiency.

Serve as a key resource for coordinating dependencies across platform teams and ensuring consistent quality across initiatives.

Report test results, risks, and quality metrics to stakeholders and recommend improvements for platform reliability and scalability.

Self-driven and able to demonstrate strong understanding of products, services, business flows, and financial context to validate platform changes effectively.

Required Skills:




15+ years of experience in software quality assurance, platform validation, and testing across complex infrastructure and application environments.

10+ years of hands-on experience in test automation, serving in lead and technical leadership roles.

10+ years of hands-on experience in reviewing requirements and project documentation to understand the application and perform automation feasibility analysis.

8+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, executing, maintaining, and analyzing automated test scripts.

8+ years of hands-on experience executing automation scripts, preparing executions reports and defect logs analyze test failures, log defects, and collaborate with developers to drive them to resolution.

10+ years in Technologies such as Core Java, SQL, Selenium and Cucumber to write test scripts.

6+ years of Data/File/Database and ETL/Data warehouse testing and proficient in testing all conversions – File to file, file to Database, database to file etc.

Experience debugging and troubleshooting automated testcases.

Strong command over SQL. Ability to write complex queries across different systems – preferred Oracle

Strong experience (3+ years) in parsing & generating data/files, bank standards, XML/json payloads and XPath

Hands on with Eclipse or NetBeans Project Management; Version Management, API Testing, Litmus, Jenkins, Selenium, Cucumber, Version control like bitbucket

Strong analytical and troubleshooting, debugging/triaging skills.

Comfortable working with Linux & Windows operating systems including shell scripting

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

At Robinhood, Quality Engineering (QE) is a critical function within our broader engineering organization. We serve as the final line of defense for product quality—empowering teams to ship confidently by embedding robust test strategies, running critical end-to-end checks, and maintaining automation systems that scale with our product velocity. Our mission is to uphold a high bar for customer experience, especially during P0 launches, through a mix of technical expertise, test execution, and cross-functional collaboration.

As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will support high-impact product launches by designing test strategies, executing manual and automated testing, and partnering with our contractor team on regression test cycles. This role requires someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, cares deeply about the customer experience, and is eager to shape the test infrastructure behind Robinhood’s iOS, Android, and Web apps.

This role is based in our New York City, New York office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the quality of new features, including test planning, execution, and feedback throughout the development cycle
  • Define and implement test strategies for P0 product launches, including both frontend and backend validation
  • Perform manual and automated testing, with a focus on end-to-end functionality
  • Automate mobile/web E2E test cases
  • Build test coverage that accurately reflects the user experience, including functional, regression, and exploratory testing

What You Bring

  • Proven experience testing mobile (iOS/Android) and web applications in fast-paced product environments
  • Strong understanding of quality assurance principles, test case development, and test execution
  • Hands-on experience with UI automation tools such as Appium, Selenium, Playwright
  • Comfort with scripting languages (e.g., Python, Java) and test infrastructure tools
  • Familiarity with bug tracking (e.g., Jira) and test case management tools (e.g., TestRail)
  • Excellent communication skills, user empathy, and a detail-oriented mindset

What We Offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. Our mission is to uphold a high bar for customer experience, especially during P0 launches, through a mix of technical expertise, test execution, and cross-functional collaboration.

As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will support high-impact product launches by designing test strategies, executing manual and automated testing, and partnering with our contractor team on regression test cycles. This role requires someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, cares deeply about the customer experience, and is eager to shape the test infrastructure behind Robinhood’s iOS, Android, and Web apps.

This role is based in our New York City, New York office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.
