descriptionHtml:
Build quality into every product and help shape the future of AI-powered software.

As a quality engineer at Gallup, you'll help deliver software our clients can trust by partnering with product managers, software engineers, designers and fellow quality engineers to ensure quality in every stage of the software development life cycle. Rather than simply executing test cases, you'll apply systems thinking to identify risks, develop thoughtful validation strategies and help ensure every release delivers an exceptional customer experience. As Gallup continues to expand its AI-powered products, you'll also have opportunities to contribute to testing intelligent workflows and emerging AI capabilities.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop a deep understanding of product features, customer workflows, system interactions, APIs, data flows, integrations and technical dependencies to identify quality risks and determine the most effective validation strategy
  • Collaborate within Gallup's Product Operating Model alongside product managers, software engineers, designers and fellow quality engineers to ensure quality in every stage of product development
  • Design, execute and maintain manual and automated tests across user interfaces, APIs, integrations and end-to-end workflows
  • Develop and maintain automated test suites using Playwright or comparable modern automation frameworks
  • Perform exploratory, regression, smoke and end-to-end testing to uncover system risks and validate critical customer experiences
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide fast, reliable feedback throughout development
  • Troubleshoot automation failures and partner with engineering teams to improve test stability, reliability and automation coverage
  • Create and maintain test plans and traceability that reflect product intent, customer impact and overall validation strategy
  • Support production validation and investigate customer-reported issues when needed
  • Continuously improve quality engineering practices, automation capabilities and release confidence

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Systems thinking: You naturally connect product features, APIs, integrations and customer workflows to identify risks before they become production issues.
  • Quality-first mindset: You view quality engineering as an integral part of software development and proactively build quality into products rather than testing only at the end.
  • Automation expertise: You develop maintainable, scalable automated testing solutions that improve release confidence and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborative partnerships: You build strong relationships across Product, Engineering and Design teams, communicating effectively to solve complex problems and improve outcomes.
  • Continuous learning: You embrace emerging technologies, modern testing approaches and AI-enabled engineering practices while continually expanding your technical expertise.

What You Need

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, information systems or a related field, or equivalent professional experience required
  • At least three years of experience in quality engineering, including both functional and automated testing, required
  • Residence within a 200-mile radius of Omaha, Nebraska, or willingness to relocate required
  • Experience testing web applications and REST APIs required
  • Experience developing automated tests using Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or comparable automation frameworks required
  • Experience working within Agile software development teams required
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD pipelines required
  • Experience using test management platforms such as QMetry, Azure DevOps Test Plans or TestRail required
  • Experience with TypeScript/JavaScript and/or Python preferred
  • Experience with SQL and database validation preferred
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure preferred
  • Experience with performance, security or data quality testing preferred
  • Experience contributing to automation frameworks and reusable testing utilities preferred
  • Experience testing AI-powered applications, chatbots, copilots or intelligent workflows preferred
  • Experience testing Large Language Models (LLMs) preferred
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI evaluation methodologies or evaluation frameworks such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, Ragas or LangSmith preferred
  • A commitment to working on-site at Gallup’s Omaha office at least three days per week preferred

About Gallup

At Gallup, we change the world, one client at a time, through extraordinary analytics and advice on everything important facing humankind. Learn more about our work and life at Gallup.

Gallup offers a robust benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life and other insurance options; a fully vested 401(k) retirement savings plan with company matching; an employee stock ownership program; family-building benefits; an employee assistance program; and various reimbursements and activities that enhance our associates’ wellbeing. We also offer an estimated annual salary range of $80,000-$115,000 for this role. Salaries are based on a variety of factors, including an individual’s education, experience and skills.

Gallup is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

Job Title: Sr. Associate, Software Quality Engineer

Job Code: 46431

Job Location: Nashville, TN

Job Schedule: 9/80 employees work 9 out of 14 days- totaling 80 hours worked- and have every other Friday off

Role is contingent upon program award

Job Description:

The Software Quality Engineer is responsible for creating end-to-end test plans, executing the test plan, and managing all activities in the plan as part of and in conjunction with an Agile Scrum development team to ensure that all objectives are met and the software solution works as expected. The solution should be tested in terms of functionality, performance, stability, and compatibility with legacy and/or third party software and integrated external hardware.

The objective of the Software Quality Engineer is to ensure that testing of every feature of the software solution and through every phase of development is well defined, planned, and executed. The work of the Software Quality Engineer should inspire confidence that any potential issue has been identified and addressed prior to release of the software solution. The Software Quality Engineer, Senior Associate Level is a professional with job area knowledge and a key contributor to the scrum team.

Essential Functions:

  • Review functional and design specifications to ensure full understanding of individual deliverables;
  • Identify test requirements from Conditions of Acceptance, map test case requirements, and design test coverage plan;
  • Develop, document and maintain functional test cases and other test artifacts such as test plans, test summaries, and process documents as needed;
  • Execute and evaluate manual test cases and report test results;
  • Participate in test case reviews with cross-functional team members;
  • Identify any potential quality issues per defined process and escalate potential quality issues immediately to Product Owners;
  • Keep team and stakeholders informed of project QA progress and emergent risks;
  • Ensure that validated deliverables meet functional and design specifications and requirements via Functional, Regression, Performance, Stress, and Endurance Testing;
  • Isolate, replicate, and report defects and verify defect fixes via Exploratory, and Usability Testing in addition to above testing methods;
  • Seek opportunities for improvement in quality, including but not limited to efficiency gains and expanding test coverage;
  • Engage as an active participant in Scrum ceremonies;
  • Required to perform other appropriate duties as requested, directed, or assigned;
  • Perform all job functions with a positive, professional attitude;
  • Ability to obtain a US Secret security clearance


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. Graduate Degree or equivalent with 0 to 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 6 years of prior related experience.


Preferred Additional Skills:

  • Knowledge and experience in test design, development, and execution of test cases, in support of software and hardware solutions;
  • Excellent observational, analytical, and problem-solving skills;
  • Excellent listening and interpersonal skills;
  • Ability to stay disciplined and focused;
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills;
  • Able to be productive and effective working either alone or as part of a team;
  • Strong customer service orientation;
  • Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Experience with Test Track Pro, Version One, or similar testing tools/suites;
  • Experience with software that directly interfaces with 3rd party firmware;
  • Experience in an Agile Scrum environment;
  • Familiarity with closed network environments;
  • US Government security clearance.

descriptionHtml:
Intapp is looking for an enthusiastic individual for the position of QA Automation Engineer. This person will make a real impact on the business by helping grow our test automation team and processes. The ideal candidate will have a passion for high quality software and engineering principles with strong analytic, problem solving and programming skills. This person brings a software engineer mindset to this role by using best practices and appropriate design patterns to build solutions for our test automation tools, frameworks, and automated tests.

About Intapp:

Intapp, based in Silicon Valley, is a leader in Vertical AI SaaS solutions, collaborating with the world’s top firms globally across accounting, consulting, investment banking, legal, private capital, and real assets. With 20+ years of industry expertise, Intapp's "Intelligence Applied" approach is transforming how businesses operate and leverages a strategic partnership with Microsoft in delivering industry cloud solutions. The company culture promotes accountability, responsibility, and growth in a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment. Since going public in 2021 and trading on the NASDAQ, Intapp has expanded to over 1,200 employees globally with development centers in Palo Alto, Charlotte, Belfast, Berlin and Lisbon.

What you will do:


  • Collaborate across functions with product managers, software architects, and developers, contributing to release planning and software design.

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and test suites for web applications.

  • Create comprehensive test strategies, including both manual and automated test scenarios.

  • Execute manual testing where appropriate, including exploratory, functional, regression, and user acceptance testing.

  • Build and maintain automation tooling using Playwright primarily.

  • Build and run automated tests as part of continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.

  • Create dashboards and reporting metrics to drive release quality and continuous improvements.


What you will need:


  • Proven experience in software testing, including test planning, test case creation, execution, defect reporting, and issue tracking (typically 5+ years), with a strong focus on test automation.

  • Hands-on experience with Playwright for e2e test automation.

  • Solid understanding of software development principles and Agile methodologies, with hands-on experience in React(preferred), and familiarity with web technologies such as HTML and CSS.

  • Expert knowledge of software testing methodologies and tools, covering both manual and automated testing approaches.

  • Experience in configuring and maintaining CI/CD pipelines to support automated testing workflows, along with proficiency in version control systems (e.g., Git).

  • Strong organizational and time management skills to work across projects, proactively managing competing priorities.

  • Excellent communication skills to work in a collaborative environment and participate in stakeholder meetings.

  • Familiarity with load, stress, or performance testing tools and methodologies is a plus.

  • An understanding of Microsoft Azure & Amazon Web Services is a plus.


What you will gain:

At Intapp, you’ll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. Position Overview

The Test Engineer is a member of the AAMVA Quality Assurance Department within the IT Division, responsible for testing AAMVA applications and the REST services and microservices that compose them, and for supporting testing efforts with state and federal jurisdictions and commercial/third-party data consumers on motor vehicle administration and driver licensing systems. This role executes and contributes to test plans, runs functional and automated tests, and participates in testing sessions with external customers, working with a degree of independence and seeking guidance from senior team members on complex initiatives. It is a strong foundation for building modern quality engineering skills and growing toward senior technical roles.

About AAMVA

The IT Division develops and operates information systems for state and federal agencies conducting business related to motor vehicle and driver license administration. Our systems support critical government functions across multiple jurisdictions. Our systems run on a cloud-native, microservices architecture on Azure with REST interfaces across all internal and external integrations, and we invest in automation-first, AI-assisted test engineering. Our in-house test platform abstracts much of the underlying infrastructure, so we value strong test-design judgment, data and integration testing depth, and learning agility over pre-existing mastery of any single platform technology.

Key Responsibilities

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Create, execute, and maintain test cases, and contribute to test plans for AAMVA applications and their underlying REST services and microservices.
  • Conduct functional, system, integration, and regression testing based on AAMVA's business and technical specifications.
  • Build and maintain automated test scripts across UI, API/REST, and service layers, and run them within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Perform API testing of RESTful services — request/response and schema validation, status codes, and authentication.
  • Use existing service-virtualization and mocks to test components in isolation and manage test data (create/modify/reset) so tests are atomic and repeatable.
  • Validate data across relational and NoSQL data stores (Azure SQL, Cosmos DB).
  • Participate in testing for jurisdictions and partners making system or platform changes, ensuring quality standards are maintained.
  • Apply AI-assisted testing tools to speed up test creation, debugging, and reporting.

Defect & Issue Management

  • Log, track, and manage defects through resolution using established tracking systems (e.g. Jira, Azure DevOps).
  • Communicate issues clearly to technical teams and stakeholders, with steps to reproduce and supporting detail.
  • Help determine whether a failure originates in the application, the test data, or a mocked dependency, escalating complex cases to senior team members.

Customer Engagement & Support

  • Facilitate and conduct testing sessions with jurisdictions and commercial/third-party consumers (e.g. DLDV, consumer-access, and CDLIS third-party customers) implementing new or enhanced applications.
  • Conduct customer outreach including surveys, scheduling, and consultations.
  • Build and maintain strong, positive relationships with internal and external customers.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Attend meetings on testing schedules, concerns, reviews, and documentation changes, and participate actively in work groups.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including developers, business analysts, and project managers.
  • Participate in the review of testing and procedural documentation.

Learning, Knowledge & Continuous Improvement

  • Build and maintain proficiency in AAMVA applications and the team's testing tools through ongoing training and hands-on experience.
  • Provide input and recommendations to improve testing processes, efficiency, and the customer experience.

Formal Education

Four-year degree from an accredited college or university; equivalent work experience may be substituted for the degree.

Experience & Technical Skills

The skills below are described by the depth we expect. “Strong / hands-on” indicates required, working depth. “Familiarity / awareness” indicates that exposure is sufficient — our test tooling abstracts much of the underlying platform, and the ability to learn quickly matters more than deep prior expertise in those areas.

  • 3–5 years of software quality assurance and testing experience with a solid understanding of the software development lifecycle.
  • Solid test-design ability — creating and executing test cases and contributing to test plans, including basic edge and negative cases.
  • Strong analytical skills and learning agility — able to reason about system behavior and quickly become proficient in new tools and proprietary applications. *(Non-negotiable.) *
  • Working knowledge of functional, system, integration, regression, and REST/API testing.
  • Working, hands-on knowledge of databases and SQL, including validating data across relational and NoSQL stores (Azure SQL, Cosmos DB).
  • Hands-on experience with test management and defect tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps/ALM, or similar).
  • Familiarity with automated testing frameworks and tools (Selenium, Postman, Playwright, or similar).
  • Familiarity with using service virtualization / mocks and managing test data for isolated, repeatable tests.
  • Awareness of the Azure request-path components (API Management, Application Gateway, Web Application Firewall) — enough to recognize when a failure may originate outside the application.
  • Conceptual understanding of cloud-hosted, microservices environments; platform expertise is not required.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, and exposure to AI-assisted testing.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues, escalating complex problems to senior team members.

Communication & Customer Service

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality customer service to internal teams and external jurisdictions and partners.
  • Experience facilitating meetings and testing sessions with stakeholders.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Professional Attributes

  • Self-motivated, able to work with a degree of independence while seeking guidance on complex issues.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and analytical thinking.
  • Proactive problem-solver with critical-thinking ability.
  • Eager to learn and grow toward senior technical roles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of AAMVA applications, systems, and standards.
  • Experience with government or public-sector IT systems in motor vehicle administration or driver licensing.
  • Exposure to data analytics and BI pipelines (e.g. Synapse, Power BI).
  • Understanding of or exposure to white box testing.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages (JavaScript, PowerShell, Python, or similar).
  • ISTQB Foundation Level or working toward relevant QA certifications.

Salary Range: $99,606 to $147,849 Annually

The expected hiring range for this position has been provided. Actual pay will be determined based on the candidate's experience, qualifications, specific skill sets, and geographic work location.

AAMVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

About the Role:

Join us as a Principal Software Test Engineer (Quality Assurance) and lead the charge in ensuring the quality and reliability of a revolutionary music discovery experience. You will own our quality strategy from the ground up, creating the tools, processes, and systems that enable fast, confident product development.

This role is ideal for a highly autonomous, technically deep, and strategically minded engineer who is passionate about building robust systems and scalable practices. Our product combines real-time audio, content delivery, ML-driven recommendations, and an immersive Flutter mobile experience. If you're excited by complex systems and the chance to impact the future of music technology, we want to hear from you.

What You Will Do:

  • Lead QA Strategy Across the Stack Architect and implement scalable, maintainable testing strategies across mobile, backend, and data layers.
  • Define test coverage, automation frameworks, and CI/CD integration points with long-term sustainability in mind.
  • Own Execution With High Autonomy Scope, plan, and execute major QA initiatives independently. Anticipate risks and blockers, drive technical decisions, and ensure product quality with minimal oversight.
  • Serve as QA Expert be the go-to authority on quality engineering practices for the broader organization. Advise other teams on QA approaches, tools, architecture, and represent QA in cross-functional technical discussions.
  • Support Product Innovation & Launches; Partner with engineering and product leaders to evaluate changes, support feature launches, and ensure quality at every step of the product lifecycle.
  • Integrate emerging trends and keep our test systems aligned with modern best practices.
  • Mentor and Grow Talent; Act as a technical mentor and talent ambassador. Support junior engineers, help contextualize career development opportunities, and contribute to a high-performance, high-learning culture.
  • Continuously Improve Tools & Processes Drive improvements to our automation infrastructure, test data management, and performance testing practices. Ensure quality metrics and standards are clearly defined and monitored across teams.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally, working closely with Flutter developers, backend engineers, product managers, designers, and data scientists. Translate complex product and system behavior into clear, actionable quality strategies.

What You Need to Be Successful:

  • Experience: 10+ years in Quality Assurance, with a strong focus on testing fully localized mobile applications that incorporate backend services, data pipelines, and recommendation systems.
  • Technical Skills: Deep understanding of modern QA methodologies, best practices, and tools, with a specific focus on testing Flutter applications, including widget testing, integration testing, regression testing, end-to-end testing, and localization testing.
  • Automation Systems: Proven ability to build and maintain robust automated test pipelines across mobile, backend, and data systems. Skilled in CI/CD integration (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI).
  • Architectural Knowledge: Strong understanding of testing strategies for distributed systems, asynchronous event flows, APIs, mobile performance, and real-time data integrity.
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to define long-term QA vision aligned with engineering and product goals and translate it into actionable plans.
  • Decision-Making & Judgment: Makes fast, effective decisions in ambiguous environments. Routinely anticipates and mitigates quality risks before they escalate.
  • Mentorship & Influence: Track record of mentoring team members, shaping team culture, and being recognized as a trusted technical voice across the organization.
  • Trend Sensitivity: Comfortable identifying and integrating industry trends into quality workflows to ensure testing infrastructure stays ahead of the curve.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Has successfully driven breakthrough ideas and quality improvements in multi-team environments.

Bonus Points if You Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • Passion for music and interest in shaping next-gen music products
  • Experience with recommendation systems, social products, or real-time audio streaming
  • Background testing audio software, DSP, or audio UX on mobile devices
  • Experience supporting international launches or localization-heavy products

What Makes You Eligible:

  • This is a 100% remote position
  • Must be available during typical continental U.S. business hours
  • Willingness to travel up to 5%, domestically or internationally
  • Successful completion of a background investigation and drug screen as a condition of employment

- Remote

Pay Transparency

$ 108,750 - $ 159,500

Dependent on the position offered, other forms of compensation are also available, such as bonuses or commission.

Pay is based on a wide range of factors, including, without limitation, skill set, experience, training, location, and business need. While the above range is a reasonable estimate of the wage range for this position, please note the disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographical differential associated with the location where the position may be filled.

Benefits

HARMAN is interested in the health and wellbeing of you and your family and offers a range of benefits designed to support your needs for holistic wellbeing. Benefits and perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with HARMAN, and may include paid vacation and holidays, paid sick leave, volunteer leave, and paid bonding and care giver leave. Employees may also be eligible to participate in comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, fertility support and adoption assistance, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan with employer match, short and long term disability coverage, life insurance, and more.

You Belong Here

HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.

About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology

Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.

Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.

If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

Important Notice: Recruitment Scams

Please be aware that HARMAN recruiters will always communicate with you from an '@harman.com', ‘@careers.harman.com’ or ‘harmanglobal.avature.net’ email address. We will never ask for payments, banking, credit card, personal financial information or access to your LinkedIn/email account during the screening, interview, or recruitment process. If you are asked for such information or receive communication from an email address not ending in one of the above email domains about a job with HARMAN, please cease communication immediately and report the incident to us through: harmancareers@harman.com.

HARMAN is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. HARMAN strives to hire the best qualified candidates and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse marketplaces and communities of our global colleagues and customers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. HARMAN attracts, hires, and develops employees based on merit, qualifications and job-related performance.(www.harman.com)

Title: Senior Quality Engineer

Location: Atlanta, GA

We’re on the lookout for a dynamic and passionate Software Quality Engineer to join our quality engineering team and make an immediate impact! In this pivotal technical role, you’ll dive headfirst into hands-on automation challenges, deliver robust in-sprint testing support, and elevate our testing frameworks. You’ll be at the heart of strengthening quality engineering practices across the organization, collaborating closely with developers, product owners, and quality engineering leadership. As an active member of our Testing Guild, you’ll help drive continuous improvement, push for standards alignment, and champion engineering excellence every step of the way!

  • This is a hybrid role with an expectation of being in the office 2–3 days per week**


Key Responsibility Areas

In-Sprint Quality & Testing Support:

  • Participate fully in in-sprint testing, ensuring stories are validated before completion of each sprint.
  • Partner with developers to ensure functional, integration, and end-to-end test readiness.
  • Validate acceptance criteria and perform risk-based testing.
  • Ensure defects found in-sprint are triaged and resolved quickly.
  • Promote shift-left testing practices and automation first mindset.
  • Drive a measurable reduction in escaped defects through improved automation coverage.
  • Contribute to faster release cycles by optimizing in-sprint testing processes.


Automation Design & Execution

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated tests using Java, Playwright, and Cucumber.
  • Build automated tests across UI, API, integration, and regression layers.
  • Review application designs for testability and provide input early in SDLC.
  • Execute automation aligned with CI/CD pipelines.


Product Quality Advocacy

  • Serve as a quality champion within the team.
  • Monitor key quality indicators including defect trends and automation health.
  • Support performance, security, and observability test initiatives.
  • Ensure deliverables meet reliability and functional completeness standards.
  • Join a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and supports ongoing learning through participation in our Testing Guild and regular knowledge-sharing sessions.


Qualifications

  • Programming Languages: Java
  • Automation Tools: Playwright, Jmeter/Load Runner, Cucumber
  • Test Management: JIRA, Xray, Zephyr
  • Testing Concepts: API testing, performance testing, observability tools
  • Methodologies: Agile/SAFe
  • 5–7+ years of experience in test automation or software engineering
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native testing
  • Insurance/finance experience is a plus
  • Excellent communication, debugging, and problem-solving skills


Hiscox Values

At Hiscox our spirit is in Challenging Convention and everything we do is guided by our Values.

  • Courage: Dare to take a risk
  • Ownership: Passionate, commercial and accountable
  • Integrity: Do the right thing, however hard
  • Connected: Together, build something better
  • Human: Clear, fair and inclusive


Salary Range: $80-$100k

The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment.

What Hiscox USA Offers

  • Competitive salary and bonus (based on personal & company performance)
  • 401(k) with competitive company matching
  • Comprehensive health insurance, vision, dental and FSA plans (medical, limited purpose, and dependent care)
  • Company paid group term life, short- term disability and long-term disability coverage
  • Paid parental leave
  • 4 week paid sabbatical after every 5 years of service
  • Financial Adoption Assistance and Medical Travel Reimbursement Programs
  • Annual reimbursement up to $600 for health club membership or fees associated with any fitness program
  • Recipient of 2024 Cigna’s Well-Being Award for having a best-in-class health and wellness program
  • Dynamic, creative and values-driven culture
  • Modern and open office spaces, complimentary drinks


About Hiscox USA

Hiscox USA was established in 2006 to focus on the needs underserved and specialty commercial clients via both the regional broker and direct distribution channels and is today the fastest-growing business unit within the Hiscox Group.

Today, Hiscox USA has a talent force of about 400 employees mostly operating out of 6 major cities. Hiscox USA offers a broad portfolio of commercial products, including technology, cyber & data risk, multiple professional liability lines, media, entertainment, management liability, crime, kidnap & ransom, commercial property and terrorism.

Work with amazing people and be part of a unique culture

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description

Collaborates closely with embedded system software developers to define comprehensive test plans and ensure thorough test coverage for all new functionalities. Design, implement, and execute manual and automated tests, analyze results, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our testing processes. The ideal candidate has experience in embedded software testing, excellent problem-solving skills, and a passion for delivering high-quality products

Responsibilities

  • Design enhancements, updates, and programming changes for portions and subsystems and software tests.
  • Execute and author testing plans, protocols, and documentation for assigned portions of applications; identify and debug issues with code, recommending changes or improvements as needed.
  • Analyse system designs to determine coding, programming, and integration activities required based on specific objectives and established project guidelines.
  • Develop and maintain manual and automated test cases, ensuring thorough test coverage of embedded software features and functionalities.
  • Participate as a key member of project teams, collaborating with other software systems engineers and internal or outsourced development partners to deliver reliable, cost-effective, and high-quality solutions.
  • Collaborate and communicate regularly with internal and outsourced partners regarding software systems design status, project progress, and issue resolution.
  • Lead or contribute to the validation and resolution of complex technical issues, facilitating effective team decision-making.
  • Continuously improve testing methodologies, tools, and processes to enhance software quality and reliability.

Education And Experience Required

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent
  • Must graduate within 1 year before start date

Knowledge And Skills

  • Proficiency with software systems design tools and programming languages (e.g., Python, C, Go).
  • Expertise in software systems testing methodology, including creation and execution of test plans, debugging, and use of testing scripts and tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply these to complex system-level challenges.
  • Experience designing software systems running on multiple platform types.
  • Solid understanding of computer system architecture, devices, and communication protocols.
  • Familiarity with embedded Linux, device drivers, and related technologies.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; mastery of English and local language.
  • Ability to effectively communicate design proposals, negotiate technical options, and facilitate collaborative solutions.
  • Proven leadership abilities in directing team activities and supporting team-based decision processes.

Accessibility

If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

We are seeking an experienced Quality Assurance Engineer for our Home Networking team! In our team, you can always stay at the forefront of technology, have access to and learn about the latest generation of networking technologies worldwide. Together with other outstanding engineers in the team, you will create reliable, stable, and high-speed network access products for users, provide user-friendly and convenient smart home solutions, and bring convenience to the lives of millions of users worldwide!

  • Perform manual and automated testing on Wi-Fi routers, Mesh Wi-Fi, network adapters, accessories, etc.

Other Expectations

Company Overview

Brother is a leading provider of home and office equipment, sewing and crafting products, and industrial solutions. With a legacy spanning over 115 years, our brand is renowned for producing award-winning printers, sewing machines, P-touch labelers, and more. Brother International Corporation (BIC) was established in 1954, marking over 70 years of operations in the United States. Our Americas headquarters is located in Bridgewater, New Jersey. BIC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Brother Industries Limited (BIL), which was founded in 1908 in Nagoya, Japan, and operates in more than 30 countries worldwide. Brother’s Americas presence includes subsidiaries in Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, and Peru.

Why Work at Brother?

Brother USA has consistently been recognized as a best place to work, reflecting our commitment to fostering a workplace culture aligned with our core values of being inclusive, collaborative, customer-centric, and socially responsible. We value work-life balance and flexibility, and as a result have introduced policies such as our hybrid office schedule, casual dress code, and flexible Fridays, which allow us to wrap up meetings for dedicated focus time or to start our weekends sooner, year-round. Our commitment to employee growth and development is demonstrated through our offering of facilitated courses and certificate programs and our investment in resources that enable self-paced learning.

Role Overview

The Engineer, Quality Assurance is responsible for testing new releases of printers, firmware, mobile applications, software development kits (SDKs), and sample code, as well as investigating and troubleshooting customer issues escalated through Technical Support and Sales. On an occasional basis, the role also involves implementing customer-requested hardware and configuration changes, including firmware updates and component replacements.

The role requires a self-motivated individual who can develop consistent, repeatable testing processes and maintain clear, thorough documentation that supports knowledge sharing, troubleshooting, and the team's ongoing success.

Duties & Responsibilities

Test New Releases

    • Plan and perform functional and regression testing of printers, firmware, mobile applications (iOS and Android),
    • SDKs, and sample code before each release
    • Write and maintain clear, repeatable test cases and release checklists
    • Record, track, and retest defects in the bug tracking system (Jira or Azure DevOps (ADO)
    • Write basic scripts (e.g., Python) to speed up repetitive testing tasks


Investigate and Troubleshoot Customer Issues

    • Reproduce and investigate customer issues escalated by Technical Support and Sales that are uncertain or unknown
    • Isolate whether a problem comes from printer hardware, firmware, configuration, connectivity, or the customer’s software
    • Document all findings so that others can quickly understand and act on them; occasionally work directly with customer engineers and developers
    • Turn recurring customer issues into new test cases to prevent repeat problems


Fulfill Customer Hardware Change Requests

    • Perform firmware updates, printer configuration changes, and custom settings requested by customers
    • Perform part swaps and assembly using basic hand tools, and document every change made


Build the QA Function

    • Work with the Engineering Manager to establish test plans, release criteria, and documentation standards
    • Share test results and quality trends with the engineering team


Experience & Qualifications

Education Level:

    • Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Engineering Technology, or related field


Experience Level:

    • 2+ years of experience in software or hardware testing/QA, technical support, or device troubleshooting (internships and co-ops count
    • 2+ years of experience in testing mobile applications (iOS/Android) or connected hardware such as printers, scanners, or other devices Preferred
    • 2+ years of hands-on tinkering: building, repairing, or modifying electronics or devices (work, school, or personal projects


Software/Technical Skills

    • Bug tracking and test management (Jira or Azure DevOps (ADO)
    • iOS and Android devices: installing builds and collecting logs (Xcode, Android Studio)
    • Scripting (Python)
    • Basic hand tools for hardware assembly and part swaps


Other Skills/Knowledge/Abilities

    • Self-motivated; works independently with minimal supervision
    • Clear Documentation
    • Effective Communication
    • Methodical, detail-oriented troubleshooting
    • Technical tinkering / mechanical aptitude


Additional Details For This Role

This role will be an onsite role. You are expected to work from the stated job location 5 days a week.

Base Salary

The targeted base salary range for this position is $ 90,000 - $ 110,000 per year.

Base salary is determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the successful candidate, as well as factors such as internal equity, cost of labor in the hiring location, and alignment with market data.

Our Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package with diverse plan options to meet your family’s needs, including health, vision, and dental insurance—all effective from day one of employment. Under our 401(k) retirement savings plan, we match up to 100% of the first 4% of employee contributions, with employer matches vesting immediately. Additionally, we offer an educational assistance program that reimburses up to 100% of tuition, lab fees, textbooks, and other related expenses for qualifying programs. Details are available at https://mybenefits.nfp.com/Brother/2026/guidebook/ for 2026 and https://mybenefits.nfp.com/Brother/2027/guidebook/ for 2027.

Our Mission, Vision & Culture

Our mission is to live our “at your side” promise to simplify and enrich the lives of our customers, employees, and communities. We aim to be where people and technology meet, providing products and solutions that enhance how people live, work, and create. We look to our strategic culture drivers - accountability, authenticity, boldness, and excellence - to enable us to consistently deliver on our vision, mission, and shared values. These drivers help us shape a culture that empowers the business to succeed.

About Where We Work

Brother’s corporate headquarters for the Americas is in Bridgewater, NJ, across from the Bridgewater Commons Mall. This location houses key corporate functions, including HR, legal, finance, IT, and supply chain, and a significant presence of our business unit leadership and marketing teams. Our manufacturing and distribution facility in Bartlett, TN spans an impressive 1.5 million square feet - equivalent to 26 football fields - and is located on Brother Boulevard. In addition to the distribution center operations team, this facility hosts several other departments, including our customer service group. Brother also has employees based in other locations, such as Westminster, CO, where many of our marketing and product engineering team members from the mobile solutions division operate, as well as our distribution centers in Richmond, VA and Perris, CA. Additionally, our outside sales teams work remotely within their territories, staying geographically close to the accounts they support to ensure they are always “at your side” for our customers.

Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) Statement

Brother International Corporation ("Brother") is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local, state or federal laws. Brother is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities throughout the application or interview process. If you need an accommodation, please contact us at eoe_applicant_accommodations@brother.com .

POSITION DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a hands-on Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Quality Engineering team, focusing on Salesforce testing, test automation, and end-to-end validation of integrated enterprise systems. The ideal candidate can assess code quality, validate integrations, prevent production defects, and take ownership of release quality.

The ideal candidate will have at least 5 years of Salesforce testing experience and 5 years of software quality engineering and test automation experience, with strong expertise in Playwright and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD).

This role will be based in San Francisco, CA.

Responsibilities

  • Software Quality Engineering: Develop test strategies, plans, scenarios, and cases; perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and end-to-end testing.
  • Salesforce Testing: Validate Salesforce configurations, workflows, business rules, permissions, reports, dashboards, data integrity, and integrations.
  • Test Automation: Design, develop, and maintain scalable Playwright automation frameworks using BDD, Gherkin, and reusable components.
  • API and Integration Testing: Validate REST APIs, backend functionality, database integrity, and data exchanges across enterprise applications.
  • Defect and Release Management: Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects; perform root-cause analysis and assess release readiness based on quality risks and test results.
  • CI/CD and Continuous Improvement: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, improve regression coverage, and explore AI-assisted testing solutions.
  • Collaboration: Work with developers, product owners, business analysts, and stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Manage field testing and performance data analysis for test sites across the US.

Required Qualifications

  • 5 years of hands-on Salesforce application testing experience.
  • 5 years of software quality engineering and test automation experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Playwright and BDD using Gherkin.
  • Experience designing and maintaining reusable automation frameworks.

Classification: Exempt

Status: Full-Time

Reports to: Manager, Quality Assurance Business

Purpose

PANTHERx Rare Pharmacy is looking for a talented and experienced intermediate level professional IT QA (Quality Assurance) Engineer to join our Specialty Pharmacy team. As a member of our IT Quality Assurance team, you will design and execute test plans to ensure the highest quality software products for our specialty pharmacy customers.

The ideal candidate for this role will have strong technical knowledge of software quality assurance and emerging AI-driven testing methodologies. The candidate should have excellent communication and problem-solving skills and be able to think critically to evaluate and analyze software applications. This position will be responsible for evangelizing and executing QA policies and procedures, adhering to QA standards, and monitoring the QA process to ensure a high quality of deliverables.

Responsibilities

  • Develops test plans and executes test cases based on business requirements.
  • Ability to test across multiple platforms and applications on mobile and desktop as well as APIs
  • Monitors the QA process to ensure the highest quality of deliverables.
  • Follows comprehensive QA processes and procedures.
  • Analyzes and evaluates QA results.
  • Provides a voice during team meetings and scrum ceremonies.
  • Writes SQL queries to set up and validate test data.
  • Communicates QA results to stakeholders.
  • Develops and implements automated testing.
  • Ability to leverage AI-powered testing tools and frameworks to enhance test coverage and efficiency.
  • Implements machine learning models for predictive defect analysis and risk-based testing.
  • Utilizes AI-driven test case generation and optimization techniques.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience in software quality assurance.
  • Knowledge of software testing processes and methodology.
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Basic understanding of AI concepts and their application in software testing.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven software tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Two (2) years of experience testing mobile applications.
  • Experience testing SMS.
  • Experience testing APIs
  • Experience in the pharmacy industry
  • Experience using proprietary project and issue tracking software (Azure DevOps, JIRA, etc.).
  • Experience using test management systems (Azure Test Plans, TestRail, etc.)
  • Experience in developing and implementing automated testing using a scripting language (C# preferred) and Selenium.
  • Experience with AI-based visual testing and intelligent defect prediction tools.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, see, talk, or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms. Visual acuity is necessary for tasks such as reading, or working with various forms of data on a screen for extended periods. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Benefits

Hybrid, remote and flexible on-site work schedules are available, based on the position. PANTHERx Rare Pharmacy also affords an excellent benefit package, including but not limited to medical, dental, vision, health savings and flexible spending accounts, 401K with employer matching, employer-paid life insurance and short/long term disability coverage, and an Employee Assistance Program! Generous paid time off is also available to all full-time employees, as well as limited paid time off for part-time employees. Of course we offer paid holidays too!

Equal Opportunity

Important Disclaimers

  • Please note: A few of our roles may require in-person interviews at Cognizant offices or client locations, depending on project or client needs.**

In This Role, You Will

  • Design comprehensive test strategies and detailed test plans for complex enterprise applications built with TypeScript and Core Java ensuring thorough validation of functional integration and regression scenarios across hybrid work arrangements.
  • Develop robust automated test suites and maintain reusable test frameworks aligned with Core Java and TypeScript coding standards improving test coverage reducing execution time and supporting reliable continuous integration pipelines.
  • Execute systematic functional integration system and regression testing cycles documenting test outcomes with clear defect descriptions and actionable evidence to support efficient resolution by engineering teams.
  • Collaborate closely with product owners business analysts and software engineers to refine testable requirements clarify business rules and align test scenarios to expected outcomes that enhance customer and stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Analyze production incidents and recurring defects to identify patterns propose targeted quality improvements and help teams implement root cause fixes that strengthen overall application stability and maintainability.
  • Provide clear guidance to junior test team members by sharing test design best practices reviewing test cases and promoting disciplined defect management that improves overall team productivity and consistency.
  • Coordinate end to end test execution across multiple environments track progress against test plans and communicate concise status updates and risk assessments to project stakeholders supporting timely release decisions.
  • Drive data preparation activities by defining realistic test data sets validating data integrity and aligning data scenarios to merchandising use cases where applicable ensuring meaningful coverage of business flows.
  • Validate integration points and service interfaces for TypeScript and Core Java components by executing focused interface tests monitoring logs and confirming that end to end transaction behavior meets performance and reliability expectations.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating existing test processes recommending pragmatic enhancements and implementing measurable changes that reduce defect leakage and increase release confidence.
  • Review technical designs and code changes from a testability perspective highlighting potential risk areas suggesting additional test scenarios and ensuring that quality considerations are integrated early in the development lifecycle.
  • Engage in hybrid collaboration ceremonies by participating in planning estimation and defect triage discussions contributing analytical insights that help teams prioritize work and optimize testing efforts.
  • Contribute to the company purpose by safeguarding software reliability for merchandising related solutions enabling smoother retail operations better customer experiences and more efficient decision making that positively impacts society.

Locations: Atlanta,GA

Work model: Hybrid

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Atlanta,GA. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered (Required)

  • Possess extensive experience in Core Java based test automation and service validation demonstrating skill in creating maintainable test suites that integrate seamlessly with enterprise pipelines.
  • Demonstrate strong proficiency in TypeScript for validating modern web interfaces and front end behavior including structured test case design for complex user journeys and edge conditions.
  • Bring solid background in advanced test design techniques including boundary analysis equivalence partitioning and risk based testing to maximize coverage while optimizing effort.
  • Apply deep understanding of defect management practices and test lifecycle tools to maintain accurate test artefacts traceability records and high quality reporting that supports audit ready documentation.
  • Utilize practical knowledge of merchandising processes such as product assortment pricing and inventory flows where available translating domain insight into more realistic and valuable test scenarios.
  • Show proven capability in working within hybrid delivery models using modern application lifecycle tools maintaining effective communication and collaboration across onsite and remote team members.
  • Exhibit strong analytical and problem solving skills enabling effective investigation of complex defects precise isolation of root causes and clear articulation of findings to technical and business partners.
  • Apply experience gained over ten to fourteen years in structured testing environments to handle large scale test initiatives maintain discipline under tight timelines and meet quality expectations for enterprise releases.

Salary And Other Compensation

Applications will be accepted until 11/20/2026.

The annual salary for this position is from $71k to $112K depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Benefits: Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
  • Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) plan and contributions
  • Long-term/Short-term Disability
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

Job Title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer

Location: Maple Grove, MN

Reports To: Jeff Guhin

Employment Type: Full Time

Job Requisition ID: 2026-1076

Requisition Begin Date: 11/3/2026

Requisition End Date: 1/3/2027

Role Overview

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape how quality is built into technology at ProAg. As a Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you’ll partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, developers, architects, DevOps, and other quality professionals to understand business outcomes, identify risks, and create maintainable automated testing solutions. You’ll use automation and practical AI capabilities to improve testing efficiency, reliability, and feedback throughout the development lifecycle. Through this work, you’ll help reduce delivery risk, improve customer experiences, and support the technology behind the people who grow America’s food, fuel, and fiber.

In This Exciting Opportunity, You Will

  • Participate throughout the Agile software development lifecycle, helping define acceptance criteria, testability, and quality risks early, and translating business requirements and technical designs into practical test strategies, plans, scenarios, and automated checks.
  • Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated and manual tests for web applications, APIs, service-oriented architectures, and integrated business workflows using approved technologies such as Playwright or Selenium, C#, NUnit, and related tools to create reliable, reusable, and supportable solutions.
  • Apply AI-assisted tools responsibly to accelerate automated test design, code generation, refactoring, debugging, documentation, and maintenance, while validating outputs for accuracy, security, and quality.
  • Analyze test failures and operational information to isolate root causes, clearly communicate and support defects through resolution and verification, identify coverage gaps and defect trends, and improve product quality, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and collaborate with DevOps and engineering teams to provide fast, trustworthy feedback across environments, while participating in peer reviews of test code, test cases, test plans, and defects and contributing to shared engineering standards.
  • Support risk-based testing decisions that balance speed, coverage, maintainability, and business impact, while documenting automation frameworks, testing processes, tools, and workflows and continuously improving ProAg’s quality engineering strategy, frameworks, and skill-based ways of working.

What You Bring

  • Relevant professional experience in software quality assurance, automated testing, software development, or a closely related discipline, along with a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent education and/or experience.
  • Hands-on experience designing automated tests and contributing to test frameworks for modern applications and services, with experience in several of the following highly valued: C#, Python, Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, API testing, SQL, PostgreSQL, AWS, CI/CD, Azure DevOps pipelines, Page Object Model, web applications, and service-oriented architectures.
  • Strong understanding of software testing and development principles, including risk-based testing, test design, defect lifecycle management, quality throughout the SDLC, object-oriented programming, full-stack web applications, and common application integration patterns.
  • Experience testing APIs for functionality, reliability, performance, and security, with strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills to investigate complex failures and clearly explain findings.
  • Ability to estimate, prioritize, plan, and coordinate testing activities in Scrum, Kanban, or similar Agile delivery models, along with the ability to learn and work effectively in a technology stack or business domain that may differ from previous environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, emphasizing clarity, collaboration, confidentiality, tact, and diplomacy, combined with curiosity and a continuous-learning mindset, including an interest in applying AI and emerging technology to improve quality engineering outcomes.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefit package
  • Strong learning culture with ongoing development opportunities
  • Opportunities for growth and career advancement
  • Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, with eligibility beginning on your first day of employment
  • Basic life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) plan with 6% company match
  • 20 days of PTO, three floating holidays, approximately 10 paid holidays, and volunteer time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Access to our award-winning wellness program, including mental health services, fitness network membership, and a complimentary Headspace subscription
  • Student loan matching program
  • Employee discount program
  • An opportunity to do meaningful work and love what you do

What We Represent

A career with purpose. Our crop insurance professionals work each day to bring peace of mind and protection to American farmers and ranchers. Join a team who truly cares.

  • Part of something bigger: We offer a career with purpose as you support the farmers and ranchers who create food, fuel, and fiber for the world.
  • Personal connections: We are built on strong relationships and appreciation of your individuality.
  • A team who cares: We look out for each other personally and professionally because we care about each other.
  • Innovators by trade: We’re committed to a brighter tomorrow for our team members and agriculture.
  • The best of both worlds: We combine personal connections with powerful resources, thanks to our culture and the backing of Tokio Marine HCC.

The Company

ProAg, a member of the Tokio Marine HCC group of companies, is positioned as a financially strong and well-capitalized insurer with an AM Best rating of A++. With 100 years of service to our agents & insureds, we stand committed to continuing the principles that ProAg was founded on: Integrity, Loyalty, and Customer Service.

Tokio Marine HCC is a leading specialty insurance group with offices in the United States,

the United Kingdom, Europe, and other exciting locations. With the strength and stability

that comes from being a member of the Tokio Marine Group, and more than fifty years of

growth, profitability, and stability, we offer important insurance products that most people

don’t even know exist. Every policy we write is special, enabling our clients to do amazing

things.

Functioning under minimal supervision, the Retail QA Engineer II works closely with Development, QA Team Lead and the QA Manager to insure that the overall quality of the product as released to the customer satisfies company standards. The QA Engineer II will be involved in the review of requirements for weaknesses in function, performance, reliability, scalability, testability, usability, security and compliance, and provides recommendations to the development team. The QA Engineer II will provide input into sizings for assigned projects to the Pomeroy PMO. The QA Engineer II will prepare a test plan (manual and/or automated) covering all aspects of the release including entry and exit criteria, hardware certifications and documentation. The QA Engineer II assists QA Leads in preparing specific test scripts designed to validate that the programs produced meet specifications as well as the customer's expectations and terms of acceptance. The QA Engineer examines the customers’ requirements and terms of acceptance, development functional and design specifications and verifies that they meet the company measures of acceptance. The QA Engineer may test the software utilizing the test plan and test scripts prepared and validate that the software and documentation meet all established criteria. The QA Engineer will work with more junior QA Specialists to assist in their training and will provide leadership with test teams.

The successful QA Engineer has good communication skills and is able to work as a member of the team.

This position is a Greenville-based inbound position and works directly as part of the Software Development/QA Team. As such, each job function is stated in the context of the overall Software Development goal with clarification for the specific responsibility assigned to this role.

Senior QA Engineer -AI & Engineering

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to business. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models-traditional teams, pools, or pods-are tailored to each client's needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Work You'll Do

As an SDET III, you will bring considerable technical expertise to deliver effective solutions to clients including the following:

  • Acting as the lead, interfacing between clients and our Deloitte teams.
  • Helping to create testing solutions to meet our clients' business needs.
  • Leading the testing of custom technology solutions.

Required Qualifications And Experience

  • 6+ years' relevant consulting or industry experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field.
  • 4+ years hands-on experience defining the testing strategy for large scale programs and ensuring requirements traceability throughout the system development lifecycle. Experience should include leading the testing efforts, including experience with all phases of testing: system integration, user acceptance, and performance testing.
  • Experience with at least two of the following: TCOE, TMO, mobile testing, automation testing, SAP/Oracle testing, data testing in a client-facing or industry role.
  • 4+ years' experience driving the quality assurance processes and gaining delivery and buy-in from executive leadership.
  • 2+ years' experience leading teams - onshore, offshore and nearshore.
  • Experience with Test and Defect Management tools - MicroFocus, ALM, JIRA.
  • 4+ years' experience working in a testing role in different environments including the following: client server, service-oriented architecture, web-based, mainframe-based and three-tier architectures.
  • Experience with the following: MicroFocus UFT, Rational Tooling, and Open Source Automation Tools such as Selenium, Cucumber, OpSoapUI, PostMan, RESTAssured, Mockito.
  • Experience in at least one Scripting language - Shell, VBScript, Perl or Python.
  • Experience with Source Control Systems - SVN or GIT.
  • Experience with Build tools - Maven, CircleCI.
  • Experience with Automated Reporting.
  • Experience with Cloud testing, API testing
  • Experience with CI/CD/CT tools - Jenkins, Bamboo, Quickbuild.
  • Experience applying prompt engineering techniques to generate, refine, or debug automated test scripts and test data.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred Qualifications And Experience

  • Experience working in Cloud, Web and Mobile Testing platforms - Saucelabs, Browerstack are preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning models.
  • Experience in Python NLTK or similar natural language processing technology.
  • Experience evaluating or testing AI/LLM-based application features (e.g., chatbots, copilots, RAG-based systems), including prompt-response validation and hallucination/edge-case testing.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted defect triage or root-cause analysis tools that reduce manual investigation time.
  • Exposure to self-healing test automation frameworks (AI-driven locator repair, visual AI testing).
  • Understanding of responsible AI/testing governance principles (bias detection, explainability, model validation) as applied to QE.
  • Experience contributing to or influencing AI-adoption roadmaps within a testing/QE organization.
  • Experience implementing testing best practices specific to the test planning and execution processes and gaining buy-in for changes from executives.
  • A deep understanding of testing planning and associated delivery challenges.
  • A strong understanding of the various approaches used in testing techniques - white-box, black-box, load testing, coverage testing and regression testing.

Sponsorship:

  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Wages + Salary

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400 to $207,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to own end-to-end testing and quality assurance for our Industrial IoT (IIoT) device ecosystem. This role is responsible for validating every device touch point—from firmware behavior and device calibration through message processing, telemetry accuracy, and downstream data consumers (APIs, reports, integrations). You will design and execute QA strategies across device, cloud, and mobile surfaces to ensure reliable customer outcomes in real-world field deployments.

You will embed testing into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps Pipelines) and validate event-driven, asynchronous workflows (including Azure Service Bus Topics/Subscriptions and Queues). The validation scope spans system, integration, and data validation testing for applications and services built with Windows Forms/Services, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Services, SQL Server, and Cosmos DB, ensuring telemetry data hierarchies and channels (MQTT, API, and sFTP-based exchanges) are correct, complete, and traceable end to end.

Key Responsibilities Include

  • Own end-to-end QA of IIoT devices and supporting services, including firmware behavior, device calibration workflows, message processing, and telemetry accuracy.
  • Integrate automated testing within CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps Pipelines), leveraging quality gates and clear failure reporting for faster developer feedback loops.
  • Design test strategies for firmware, including test coverage planning, regression strategy, release validation gates, and traceability from requirements to results.
  • Validate IoT telemetry ingestion pipelines and protocols (MQTT), including topic structures, payload schemas, timestamps, units, and data quality rules.
  • Validate telemetry data hierarchies and channel delivery across the platform, including API-based extraction and sFTP-based data exchanges where applicable.
  • Validate event-driven and asynchronous workflows, particularly Azure Service Bus (Topics/Subscriptions and Queues), including ordering, retries, dead-letter handling, idempotency, and replay scenarios.
  • Perform system, integration, and data validation testing across applications and services built with Windows Forms/Services, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Services, SQL Server, and Cosmos DB.
  • Implement end-to-end quality strategies to verify the full data flow: IoT telemetry → data ingestion → processing → storage → reporting and/or API extraction.
  • Lead performance and reliability testing (device-to-cloud and cloud-to-consumer), and validate observability (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting) to ensure issues are detectable and diagnosable. Partner with engineering team members by aligning acceptance criteria, testability, and defect prevention practices.
  • Plan and execute mobile application validation (including automated testing where feasible) across UI/UX and backend flows, including MAUI-based apps
  • Validate mobile Bluetooth (BLE) interactions with IIoT devices in field-like conditions, including pairing, reconnect behavior, range/interference considerations, and failure recovery.
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs.
  • The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional software testing & QA experience, with experience involving end to end platform testing
  • Demonstrated experience with automated testing strategies using common tools like Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Puppeteer.
  • Strong understanding of Black box testing, Load Testing, Observability and Performance/Reliability
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving skills, and an ownership mindset
  • Experience with basic queries using Microsoft SQL Server
  • This position can be based out of the Atlanta, GA or Herndon, VA area.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with testing event-oriented architectures utilizing message broker systems such as Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, etc.
  • Experience testing of and RESTful and SOAP based APIs.
  • Knowledge of cloud services (preferably Azure).
  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog.
  • Prior work experience in IoT or adjacent industries.
  • Relevant industry certifications.

Education

Bachelor's degree in IT, Software Engineering, or related field Preferred

Other Beneficial Skills

  • Azure DevOps or other DevOps methodologies experience.
  • MAUI mobile framework and experience with mobile app development
  • Understanding cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines.

Compensation

Employee Type: Salaried

Currency: USD

Salary Minimum: 125,000

Salary Maximum: 145,000

Incentive: No
