About the Role: QA Automation Engineer

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical QA Automation Engineer to design, build, and maintain automated testing frameworks for web, mobile, and API applications. In this role, you will bridge the gap between software development, product management, and DevOps to ensure software quality, system reliability, and seamless continuous delivery across release cycles.

Core Responsibilities

  • Test Automation Framework Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test scripts and frameworks for UI, API, and regression testing to maximize test coverage and reduce manual testing effort.
  • Test Planning & Execution: Translate product requirements and user stories into comprehensive test plans, test cases, and automated test suites. Execute functional, integration, performance, and end-to-end tests.
  • Defect Tracking & Root Cause Analysis: Identify, log, and track software defects using tools like Jira. Perform root cause analysis on test failures and collaborate with developers to verify bug fixes.
  • CI/CD Pipeline Integration: Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to enable continuous testing and rapid feedback on code deployments.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Software Developers, Product Managers, DevOps Engineers, and Manual QA teams during Agile/Scrum ceremonies to enforce quality standards throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field (Required).
  • Experience: 0–5 years of experience in QA automation, software testing, SDET roles, or software quality engineering.
  • Required Skills:
  • Strong programming and scripting skills in languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or C#.
  • Hands-on experience with test automation tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, or TestNG/JUnit).
  • Experience with API testing and automation tools (e.g., Postman, REST Assured).
  • Solid understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and defect management tools (e.g., Jira).
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and written/verbal communication skills.
  • Preferred Skills:
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker) and version control systems (Git).
  • Familiarity with performance and load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6) and SQL for backend database validation.
  • Knowledge of Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) frameworks (e.g., Cucumber).

What We Offer

  • Targeted Placement: Direct marketing to our network of hiring managers across top Tech, SaaS, FinTech, and Enterprise IT companies.
  • Technical Resume Rebuild: Optimization of your profile to highlight automation frameworks, test coverage metrics, CI/CD integration, and technical stack expertise.
  • Interview Coaching: Guidance on live coding challenges, automation framework architecture questions, and technical QA/SDET interviews.

Ready to Take the Next Step?

Email your updated resume to: yashwanth.phani@maximatek.com

Employer: Amazon.com Services LLC

Position: Quality Assurance Engineer II - AMZ27490.1

Location: Herndon, VA

Multiple Positions Available

Lead the testing of large-scale systems, create test plans, test cases, and drive continuous improvements to the quality assurance processes using Internet and Web technologies including Apache, HTTP, XML, HTML, Load Balancing, and DNS. Develop tests using Java and Shell Scripts in a Linux environment, document and coordinate the deployment of manual and automated tests for complex systems, and test mobile device development kits and device frame works. Consult with and advise project management and development teams on technical issues related to planning, developing, implementing, and modifying testing procedures. Use functional specifications to plan, create, or sign-off on test plans, test cases, and automated test cases. Provide regular, detailed status report on project progress, including test cases executed, bugs discovered, and bugs fixed.

(40 hours / week, 8:00am-5:00pm, Salary Range $113900 - $160000)

Amazon.com is an Equal Opportunity – Affirmative Action Employer – Minority / Female / Disability / Veteran / Gender Identity / Sexual Orientation

Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field and one year of experience in the job offered, or as a Programmer/Analyst, Quality Assurance Engineer, Software Test Developer, or a related occupation. Applications are accepted until further notice.

Meet The Team

The Cisco Wireless Test & Automation team ensures the quality, reliability, and performance of next-generation wireless products. We work closely with development, platform, and system teams to validate features, automate test coverage, and reproduce real-world customer scenarios at scale. Our work directly impacts the experience of millions of users relying on Cisco wireless infrastructure.

Your Impact

Role

As a QA / Automation Engineer, you will contribute to validating Cisco’s wireless platforms by writing test plans, developing automation, and analyzing system behavior. You will gain hands-on experience with real networking environments, lab setups, and modern AI-assisted development tools. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy breaking systems, understanding how they work, and ensuring high-quality product delivery. In This Role, You Will:

  • Write and execute test plans and test cases for wireless features and systems
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts using Python or similar languages
  • Analyze test results and identify issues, inconsistencies, or performance gaps
  • Reproduce customer and system issues in controlled lab environments
  • Assist in setting up and maintaining testbeds and lab environments (routers, switches, access points)
  • Collaborate with development and platform teams to debug and resolve issues
  • Learn and apply AI-assisted tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor) to improve testing efficiency and automation

Minimum Qualification

  • A Bachelor's degree (completed within the past 3 years or expected to be completed within the next 12 months).
  • Qualifying education and work experience should be in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Information Systems, Network Engineering or a related field.
  • Strong programming fundamentals, preferably in Python or a similar scripting language, with a basic understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, and routing.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills with a detail-oriented approach to troubleshooting system behavior.
  • Curious and interested in AI-enabled engineering practices, including using AI tools to improve productivity.

Preferred Qualification

  • Exposure to networking devices (routers, switches, access points) through coursework, labs, or internships
  • Familiarity with setting up small network environments
  • Basic understanding of wireless technologies (Wi-Fi / 802.11)
  • Certifications such as CCNA (or working toward it)

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Job Description

Position Description:

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows. You will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability. You will also collaborate closely with software development partners to define test strategies, expand automation, and responsibly use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support test creation, code review, documentation, and regression analysis while maintaining strong human oversight.

Responsibilities

  • Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with TypeScript, Selenium, and related API-testing tools.
  • End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products.
  • Set up cloud and on-premises environments to verify supported solution scenarios, including LDAP, database, and network configurations.
  • Some possible Dev Ops work to automate creating different environments including single and distributed deployment.
  • Execute product testing focusing on end-to-end, performance and load testing.
  • Create and report test-cycle metrics, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements that reduce cycle time.
  • Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
  • Create reusable automation workflows and prompts that connect product requirements, code changes, Jira or Azure DevOps issues, test results, logs, and documentation into repeatable QA processes.
  • Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.
  • Improve automated test coverage, regression readiness, and feedback speed by identifying repeatable QA workflows and reducing manual effort across release cycles.
  • Document how AI-assisted outputs were reviewed, validated, and incorporated into automation assets when those outputs influence test coverage, quality decisions, or product release readiness.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
  • 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
  • Programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Powershell and/or C#.
  • Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
  • Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
  • Cryptography knowledge including Key Management.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization in the U.S.

Preferred Qualifications

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Ansible experience scripting deployments from development to test to production.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Bitbucket for source code control.
  • Experience with Jira and/or Microsoft Azure DevOps Server for user-story coordination, test-case management, build integration, and issue tracking.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted QA workflows with pull requests, design documentation, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, logs, virtual machines, or test reporting.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including approved-tool usage, sensitive-data handling, intellectual-property awareness, secure coding guardrails, and review of AI-generated automation before reuse.

About Entrust

Our growing company relies on curious, dedicated, and innovative colleagues to anticipate the future and provide solutions for a more connected, mobile and secure world. Entrust technologies and expertise help government agencies, enterprises, and financial institutions in more than 150 countries serve and safeguard citizens, employees and consumers. Each year, our solutions secure billions of transactions — and every day, our technologies issue and manage more than 10 million secure identities. How do we do all of this? Together.

Join us. Together we’ll create solutions for a more connected, mobile and secure life.

For more information, visit www.entrustdatacard.com. Follow us on Twitter, YouTube and LinkedIn.

Entrust Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer with a functional focus, you specialize in designing and executing testing for applications and systems built using custom technologies. Your expertise spans across all levels of testing, including functional, system integration, and end-to-end testing.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Design Test Scenarios: Create optimized test scenarios, plan testing activities, estimate work efforts, and identify test environment and data requirements to ensure thorough testing of applications and systems.
  • Execute Testing: Perform manual and automation testing, execute test cases, report test status, and address defects through creation, triage, and resolution to ensure high-quality deliverables.
  • Analyze Test Outcomes: Apply analytical and cognitive techniques to analyze test outcomes, driving continuous improvements in testing processes and overall quality.
  • Utilize Testing Tools: Leverage various testing tools, BDD/TDD approaches, and test accelerators to enhance test efficiency and quality, ensuring optimal testing outcomes.
  • Report Defects: Identify, document, and report defects, collaborating with teams to resolve issues and improve overall product quality.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Exposure to Testing Methodologies: Experience working with various testing methodologies, including functional, system integration, and end-to-end testing, with the ability to design and execute testing for applications and systems built using custom technologies.
  • Core Testing Skills: Exposure to core testing, technical testing, and business domain/processes, enabling the creation of optimized test scenarios, planning testing activities, estimating work efforts, and identifying test environment and data requirements.
  • Testing Tools and Techniques: Experience working with various testing tools, BDD/TDD approaches, and test accelerators to enhance test efficiency and quality.
  • Manual and Automation Testing: Exposure to both manual and automation testing, including executing test cases, reporting test status, and addressing defects through creation, triage, and resolution.
  • Analytical and Cognitive Techniques: Experience applying analytical and cognitive techniques to analyze test outcomes, driving continuous improvements in testing processes and overall quality.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Proficiency in BDD/TDD: Experience working with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD) approaches to enhance test efficiency and quality, ensuring optimal testing outcomes.
  • Familiarity with Test Accelerators: Exposure to test accelerators, leveraging them to streamline testing processes and improve overall quality.
  • Knowledge of Testing Tools: Experience working with various testing tools, utilizing them to enhance test efficiency and quality, and ensuring thorough testing of applications and systems.
  • Preferred Skills: Telco Billing - client likely to move this to their GCC.

Description

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover anything they want to buy online. We hire the world's brightest minds, offering them a fast paced, technologically sophisticated, and friendly work environment.

In the Mechatronics & Sustainable Packaging Design for Scale (DfS) organization, we have the unique role and privilege to work backwards from our customer needs and represent their voice through the entire product lifecycle (from product development, to deployment, to support & service), embodying Amazon’s leadership principle: Customer Obsession. We raise the bar on the readiness of new technologies in deployment and on the performance of those already in production; our mission is to transform “stand-alone work-cells” into “end-to-end integrated solutions” that are safe, easy-to-operate, easy-to-maintain, easy-to-deploy, and easy-to-service. Are you enthusiastic about the latest advancements in Mechatronics Sustainable Packaging (MSP) automation technology? Would you like to play a vital role in Amazon's dynamic growth? If you have a passion for making an impact on the future today, consider joining Mechatronics & Sustainable Packaging Design for Scale Org.

Key job responsibilities

  • Develop an understanding and assess the quality of fulfillment center and IXD automation
  • Ideate and author validation plans from a written set of product requirements with clarity on specific test cases to be executed against
  • Measure and report machine metrics
  • Provide thoughtful test reports which quantify and prove product maturity
  • Collaborate with partner teams to ensure an aligned view on the quality of the product being validated
  • Develop test scripts and other automation to aid in validation

A day in the life

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  • Maternity and Parental Leave Options
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you!

At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About The Team

You'll be joining a team of Engineers who genuinely care about the Customer. Engineers who use data and scientific methods to measure the quality of the product and who have a passion for not allowing failures into the field.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
  • Experience in automation testing
  • Experience in manual testing
  • Experience in UI and API automation testing (Selenium/SOAPUI)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in API & Mobile testing
  • Experience designing and planning test conditions, test scripts, and test data sets to ensure appropriate and adequate coverage and control

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Applications accepted until further notice.

Meet The Team

The Cisco Wireless team ensures the quality, reliability, and performance of next-generation wireless products. We work closely with development, platform, and system teams to validate features, automate test coverage, and reproduce real-world customer scenarios at scale. Our work directly impacts the experience of millions of users relying on Cisco wireless infrastructure.

Your Impact

Role

Role

As a QA / Automation Engineer, you will contribute to validating Cisco’s wireless platforms by writing test plans, developing automation, and analyzing system behavior. You will gain hands-on experience with real networking environments, lab setups, and modern AI-assisted development tools. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy breaking systems, understanding how they work, and ensuring high-quality product delivery. In This Role, You Will:

  • Write and execute test plans and test cases for wireless features and systems
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts using Python or similar languages
  • Analyze test results and identify issues, inconsistencies, or performance gaps
  • Reproduce customer and system issues in controlled lab environments
  • Assist in setting up and maintaining testbeds and lab environments (routers, switches, access points)
  • Collaborate with development and platform teams to debug and resolve issues
  • Learn and apply AI-assisted tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor) to improve testing efficiency and automation

Minimum Qualification

  • Meet one of the following (completed within the past 3 years or expected to be completed within the next 12 months):
  • A Master's degree with 0 years of work experience; or
  • A Bachelor's degree with 2 years of work experience.
  • Qualifying education and work experience should be in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Information Systems, Network Engineering or a related field.
  • Strong programming fundamentals, preferably in Python or a similar scripting language, with a basic understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, and routing.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills with a detail-oriented approach to troubleshooting system behavior.
  • Curious and interested in AI-enabled engineering practices, including using AI tools to improve productivity.

Preferred Qualification

  • Exposure to networking devices (routers, switches, access points) through coursework, labs, or internships
  • Familiarity with setting up small network environments
  • Basic understanding of wireless technologies (Wi-Fi / 802.11)
  • Certifications such as CCNA (or working toward it)

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

About Plenful

Plenful is on a mission to transform healthcare operations from the inside out. Fresh off our $50M Series B and backed by Notable Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, TQ Ventures, Susa/Kivu Ventures, and other leading investors, we’re building the category-defining AI automation platform that healthcare teams rely on to operate smarter, faster, and more efficiently. Our technology empowers healthcare operators across hospital and health systems, pharmacies and payors to eliminate manual work, reduce administrative burden, and improve compliance, all while unlocking critical revenue to fund programs for their in-need patient populations.

Built by healthcare operators for healthcare operators, Plenful is driven by a deep understanding of the challenges facing today’s care teams. We’re passionate about equipping healthcare workers with world-class tools that deliver real, measurable impact, and we’re proud to serve 100+ leading health systems, pharmacies, and healthcare organizations across the country. If you’re excited to help shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to meet you. Apply now to join our growing team.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer who's passionate about quality engineering, automation, and building scalable testing practices from the ground up. You'll help define the future of quality at Plenful, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, and Design to deliver reliable software at startup speed.

In your first six months, you'll establish and improve automated testing coverage across our core platform, integrate automated testing throughout our deployment pipeline to reduce regression risk, and build the quality metrics that give engineering teams the confidence to ship faster without sacrificing reliability.

What You'll Do

  • Own quality strategy across multiple products and engineering teams
  • Design, build, and maintain robust automated test suites for web applications, APIs, backend services, and integrations
  • Develop testing frameworks that are scalable, maintainable, and integrated into CI/CD pipelines
  • Partner with software engineers during feature development to identify quality risks early
  • Define test plans, acceptance criteria, and release readiness for new product initiatives
  • Perform exploratory, functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing where appropriate
  • Drive automation-first testing practices while minimizing manual regression testing
  • Work closely with Product Managers and Designers to ensure requirements are testable and complete
  • Monitor production quality metrics and partner with engineering to investigate customer-reported issues
  • Champion engineering excellence through code reviews of test automation, quality metrics, and continuous process improvements
  • Mentor engineers on testing best practices and help build a culture where quality is everyone's responsibility

You May Be a Fit If

  • You have 8+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Quality Engineering
  • You've built automated testing frameworks for modern SaaS applications
  • You've tested REST APIs and microservice-based architectures
  • You have experience with YAML-based testing
  • You're proficient with one or more automation frameworks — Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar
  • You write automated tests in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, or C#
  • You have a strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated testing into deployment workflows
  • You have experience with Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions, and modern software development practices
  • You have experience designing and running performance and load tests with tools like k6, Gatling, JMeter, or Locust — and know how to interpret the results against real system behavior
  • You're familiar with SQL and validating data across relational databases
  • You have strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills
  • You communicate well and collaborate easily across Engineering, Product, and Design

Bonus Points If You

  • Have tested AI or machine learning-enabled applications
  • Have worked with healthcare software or in regulated environments
  • Are familiar with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native architectures
  • Have experience with performance, load, or security testing
  • Have tested workflow automation platforms or enterprise SaaS products
  • Have exposure to observability platforms such as Datadog, Grafana, or similar
  • Have worked in fast-paced startup environments

Technologies you'll likely work with: Python, TypeScript, React, YAML, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, GitHub Actions, Playwright, REST APIs, and AI/LLM integrations

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • 🚀 Mission-Driven, World-Class Team — Join an exceptional group of professionals aligned around a meaningful mission and committed to making an impact
  • 📈 Opportunities for Growth — Strengthen your expertise through collaboration with experienced, high-performing leaders across the organization
  • 🏢 Flexible Hybrid Work Environment — We're remote-first, with meaningful office presence in San Francisco and New York. R&D roles follow a hybrid model, with two days per week in our San Francisco office

Benefits & Perks

  • 🏥 Healthcare Coverage — Full medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and participation for your family
  • 💰 401(k) with Company Match — Plenful matches 50% of your first 3% contributed
  • 📊 Equity — Every full-time employee shares in our success
  • 🌴 Unlimited PTO — Take the time you need, when you need it
  • 🍽️ Daily Lunch Stipend — $100/week to cover your midday meals
  • 💪 Wellness Stipend — $100/month to support your health and well-being
  • 🚇 Commuter Benefits — $100/month for SF and NYC-based employees
  • 👶 Parental Leave — Paid leave to support growing families

Compensation

The compensation range for this position reflects the average span for this role. Where an offer lands depends on your experience, qualifications, and interview performance, measured against Plenful’s internal leveling guidelines and market benchmarks. We set offers individually.

This role is also eligible to participate in Plenful’s equity plan, subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Job Purpose

We are seeking an experienced Senior QA Engineer to join our Atlanta-based Quality Assurance organization. In this role, you will combine strong functional testing discipline with practical automation, AI-assisted workflows, exploratory testing, defect management, and quality reporting.

This position will help shape how our organization adopts automation and artificial intelligence in a practical, sustainable way. You will use AI tooling and automation to strengthen our QA process, applying them across requirements analysis, test authoring, coverage review, automation planning, execution, and reporting. We are looking for an engineer who can meet the organization where it is today while helping establish scalable practices for where it needs to go next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role that does not require people management.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Functional Test Ownership
    • Assume full accountability for functional test coverage of assigned applications, including the user interface, service layers, and integration points.
    • Be hands-on across assigned applications, combining manual, exploratory, regression, integration, and automated testing based on risk, value, and maintainability.
    • Define and maintain the application's test strategy, determining which tests should remain manual, which should be automated, and how coverage should evolve over time.
    • Act as the quality authority for the application, providing evidence-based release readiness assessments to engineering and product leadership.
  • AI-Enabled Quality Workflow
    • You will apply AI tooling and automation selectively across the quality lifecycle, with emphasis on improving consistency, speed, coverage, and decision-making:
    • Evaluate requirements, acceptance criteria, and design documentation to surface ambiguities, missing edge cases, and untestable requirements prior to development.
    • Create manual test cases and scenarios from requirements, then apply engineering judgment to refine, consolidate, and prioritize them.
    • Review implemented functionality, requirements, and the existing test suite to identify coverage gaps, duplicate effort, ineffective assertions, and divergence between specified and actual behavior.
    • Assess each test for automation suitability based on stability, execution frequency, maintenance cost, and exploratory value, and make defensible recommendations on automated versus manual execution.
    • Build and maintain Playwright automation where it provides clear value, using AI tooling to accelerate authoring, refactoring, debugging, and long-term maintenance.
    • Operate automated suites within CI/CD pipelines while continuing to perform manual, exploratory, and scenario-based testing where human judgment is the better instrument.
    • Triage, reproduce, document, and drive defects to resolution, using AI-assisted analysis to shorten root-cause isolation.
    • Produce clear, decision-ready reporting on coverage, execution results, defect trends, and release risk.
  • Test Framework Development
    • Contribute substantively to the organization's growing QA automation framework, extending its capability while ensuring it complements a manual testing model.
    • Design and implement automation solutions when required, including architecture, page and component abstractions, fixtures, test data management, environment configuration, CI integration, and reporting, with attention to long-term adoption.
    • Establish automation standards and design patterns that keep test suites fast, reliable, readable, and approachable for QA engineers building automation skills.
  • Technical Leadership
    • Lead by example through code review, pairing, and hands-on guidance; help manual QA engineers build practical automation, AI, and technical testing skills over time.
    • Serve as a resource for the broader QA and engineering organization on practical automation, AI-assisted testing methods, and when manual testing remains the most effective approach.
    • Partner with software engineers, product managers, and DevOps to shift quality activities earlier in the delivery cycle.
Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience in software quality engineering, including strong manual testing experience and meaningful hands-on test automation work.
  • Demonstrated depth with Playwright, extending beyond test authoring to suite architecture, flakiness mitigation, test data strategy, and execution at scale within CI.
  • Practical, applied experience using AI-assisted engineering tooling as part of a routine development or testing workflow for example, AI coding agents, AI-assisted test authoring, or AI-supported code and requirements analysis.
  • Strong foundation in functional testing, including test design techniques, risk-based prioritization, boundary and negative testing, and structured exploratory testing.
  • Experience contributing to or building test automation frameworks, with the ability to explain architectural decisions and adapt solutions for teams at different automation maturity levels.
  • Proficiency in TypeScript or JavaScript, or comparable programming experience with the ability to become productive quickly.
  • Experience owning both manual and automated testing for an application, with sound judgment regarding the appropriate role of each in a hybrid QA model.
  • Working knowledge of defect and test management tooling such as Jira, Xray, or equivalent.
  • Experience integrating automated test execution into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; test plans, defect reports, and quality summaries must stand on their own without narration.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Claude Code or a comparable AI coding agent.
  • Experience creating AI agent skills and custom agents, and using Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, including building MCP servers when existing tooling is not sufficient.
  • API test automation experience across REST or GraphQL, including contract testing.
  • Experience helping a manual QA organization adopt automation, AI tooling, or modern quality practices in a practical and sustainable way.
  • Background in a regulated or high-reliability domain.

descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay And Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
  • Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
  • Pension / Retirement benefits
  • Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  • DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

Being a member of IT FinSight Delivery team, the Delivery Practice Office Testing ("DPO") family is responsible for ensuring that all applications and systems meet defined quality standards. The ETE family encompasses three major areas including (a) functional testing, (b) non-functional testing, and (c) test architecture and enablement. Other key focuses include: regression testing, browser testing, performance testing, capacity and stress testing, resiliency testing, environment management services, and infrastructure testing. Develops, conducts, and evaluates testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. The Test Engineering role is responsible for ensuring that all applications, system products, projects, and solutions meet defined enterprise quality standards. Provide centralized, independent quality assurance services across the firm, including functional and non-functional testing for all products, services, and applications across businesses. Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions, providing testing expertise, oversight, and direction to ensure the functionality of solutions and that design specifications are met.

Your Primary Responsibilities

  • Prepare, maintain and execute test cases based on user stories; present results and track defects to closure
  • Prepare, maintain and execute automated test scripts
  • Maintain traceability from business requirements through test cases to automated scripts
  • Review test cases / automation approach with stakeholder to ensure comprehensive coverage and obtain feedback
  • Track test execution milestones, report on issues and risks with the potential to affect project timelines
  • Construct appropriate end-2-end business scenarios through the application of a broad understanding of business objectives and goals
  • Collaborate with delivery pipeline teams to drive adoption and resolve open issues;
  • Identify dependencies for environmental and data requirements; manage and maintain environment and data.
  • Provide guidance to colleagues related to test coverage and test cases
  • Develop a detailed understanding of the product being delivered
  • Responsible for process compliance & associated documentation
  • Aligns risk and control processes into day to day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately

NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above.*

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 6 years of related experience
  • Bachelor's degree preferred and/or equivalent experience

Talents Needed For Success

  • Java-based test automation using frameworks such as TestNG, Karate, Rest Assured, and Cucumber, including BDD layer with Gherkin, data-driven testing, and API request/response validation.
  • REST API testing using tools like Postman, JMeter, Karate, and Rest Assured, working across multiple payload formats (JSON, XML, CSV).
  • Oracle database experience using Toad and Java JDBC for data access, along with automated data validation.
  • Familiarity with Amazon S3 and file storage across JSON, XML and CSV formats. Test Automation Exposure in S3.
  • Selenium Grid for UI automation testing
  • ALM (Micro Focus ALM / QC Center) for test case management.
  • JIRA integrated with ALM for requirements, test cases, and automation metrics.
  • Git / Bitbucket for source control
  • Fosters a culture where honesty and transparency are expected.
  • Stays current on changes in his/her own specialist area and seeks out learning opportunities to ensure knowledge is up-to-date.
  • Invests effort to individually coach others.
  • Builds collaborative teams across the organization.
  • Communicates openly keeping everyone across the organization informed.

The salary range is indicative for roles at the same level within DTCC across all US locations. Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

descriptionHtml:
By living according to a common set of values, we create a culture that unifies, embraces the uniqueness we all bring to the company, and positions Integer for long-term success.

At Integer, our values are embedded in everything we do.

Customer

We focus on our customers’ success

Innovation

We create better solutions

Collaboration

We create success together

Inclusion

We always interact with others respectfully

Candor

We are open and honest with one another

Integrity

We do the right things and do things right

Who are we?

Integer Holdings Corporation is one of the largest medical device contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs) in the world, serving the cardio and vascular, neuromodulation, and cardiac rhythm management markets. As a strategic partner of choice, we advance the goals of our medical device customers through industry-leading engineering and manufacturing, with a relentless commitment to quality, service, and innovation. The Company's brands include Greatbatch Medical® and Lake Region Medical®.

What You’ll Do In This Role

The primary purpose of this position is to perform work which involves general engineering methods and tools. You will now be utilizing more advanced quality tools and concepts while developing your role as a quality engineering the medical device industry. You apply engineering concepts to resolve acute or chronic problems. You will ensure Integer internal and external customer expectations are met or exceeded with the direction, instruction and guidance from more experienced engineers and managers in your organization.

  • You adhere to Integer’s Values and all safety, environmental, security and quality requirements including, but not limited to: Quality Management Systems (QMS), Safety, Environmental and Security Management Systems, U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, company policies and operating procedures, and other regulatory requirements.

Manufacturing Support

  • You will support regulatory and agency inspections, audits, investigations, and inquiries regarding the control and assessment of product design and manufacturing quality.
  • You will monitor manufacturing of assigned products, assuring compliance with DMR while providing deviation/waiver guidance and assuring complete and correct Device History Records are maintained.
  • You will review the adequacy and correctness of changes to Bill of Materials (BOM’s), Assembly Procedures, Drawings, Component Specification, FMEAs, Control Plans, etc.
  • You will participate in continuous improvement projects.
  • You will assist with product transfers.
  • You will perform work on technical projects where you will follow Integer’s standard quality management and production system methodologies to investigate opportunities for product and process improvements.
  • You are expected to collaborate with others in the exchange of information, ask questions and regularly check for understanding in support of your development as an engineer.

Create Test Methods

  • You will Lead the generation and completion of protocols and reports for test method validations.
  • You will interface with Manufacturing Engineers to review processes for new and existing products and coordinate process validations and capability studies. Recommends process monitoring devices where applicable.
  • You will develop various inspection techniques and procedures to ensure product integrity to design specifications. Responsible for the writing, approval, and implementation of Incoming, In-Process and Final Inspection procedures.

Support Non-Conforming Material Process

  • You will ensure that the disposition of non-conforming materials meet all necessary procedures and assure adequacy of corrective actions to prevent re-occurrence.
  • You will lead and manage complaint investigations.
  • You will participate in plant CAPA activities, including analysis of data and trends in complaints, supplier quality, nonconforming material, training effectiveness, and root causes analysis.
  • You will apply standard data analysis practices and observe products and processes to establish root cause for product and process failures or to support the justification for improvements to products and processes.

Support Site Quality Activities

  • You will support internal quality audit activities, as applicable
  • You embed Quality– “I own Quality.” You are a standard bearer for Quality in everything we do at Integer, by assuring adherence to our Quality Management System (QMS), supporting to corrective and preventive actions investigation and implementation, and contributing to the successful attainment of our quality KPI’s and journey to differentiated quality.
  • You may perform other duties as needed and as directed by your line of supervision.

Support Integer’s Manufacturing Excellence and Market Focused Innovation Strategies:

  • Strategy Alignment through Site Hoshin Plans, Quality Plans, Validation master plans, associated quality improvement imperatives, and regular updates to QA RA weekly and monthly metrics, supporting the walk to 5 sigma.
  • Leadership of Sustained Change ensuring customer change notifications are initiated and completed, as necessary, and supporting continuous improvement activities as required.
  • Standardization through workplace organization & visual controls (5S), Manufacturing Standard Work, and robust training & certification programs where applicable.
  • Associate Engagement promoted through the adoption of standardized problem solving. methodologies, behavior-based safety programs, and improvement idea and suggestion systems.
  • Systems & Process Optimization through adoption of principles of built-in-quality

How You Will Be Measured

The specific measures listed below may be subject to change and are not intended to be an all-inclusive list.

  • Safety is our highest priority; you will be an active supporter of the Integer Environmental, Health & Safety programs.
  • Adhere to all Integer Values: Customer, Integrity, Candor, Inclusion, Collaboration, Innovation
  • You will have defined Goals and Objectives specifying key projects and expected milestones to achieve.
  • Quality - Customer Direct Complaint Rate, NCR rate, Complaint Cycle Time, CAPA Cycle Time
  • Innovation and ideation are critical aspects of your role, and you will be expected to generate continuous improvement suggestions and support the implementation of them.

What Sets You Apart

  • Minimum Education:
    • At a minimum you have earned a bachelor’s degree in an engineering or related field and 3 years relevant experience
    • Candidates who do not meet the education requirement may be considered with 7+ years of relevant experience.
  • Specialized Knowledge:
    • You will have awareness of relevant Domestic and International Regulations and Industry Standards (e.g. ISO, QSR, UL, MDD, TGA etc.)
    • You will have good knowledge in Microsoft Office
    • While you will have regular support and guidance from more experienced engineers, supervisors or managers, you will demonstrate the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with other associates and cross functional teams.
  • Specialized Skills:
    • You will demonstrate a solid technical aptitude with the ability to be an effective contributor to a team or produce results of a technical nature as an individual.
    • You will demonstrate competencies in both written and oral communications.
    • For outside of US countries, you will demonstrate competencies in both written and oral English communications
    • You will maintain a calm demeanor that transcends the high energy, constantly changing production environment.
    • You will possess a positive, can-do attitude with an underlying belief that failure is not an option.
Quality Engineer II Salary: $78,375- $114,950

#IND1

Our total rewards program is designed to attract, retain, and motivate associates to contribute to Integer’s success. Our compensation program includes base salary and a cash-based incentive program supporting our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide a comprehensive benefits package with immediate eligibility including medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, and adoption benefits. Parental leave is available after one year. Optional employee-paid programs include supplemental life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity and accident insurance. Employees are immediately eligible to participate in the 401(k) plan with company matching contributions. We provide 80 hours (10 days) of company designated holidays per year plus an annual allotment of paid time off.

U.S. Applicants: Equal Opportunity Employer. In addition, veterans and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Job Description:

The world is transforming - and so is Intel. Intel is a company of bold and curious inventors and problem solvers who create some of the most astounding technology advancements and experiences in the world. With a legacy of relentless innovation and a commitment to bring smart, connected devices to every person on Earth, our diverse and brilliant teams are continually searching for tomorrow's technology and revel in the challenge that changing the world for the better brings. We work every single day to design and manufacture silicon products that empower people's digital lives. Come join us and do something wonderful.

The Role and Impact

As a Software QA Test Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the quality and reliability of Intel's software products. Through systematic testing, you will help develop and maintain high standards, contributing directly to the functionality and performance of key technologies. Your day-to-day responsibilities will involve creating and executing detailed test plans, analyzing results, and collaborating with development teams to resolve issues, ensuring software meets rigorous quality benchmarks.

In this role, you will identify and isolate defects across software systems and tool interfaces, drive thorough root cause investigations, collaborate directly with software development and engineering teams, and champion quality engineering best practices across the development lifecycle. Your work directly influences the stability, automated efficiency, and operational excellence of mission-critical software powering Intel Mask Operation.

Business group

This role is part of Intel's engineering organization, which drives innovation and excellence in software and hardware development to support Intel's broader goals of delivering cutting-edge technology solutions. Our team focuses on ensuring product quality through robust testing methodologies, fostering collaboration, and advancing Intel's leadership in the tech industry.

Key Responsibilities

Test Strategy & Systematic Execution

  • Design, implement, and execute systematic software test plans, test cases, and test suites across diverse operational environments, toolsets, and system configurations.
  • Formulate clear, repeatable test standards and validation procedures to verify software functionality against architectural specifications and engineering requirements.
  • Validate end-to-end user workflows, system performance characteristics, and software interoperability within production and development environments.

Test Automation & Infrastructure

  • Build, enhance, and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks to accelerate test execution and expand regression coverage.
  • Validate multi-system integrations, data flows, and web service/API calls across interconnected tools and distributed systems.
  • Integrate automated test suites into modern Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to enable continuous quality feedback and rapid validation cycles.

Debugging, Defect Triage & Root Cause Analysis

  • Isolate complex, intermittent, and multifaceted software defects using modern debugging tools and systematic diagnostic methodologies.
  • Conduct deep-dive root cause analyses (RCA) and partner with development teams to formulate, verify, and document effective corrective actions.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of test findings, defect metrics, and verification records to ensure complete end-to-end traceability.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Quality Advocacy

  • Partner actively with software architects, development engineers, and operational stakeholders within IMO to resolve technical blockers and align on acceptance criteria.
  • Participate in technical design and code reviews, providing actionable quality insights regarding system interfaces, scripting standards, and testability.
  • Promote modern testing practices, fostering continuous improvement in test coverage, automated tooling, and team agility.

Experience listed below would be obtained through a combination of your degree, research and or relevant previous job and or internship experiences.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline with 6+ years of hands-on experience in software quality engineering, validation, or software development experience in the following:

  • US Citizenship required.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a US Government Security Clearance.
  • Test automation development and scripting using languages such as Python, Bash, or equivalent.
  • Hands-on experience debugging complex software stacks, including systematic root cause analysis, log analysis, and defect isolation tools.
  • Testing web services/APIs (REST, RPC, etc.) and communication mechanisms across distributed or interconnected systems.
  • Standard software testing levels and methodologies (unit, integration, functional, regression, and performance testing).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in a relevant technical field with 4+ years of experience; OR Ph.D. in a relevant technical field with 2+ years of experience.
  • CI/CD & DevOps: Hands-on experience integrating test frameworks within CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) and containerized test environments (e.g., Docker).
  • Development Lifecycle: Working familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies and defect/project tracking workflows (e.g., Jira).
  • Semiconductor / Manufacturing Systems Context: Exposure to semiconductor manufacturing software, EDA / layout processing tools, platform-level software, OS internals (Linux/Windows), or system computation software.
  • Communication & Analytical Rigor: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proven track record of clearly articulating technical issues to cross-functional engineering teams.

Join Amazon's Prime Video Ads QA team, where we ensure seamless ad delivery across millions of customers worldwide and deliver high-quality advertising experiences at scale.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for Prime Video Ads platform, ensuring high coverage across functional, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Participate in org-level quality initiatives and define QA strategy & test plans across multiple concurrent projects, collaborating with engineering, product, and data science teams.
  • Leverage AI in test automation to generate test cases, predict risk areas, detect anomalies, and accelerate defect resolution.
  • Drive shift-left testing practices by embedding quality early in the software development lifecycle, including requirements review and design validation.
  • Track quality metrics and KPIs, providing data-driven insights to stakeholders on release readiness.
  • Identify gaps in test coverage and proactively drive improvements to reduce customer-impacting defects.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, ensuring automated tests are integrated and executed efficiently across build and deployment workflows.

A day in the life

As a QAE on the Prime Video Ads team, your day involves collaborating with engineers, program and product managers to review requirements, identify risks early, and define test strategies. You'll write and review automation scripts, triage failures in CI/CD pipelines, and leverage AI tools to improve test coverage. You will optimize QA processes using AI adoption. You'll participate in sprint ceremonies, contribute to design reviews, and mentor junior QA engineers. You'll also partner with development teams to validate ad delivery and measurement accuracy, and present quality metrics to stakeholders to drive release readiness decisions.

About The Team

The Prime Video Ads QA team is at the forefront of ensuring seamless and high-quality advertising experiences for millions of customers worldwide. We are a passionate group of quality engineers who thrive on innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Our team works closely with engineering, product, and data science teams to deliver reliable and impactful advertising solutions at scale. We embrace a culture of ownership, where every team member is empowered to drive quality initiatives and make a meaningful impact. We are committed to leveraging AI tools and automation to stay ahead in a fast-paced, ever-evolving landscape.

Basic Qualifications

  • 1+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience in manual testing
  • Experience in automation testing
  • Experience in UI and API automation testing (Selenium/SOAPUI)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in API & Mobile testing
  • Experience designing and planning test conditions, test scripts, and test data sets to ensure appropriate and adequate coverage and control

Position Description:

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows. You will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability. You will also collaborate closely with software development partners to define test strategies, expand automation, and responsibly use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support test creation, code review, documentation, and regression analysis while maintaining strong human oversight.

Responsibilities:

  • Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with TypeScript, Selenium, and related API-testing tools.
  • End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products.
  • Set up cloud and on-premises environments to verify supported solution scenarios, including LDAP, database, and network configurations.
  • Some possible Dev Ops work to automate creating different environments including single and distributed deployment.
  • Execute product testing focusing on end-to-end, performance and load testing.
  • Create and report test-cycle metrics, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements that reduce cycle time.
  • Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
  • Create reusable automation workflows and prompts that connect product requirements, code changes, Jira or Azure DevOps issues, test results, logs, and documentation into repeatable QA processes.
  • Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.
  • Improve automated test coverage, regression readiness, and feedback speed by identifying repeatable QA workflows and reducing manual effort across release cycles.
  • Document how AI-assisted outputs were reviewed, validated, and incorporated into automation assets when those outputs influence test coverage, quality decisions, or product release readiness.


Basic Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
  • 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
  • Programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Powershell and/or C#.
  • Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
  • Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
  • Cryptography knowledge including Key Management.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization in the U.S.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Ansible experience scripting deployments from development to test to production.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Bitbucket for source code control.
  • Experience with Jira and/or Microsoft Azure DevOps Server for user-story coordination, test-case management, build integration, and issue tracking.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted QA workflows with pull requests, design documentation, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, logs, virtual machines, or test reporting.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including approved-tool usage, sensitive-data handling, intellectual-property awareness, secure coding guardrails, and review of AI-generated automation before reuse.

Position Description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows. You will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability. You will also collaborate closely with software development partners to define test strategies, expand automation, and responsibly use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support test creation, code review, documentation, and regression analysis while maintaining strong human oversight.
 
Responsibilities:

- Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with TypeScript, Selenium, and related API-testing tools.
- End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products.
- Set up cloud and on-premises environments to verify supported solution scenarios, including LDAP, database, and network configurations.
- Some possible Dev Ops work to automate creating different environments including single and distributed deployment.
- Execute product testing focusing on end-to-end, performance and load testing.
- Create and report test-cycle metrics, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements that reduce cycle time.
- Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
- Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
- Create reusable automation workflows and prompts that connect product requirements, code changes, Jira or Azure DevOps issues, test results, logs, and documentation into repeatable QA processes.
- Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.
- Improve automated test coverage, regression readiness, and feedback speed by identifying repeatable QA workflows and reducing manual effort across release cycles.
- Document how AI-assisted outputs were reviewed, validated, and incorporated into automation assets when those outputs influence test coverage, quality decisions, or product release readiness.


Basic Qualifications:

- 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
- 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
- Programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Powershell and/or C#.
- Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
- Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
- Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
- Cryptography knowledge including Key Management.
- Must have unrestricted work authorization in the U.S.


Preferred Qualifications:

- BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
- Ansible experience scripting deployments from development to test to production.
- Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Bitbucket for source code control.
- Experience with Jira and/or Microsoft Azure DevOps Server for user-story coordination, test-case management, build integration, and issue tracking.
- Experience integrating AI-assisted QA workflows with pull requests, design documentation, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, logs, virtual machines, or test reporting.
- Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including approved-tool usage, sensitive-data handling, intellectual-property awareness, secure coding guardrails, and review of AI-generated automation before reuse.

The application window is expected to close on: 11/26/2026

This position is hybrid and open to candidates in Fulton, MD or Austin, TX as this person will be in office a minimum of 2-3 days per week.

Meet the Team

Cisco’s Network Security System and Integration Test (SIT) and System Test (ST) teams ensure the quality, reliability, and scalability of our Secure Firewall solutions, serving as a vital line of defense for our enterprise customers.

Your Impact

As a Software Quality Engineer, you will independently own assigned test areas and validate complex, end-to-end customer workflows across physical, virtual, and cloud environments. You will combine hands-on system testing, automation, network-security expertise, and disciplined defect investigation to identify integration and regression risks before release.

Role

You will work closely with software development, platform, automation, product, and release teams throughout the development lifecycle. This role requires strong technical judgment, execution ownership, and clear communication of product-quality risks. In this role, you will:

  • Develop and execute risk-based test plans for Cisco Secure Firewall products and their management, data-plane, platform, and ecosystem integrations.
  • Validate end-to-end workflows across firewall management, threat inspection, routing, switching, NAT, VPN, identity, logging, policy deployment, and related security capabilities.
  • Test complex deployment topologies, including standalone, high-availability, clustered, multi-instance, virtualized, and cloud-based environments.
  • Perform feature integration, system, regression, upgrade, rollback, backward-compatibility, resiliency, recovery, scale, stress, and longevity testing.
  • Design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot automated tests using Python-based frameworks and supporting tools.
  • Build, configure, and maintain representative test environments containing network devices, security appliances, traffic generators, virtual machines, and cloud resources.
  • Reproduce, isolate, and characterize complex software and system failures using packet captures, logs, traces, core files, system metrics, and diagnostic tools.
  • Document defects with clear reproduction procedures, technical evidence, business impact, and severity justification.
  • Participate in feature handoffs, technical reviews, test-plan reviews, defect triage, and cross-functional quality reviews.

descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer to join our performance analysis squad, a team dedicated to building best-in-class tools that help coaches and analysts turn game video and data into winning insights. You'll help us build and scale the products that power film breakdowns, tagging, stats, and reporting, so every clip, metric, and playlist is accurate, fast, and reliable. In this role, you'll lead testing efforts within your squad, focusing on both prevention and efficiency so that coaches and analysts have a seamless experience, from game day through the film room.

As a QA Engineer, You’ll

  • Champion squad quality. Attend and actively voice quality focus in squad sprint scrum ceremonies, understand the core problem being solved and ensure backlog defects are prioritized.
  • Drive test strategy. Create test plans, implement squad quality best practices, use data to drive high-quality outcomes and ensure post-mortems or root cause analyses (RCAs) are created for all hotfixes.
  • Test and merge. Leverage multiple testing approaches—including automated, exploratory and manual testing—from start to finish, ensuring sub-defects are resolved and merge builds run cleanly.
  • Grow professionally. Dedicate time to your own professional development and skill-building.

Location

Time spent collaborating with other Hudlies in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently prioritizing applicants within commuting distance of Lincoln or Omaha, Nebraska. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

  • Experienced. You have 2+ years of software testing experience and have worked in fast-paced environments with changing deadlines.
  • Technical. You have solid experience designing and executing tests across the stack, from front-end UI validation to in-depth API testing, including proven, hands-on experience and proficiency with key languages (e.g. Python, Typescript) and modern automation frameworks (e.g. Playwright, Selenium).
  • Mobile testing exposure. You have experience testing iOS or Android applications and an understanding of mobile-specific performance, UI nuances and automation using Appium, Detox, and/or React Native tooling and the associated APIs that apps rely on (protocols such as GraphQL, REST, etc.).
  • A team player. You work effectively within a global team, leading with empathy and clear communication to help your squad achieve the best outcomes.
  • Problem solver. You can navigate technical and team challenges during changing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Naturally curious. You think outside the box by exploring creative solutions to break software.
  • User-focused. You think critically about the user experience and easily relate to our users.
  • Constantly learning. You are passionate about learning and open to growth areas.
