About Us

Headquartered in the United States, TP-Link Systems Inc. is a global provider of reliable networking devices and smart home products, consistently ranked as the world’s top provider of Wi-Fi devices. The company is committed to delivering innovative products that enhance people’s lives through faster, more reliable connectivity. With a commitment to excellence, TP-Link serves customers in over 170 countries and continues to grow its global footprint.

We believe technology changes the world for the better! At TP-Link Systems Inc, we are committed to crafting dependable, high-performance products to connect users worldwide with the wonders of technology.

Embracing professionalism, innovation, excellence, and simplicity, we aim to assist our clients in achieving remarkable global performance and enable consumers to enjoy a seamless, effortless lifestyle.

TP-Link is seeking a Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Cloud Web Platforms Quality Engineering team. In this role, you will help ensure the quality of TP-Link's global websites, web applications, and AI-powered customer experiences, which reach millions of users across dozens of countries and languages.

You will drive quality throughout the development lifecycle—from reviewing requirements and identifying risks to designing tests, expanding automation coverage, investigating failures, and supporting release decisions. The work ranges from product pages and content-management platforms to AI-powered search and support assistants. You also have the opportunity to contribute to testing the cloud services and APIs behind these experiences. Throughout, you'll work closely with software engineers, product managers, designers, and senior quality engineers.

This role is ideal for a quality engineer who enjoys both breadth and depth: someone comfortable moving between browser-based UI testing, backend API validation, and automation, and who wants to grow expertise across web and cloud technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Develop risk-based test strategies and execute functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing for websites, web applications, content-management systems, APIs, and supporting cloud services.
  • Participate in requirements reviews and design discussions to clarify acceptance criteria, identify risks early, and improve product testability.
  • Build and maintain automated UI and API tests using Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript and frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or equivalent tools. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Validate backend APIs, service integrations, database behavior, and data integrity using API tools, code-based test frameworks, and SQL.
  • Investigate failures and isolate root causes using browser developer tools, network traces, application logs, system telemetry, and database queries.
  • Perform release validation across browsers, devices, and screen sizes, including responsive UI, visual regression, functional, and end-to-end testing to ensure seamless product rollouts.
  • Conduct web performance, load, and accessibility testing, monitoring metrics like Core Web Vitals and ensuring compliance with WCAG guidelines.
  • Produce clear test reports, defect analyses, and go/no-go risk assessments to support release decisions.
  • Advocate for QA best practices, test-code quality, and continuous improvement, using AI-assisted tools where appropriate to improve engineering productivity.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of experience in software quality engineering, with significant experience testing web applications.
  • Solid understanding of software testing principles, test design techniques, and the software development lifecycle.
  • Hands-on experience testing web applications across browsers, devices, and screen sizes, using browser developer tools to inspect network requests, console errors, and page behavior.
  • Experience developing and maintaining automated UI and API tests in Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs with tools such as Postman or code-based test frameworks, and validating data using SQL.
  • Working knowledge of how websites are built and delivered, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, HTTP, redirects, caching, and content-management systems.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and Jira or similar defect-tracking tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain quality risks and test results clearly to engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience owning quality for a web product, website migration, or CMS platform from planning through release.
  • Experience testing SEO elements, structured data (Schema.org), analytics and tag implementations, or localized content across many locales.
  • Experience testing AI or LLM-powered features such as chatbots, search, or recommendations, including approaches for evaluating non-deterministic output.
  • Experience with web performance and accessibility testing tools such as Lighthouse, WebPageTest, or axe.
  • Experience testing applications deployed on AWS or other public cloud platforms, or backend services built on microservices.
  • Familiarity with visual regression testing tools such as Percy, Applitools, or Chromatic.
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered tools such as GitHub Copilot or other AI-assisted testing solutions to improve testing efficiency and engineering productivity.
  • Experience with networking products, smart home technologies, connected device ecosystems, or e-commerce websites.

Why Join TP-Link

  • Shape the quality of TP-Link’s global websites and web experiences, used by customers in over 170 countries.
  • Work across web and cloud technologies, from browser-based applications to the APIs and services behind them.
  • Help define how the team tests emerging AI-powered features such as conversational assistants and intelligent search.
  • Build scalable automation using modern frameworks and AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Collaborate with talented engineering, product, and design teams across global locations.
  • Grow your career with broad ownership and visible impact on TP-Link’s next generation of web and cloud experiences.

TP-Link is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive.

  • Contributions to 401k funds
  • Over four weeks of PTO per year
  • Bi-annual pay increases
  • Health and wellness benefits, including free gym membership
  • Quarterly team-building events

We believe that diversity fuels innovation, collaboration, and drives our entrepreneurial spirit. As a global company, we highly value diverse perspectives and are committed to cultivating an environment where all voices are heard, respected, and valued. descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer with a functional focus, you specialize in designing and executing testing for applications and systems built using custom technologies. Your expertise spans across all levels of testing, including functional, system integration, and end-to-end testing.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Design Test Scenarios: Create optimized test scenarios, plan testing activities, estimate work efforts, and identify test environment and data requirements, utilizing deep skills in core testing, technical testing, and business domain/processes.
  • Execute Testing: Perform manual and automation testing, execute test cases, report test status, and address defects through creation, triage, and resolution, leveraging various testing tools, BDD/TDD approaches, and test accelerators.
  • Analyze Test Outcomes: Apply analytical and cognitive techniques to drive continuous improvements, analyzing test outcomes to inform future testing strategies and optimize test efficiency and quality.
  • Lead Testing Activities: Oversee testing activities, ensuring effective test planning, execution, and defect resolution, and guiding junior team members in testing best practices.
  • Optimize Test Efficiency: Develop strategies to enhance test efficiency and quality, identifying opportunities for process improvements and implementing changes to optimize testing outcomes.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Core Testing Expertise: Experience with designing and executing testing for applications and systems built using custom technologies, with expertise spanning across all levels of testing, including functional, system integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Technical Testing Skills: Experience in utilizing various testing tools, BDD/TDD approaches, and test accelerators to enhance test efficiency and quality, with proficiency in manual and automation testing.
  • Business Domain Knowledge: Experience working with business domain/processes, enabling the creation of optimized test scenarios, planning testing activities, estimating work efforts, and identifying test environment and data requirements.
  • Test Analysis and Improvement: Experience with analyzing test outcomes using analytical and cognitive techniques to drive continuous improvements, informing future testing strategies and optimizing test efficiency and quality.
  • Test Leadership: Experience in leading testing activities, overseeing effective test planning, execution, and defect resolution, and guiding junior team members in testing best practices.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Advanced Testing Methodologies: Experience with BDD/TDD approaches and test accelerators to enhance test efficiency and quality, with the ability to leverage these methodologies to optimize testing outcomes.
  • Multi-Level Testing Expertise: Experience in designing and executing testing across all levels, including functional, system integration, and end-to-end testing, with the ability to create optimized test scenarios and plans.
  • Analytical Techniques: Experience with analytical and cognitive techniques to drive continuous improvements, with the ability to analyze test outcomes and inform future testing strategies.
  • Preferred Skills: Test Architect, Test Automation, Life and Disability Insurance

Meet the Team

Cisco’s Network Security System and Integration Test (SIT) and System Test (ST) teams ensure the quality, reliability, and scalability of our Secure Firewall solutions, serving as a vital line of defense for our enterprise customers.

Your Impact

As a Software Quality Engineer, you will independently own assigned test areas and validate complex, end-to-end customer workflows across physical, virtual, and cloud environments. You will combine hands-on system testing, automation, network-security expertise, and disciplined defect investigation to identify integration and regression risks before release.

Role

You will work closely with software development, platform, automation, product, and release teams throughout the development lifecycle. This role requires strong technical judgment, execution ownership, and clear communication of product-quality risks. In this role, you will:

  • Develop and execute risk-based test plans for Cisco Secure Firewall products and their management, data-plane, platform, and ecosystem integrations.
  • Validate end-to-end workflows across firewall management, threat inspection, routing, switching, NAT, VPN, identity, logging, policy deployment, and related security capabilities.
  • Test complex deployment topologies, including standalone, high-availability, clustered, multi-instance, virtualized, and cloud-based environments.
  • Perform feature integration, system, regression, upgrade, rollback, backward-compatibility, resiliency, recovery, scale, stress, and longevity testing.
  • Design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot automated tests using Python-based frameworks and supporting tools.
  • Build, configure, and maintain representative test environments containing network devices, security appliances, traffic generators, virtual machines, and cloud resources.
  • Reproduce, isolate, and characterize complex software and system failures using packet captures, logs, traces, core files, system metrics, and diagnostic tools.
  • Document defects with clear reproduction procedures, technical evidence, business impact, and severity justification.
  • Participate in feature handoffs, technical reviews, test-plan reviews, defect triage, and cross-functional quality reviews.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering and testing tools where appropriate to accelerate test design, failure analysis, and automation development while validating outputs and protecting confidential information.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree + 5 years of experience in software quality engineering, system testing, network engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience designing test scenarios, selecting appropriate methodologies, and configuring the required test environments.
  • Experience using Python or a comparable scripting language for test automation and tooling.
  • Experience with Linux or Unix administration and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience leveraging generative AI assistants across the software development lifecycle to accelerate coding, automate testing, and streamline work item management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing network-security products such as firewalls, intrusion prevention or detection systems, secure gateways, or comparable security platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP and network troubleshooting.
  • Practical experience with:
    • Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking
    • LANs, link aggregation, and interface configurations
    • Static and dynamic routing, including OSPF and BGP
    • IPv4 and IPv6
    • NAT and access-control policies
    • Site-to-site and remote-access VPN technologies
    • High availability, failover, clustering, or redundant systems
  • Experience using packet-analysis and diagnostic tools such as Wireshark, tcpdump, system logs, debuggers, or equivalent utilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across geographically distributed teams.
  • Ability to investigate complex failures across multiple interacting components and communicate findings clearly.
  • Experience with Cisco Secure Firewall, including FTD, FMC, ASA, FXOS, Snort, or related technologies.
  • Experience with Python test frameworks such as pyATS, pytest, or comparable automation platforms.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, Git-based development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and automated test execution systems.
  • Experience validating upgrades, rollback, backward compatibility, configuration migration, and long-running production-like workloads.
  • Experience with performance, scale, stress, soak, resiliency, or fault-injection testing.
  • Familiarity with virtualization and cloud platforms such as VMware, KVM, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience with traffic-generation, protocol-simulation, or network-performance tools.
  • Knowledge of security threats, traffic inspection, identity integration, telemetry, logging, and observability.
  • Cisco networking or security certification, such as CCNP Enterprise or CCNP Security.
Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We’re hiring a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Core Video & Data team, where quality work supports the platform athletes and coaches rely on to train, compete and improve. You’ll work at the intersection of video, data and AI, and you’ll have a real voice in how we define “done.”

As a Senior QA Engineer, You’ll

  • Lead quality in your squad: As an integral part of a cross-functional team across Engineering, Product, Design, and Scrum, you will guide quality-focused conversations in sprint ceremonies. You will partner with stakeholders to explain how defects affect users and advocate for the right priority on backlog defects before they enter a sprint.
  • Shape our quality strategy: You will use your customer and system understanding to build a risk-based testing approach tailored to our video and data platform architecture. You will measure quality to help define when a project is truly complete and validate your improvements with real, data-backed results.

The right candidate will have a robust system delivery background, well-rounded technical knowledge, and demonstrated experience working on large scale projects. The candidate must be customer-obsessed, have strong analytical and communication skills, and passionate about learning new technologies.

You will work with software development engineers to understand features and technical implementation. You will also work with groups such as product management, UX designers to understand customer usage models and develop test plans and suites that approximate real-world environments and regression tests driving the software development process toward quality-centric methodologies. You will develop automated tests to help fasten testing cycles and release faster to our customers. Position Description:

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows.


This role will have an emphasis on managing performance/load testing within our current K6 environment.


In addition, you will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability. You will also collaborate closely with software development partners to define test strategies, expand automation, and responsibly use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support test creation, code review, documentation, and regression analysis while maintaining strong human oversight.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage, troubleshoot and report on performance/load testing of web sites and components using our K6 environment. It measures the throughput and resilience of thousands of printers hitting a site for the purpose of issuing credit, debit and ID cards.
  • Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with C# and API-testing tools such as RestSharp and Playwright.
  • End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products.
  • Set up cloud and on-premises environments to verify supported solution scenarios, including LDAP, database, and network configurations.
  • Some possible Dev Ops work to automate creating different environments including single and distributed deployment.
  • Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
  • Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.



Basic Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
  • 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
  • Performance/Load testing
  • Programming experience in C#. JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Powershell.
  • Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
  • Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization in the U.S.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with K6 performance testing tool
  • Ansible experience scripting deployments from development to test to production.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Bitbucket for source code control.
  • Experience with Jira and/or Microsoft Azure DevOps Server for user-story coordination, test-case management, build integration, and issue tracking.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted QA workflows with pull requests, design documentation, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, logs, virtual machines, or test reporting.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including approved-tool usage, sensitive-data handling, intellectual-property awareness, secure coding guardrails, and review of AI-generated automation before reuse.


Where you will be: This is a hybrid role requiring three days per week in our Shakopee, MN headquarters office.


About Entrust


Our growing company relies on curious, dedicated and innovative colleagues to anticipate the future and provide solutions for a more connected, mobile and secure world. Entrust technologies and expertise help government agencies, enterprises and financial institutions in more than 150 countries, serve and safeguard citizens, employees and consumers. Each year, our solutions secure billions of transactions — and every day, our technologies issue and manage more than 10 million secure identities. How do we do all of this? Together.

At Entrust, we don’t just offer jobs – we offer career journeys. Here is what you can expect when you join our team:

  • Career Growth: Whether you’re a budding developer or a seasoned expert, we’re invested in your professional journey. With learning-forward initiatives and exciting challenges, your growth is our priority.
  • Collaboration: Here, your voice matters. Our teams thrive on sharing ideas, brainstorming solutions, and working together to build a better tomorrow.
  • Inclusion: Our culture is built on diversity, inclusion, and respect.


For more information, visit www.entrust.com. Follow us on, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube

A Day In The Life

The Systems Software Test Engineer contributes to developing, executing, and documenting automated tests that verify end-to-end system functionality, robustness, and reliability in accordance with approved test plans, procedures, and defined metrics. The role supports system verification through test-case development, test automation and execution, analysis of data and results, and defect tracking and investigation. Working with Systems Test, Systems Engineering, Development, Test Tools, and Quality teams, the engineer contributes to verification and automation initiatives, supports CI/CD test workflows, and builds an understanding of system architecture and interfaces to support evaluation of the impact of software changes across the system.

Software Test Engineer 1's at Tandem are also responsible for:

  • Collaborates with Systems Test and Systems Engineering to review product requirements, feature designs, system robustness and reliability metrics, and system configurations, and develops test cases for system verification with appropriate guidance.
  • Develops and maintains automated test suites using established test automation frameworks and approved verification procedures.
  • Executes and monitors automated test suites through CI/CD pipelines; reviews test results, metrics, logs, and artifacts; investigates failures using established procedures; and escalates suspected product defects.
  • Participates in automation code reviews and follows established source control, branching, and documentation practices.
  • Stays current with industry trends and best practices in software testing and automation.
  • Assists development engineers in the diagnosis and replication of product failures.
  • Efficiently manages own time to complete work by assigned completion dates.
  • Records and compiles data for documentation of test procedures and prepares reports.
  • Assists with estimating test effort for project deliverables.
  • Works as a contributing member of cross-functional teams as needed, working closely with R&D engineering and Quality Engineers to match software test scope with documented specification requirements.

When & Where You’ll Work

Hybrid: This role will be a mix of in-office work at our corporate headquarters in Del Mar, CA and remote work. This position is expected to be in office 2-3 days per week but may require on-site attendance up to five days per week depending on business demands.

What You’ll Need

  • Foundational knowledge of TypeScript required; experience with additional programming or scripting languages such as C++, C#, JavaScript, or Python is preferred.
  • Familiarity with test frameworks used for automated testing, such as Cucumber, Jasmine, or similar technologies.
  • Exposure to test automation tools used for web and mobile such as Appium, WebdriverIO, Selenium, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with source control concepts and CI/CD pipelines used to support automated testing workflows.
  • Ability to read and follow procedures and flow diagrams.
  • Able to effectively share information and ideas within and outside of department in written or verbal form; able to put forth own ideas and gain understanding from others.
  • Ability to support effective interactions between team members and cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize assigned tasks, manage competing priorities, meet established deadlines, and produce high-quality work with appropriate guidance.
  • Experience with MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).

Extra Awesome

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or computer science or related field or equivalent combination of education and applicable job experience.
  • Relevant internship, academic, project, or hands-on experience in software testing, software development, or test automation is preferred.
  • Exposure to developing and executing software test cases and documenting test results and defects, preferred.
  • Exposure to automated software testing and software verification activities.
  • Exposure to using test automation tools, source control systems, or CI/CD workflows is preferred.
  • Experience following detailed procedures, troubleshooting technical issues, and applying critical thinking to resolve problems within established guidelines.
  • Experience in mobile, cloud, or integrated software systems is preferred.

Compensation & Benefits

The starting base pay range for this position is $39.23 - $49 per hour. Base pay will vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes bonus and a robust benefits package.

Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, a minimum of 20 days of paid time off (with accrual starting on day 1) and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here!

descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're seeking an experienced, automation-focused Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to join our North American Sports product team. This team develops insightful analytics and Recruit products for American Football, helping high-level coaches and analysts make faster, data-driven decisions on player performance and talent acquisition.

As the testing expert within your cross-functional squad, you'll own quality end-to-end — building the strategies and automation that ensure we're shipping software our users love. You'll drive quality discussions, challenge the team to maintain high standards, and be the advocate for reliability and performance at every stage of delivery.

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, You'll

  • Lead quality initiatives. Build risk-based testing strategies tailored to your squad's architecture, drive quality discussions in scrum ceremonies, challenge defect priorities, and continuously look for ways to improve practices and keep your squad's quality processes ahead of the curve.
  • Test across the stack. Design and execute tests spanning front-end UI, APIs, backend services, and data pipelines — validating transformations, service outputs, and complex logic at scale.
  • Automate with intent. Make informed decisions about what, when, and how to automate. Use Playwright and scripting to build reliable, maintainable automated checks that keep pace with development.
  • Mentor and grow others. Use your technical depth and quality instincts to coach teammates, raise the bar for quality standards across the team, and influence how the whole squad thinks about quality.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally. Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Design, contribute to hiring, and invest in your own professional development.

Location

While local candidates in Lincoln and Omaha, Nebraska are prioritized, we're open to remote applicants who reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, North Carolina, Nevada, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

Must-Haves

  • Quality focus. You see the big picture and use it to drive improvements in both quality and velocity.
  • Technical depth. 4+ years of software testing experience with hands-on expertise across the full stack — API testing, backend and data-heavy systems, and front-end validation — plus proficiency in automation frameworks like Playwright and languages like Python or TypeScript.
  • A track record of leadership. You've owned quality for a squad, led testing initiatives end-to-end, defined success criteria, and designed approaches that measurably reduce risk in production.
  • Investigative rigour. You dig to root causes of complex problems, back your findings with data, and measure outcomes.
  • User focus. You think critically about the user experience and let that understanding shape your testing approach.
  • AI-powered working. You actively use AI tools in your day-to-day workflow — for test case creation, failure diagnosis, documentation, and beyond — and look for new ways to apply them to raise the team's efficiency.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Performance testing exposure. Familiarity with load, stress, and scalability testing concepts and tools (e.g. JMeter) for validating API and backend performance.
  • Sports knowledge. Passion for or experience in Basketball, American Football or Ice Hockey — whether as an athlete, coach, or fan — and an appreciation for the unique challenges of sports technology.
  • A relevant degree or equivalent experience. A bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We're always investing in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.
  • Take care of your mental and physical health. Medical plans tailored for you and your family—including vision, dental, and fertility benefits—and stay supported with our EAP and Employee Resource Groups.
  • Contribute to your 401(K). Yep, that's free money. We'll match up to 4% of your own contribution.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

Base Salary Range

$82,000 - $137,000 USD

Rockwell is looking for a Senior Software Test Engineer to join an agile team. This team is building and validating FactoryTalk Optix, a modern industrial visualization and HMI platform. The platform is used by customers to design, deploy, and maintain applications for manufacturing environments.

Position Summary

The Senior Software Test Engineer will help ensure the quality of FactoryTalk Optix by creating and executing manual and automated tests for new and existing product functionality. This role will work closely with product owners, developers, and other test engineers to understand requirements, validate features, reproduce and document defects, and support regression and release testing activities. The scope of work is focused on developing solid test engineering practices, learning the product and industrial automation domain, and contributing to a high-quality customer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Create, maintain, and execute manual and automated tests for FactoryTalk Optix features.
  • Validate design-time and runtime workflows to help ensure a reliable customer experience.
  • Lead test planning, estimation, execution, and defect triage as part of an Agile team.
  • Reproduce, document, and track defects with clear titles, descriptions, steps, and supporting details.
  • Collaborate with developers, product owners, and other test engineers to understand requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support regression, release, and exploratory testing activities.
  • Contribute to test documentation, quality procedures, and continuous improvement of test practices.
  • Use tools such as JIRA, QTest, Confluence, GitHub, and Jenkins to support testing and quality tracking.
  • Learn FT Optix product functionality and relevant industrial automation concepts over time.
  • Collaborate effectively with geographically distributed teams.

The Essentials - You Will Have

  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Legal authorization to work in the US is required.

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

  • Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of experience in software testing, software development, test automation, or a related technical role.
  • Experience creating, executing, and documenting manual or automated test cases.
  • Experience developing or maintaining automated tests using Python, C#, or similar programming or scripting languages.
  • Experience with Squish and Selenium test frameworks
  • Experience creating or updating GitHub Actions
  • Familiarity with Linux
  • Experience with C# scripting
  • Familiarity with test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and tools such as GitHub, Jenkins, JIRA, Confluence, or QTest.
  • Exposure to performance, reliability, longevity, or regression testing.
  • Experience with industrial automation, HMI software, PLCs, and protocols such as CIP or OP-CUA

What We Offer

  • Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision
  • 401k
  • Paid Time off
  • Parental and Caregiver Leave
  • Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
  • To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com.

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.

This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans.

If you are an individual with a disability and you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact our services team at +1 (844) 404-7247.

Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more — we can innovate, invest, inspire and integrate our capabilities to transform the future.

Join us in shaping a new era in space and find a career that's built for you.

Lockheed Martin is seeking an Associate Quality Engineer for the Quality Engineering team. Our team is responsible for ensuring the highest quality of manufactured and procured products within Lockheed Martin Space.

Analyze quality data to identify trends and drive continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is a detail‑oriented professional who thrives in a collaborative environment, brings strong analytical skills, and is committed to delivering high‑impact results. This role offers the opportunity to influence product quality at a critical business unit and work alongside seasoned engineers.

We are committed to supporting your work‑life balance and overall well‑being, offering flexible scheduling options. Learn more about Lockheed Martin’s comprehensive benefits package here.

MUST BE A U.S. CITIZEN - This position is located at a facility that requires special access.

  • This position requires the ability to obtain a secret clearance within a year of starting, therefore all candidates need to be US Citizens

Overview

Good things are happening at Berkshire Hathaway GUARD Insurance Companies —an A+ (Superior) rated, nationwide Property & Casualty insurer backed by Berkshire Hathaway. With supportive leadership, collaborative teams, and opportunities to grow, GUARD is a place where people build meaningful, long‑term careers.

Good Things You Can Count On.

  • Hybrid schedule: 2 days remote / 3 in‑office
  • Predictable hours (no nights, weekends, or holidays)
  • Competitive pay + generous PTO
  • Medical, dental & vision starting day one
  • 401(k), tuition reimbursement & longevity bonuses

Responsibilities

We are seeking a skilled and experienced QA Automation Engineer to design, develop, and maintain robust automated testing solutions. This role requires a deeper understanding of automation frameworks and the ability to lead testing efforts for complex features and systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement scalable and maintainable automated test frameworks using Tricentis Tosca and other tools.
  • Analyze business and functional requirements related to P&C insurance systems and translate them into effective automated test strategies and plans.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, API testing, accessibility testing across web and backend systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business analysts, developers, and product owners to ensure test coverage and quality.
  • Execute automated test cases, log defects, and track them to closure using Azure DevOps.
  • Develop automated tests for APIs, UI, and backend systems.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and review their test scripts.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Analyze test results, identify trends, and provide actionable insights.
  • Maintain test documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing across QA teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in software testing, preferably in the P&C insurance domain
  • 3–5 years of experience in test automation.
  • Proficiency in test automation tools, with a strong emphasis on Tricentis Tosca and Playwright; experience with Selenium, Cypress, or similar automation frameworks is also preferred.
  • Proficiency in SQL for backend/database testing.
  • Experience with API testing using tools like Postman or REST Assured.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Strong understanding of Agile QA methodologies, test planning, and defect management.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills.

Optional Certifications (Preferred But Not Required):

  • Tricentis Tosca Automation Specialist Level 1 & 2
  • ISTQB Certified Tester – Advanced Level Test Automation Engineer
  • Certified Agile Tester (CAT)
  • Certified Jenkins Engineer (CJE)
  • Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional

Salary Range $56,000.00 - $130,000.00

In accordance with applicable pay transparency laws, this range represents a good-faith estimate. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, credentials, geographic location, and other considerations permitted by law.

This role may be based out of any of our office locations, including:

Parsippany, NJ; Conshohocken, PA; Wilkes ‑ Barre, PA; Alpharetta, GA; Scottsdale, AZ

descriptionHtml:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We're hiring Senior Quality Engineers to join Veeva, building mission-critical software for the global Life Sciences industry across pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and medical devices.

As part of our Quality Assurance and Release Engineering team, you will drive functional and automated quality across cutting-edge, complex systems—ensuring high reliability and customer success with every release.

What You'll Do

  • Design and execute multi-platform test strategies covering native mobile (iOS), Windows desktop/web, and hybrid environments to ensure consistent user experience across all surfaces
  • Create comprehensive testing documentation, including test plans, automated scripts, risk assessments, and detailed bug reports for fast-paced release cycles
  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to automate features and maximize regression coverage across modern web and mobile platforms
  • Mentor junior Quality Engineers in QA methodologies, automation design patterns, and debugging strategies
  • Develop deep technical and domain expertise across Veeva’s suite of industry-leading products
  • Collaborate daily in a fast, agile team environment with software engineers, product managers, and cross-functional partners
  • Test and validate quality across complex, multi-agentic modules—tackling some of the most challenging non-deterministic edge cases and architecture patterns in today’s software landscape

Requirements

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in software quality engineering, software development, or test automation
  • Strong expertise in QA methodologies, automated testing frameworks, and short-cycle software releases
  • Hands-on experience writing and maintaining automated test suites covering sanity, boundary, negative, concurrency, and compatibility scenarios

Location: Hybrid (Lakeland, FL):

To support our hybrid work model, candidates must reside, or be willing to relocate, within a commutable distance of Lakeland, FL.

Work Model

Enjoy the best of both worlds - collaborate in person and innovate remotely.

Candidates selected to advance in the interview process will be required to participate in at least one onsite interview at our Lakeland, FL campus.

  • Hybrid Flexibility: Work remotely when you need focus time and join us onsite for high-impact collaboration and brainstorming sessions.
  • Operational Efficiency: Ensure technology solutions support efficient workflows and enable automation to improve operational effectiveness.
  • Cutting-Edge AI Projects: Drive innovation in AI platforms, integrating advanced tools and frameworks to solve complex business challenges.
  • Empowered Culture: We value autonomy, creativity, and continuous learning—your ideas shape the future of technology in our organization.

Your Impact

  • Lead quality assurance activities across the vendor funding product portfolio and modernization roadmap
  • Define test strategies, test plans, test data requirements, and quality metrics for complex initiatives
  • Design and implement scalable automated testing solutions using Playwright with Python or C#
  • Establish and maintain automation standards, frameworks, and CI/CD testing practices
  • Leverage AI-assisted engineering and testing tools to accelerate test design, automation development, defect analysis, and quality validation activities
  • Evaluate and promote AI-enabled quality engineering practices that improve test coverage, increase delivery velocity, and enhance overall product quality
  • Drive functional, integration, regression, API, data validation, and end-to-end testing efforts
  • Validate financial calculations, accounting processes, data transformations, and reporting accuracy
  • Use SQL to analyze and validate large data sets across multiple systems and environments
  • Partner with developers and business analysts to identify testing risks, gaps, and dependencies early in the delivery lifecycle
  • Facilitate defect triage, root cause analysis, and release readiness reviews
  • Mentor and provide technical leadership to other Quality Assurance Engineers
  • Develop and communicate quality metrics, test coverage metrics, defect trends, and release recommendations to project leadership
  • Lead continuous improvement efforts that enhance testing practices, automation capabilities, and overall product quality across the team
  • Utilize Azure DevOps test plan creation and management

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related analytical field, or equivalent experience
  • 4+ years of software testing and quality assurance experience
  • 3+ years of experience developing and executing automated testing solutions for front-end, back-end, and APIs
  • 3+ years of experience using SQL to create and execute complex queries for test validation and data analysis
  • 2+ years of experience creating test strategies, test plans, and automation approaches for enterprise applications
  • 2+ years of hands-on test automation experience using Playwright or other test automation tools
  • 1+ years of experience providing technical leadership to Quality Assurance Engineers, including mentoring, test strategy development, and establishing testing best practices
  • Experience testing APIs, integrations, ETL processes, and data-intensive applications
  • Experience working with Azure DevOps for test management, defect tracking, and release support
  • Experience leading testing efforts on complex projects involving multiple teams and stakeholders
  • Experience working in Agile product teams and supporting continuous delivery environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing financial, accounting, ERP, or enterprise business applications
  • Experience validating financial calculations, ledger postings, accruals, rebates, incentives, or settlement processes
  • Experience testing container-based applications
  • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience testing microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven architectures
  • Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, or large-scale data platforms
  • Experience implementing test automation frameworks from the ground up
  • Experience performing data reconciliation testing between legacy and modernized platforms

Benefits Information

  • Employee stock ownership plan that contributes Publix stock to associates each year at no cost
  • An opportunity to purchase additional shares of our privately-held stock
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Group health, dental and vision plans
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Short- and long-term disability insurance
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Free hot lunches (buffet-style) at facilities with a cafeteria
  • Visit our website to see all of our benefits: https://jobs.publix.com/benefits/

Year End Bonus

As a year-end bonus to associates, Publix issues one month’s extra pay (pro-rated in the first year) each year if associate remains employed through issue date of the bonus check that year. This is calculated as a 13th month of pay in the Potential Annual Pay with Bonus line above.

Additional Information

Your application may have additional steps that you will need to complete in order to remain eligible for consideration. Please be sure to monitor your email, including your spam folder, on a daily basis for critical, time-sensitive emails that could require action within 24-48 hours. Please do not use your Publix email address when applying. Once your application has been successfully submitted you will receive a confirmation email.

  • Please note that Publix will not sponsor any hire for this position for a visa or permanent residence*****Relocation/Household Good Shipment Allowance will NOT be provided.***

Overview

Good things are happening at Berkshire Hathaway GUARD Insurance Companies —an A+ (Superior) rated, nationwide Property & Casualty insurer backed by Berkshire Hathaway. With supportive leadership, collaborative teams, and opportunities to grow, GUARD is a place where people build meaningful, long‑term careers.

Good Things You Can Count On.

  • Hybrid schedule: 2 days remote / 3 in‑office
  • Predictable hours (no nights, weekends, or holidays)
  • Competitive pay + generous PTO
  • Medical, dental & vision starting day one
  • 401(k), tuition reimbursement & longevity bonuses

Responsibilities

We are seeking a skilled and experienced QA Automation Engineer to design, develop, and maintain robust automated testing solutions. This role requires a deeper understanding of automation frameworks and the ability to lead testing efforts for complex features and systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement scalable and maintainable automated test frameworks using Tricentis Tosca and other tools.
  • Analyze business and functional requirements related to P&C insurance systems and translate them into effective automated test strategies and plans.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, API testing, accessibility testing across web and backend systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business analysts, developers, and product owners to ensure test coverage and quality.
  • Execute automated test cases, log defects, and track them to closure using Azure DevOps.
  • Develop automated tests for APIs, UI, and backend systems.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and review their test scripts.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Analyze test results, identify trends, and provide actionable insights.
  • Maintain test documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing across QA teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in software testing, preferably in the P&C insurance domain
  • 3–5 years of experience in test automation.
  • Proficiency in test automation tools, with a strong emphasis on Tricentis Tosca and Playwright; experience with Selenium, Cypress, or similar automation frameworks is also preferred.
  • Proficiency in SQL for backend/database testing.
  • Experience with API testing using tools like Postman or REST Assured.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Strong understanding of Agile QA methodologies, test planning, and defect management.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills.

Optional Certifications (Preferred But Not Required):

  • ISTQB Certified Tester – Advanced Level Test Automation Engineer
  • Certified Agile Tester (CAT)

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer with a functional focus, you specialize in designing and executing testing for applications and systems built using custom technologies. Your expertise spans across all levels of testing, including functional, system integration, and end-to-end testing.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Design Test Scenarios: Create optimized test scenarios, plan testing activities, estimate work efforts, and identify test environment and data requirements, utilizing deep skills in core testing, technical testing, and business domain/processes.
  • Execute Testing: Perform manual and automation testing, execute test cases, report test status, and address defects through creation, triage, and resolution, leveraging various testing tools, BDD/TDD approaches, and test accelerators.
  • Analyze Test Outcomes: Apply analytical and cognitive techniques to drive continuous improvements, analyzing test outcomes to inform future testing strategies and optimize test efficiency and quality.
  • Lead Testing Activities: Oversee testing activities, ensuring effective test planning, execution, and defect resolution, and guiding junior team members in testing best practices.
  • Optimize Test Efficiency: Develop strategies to enhance test efficiency and quality, identifying opportunities for process improvements and implementing changes to optimize testing outcomes.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Core Testing Expertise: Experience with designing and executing testing for applications and systems built using custom technologies, with expertise spanning across all levels of testing, including functional, system integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Technical Testing Skills: Experience in utilizing various testing tools, BDD/TDD approaches, and test accelerators to enhance test efficiency and quality, with proficiency in manual and automation testing.
  • Business Domain Knowledge: Experience working with business domain/processes, enabling the creation of optimized test scenarios, planning testing activities, estimating work efforts, and identifying test environment and data requirements.
  • Test Analysis and Improvement: Experience with analyzing test outcomes using analytical and cognitive techniques to drive continuous improvements, informing future testing strategies and optimizing test efficiency and quality.
  • Test Leadership: Experience in leading testing activities, overseeing effective test planning, execution, and defect resolution, and guiding junior team members in testing best practices.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Advanced Testing Methodologies: Experience with BDD/TDD approaches and test accelerators to enhance test efficiency and quality, with the ability to leverage these methodologies to optimize testing outcomes.
  • Multi-Level Testing Expertise: Experience in designing and executing testing across all levels, including functional, system integration, and end-to-end testing, with the ability to create optimized test scenarios and plans.
  • Analytical Techniques: Experience with analytical and cognitive techniques to drive continuous improvements, with the ability to analyze test outcomes and inform future testing strategies.
  • Preferred Skills: PM;Healthcare;Speciality;Rx;Applied AI;PowerBI;Portal;DB;Mainframe & API Testing

descriptionHtml:
Overview

Good things are happening at Berkshire Hathaway GUARD Insurance Companies —an A+ (Superior) rated, nationwide Property & Casualty insurer backed by Berkshire Hathaway. With supportive leadership, collaborative teams, and opportunities to grow, GUARD is a place where people build meaningful, long‑term careers.

Good Things You Can Count On.

  • Hybrid schedule: 2 days remote / 3 in‑office
  • Predictable hours (no nights, weekends, or holidays)
  • Competitive pay + generous PTO
  • Medical, dental & vision starting day one
  • 401(k), tuition reimbursement & longevity bonuses

Responsibilities

We are seeking a skilled and experienced QA Automation Engineer to design, develop, and maintain robust automated testing solutions. This role requires a deeper understanding of automation frameworks and the ability to lead testing efforts for complex features and systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement scalable and maintainable automated test frameworks using Tricentis Tosca and other tools.
  • Analyze business and functional requirements related to P&C insurance systems and translate them into effective automated test strategies and plans.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, API testing, accessibility testing across web and backend systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business analysts, developers, and product owners to ensure test coverage and quality.
  • Execute automated test cases, log defects, and track them to closure using Azure DevOps.
  • Develop automated tests for APIs, UI, and backend systems.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and review their test scripts.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Analyze test results, identify trends, and provide actionable insights.
  • Maintain test documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing across QA teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in software testing, preferably in the P&C insurance domain
  • 3–5 years of experience in test automation.
  • Proficiency in test automation tools, with a strong emphasis on Tricentis Tosca and Playwright; experience with Selenium, Cypress, or similar automation frameworks is also preferred.
  • Proficiency in SQL for backend/database testing.
  • Experience with API testing using tools like Postman or REST Assured.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Strong understanding of Agile QA methodologies, test planning, and defect management.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills.

Optional Certifications (Preferred But Not Required):

  • Tricentis Tosca Automation Specialist Level 1 & 2
  • ISTQB Certified Tester – Advanced Level Test Automation Engineer
  • Certified Agile Tester (CAT)
  • Certified Jenkins Engineer (CJE)
  • Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional

Salary Range $56,000.00 - $130,000.00

In accordance with applicable pay transparency laws, this range represents a good-faith estimate. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, credentials, geographic location, and other considerations permitted by law.

This role may be based out of any of our office locations, including:

Parsippany, NJ; Conshohocken, PA; Wilkes ‑ Barre, PA; Alpharetta, GA; Scottsdale, AZ

Interview Integrity Notice: Berkshire Hathaway GUARD is committed to a fair and consistent hiring process. Candidates are expected to participate independently in interviews. Unauthorized recording, transcription, AI note-taking, or AI interview assistance tools may not be used during interviews without prior approval.

With a global presence, the team operates from centers in the US, Canada, and India.

  • Crafting, automating, configuring, and qualifying customer use cases based on IOS XR platforms. This includes generating test plans and dynamically prioritizing tasks based on customer demands, maximizing the right technical expertise and skills in each area.
  • Designing and developing innovative test frameworks and tools to support the test execution environment, as well as develop web-based GUIs that use analytics and machine learning to thoughtfully display and analyze execution results.
  • Driving test cases both manually and through automation, raising, tracking, prioritizing, and verifying defects and fixes.
  • Proactively seek continuous improvements in test coverage, execution, and automation, optimizing performance and configuration dimensioning.
  • Reproduce customer issues in internal test labs as requested by the customer support team, generate test execution.
  • Collaborating with the development team, account team, and customers to understand and validate customer use cases.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelors in STEM with 7+ years of relevant experience or Masters in STEM with 5+ years of relevant experience
  • Networking domain experience working with L2 or L3 networking protocols such as ISIS, BGP, MPLS, IPv6, GRE, MPLS-TE, LDP, RSVP, LDP, Segment routing, L2VPN, L3VPN, EVPN.
  • Experience in networking software quality assurance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certificate in CCIE (Routing & Switching / Service Provider / Data Center).
  • Experience on platforms such as ASR9K, NCS5500, NCS5000, NCS540/NCS560, NCS6K, CRS, 8000.
  • Demonstrated experience with RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access) technologies and related protocols such as InfiniBand, RoCE, or iWARP.
  • Experience in OpenFlow, Netconf & REST API.
  • Background in network automation tools like pyATS, Ansible, Jenkins, Robot framework, and Cisco NSO.
  • Expertise in UNIX/Linux environments and Bash/Unix Shell Scripting, with experience in configuring/fixing protocols such as L2/L3 VPN, EVPN, Segment Routing, IPv6, MPLS-LDP/RSVP-TE, Multicast, SNMP, Telemetry, gNMI, gRPC, Netconf & OpenConfig Yang Models.

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Job Title: Senior Software Test Engineer

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 25%

Type of Travel: Continental US

* * *

The Opportunity

This opportunity provides advanced software development support to a major United States strategic command, contributing to capabilities that underpin national‑level strategic deterrence and long‑range operational readiness.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end testing efforts by developing and executing comprehensive test strategies that validate software functionality, performance, and overall system readiness throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Drive test automation initiatives by designing, implementing, and maintaining automated test solutions that increase coverage, improve efficiency, and support continuous delivery objectives.
  • Develop quality-focused test plans and validation strategies through analysis of software requirements, system capabilities, and user needs.
  • Execute comprehensive software verification activities including functional, regression, integration, exploratory, performance, load, and smoke testing across web applications and databases.
  • Collaborate across engineering teams to identify risks, improve testability, and incorporate quality assurance practices throughout the software development process.
  • Manage defect identification and resolution by documenting issues, reproducing defects, and working closely with development teams through closure.
  • Evaluate and recommend testing technologies that enhance automation capabilities, improve testing efficiency, and support organizational quality objectives.
  • Measure and improve testing effectiveness through the development, collection, and analysis of quality metrics and performance indicators.
  • Provide technical leadership within Agile teams by supporting sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, release readiness activities, and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Support modern CI/CD practices by integrating verification and validation activities throughout the software delivery pipeline

Qualifications

Required:

  • U.S. Citizen eligible to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field and 8+ years relevant software testing experience.
  • Experience developing and executing automated testing solutions.
  • Knowledge of software testing methodologies, defect tracking, and quality assurance best practices.
  • Experience with Agile development practices and CI/CD environments.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Jira and other test management platforms.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to identify quality risks and drive testing improvement

This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

What You Can Expect

 A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is

$65,700 - $134,400

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

Location: Raleigh and Dallas

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

We are a professional services firm with a business unit dedicated to the financial services marketplace. Our teams have been at the forefront of every event that has reshaped and redefined the financial services industry. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic team!

We help our clients transform. Together we are changing the way they interact with their Customers, Employees and Partners alike. We are modernizing their applications, creating new ones and driving business efficiency across their ever-changing platform and channel infrastructures. Everything we do centers around this simple story.

The opportunity

As a Technology Service Delivery Staff, you’ll be based in our Service Delivery Center, which is made up of high-performing US-based colleagues who work closely with our experienced advisory professionals. We deliver Technology project-based work and managed services to our clients. Here, you’ll work as part of a project team and will be responsible for the design, build/configuration, testing, analysis, delivery and support of Technology solutions. This position is fast-paced and ever-changing, which means you’ll need to be a flexible self-starter and be able to manage changing priorities and learning new and rapidly changing technology solutions.

We are looking for Test/Quality Engineers who will support quality through test planning, functional testing, automation, and release readiness for our financial services clients. The team leverages test automation frameworks such as JUnit, Selenium, Cucumber, ReadyAPI, and REST Assured, alongside SQL for data validation and CI/CD pipelines to deliver reliable, high-quality software. This is an entry-level, hands-on role where you will build your skills across the full delivery lifecycle under the guidance of experienced colleagues.

Your Key Responsibilities

The goal is to help clients solve complex business problems by ensuring software quality from planning through release readiness. You will assist with test design, execution, and defect tracking, learn the team’s tools and standards, and contribute to assigned workstreams under the guidance of experienced colleagues.

Skills And Attributes For Success

  • Foundational knowledge of software testing, quality assurance, and test automation concepts, with support from experienced colleagues.
  • Foundational knowledge of automation frameworks such as JUnit, Selenium, Cucumber, ReadyAPI, or REST Assured.
  • Foundational knowledge of SQL for data validation and of API testing concepts.
  • Foundational knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, quality gates, and defect tracking.
  • Assist with test design, execution, and defect tracking tasks, and contribute to assigned workstreams.
  • Learn and apply the team’s quality, testing, and automation standards.
  • Eagerness to learn new and rapidly changing technologies.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 30% of the time.

To qualify for the role you must have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • At least two years of relevant experience in software testing and quality assurance.
  • Exposure to software testing, quality assurance, and test automation.
  • Familiarity with JUnit, Selenium, Cucumber, ReadyAPI, or REST Assured.
  • Exposure to SQL, CI/CD, and defect tracking concepts.
  • Comfortable working in Agile environments and collaborating with business and technical stakeholders.

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Experience with the following technologies
  • Software testing, quality assurance, and test automation
  • JUnit, Selenium, Cucumber, ReadyAPI, and REST Assured
  • Java/J2EE, Unix/Linux shell, JavaScript, Spring, web services, and Angular
  • SQL for data validation
  • CI/CD pipelines, quality gates, and Jenkins
  • Functional, regression, integration, API, and performance testing

What We Look For

We’re interested in intellectually curious people with a passion for finding new and innovative ways to make things better. You’ll also need to be a self-starter and quick learner with a strong background in computer science from both theoretical and practical points of view. If you’re ready to be the future of the group and make your mark in a growing business, this role is for you.

About The Organization

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. So that whenever you join, however long you stay, the experience you gain lasts a lifetime.

Join us in building a better working world.

Apply now.

We are an equal employment opportunity employer (Females/Minorities/Protected Veterans/Disabled) and value the diversity of our workforce and the knowledge of our people.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $80,300 to $149,100
    • Bay Area California offices – $83,700 to $155,300
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $67,000 to $136,800
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
  • Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  • To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
  • EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
  • For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
  • At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

All in to shape the future with confidence.
