Description

About Us

Headquartered in the United States, TP-Link Systems Inc. is a global provider of reliable networking devices and smart home products, consistently ranked as the world’s top provider of Wi-Fi devices. The company is committed to delivering innovative products that enhance people’s lives through faster, more reliable connectivity. With a commitment to excellence, TP-Link serves customers in over 170 countries and continues to grow its global footprint.

We believe technology changes the world for the better! At TP-Link Systems Inc, we are committed to crafting dependable, high-performance products to connect users worldwide with the wonders of technology.

Embracing professionalism, innovation, excellence, and simplicity, we aim to assist our clients in achieving remarkable global performance and enable consumers to enjoy a seamless, effortless lifestyle.

Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Home Networking Test Engineer to join us! In our team, you can always stay at the forefront of technology, have access to and learn about the latest generation of networking technologies worldwide. Together with other outstanding engineers in the team, you will create reliable, stable, and high-speed network access products for users, provide user-friendly and convenient smart home solutions, and bring convenience to the lives of millions of users worldwide!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the quality assurance efforts for home networking products such as Wi-Fi routers, Mesh Wi-Fi, network adapters, and USB accessories.
  • Responsible for executing system-level test cases that require extensive experience and sound judgment.
  • Simulate media evaluations to ensure that the test results meet expectations.
  • Design, develop, and implement comprehensive test plans and test cases based on product specifications and industry standards.
  • Explore user scenarios and establish local testing standards that align with user perception.
  • Lead test strategy discussions, mentor junior engineers, and drive process improvements.
  • Collaborate with the R&D team to troubleshoot and debug issues.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of QA/testing experience with networking products, with a solid understanding of software testing methodologies, processes, and quality assurance practices. Proven experience independently leading testing activities for NPI (New Product Introduction) projects.
  • Strong knowledge of Wi-Fi/WLAN technologies, including IEEE 802.11 protocols, major Wi-Fi generations and key features (e.g., Wi-Fi 5/6/6E/7), Wi-Fi testing methodologies, and end-to-end Wi-Fi test coverage. Hands-on Wi-Fi product testing experience is required.
  • Solid understanding of common networking protocols and technologies, including TCP/UDP, IPv4/IPv6, DHCP, DNS, VLAN, and IPTV.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills for both wireless and wired networking issues, with the ability to analyze packet captures, logs, and test data to identify root causes.
  • Proficiency with network testing and analysis tools such as iPerf/iPerf3, Wireshark, and IxChariot.
  • Strong test analysis and test design capabilities, with the ability to independently analyze complex features, identify risks, develop test strategies, and design comprehensive test plans and test cases.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to independently drive complex technical issues from identification through resolution.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with R&D, Product Management, Hardware, chipset vendors, and other cross-functional teams.

Additional Preferred Skills:

  • Hands-on development or testing experience with Wi-Fi routers, Mesh Wi-Fi systems, gateways, or other consumer/home networking products.
  • Experience with Wi-Fi Alliance certification and/or wireless regulatory and compliance testing.
  • Strong understanding of user experience and real-world usage scenarios, with close attention to product quality and details and the ability to identify issues from an end-user perspective.
  • Proven experience designing and building automated testing frameworks or test systems, including test architecture, tool development, and automation deployment.
  • Experience developing Python-based test automation for devices, networking products, or system-level testing.

Benefits

Salary range: $135,000 - $170,000

  • Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance (partial premium coverage for dependents)
  • Employer quarterly contributions to 401k funds
  • 15 days accrued vacation
  • 11 paid holidays
  • Bi-annual reviews, and annual pay increases
  • Health and wellness benefits, including free gym membership
  • Quarterly team-building event

Benefits

$135,000 - 170,000

Benefits:

  • Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance (partial coverage for dependents)
  • Contributions to 401k funds
  • Over four weeks of PTO per year
  • Bi-annual pay increases
  • Health and wellness benefits, including free gym membership
  • Quarterly team-building events

At TP-Link Systems Inc., we are continually searching for ambitious individuals who are passionate about their work. We believe that diversity fuels innovation, collaboration, and drives our entrepreneurial spirit. As a global company, we highly value diverse perspectives and are committed to cultivating an environment where all voices are heard, respected, and valued. We are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants, and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Job Description

The American Express Travel & Lifestyle Services (TLS) Test Team validates travel-related products and capabilities across the TLS product suite.

The Quality Engineer II supports User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Quality Assurance (QA) by preparing test strategies, developing and executing test scripts, maintaining test data and environments, logging results, and supporting defect resolution. This role executes against the portfolio-level test and automation strategy and supports delivery in a Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) environment.

The Quality Engineer II partners with Product Managers, vendors, American Express developers, and technical teams to coordinate end-to-end testing across the TLS portfolio and ensure quality principles and processes are consistently applied throughout software delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinates and facilitates UAT/E2E testing activities across programs and large projects.
  • Creates and maintains comprehensive test data sets to support systems integration, regression, and customer journey testing, ensuring accurate and reliable results.
  • Monitors and tracks defect resolution, partnering with development teams to support timely and effective fixes.
  • Participates in design discussions to identify quality risks early and recommend refinements to user story requirements.
  • Defines, documents, and analyzes quality assurance metrics, including defect trends, test results, and test status, to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Supports core quality principles and promotes adherence to quality standards, engineering practices, and continuous improvement.
  • Develops, enhances, and maintains CI/CD automation processes, ensuring automated tests are integrated and executed effectively within delivery pipelines.
  • Collaborates with product and business teams to align quality engineering activities with business objectives.
  • Integrates agentic AI tools into test design, documentation, execution, and defect management workflows to improve testing efficiency and coverage across applications and systems
  • Uses agentic AI analysis capabilities to identify defect patterns, testing gaps, and quality risks, providing recommendations for process improvements
  • Applies agentic AI testing and automation capabilities within continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines to enhance quality and delivery outcomes
  • Applies responsible AI principles when using AI-enabled tools, including data privacy, bias awareness, human oversight, traceability, and validation of AI-generated outputs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or another technical discipline, or equivalent work experience required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in QA, UAT, or software testing.
  • Experience with Agile, Agile at scale (SAFe), and other iterative application development methods
  • Proficiency with Rally, JIRA, or similar development and defect tracking applications.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Able to work flexible hours with occasional overtime as needed.
  • Knowledge of testing methodologies, test data management tools, and at least one programming or scripting language.
  • Working knowledge of AI-enabled testing capabilities within quality engineering, automation, and defect management tools.
  • Understanding of AI use cases in software testing, including automated test generation, defect analysis, reporting, and test optimization techniques

Work Experience

  • Experience in writing test cases, running functional, automated, or performance tests, and managing and mitigating defects
  • Experience in Software Development Life Cycle (test, defect, reporting and metrics, etc.)
  • Experience in automation and testing in a continuous deployment/continuous integration environment
  • Experience in quality scanning tools, ability to baseline and measure on-going quality metrics, and display via Dashboards
  • Experience in working with the core tools used in the planning, analyzing, crafting, building, testing, configuring, and maintaining of assigned application(s)
  • Experience in application programming interface testing, accessibility testing, chaos testing, security testing, performance testing, user interface testing, disaster recovery and relevant frameworks
  • Desired skills/certification: Automation Frameworks, and Methodologies.
  • Software engineering and development experience or a related job, with a focus on quality engineering
  • Experience applying agentic AI capabilities within functional, automated, performance, or regression testing activities in software delivery environments
  • Experience validating AI agent-generated testing outputs and integrating AI agent-enabled practices into quality engineering and automation workflows

- Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
- Able to work flexible hours with occasional overtime as needed.
- Knowledge of testing methodologies, test data management tools, and at least one programming or scripting language.
- Working knowledge of AI-enabled testing capabilities within quality engineering, automation, and defect management tools.

Work Experience



- Experience in writing test cases, running functional, automated, or performance tests, and managing and mitigating defects

- Experience in automation and testing in a continuous deployment/continuous integration environment
- Experience in quality scanning tools, ability to baseline and measure on-going quality metrics, and display via Dashboards

- Desired skills/certification: Automation Frameworks, and Methodologies.
- Software engineering and development experience or a related job, with a focus on quality engineering
- Experience applying agentic AI capabilities within functional, automated, performance, or regression testing activities in software delivery environments

MicroAire Surgical Instruments LLC


As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.


Senior Quality Assurance Engineer – Medical Devices

Charlottesville, VA 22911

  • Department: Quality Assurance / Regulatory Affairs
  • Reports To: Director, Quality and Design Assurance Engineering


100% onsite, Relocation assistance provided


POSITION SUMMARY:

  • MicroAire is seeking talented Quality Engineers at multiple experience levels. Candidates may be considered for either a Quality Assurance Engineer or Senior Quality Assurance Engineer position based on qualifications, experience, and demonstrated capabilities
  • The Quality Assurance Engineer supports and leads quality engineering activities associated with new product development, sustaining engineering, supplier quality, and Quality Management System (QMS) initiatives within a regulated medical device environment. This role partners with cross-functional teams to ensure products, processes, and systems meet quality, regulatory, and customer requirements while supporting innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Depending on experience and qualifications, the successful candidate may be hired at the Quality Assurance Engineer or Senior Quality Assurance Engineer level


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Support and/or lead quality engineering activities related to new product development, design control, and sustaining engineering programs
  • Participate in design verification, design validation, risk management, process validation, packaging validation, sterilization validation, and design transfer activities
  • Develop, execute, and review validation and qualification protocols and reports, including IQ/OQ/PQ activities
  • Ensure compliance with applicable FDA regulations, ISO standards, company procedures, and other regulatory requirements
  • Support and/or lead CAPA, complaint investigations, nonconformance investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action activities
  • Evaluate product and process changes and assess impact on product quality, validation status, and regulatory compliance
  • Collaborate with R&D, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Operations teams to drive quality objectives and support product launches
  • Support supplier quality activities including supplier qualification, audits, incoming quality issues, and material discrepancy resolution
  • Utilize statistical analysis and data-driven decision-making to evaluate process capability, quality trends, and product performance
  • Participate in quality metrics reviews and continuous improvement initiatives to improve QMS effectiveness and operational performance
  • Support internal and external audits and assist in maintaining an inspection-ready quality system
  • Assist with or lead implementation of quality system improvements, software tools, and process optimization projects
  • Provide technical quality guidance to cross-functional teams and, at the senior level, mentor less experienced team members
  • Perform other duties as assigned


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, or a related technical discipline


For Quality Assurance Engineer

  • At least 1+ years of quality, manufacturing, or engineering experience
  • Experience in medical device or aerospace manufacturing environment
  • Knowledge of FDA, ISO 13485, CAPA, validation, and quality systems preferred


For Senior Quality Assurance Engineer

  • At least 6+ years of quality or manufacturing engineering experience
  • Experience in medical devices or aerospace industry required
  • Demonstrated experience leading CAPAs, risk management activities, validation programs, supplier quality initiatives, and quality improvement projects
  • Prior experience mentoring or providing technical leadership preferred


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Medical device industry experience
  • Supplier quality experience
  • ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or other ASQ certification
  • Lean Six Sigma certification or experience
  • Experience with statistical analysis, process capability studies, and quality improvement methodologies

Senior QA Engineer -AI & Engineering

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to business. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models-traditional teams, pools, or pods-are tailored to each client's needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Work You'll Do

As an SDET III, you will bring considerable technical expertise to deliver effective solutions to clients including the following:

  • Acting as the lead, interfacing between clients and our Deloitte teams.
  • Helping to create testing solutions to meet our clients' business needs.
  • Leading the testing of custom technology solutions.

Required Qualifications And Experience

  • 6+ years' relevant consulting or industry experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field.
  • 4+ years hands-on experience defining the testing strategy for large scale programs and ensuring requirements traceability throughout the system development lifecycle. Experience should include leading the testing efforts, including experience with all phases of testing: system integration, user acceptance, and performance testing.
  • Experience with at least two of the following: TCOE, TMO, mobile testing, automation testing, SAP/Oracle testing, data testing in a client-facing or industry role.
  • 4+ years' experience driving the quality assurance processes and gaining delivery and buy-in from executive leadership.
  • 2+ years' experience leading teams - onshore, offshore and nearshore.
  • Experience with Test and Defect Management tools - MicroFocus, ALM, JIRA.
  • 4+ years' experience working in a testing role in different environments including the following: client server, service-oriented architecture, web-based, mainframe-based and three-tier architectures.
  • Experience with the following: MicroFocus UFT, Rational Tooling, and Open Source Automation Tools such as Selenium, Cucumber, OpSoapUI, PostMan, RESTAssured, Mockito.
  • Experience in at least one Scripting language - Shell, VBScript, Perl or Python.
  • Experience with Source Control Systems - SVN or GIT.
  • Experience with Build tools - Maven, CircleCI.
  • Experience with Automated Reporting.
  • Experience with Cloud testing, API testing
  • Experience with CI/CD/CT tools - Jenkins, Bamboo, Quickbuild.
  • Experience applying prompt engineering techniques to generate, refine, or debug automated test scripts and test data.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred Qualifications And Experience

  • Experience working in Cloud, Web and Mobile Testing platforms - Saucelabs, Browerstack are preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning models.
  • Experience in Python NLTK or similar natural language processing technology.
  • Experience evaluating or testing AI/LLM-based application features (e.g., chatbots, copilots, RAG-based systems), including prompt-response validation and hallucination/edge-case testing.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted defect triage or root-cause analysis tools that reduce manual investigation time.
  • Exposure to self-healing test automation frameworks (AI-driven locator repair, visual AI testing).
  • Understanding of responsible AI/testing governance principles (bias detection, explainability, model validation) as applied to QE.
  • Experience contributing to or influencing AI-adoption roadmaps within a testing/QE organization.
  • Experience implementing testing best practices specific to the test planning and execution processes and gaining buy-in for changes from executives.
  • A deep understanding of testing planning and associated delivery challenges.
  • A strong understanding of the various approaches used in testing techniques - white-box, black-box, load testing, coverage testing and regression testing.

Sponsorship:

  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Wages + Salary

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400 to $207,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

  • Perform root cause analysis and analyze historical defect trends to identify recurring patterns and recommend preventive improvements.
  • Provide clear quality reports covering test results, coverage, defects, risks, and release readiness.
  • Improve quality dashboards, reporting, and testing efficiency by automating repetitive tasks and streamlining QA processes.
  • Use AI-assisted tools for test design, automation development, maintenance, and defect investigation. Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and reliability.
  • Develop testing approaches for new products built using AI, including validation of functionality, business workflows, and expected behavior.
  • Strengthen quality practices throughout the development lifecycle and mentor junior team members.


Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of software quality engineering experience spanning functional and automation testing.

  • Hands-on experience with both Playwright and Selenium, including proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience with API testing using Postman or similar tools.
  • Demonstrated experience improving quality dashboards, reporting, and testing efficiency through automation and process improvements.
  • Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile delivery practices.
  • Experience testing AI-powered products and prompts is a plus.
  • Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as ADO/JIRA
  • Practical familiarity with AI-assisted testing or development tools, including their limitations and methods for validating their outputs.

descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're seeking an experienced, automation-focused Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to join our North American Sports product team. This team develops insightful analytics and Recruit products for American Football, helping high-level coaches and analysts make faster, data-driven decisions on player performance and talent acquisition.

As the testing expert within your cross-functional squad, you'll own quality end-to-end — building the strategies and automation that ensure we're shipping software our users love. You'll drive quality discussions, challenge the team to maintain high standards, and be the advocate for reliability and performance at every stage of delivery.

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, You'll

  • Lead quality initiatives. Build risk-based testing strategies tailored to your squad's architecture, drive quality discussions in scrum ceremonies, challenge defect priorities, and continuously look for ways to improve practices and keep your squad's quality processes ahead of the curve.
  • Test across the stack. Design and execute tests spanning front-end UI, APIs, backend services, and data pipelines — validating transformations, service outputs, and complex logic at scale.
  • Automate with intent. Make informed decisions about what, when, and how to automate. Use Playwright and scripting to build reliable, maintainable automated checks that keep pace with development.
  • Mentor and grow others. Use your technical depth and quality instincts to coach teammates, raise the bar for quality standards across the team, and influence how the whole squad thinks about quality.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally. Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Design, contribute to hiring, and invest in your own professional development.

Location

While local candidates in Lincoln and Omaha, Nebraska are prioritized, we're open to remote applicants who reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, North Carolina, Nevada, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

Must-Haves

  • Quality focus. You see the big picture and use it to drive improvements in both quality and velocity.
  • Technical depth. 4+ years of software testing experience with hands-on expertise across the full stack — API testing, backend and data-heavy systems, and front-end validation — plus proficiency in automation frameworks like Playwright and languages like Python or TypeScript.
  • A track record of leadership. You've owned quality for a squad, led testing initiatives end-to-end, defined success criteria, and designed approaches that measurably reduce risk in production.
  • Investigative rigour. You dig to root causes of complex problems, back your findings with data, and measure outcomes.
  • User focus. You think critically about the user experience and let that understanding shape your testing approach.
  • AI-powered working. You actively use AI tools in your day-to-day workflow — for test case creation, failure diagnosis, documentation, and beyond — and look for new ways to apply them to raise the team's efficiency.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Performance testing exposure. Familiarity with load, stress, and scalability testing concepts and tools (e.g. JMeter) for validating API and backend performance.
  • Sports knowledge. Passion for or experience in Basketball, American Football or Ice Hockey — whether as an athlete, coach, or fan — and an appreciation for the unique challenges of sports technology.
  • A relevant degree or equivalent experience. A bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We're always investing in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.
  • Take care of your mental and physical health. Medical plans tailored for you and your family—including vision, dental, and fertility benefits—and stay supported with our EAP and Employee Resource Groups.
  • Contribute to your 401(K). Yep, that's free money. We'll match up to 4% of your own contribution.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

Base Salary Range

$82,000 - $137,000 USD

Job Description

Job Purpose

We are seeking an experienced Senior QA Engineer to join our Atlanta-based Quality Assurance organization. In this role, you will combine strong functional testing discipline with practical automation, AI-assisted workflows, exploratory testing, defect management, and quality reporting.

This position will help shape how our organization adopts automation and artificial intelligence in a practical, sustainable way. You will use AI tooling and automation to strengthen our QA process, applying them across requirements analysis, test authoring, coverage review, automation planning, execution, and reporting. We are looking for an engineer who can meet the organization where it is today while helping establish scalable practices for where it needs to go next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role that does not require people management.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Functional Test Ownership
  • Assume full accountability for functional test coverage of assigned applications, including the user interface, service layers, and integration points.
  • Be hands-on across assigned applications, combining manual, exploratory, regression, integration, and automated testing based on risk, value, and maintainability.
  • Define and maintain the application's test strategy, determining which tests should remain manual, which should be automated, and how coverage should evolve over time.
  • Act as the quality authority for the application, providing evidence-based release readiness assessments to engineering and product leadership.
  • AI-Enabled Quality Workflow
  • You will apply AI tooling and automation selectively across the quality lifecycle, with emphasis on improving consistency, speed, coverage, and decision-making:
  • Evaluate requirements, acceptance criteria, and design documentation to surface ambiguities, missing edge cases, and untestable requirements prior to development.
  • Create manual test cases and scenarios from requirements, then apply engineering judgment to refine, consolidate, and prioritize them.
  • Review implemented functionality, requirements, and the existing test suite to identify coverage gaps, duplicate effort, ineffective assertions, and divergence between specified and actual behavior.
  • Assess each test for automation suitability based on stability, execution frequency, maintenance cost, and exploratory value, and make defensible recommendations on automated versus manual execution.
  • Build and maintain Playwright automation where it provides clear value, using AI tooling to accelerate authoring, refactoring, debugging, and long-term maintenance.
  • Operate automated suites within CI/CD pipelines while continuing to perform manual, exploratory, and scenario-based testing where human judgment is the better instrument.
  • Triage, reproduce, document, and drive defects to resolution, using AI-assisted analysis to shorten root-cause isolation.
  • Produce clear, decision-ready reporting on coverage, execution results, defect trends, and release risk.
  • Test Framework Development
  • Contribute substantively to the organization's growing QA automation framework, extending its capability while ensuring it complements a manual testing model.
  • Design and implement automation solutions when required, including architecture, page and component abstractions, fixtures, test data management, environment configuration, CI integration, and reporting, with attention to long-term adoption.
  • Establish automation standards and design patterns that keep test suites fast, reliable, readable, and approachable for QA engineers building automation skills.
  • Technical Leadership
  • Lead by example through code review, pairing, and hands-on guidance; help manual QA engineers build practical automation, AI, and technical testing skills over time.
  • Serve as a resource for the broader QA and engineering organization on practical automation, AI-assisted testing methods, and when manual testing remains the most effective approach.
  • Partner with software engineers, product managers, and DevOps to shift quality activities earlier in the delivery cycle.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience in software quality engineering, including strong manual testing experience and meaningful hands-on test automation work.
  • Demonstrated depth with Playwright, extending beyond test authoring to suite architecture, flakiness mitigation, test data strategy, and execution at scale within CI.
  • Practical, applied experience using AI-assisted engineering tooling as part of a routine development or testing workflow for example, AI coding agents, AI-assisted test authoring, or AI-supported code and requirements analysis.
  • Strong foundation in functional testing, including test design techniques, risk-based prioritization, boundary and negative testing, and structured exploratory testing.
  • Experience contributing to or building test automation frameworks, with the ability to explain architectural decisions and adapt solutions for teams at different automation maturity levels.
  • Proficiency in TypeScript or JavaScript, or comparable programming experience with the ability to become productive quickly.
  • Experience owning both manual and automated testing for an application, with sound judgment regarding the appropriate role of each in a hybrid QA model.
  • Working knowledge of defect and test management tooling such as Jira, Xray, or equivalent.
  • Experience integrating automated test execution into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; test plans, defect reports, and quality summaries must stand on their own without narration.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Claude Code or a comparable AI coding agent.
  • Experience creating AI agent skills and custom agents, and using Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, including building MCP servers when existing tooling is not sufficient.
  • API test automation experience across REST or GraphQL, including contract testing.
  • Experience helping a manual QA organization adopt automation, AI tooling, or modern quality practices in a practical and sustainable way.
  • Background in a regulated or high-reliability domain.

Job Title: QA Senior Test Engineer

Location: Corporate

Department: Information Technology

Job Summary: The QA Senior Test Engineer is responsible for developing, executing, and maintaining automated and manual tests for web, API, and mobile applications. This role supports quality engineering practices across Digital, Mobile, and IT teams by contributing to test automation, validating application functionality, documenting defects, and helping improve overall software quality. This role is expected to actively participate in agile ceremonies, support CI/CD testing activities, and help ensure that features meet defined acceptance criteria and quality standards. Contribute to test planning, test case design, automated test development, defect validation, and continuous improvement of testing practices.

Principal Duties

  • Collaborate with software development engineers and QA team members to understand feature requirements, technical design, and test coverage needs.
  • Participate in and contribute to code reviews and design discussions to provide input on testability and automation considerations.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute automated functional, integration, API, and end-to-end tests for Digital, Mobile, and IT initiatives.
  • Assist with defining test cases, test data needs, and acceptance criteria in partnership with product and engineering teams.
  • Contribute to improvements to quality assurance practices by identifying opportunities to increase automation, reliability, and repeatability.
  • Find, isolate, document, regress, and track defects through resolution.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of manual and automated test execution across assigned products and features to ensure features meet defined acceptance criteria and quality standards.
  • Assist with end-to-end configuration, environment validation, and test data setup for digital, mobile, and other IT projects.
  • Track and report testing progress, automation results, and defect trends to help teams assess quality and readiness.

Essential Functions

  • Ability to work well individually and in a team environment
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently on assigned tasks with appropriate guidance and escalation
  • Detail oriented with strong organizational and time management skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and communicate risks or blockers in a timely manner
  • Ability to communicate technical information clearly with technical and non-technical peers
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and willingness to learn
  • Ability to follow established engineering and QA practices while contributing ideas for improvement
  • Enjoys working with partners, colleagues, and teams to solve software quality challenges
  • Passionate about QA, test automation, and continuous learning

Basic Qualifications

  • BS/BA degree preferred or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience writing test cases, executing software tests, documenting defects, and supporting test automation
  • 5+ years of experience with automated testing tools or frameworks
  • Familiarity with software development processes including Agile/Lean methodologies and DevOps concepts, particularly in a CI/CD environment
  • QA professional certifications preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver assigned work with quality and consistency
  • Experience using automation to support repeatable software testing
  • Experience creating and executing test cases for assigned features or applications
  • Experience with automated testing tools such as WebdriverIO, SmartBear, or similar platforms
  • Programming or scripting experience using TypeScript, JavaScript, or similar languages
  • Working knowledge of software development life cycle practices, including coding standards, code reviews, source control, build and release processes, CI/CD, and test suite maintenance

Job Description

The American Express Travel & Lifestyle Services (TLS) Test Team validates travel-related products and capabilities across the TLS product suite.

The Quality Engineer II supports User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Quality Assurance (QA) by preparing test strategies, developing and executing test scripts, maintaining test data and environments, logging results, and supporting defect resolution. This role executes against the portfolio-level test and automation strategy and supports delivery in a Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) environment.

The Quality Engineer II partners with Product Managers, vendors, American Express developers, and technical teams to coordinate end-to-end testing across the TLS portfolio and ensure quality principles and processes are consistently applied throughout software delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinates and facilitates UAT/E2E testing activities across programs and large projects.
  • Creates and maintains comprehensive test data sets to support systems integration, regression, and customer journey testing, ensuring accurate and reliable results.
  • Monitors and tracks defect resolution, partnering with development teams to support timely and effective fixes.
  • Participates in design discussions to identify quality risks early and recommend refinements to user story requirements.
  • Defines, documents, and analyzes quality assurance metrics, including defect trends, test results, and test status, to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Supports core quality principles and promotes adherence to quality standards, engineering practices, and continuous improvement.
  • Develops, enhances, and maintains CI/CD automation processes, ensuring automated tests are integrated and executed effectively within delivery pipelines.
  • Collaborates with product and business teams to align quality engineering activities with business objectives.
  • Integrates agentic AI tools into test design, documentation, execution, and defect management workflows to improve testing efficiency and coverage across applications and systems
  • Uses agentic AI analysis capabilities to identify defect patterns, testing gaps, and quality risks, providing recommendations for process improvements
  • Applies agentic AI testing and automation capabilities within continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines to enhance quality and delivery outcomes
  • Applies responsible AI principles when using AI-enabled tools, including data privacy, bias awareness, human oversight, traceability, and validation of AI-generated outputs.

Qualifications

 QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or another technical discipline, or equivalent work experience required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in QA, UAT, or software testing.
  • Experience with Agile, Agile at scale (SAFE), and other iterative application development methods
  • Proficiency with Rally, JIRA, or similar development and defect tracking applications.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Able to work flexible hours with occasional overtime as needed.
  • Knowledge of testing methodologies, test data management tools, and at least one programming or scripting language.
  • Working knowledge of AI-enabled testing capabilities within quality engineering, automation, and defect management tools.
  • Understanding of AI use cases in software testing, including automated test generation, defect analysis, reporting, and test optimization techniques.

  • Strong understanding of software test methodologies and quality strategy 
  • 5+ years' experience in software test engineering
  • Experience with test coverage analysis, test execution, and defect management 
  • Participation in agile SDLC; usage of agile project management tools 
  • Test automation experience (Selenium, Cucumber, Jenkins, Postman, TestNG, etc.) 
  • Basic programming skills in Java 
  • Basic understanding of Linux commands and filesystem 
  • Effective verbal and written communication; able to read, write, and speak English proficiently

descriptionHtml:
About Prudentia Sciences

Prudentia Sciences is an AI-powered technology platform transforming how biopharma, biotech, and life sciences investors approach portfolio management, due diligence, and value/risk simulation. Our platform accelerates investment in breakthrough therapies by:

  • Empowering biopharma to accelerate drug pipelines, maximize ROI, and achieve clinical and commercial success for greater patient impact
  • Enabling strategic positioning of asset value during portfolio planning and dealmaking
  • Equipping investors with data-driven insights to optimize capital allocation in drug asset transactions

Backed by GV (Google Ventures), McKesson, Signal Fire, Iaso Ventures, and Virtue, we're on a mission to unlock the full potential of pharmaceutical R&D by empowering decision-makers with real-time, data-driven insights.

The Opportunity

We’re hiring our first dedicated QA Engineer: a hands-on engineer who writes code, builds quality into our platform from the ground up, and cares as much about performance and reliability as about correctness.

This is a rare opportunity to join a high-impact technology company in a major growth stage, where you’ll partner closely with engineering, product, and ML teams to safeguard the trust our pharma and biopharma customers place in our platform. Our platform is quickly seeing exceptional demand in its sector, and is backed by top-tier life science investors who have an informed perspective on where AI can have a profound impact in the industry.

What You’ll Do

  • Test Automation: Design, build, and maintain automated test suites across UI, API, and data pipelines, with most coverage at the API and data layers, so the team can ship fast and with confidence as the platform scales.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Use AI coding tools (like Claude Code) daily to build and maintain tests, and know when to question their output. You understand why the code works, not just that it runs, and you keep sensitive data out of AI tools.
  • Quality Gates in CI/CD: Own the automated quality gates in our CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions), deciding what blocks a release and what doesn’t. Be ruthless about eliminating flaky or long-running tests.
  • API & Contract Testing: Test at the API layer by default, and catch breaking changes between services before they reach production.
  • Performance & Reliability Testing: Own load, performance, and reliability testing so the platform meets the availability and responsiveness expectations of deal teams working with large volumes of sensitive, time-sensitive data.
  • Bug Tracking & Triage: Identify, document, and triage defects with clear reproduction steps, work with engineers to prioritize fixes, and make clear go/no-go release calls.
  • Data & Output Validation: Validate the accuracy and consistency of ML-driven outputs (risk analyses, valuations, scientific assessments) as they move from the orchestration layer into user-facing views.
  • Security & Compliance Awareness: Help verify secure handling of sensitive scientific and deal data, including keeping each customer’s data separate
  • Collaboration & Process: Work cross-functionally with engineers, product leads, and domain experts to translate scientific and business requirements into clear, testable acceptance criteria.
  • Continuous Improvement: Champion a quality-first culture: advocate for testability in design reviews, improve test coverage over time, and stay current on modern QA tooling and practices.

Who You Are

Core Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • QA Experience: Proven experience testing modern web applications and designing and building automated test suites, ideally as the person who owned them.
  • Test Automation Tools: Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Cypress) and API testing tools (e.g., pytest, REST-assured, pactflow).
  • CI/CD Integration: Experience owning automated tests in CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions), including setting up quality gates and managing flaky tests.
  • AI-Assisted Development: Hands-on use of AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in your daily work, with a habit of verifying what they produce.
  • Performance Testing: Experience designing load or performance tests and finding real bottlenecks.
  • Technical Fluency: Comfort reading code and working directly with engineers to understand system architecture, APIs, and data flows well enough to design meaningful tests.
  • Data-Driven Applications: Experience testing applications with complex, data-driven workflows.
  • Bug Tracking & Communication: Skilled at writing clear, reproducible bug reports and explaining quality risks and release readiness to the team.
  • Security & Compliance Awareness: Familiarity with best practices for secure data handling and testing in regulated or sensitive-data environments
  • Collaboration & Product Mindset: Strong communication and collaboration skills; ability to work closely with engineers, product managers, and scientific domain experts to deliver a high-quality user experience.

What We Offer

  • Impact: Your work directly enables breakthrough therapies to reach patients faster
  • Ownership: Build and lead the platform as a foundational engineering leader
  • Growth: Shape our product experience during a critical scaling phase
  • Compensation: Competitive salary and equity
  • Team: Collaborative, mission-driven colleagues passionate about transforming biopharma

Location

We are prioritizing candidates who can be flexibly hybrid twice per week (Tues/Thurs) from our Boston, NYC, or San Francisco office. If we find truly exceptional talent, we may consider fully remote in the United States.

Compensation Range: $120K - $145K

- Quality Gates in CI/CD: Own the automated quality gates in our CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions), deciding what blocks a release and what doesn’t. Be ruthless about eliminating flaky or long-running tests.

- Performance & Reliability Testing: Own load, performance, and reliability testing so the platform meets the availability and responsiveness expectations of deal teams working with large volumes of sensitive, time-sensitive data.

- Data & Output Validation: Validate the accuracy and consistency of ML-driven outputs (risk analyses, valuations, scientific assessments) as they move from the orchestration layer into user-facing views.
- Security & Compliance Awareness: Help verify secure handling of sensitive scientific and deal data, including keeping each customer’s data separate 
- Collaboration & Process: Work cross-functionally with engineers, product leads, and domain experts to translate scientific and business requirements into clear, testable acceptance criteria.
- Continuous Improvement: Champion a quality-first culture: advocate for testability in design reviews, improve test coverage over time, and stay current on modern QA tooling and practices.

Core Qualifications



- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
- QA Experience: Proven experience testing modern web applications and designing and building automated test suites, ideally as the person who owned them.
- Test Automation Tools: Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Cypress) and API testing tools (e.g., pytest, REST-assured, pactflow).
- CI/CD Integration: Experience owning automated tests in CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions), including setting up quality gates and managing flaky tests.
- AI-Assisted Development: Hands-on use of AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in your daily work, with a habit of verifying what they produce.
- Performance Testing: Experience designing load or performance tests and finding real bottlenecks.
- Technical Fluency: Comfort reading code and working directly with engineers to understand system architecture, APIs, and data flows well enough to design meaningful tests.

- Bug Tracking & Communication: Skilled at writing clear, reproducible bug reports and explaining quality risks and release readiness to the team.

- Collaboration & Product Mindset: Strong communication and collaboration skills; ability to work closely with engineers, product managers, and scientific domain experts to deliver a high-quality user experience.

What We Offer



- Impact: Your work directly enables breakthrough therapies to reach patients faster
- Ownership: Build and lead the platform as a foundational engineering leader
- Growth: Shape our product experience during a critical scaling phase
- Compensation: Competitive salary and equity
- Team: Collaborative, mission-driven colleagues passionate about transforming biopharma

Location

We are prioritizing candidates who can be flexibly hybrid twice per week (Tues/Thurs) from our Boston, NYC, or San Francisco office. If we find truly exceptional talent, we may consider fully remote in the United States.

Compensation Range: $120K - $145K

Senior QA Engineer

Location: Austin, TX (Hybrid – three days per week in office)

Employment Type: Full-time

Company: Black Unicorn US, Inc.

About Black Unicorn

Black Unicorn is a technology-driven family office headquartered in the Cayman Islands, with its engineering hub in Austin. We pair private capital with in-house product and engineering teams to launch platforms in payments, financial infrastructure, e-commerce, and media. We invest and operate across several countries and industries, and we move with conviction to create enduring, high growth companies.

The Role

We’re hiring a Senior QA Engineer to test our websites, mobile apps, web applications, e-commerce journeys, and banking/payment products. In a typical week, you might test an ACH payment, an e-commerce checkout, a mobile release, and the APIs underneath them. When customers move money through our platforms, you’re the one who makes sure it’s right before we ship.

This is an opportunity to build QA from the ground up. You’ll be involved from the first requirements conversation through to production, working closely with engineering, product, and design, and using AI tools to write test cases, generate test data, and speed up defect analysis.

This role is based in Austin, TX, and requires three days a week in our downtown office.

What You'll Do

  • Create and execute test plans, test cases, checklists, and regression suites.
  • Review requirements and designs early, and flag gaps, edge cases, and testability issues before development starts.
  • Own quality in our PCI and SOC 2 compliant stack, with particular focus on detecting and preventing any PCI data exposure across our web apps.
  • Test web, mobile, cloud, e-commerce, banking, payment, and API workflows.
  • Test payment and money-movement flows end to end, including ACH transfers, card payments, refunds, reversals, failed and duplicate transactions, and ledger and reconciliation accuracy.
  • Test customer onboarding and identity verification (KYC), login and authentication, roles and permissions, and how the apps handle sensitive data.
  • Test APIs and third-party integrations with Postman or similar tools, including error handling, timeouts, and data validation.
  • Identify, document, track, retest, and verify defects.
  • Validate releases across browsers, devices, operating systems, and environments.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, engineers, and operations teams to ensure release quality.
  • Support performance and load testing and help improve overall QA coverage and processes.
  • Track and report on quality, including defect trends, test coverage, and release readiness, so leadership can make clear go/no-go decisions.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of software testing experience.
  • 5+ years testing banking, payment, or transaction-based applications.
  • 2+ years of fintech experience.
  • Proven manual testing experience across mobile, web, APIs, and cloud-hosted applications.
  • Ability to test APIs using Postman or similar tools.
  • Experience testing e-commerce, checkout, payment processing, authentication, refunds, transaction errors, and related user journeys.
  • Experience with functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and user acceptance testing.
  • Experience with performance or load testing. Strong defect reporting, test-case writing, and release-validation skills.
  • Familiarity with issue-tracking tools such as Monday.com, Azure, and DevOps.

Compensation And Benefits

We offer a competitive salary and strong benefits, including comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage and 401(k) matching.

Job Description

ECS is seeking a QA Automation Engineer to work remotely.

We are seeking a QA Automation Engineer with experience in end-to-end testing, test automation, performance testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to join the Professional Services team. This role will be responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive testing strategy across functional, integration, automation, performance, security, regression, and user acceptance testing activities.

The ideal candidate will have experience validating complex web applications, APIs, data platforms, and third-party integrations. This individual will work closely with engineering teams, technical leadership, and customer stakeholders to ensure solutions meet functional requirements, performance expectations, security controls, and release readiness criteria.

Candidates should have hands-on experience with automation frameworks and testing tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Python-based testing solutions, Jira, Confluence, and performance testing tools such as Locust.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans covering functional, integration, end-to-end, performance, regression, and user acceptance testing.
  • Define test strategies, test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and release readiness metrics in collaboration with project stakeholders.
  • Design, develop, and execute automated test suites for web applications, APIs, and integrated workflows.
  • Perform end-to-end testing across frontend applications, APIs, Databricks environments, and third-party platform integrations.
  • Validate integrations spanning web applications, backend services, data platforms, and external systems.
  • Execute functional testing across multiple user personas and business workflows.
  • Coordinate and facilitate multiple rounds of User Acceptance Testing (UAT), document findings, validate remediation efforts, and support final release approvals.
  • Design and execute performance and load testing using tools such as Locust, validating system behavior under concurrent user activity and identifying performance bottlenecks.
  • Perform regression testing to ensure software quality and system stability prior to production releases.
  • Validate role-based access controls, security requirements, governance controls, and data access restrictions.
  • Identify, document, classify, and track software defects through resolution.
  • Collaborate with engineers, TPMs, product owners, and customer stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Produce testing reports, quality metrics, defect summaries, and release recommendations.
  • Utilize Jira and Confluence to manage testing activities, document results, and track defects and remediation efforts.

Salary Range: $140,000-$165,000

General Description Of Benefits

Required Skills

  • Active Secret Clearance
  • Experience with UAT (User Acceptance Testing)
  • Strong background in Software Quality Assurance (SW QA)
  • Ability to translate business requirements into effective test cases
  • Experience identifying and documenting defects clearly and concisely
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
  • Effective communication skills for cross‑team collaboration

Desired Skills

  • Active Secret Clearance.
  • Experience with end-to-end testing, software quality assurance, and test automation.
  • Hands-on experience with Selenium and/or Playwright for automated web application testing.
  • Experience developing automated test frameworks and automated regression test suites.
  • Experience establishing and maintaining automated testing pipelines.
  • Experience using Python-based testing tools, including performance and load testing solutions such as Locust.
  • Experience testing web applications, REST APIs, and distributed system integrations.
  • Experience testing applications deployed within secure cloud environments, including AWS GovCloud and IL5 environments.
  • Familiarity with Databricks, data engineering workflows, ETL pipelines, Delta Lake, and AI/ML-enabled platforms.
  • Experience validating integrations with external platforms and services, including data, analytics, and AI-related systems.
  • Experience testing React or other modern web application frameworks.
  • Familiarity with RBAC, data governance controls, compliance requirements, and secure application workflows.
  • Experience conducting performance, load, regression, functional, integration, and UAT testing.
  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum environments using Jira and Confluence.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience supporting production releases and formal release readiness activities.

Job Description

This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Software Quality Automation Engineer to join the Mist Engineering team. This role is ideal for engineers with strong software development and automation skills who are passionate about improving product quality through scalable test frameworks, intelligent automation, and rigorous validation.

While experience in Quality Assurance is valuable, we place greater emphasis on software engineering capabilities, particularly Python development, automation design, and problem-solving skills. Candidates with strong coding and cloud application experience who are interested in quality engineering are encouraged to apply.

U.S. citizenship is required for this role. This is an onsite position based in Cupertino, CA, requiring 5 days per week in the office, along with flexibility to attend meetings outside of standard business hours at least 3 days per week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and tools using Python.
  • Create scalable automation solutions for validating cloud, web UI, and REST API functionality.
  • Develop test infrastructure to improve engineering productivity and product quality.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers to identify, reproduce, troubleshoot, and resolve defects.
  • Analyze system behavior, logs, and telemetry to diagnose complex issues.
  • Build and maintain test environments, automation pipelines, and quality metrics.
  • Participate in feature reviews and provide feedback on testability and automation strategy.
  • Investigate customer-reported issues and reproduce problems in lab environments when required.
  • Continuously improve automation coverage, testing efficiency, and release quality.
  • Document automation solutions, test methodologies, and troubleshooting procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizen.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 2+ years of software engineering, automation engineering, quality engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of Python programming with demonstrated experience developing software or automation solutions.
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining automated testing frameworks.
  • Experience validating REST APIs and web applications.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working independently and driving technical solutions with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Selenium, Playwright, pytest, or similar automation frameworks.
  • Experience with cloud-native applications and distributed systems.
  • Familiarity with Django, RESTful services, and modern web architectures.
  • Knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates.
  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS products.

  • Strong coding ability and software development fundamentals.
  • Ability to design and build automation, rather than simply execute existing test suites.
  • Analytical thinking and a passion for solving complex technical problems.
  • Self-motivation and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced engineering environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and collaboration skills.
  • Curiosity, continuous learning, and ownership mindset.
  • Must be able to join team meetings three times a week during early or late hours to support international teams and customers.

companyDescription:
Heartflow is the global leader in AI-driven coronary artery disease (CAD) management, transforming how CAD — the world’s leading cause of death — is diagnosed and treated. Our advanced technology generates personalized, precision 3D heart models from a single CT scan, providing clinicians with the clarity and confidence to deliver earlier, more effective treatments — transforming CAD into a disease that can be managed for life. 

Heartflow One is the only complete, non-invasive, precision coronary care platform providing patient insights throughout the guideline-directed coronary CTA pathway. The AI-driven platform — including Roadmap™ Analysis, FFRct Analysis and Plaque Analysis — is supported by ACC/AHA guidelines and backed by more than 625 peer-reviewed publications.

With over 650,000 patients treated, more than 1,800 leading institutions adopting our solution, and 99.5% of U.S. lives covered — Heartflow is redefining the standard of coronary care. We're a global company, with employees across the United States, Europe and Japan. Our headquarters are in San Francisco, California, with additional offices in California, Texas, the UK and Japan. 

We believe CAD shouldn’t be a silent threat. We’re changing the story of CAD by making it screenable, diagnosable, and manageable — empowering clinicians to save lives and giving patients more time for what matters most.

descriptionHtml:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.

Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.

The Test Engineer is a hands-on individual contributor on the Test Engineering team, responsible for executing and extending automated test coverage across our regulated SaMD products. This role focuses on end-to-end system testing and post-deployment verification, working closely with and taking technical direction from the Test Architect and Senior Test Engineer while bringing fresh energy and fluency in modern AI-assisted tooling to accelerate the team's automation strategy. We're looking for someone genuinely excited by new testing technology, someone who will experiment with the latest AI-assisted authoring, self-healing, and triage tools, bring ideas back to the team, and help the function move faster, all while operating with the rigor required of a medical device QMS environment. The ideal candidate is comfortable with modern UI automation frameworks (Selenium and Playwright), motivated to grow their depth in regulated software testing, and driven by the chance to ship high-quality software that directly supports patient care.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain automated end-to-end (E2E) tests covering complete user workflows across UI, API, and back-end services, under the technical direction of the Test Architect and Senior Test Engineer.
  • Actively explore and apply AI-assisted test automation techniques AI-assisted authoring, self-healing locators, generative test design, and AI-supported triage and bring back recommendations on new tools and approaches worth adopting team-wide.
  • Execute post-deployment verification activities such as production smoke tests and monitoring-driven checks, including contributing to a new baseline of daily smoke tests across environments.
  • Contribute to test plans, test protocols, and test reports under the guidance of senior engineers, ensuring documentation meets QMS expectations.
  • Participate in tool validation activities for test infrastructure and automation tooling per internal procedures.
  • Implement and maintain UI test automation using Selenium and Playwright; follow established framework patterns and contribute improvements and modernization ideas.
  • Develop API-level tests using tools such as REST Assured, Postman, Karate, Pact.io.
  • Translate requirements and user stories into clear, traceable test cases in partnership with engineers, product, and RA/QA.
  • Investigate test failures, file high-quality defect reports, and partner with developers to drive issues to resolution.
  • Help keep automated tests running reliably in CI/CD pipelines and respond promptly to pipeline breakages.
  • Provide test evidence and documentation to support audits, CAPAs, and regulatory submissions as requested.
  • Partner closely with the Test Architect and Senior Test Engineer to learn HeartFlow's ML pipeline, clinical computation services, and Workstation/reporting systems, and grow into owning larger pieces of the automation strategy over time.

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in software test engineering, SDET, or quality engineering roles, with a hands-on automation focus.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI-assisted and emerging test automation tools and techniques, this role is as much about mindset and curiosity as it is about existing depth.
  • Experience testing Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) or other regulated medical device software preferred; strong candidates from other regulated or quality-critical environments will also be considered.
  • Working familiarity with medical device QMS practices and applicable standards (e.g., ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, 21 CFR Part 820), including test documentation and traceability.
  • Proficiency with Selenium / WebDriver and Playwright, including writing stable, maintainable UI automation.
  • Hands-on experience contributing to E2E automation suites and test frameworks.
  • Exposure to authoring or maintaining test plans, protocols, and reports in a regulated environment.
  • Practical use of AI-assisted testing tools or techniques (e.g., AI-augmented test authoring, self-healing automation, LLM-supported triage) or strong motivation and aptitude to ramp quickly.
  • Solid programming skills in Python and/or another mainstream automation language (e.g., TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, or C#).
  • Experience with API testing tools (REST Assured, Postman, Karate, Pact.io or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD systems (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI) and basic exposure to cloud environments such as AWS.
  • Strong debugging skills and a structured approach to investigating failures.
  • Clear written and verbal communication; able to document test designs and defects effectively, and to advocate for new tools and ideas within the team.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Desired

  • A track record of self-directed learning side projects, open-source contributions, or experimentation with new AI/testing tools.
  • Exposure to RA/QA processes and supporting evidence collection for audits.
  • Experience testing ML/AI features, clinical workflows, or medical imaging products.
  • Experience validating visualizations such as 3D models, overlays, or measurement views.
  • Familiarity with non-functional / performance testing tools (e.g., k6, Locust, JMeter, Gatling).
  • Exposure to data-pipeline or microservices testing.

A reasonable estimate of the base salary compensation range is $135,000 to $180,000, bonus, and equity.
