descriptionText:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.

Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.

The Test Engineer is a hands-on individual contributor on the Test Engineering team, responsible for executing and extending automated test coverage across our regulated SaMD products. This role focuses on end-to-end system testing and post-deployment verification, working closely with and taking technical direction from the Test Architect and Senior Test Engineer while bringing fresh energy and fluency in modern AI-assisted tooling to accelerate the team's automation strategy. We're looking for someone genuinely excited by new testing technology, someone who will experiment with the latest AI-assisted authoring, self-healing, and triage tools, bring ideas back to the team, and help the function move faster, all while operating with the rigor required of a medical device QMS environment. The ideal candidate is comfortable with modern UI automation frameworks (Selenium and Playwright), motivated to grow their depth in regulated software testing, and driven by the chance to ship high-quality software that directly supports patient care.

Responsibilities



- Build and maintain automated end-to-end (E2E) tests covering complete user workflows across UI, API, and back-end services, under the technical direction of the Test Architect and Senior Test Engineer.
- Actively explore and apply AI-assisted test automation techniques AI-assisted authoring, self-healing locators, generative test design, and AI-supported triage and bring back recommendations on new tools and approaches worth adopting team-wide.
- Execute post-deployment verification activities such as production smoke tests and monitoring-driven checks, including contributing to a new baseline of daily smoke tests across environments.
- Contribute to test plans, test protocols, and test reports under the guidance of senior engineers, ensuring documentation meets QMS expectations.
- Participate in tool validation activities for test infrastructure and automation tooling per internal procedures.
- Implement and maintain UI test automation using Selenium and Playwright; follow established framework patterns and contribute improvements and modernization ideas.
- Develop API-level tests using tools such as REST Assured, Postman, Karate, Pact.io.
- Translate requirements and user stories into clear, traceable test cases in partnership with engineers, product, and RA/QA.
- Investigate test failures, file high-quality defect reports, and partner with developers to drive issues to resolution.
- Help keep automated tests running reliably in CI/CD pipelines and respond promptly to pipeline breakages.
- Provide test evidence and documentation to support audits, CAPAs, and regulatory submissions as requested.
- Partner closely with the Test Architect and Senior Test Engineer to learn HeartFlow's ML pipeline, clinical computation services, and Workstation/reporting systems, and grow into owning larger pieces of the automation strategy over time.

Qualifications



- 3–5 years of experience in software test engineering, SDET, or quality engineering roles, with a hands-on automation focus.
- Genuine enthusiasm for AI-assisted and emerging test automation tools and techniques, this role is as much about mindset and curiosity as it is about existing depth.
- Experience testing Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) or other regulated medical device software preferred; strong candidates from other regulated or quality-critical environments will also be considered.
- Working familiarity with medical device QMS practices and applicable standards (e.g., ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, 21 CFR Part 820), including test documentation and traceability.
- Proficiency with Selenium / WebDriver and Playwright, including writing stable, maintainable UI automation.
- Hands-on experience contributing to E2E automation suites and test frameworks.
- Exposure to authoring or maintaining test plans, protocols, and reports in a regulated environment.
- Practical use of AI-assisted testing tools or techniques (e.g., AI-augmented test authoring, self-healing automation, LLM-supported triage) or strong motivation and aptitude to ramp quickly.
- Solid programming skills in Python and/or another mainstream automation language (e.g., TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, or C#).
- Experience with API testing tools (REST Assured, Postman, Karate, Pact.io or equivalent).
- Familiarity with CI/CD systems (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI) and basic exposure to cloud environments such as AWS.
- Strong debugging skills and a structured approach to investigating failures.
- Clear written and verbal communication; able to document test designs and defects effectively, and to advocate for new tools and ideas within the team.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Desired



- A track record of self-directed learning side projects, open-source contributions, or experimentation with new AI/testing tools.
- Exposure to RA/QA processes and supporting evidence collection for audits.
- Experience testing ML/AI features, clinical workflows, or medical imaging products.
- Experience validating visualizations such as 3D models, overlays, or measurement views.
- Familiarity with non-functional / performance testing tools (e.g., k6, Locust, JMeter, Gatling).
- Exposure to data-pipeline or microservices testing.

Cedar Gate Technologies, an IQVIA business, enables payers, providers, employers, and service administrators to excel at value-based care with a unified technology and services platform delivering analytics, care, and payment technology on a single data management foundation. At Cedar Gate, you’ll be part of a collaborative, innovative environment where great ideas thrive. We invest deeply in our people through ongoing training, comprehensive benefits, and a strong culture of teamwork, offering the chance to grow your skills while contributing to high impact initiatives for some of the world's most dynamic companies.

Position Summary

Join Cedar Gate Technologies, an IQVIA business, as a Software QA Engineer 2, leading quality efforts for assigned product areas. You’ll collaborate with QA, Product, Engineering, Client Success, and Implementation teams to improve quality throughout the delivery lifecycle and support reliable, high quality releases. As the primary QA contact for assigned products, you’ll align testing priorities across teams, coordinate release readiness, and promote consistent QA standards. You’ll also perform hands on testing as needed for high priority releases, complex product scenarios, and client needs.

This role is ideal for an experienced QA professional who enjoys taking ownership, working across teams, and balancing quality leadership with hands on testing.

Roles & Responsibilities

QA Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment

› Serve as the primary QA partner for Product, Engineering, Client Success, Implementation, and Leadership across assigned product areas.

› Partner with Product and Engineering throughout roadmap, sprint, and release planning to align requirements, quality priorities, dependencies, risks, and delivery expectations.

› Provide leadership with regular visibility into QA performance, release status, quality trends, and key risks.

› Participate in enterprise QA governance and promote consistent adoption of QA standards and best practices.

Release Oversight & Quality Governance

› Partner with QA teams to align priorities, address quality blockers, and ensure testing remains on track for release.

› Review QA effort estimates, test plans, and testing strategies to ensure appropriate coverage and alignment with release requirements.

› Conduct testability reviews of functional requirements before development begins.

› Assess release readiness and provide QA sign off on established quality gates prior to production releases.

› Review QA metrics, root cause analyses, reliability findings, and release trends to identify systemic quality issues and opportunities for improvement.

Quality Execution & Client Support

› Provide hands on testing support for high priority releases, complex product scenarios, and client specific needs.

› Participate in client discussions when QA expertise is needed to address product quality questions or testing gaps.

Automation & AI

› Contribute to test automation and AI enabled testing initiatives, with a focus on adoption, effectiveness, and quality outcomes.

› Evaluate and support the use of AI assisted testing tools and validation approaches as product capabilities and QA practices evolve.

Job Location

Greenwich, CT

Work Arrangement: Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 remote)

Experience / Qualifications

› At least 5 years of software QA and testing experience, including coordination across functions, with at least 1 year leading QA activities, initiatives, or projects.

› Experience collaborating with QA, Product, and Engineering teams throughout software development and release.

› Proven ability to balance QA leadership and coordination with direct testing as needed.

› Background in test planning, release readiness, defect management, and root cause analysis.

› Practical experience with QA automation and testing tools or approaches that use AI.

› Strong skills in analysis, problem solving, and logical reasoning.

› Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal skills for effective communication across technical, business, and distributed teams.

› Adaptability to shifting priorities and ability to support adoption of new technologies, tools, and QA processes.

› Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or substantial professional experience.

› Healthcare experience in payer, provider, or healthcare technology environments is highly preferred.

Preferred

› Client-facing QA support experience is preferred.

› Familiarity with enterprise QA governance, quality metrics, and scorecards is preferred.

› To be eligible for this position, you must reside in the same country where the job is located.

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description

The Associate Quality Engineer supports Quality Engineering activities throughout the development of XBAT, a first-of-a-kind aerospace and defense product. This role partners closely with Design Engineering, Systems Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Test, Supply Chain, and Program Management to identify and mitigate product and process risks as the product moves from development toward production.

This role will help establish quality into the product development process rather than relying on inspection to detect problems after the fact. The role provides hands-on support for risk management, root cause analysis, verification and validation activities, configuration and change control, nonconformance management, and development process compliance.

This is an early-career engineering role with significant opportunity to develop expertise in aerospace product development, quality engineering, and product assurance.

What You'll Do

  • Support Quality Engineering activities across the XBAT product development lifecycle.
  • Partner with Design Engineering to identify product risks and establish appropriate controls.
  • Participate in design reviews, manufacturing readiness reviews, test reviews, and other development milestones from a quality perspective.
  • Support investigation and root cause analysis of prototype, test, and manufacturing failures.
  • Lead or support RCCA activities using structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • Support management of nonconforming material and prototype hardware, including containment, investigation, disposition, and documentation.
  • Evaluate engineering and manufacturing changes for quality risks and support implementation of appropriate verification activities.
  • Support development of inspection, test, and verification strategies based on product risk.
  • Support First Article Inspection and other product verification activities as XBAT transitions toward production.
  • Support audits and assessments of XBAT development processes against AS9100, customer, contractual, and program requirements.
  • Develop and maintain quality documentation, procedures, checklists, and objective evidence.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 0–3 years of engineering, quality, manufacturing, test, or related experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Internship, co-op, or project experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, electronics, or other complex product development.
  • Familiarity with AS9100 or other aerospace/quality management systems.
  • Experience with root cause analysis, 8D, RCCA, CAPA, DMAIC, or similar methodologies.
  • Familiarity with FMEA, risk management, or reliability engineering.
  • Experience participating in design reviews, test activities, or product development projects.
  • Understanding of configuration management and engineering change processes.
  • Familiarity with GD&T and engineering drawings.

descriptionHtml:
Key Responsibilities - Test Automation & Quality

  • Design, build, and maintain automated test coverage for ActiveScale object storage features across S3, data-path, durability, and data-movement functionality.
  • Develop component, integration, system, regression, and failure-injection tests that validate correctness and reliability at scale.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI pipelines and improve test reliability, execution time, diagnostics, and reporting.
  • Own the team's automated test strategy and work with developers to define coverage and acceptance criteria early in the development cycle.
  • Investigate failures, reproduce complex issues, and help isolate defects across distributed system components.

Object Storage & Resilience Testing

  • Validate S3 API behavior, compatibility, error handling, and data integrity using AWS S3 SDKs, tools, and automated test frameworks.
  • Develop automated coverage for failure scenarios such as node loss, disk faults, partial writes, network disruption, and recovery.
  • Test data placement, erasure coding, tiering, and movement of data across NVMe, HDD, and tape where applicable.
  • Contribute to performance, scalability, and long-running reliability testing of the I/O pipeline.

Engineering

  • Write clean, maintainable automation code and build reusable test infrastructure that supports functional, resilience, and failure testing.
  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, defect triage, and release readiness activities.
  • Partner closely with developers and the Software Engineering Manager / Product Owner to identify quality risks and ensure appropriate coverage.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software quality engineering, test automation, or software development experience, with strong programming or scripting skills in Python, Go, C/C++, or similar languages.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining automated tests for complex software systems.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools to create, extend, debug, or maintain test automation, with the ability to critically review generated code and test results.
  • Solid Linux fundamentals, including debugging, log analysis, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience testing APIs and distributed or networked systems.
  • Understanding of concurrency, failure handling, and data integrity concepts.
  • Experience with CI systems and source control.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work effectively with developers and remote colleagues.
  • This is a hybrid role, with in-office work at our Centennial, CO office Tuesday through Thursday.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with object storage and the Amazon S3 API, SDKs, and tools.
  • Experience testing storage systems or storage media such as HDD, SSD, NVMe, or tape.
  • Experience with failure injection, resiliency testing, performance testing, or large-scale system testing.
  • Knowledge of erasure coding principles.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

TechTrend is seeking a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, security, and compliance of enterprise software applications operating within a secure, cloud-hosted environment. The successful candidate will work as an integral member of Agile development teams, collaborating with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to validate system functionality and support continuous improvement.

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Support user acceptance testing (UAT) activities and validate results against acceptance criteria.
  • Verify compliance with security, performance, and operational requirements.
  • Contribute to quality metrics, test reports, and release readiness assessments.
  • Assist with test environment coordination and release validation activities.


REQUIRED SKILLS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field.
  • 5–10 years in software QA/testing, including web and cloud applications.
  • Strong knowledge of testing methodologies, test life cycle, and defect management.
  • Experience leading QA efforts, mentoring testers, and coordinating across teams.
  • Agile development experience and familiarity with issue tracking tools (e.g., Jira).
  • Experience with test automation frameworks and CI/CD integration.
  • Familiarity with secure cloud environments (Azure IL5/IL6 or FedRAMP).
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication.
  • Certifications: ISTQB Advanced Level (Test Analyst or Test Manager) and CSQA or CSTE.


PREFERRED SKILLS:

  • · Government or regulated system experience
  • · Agile/DevOps testing certifications (e.g., CAT, ICP-TST)
  • · Test automation tools (e.g., Selenium, CTAE)
  • · Process improvement certifications (e.g., Six Sigma Green Belt)
  • · Knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, security, and performance testing.


CLEARANCE:

  • Active Secret Clearance or TS


PLACE OF PERFORMANCE:

  • Hybrid at Ft Eustis, VA (3 days on-site / 2 days remote)


COMPETITIVE BENEFITS:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Life Insurance
  • Short, Long Term Disability Insurance
  • PTO & Federal Holidays Off
  • 401(k) Plan

descriptionHtml:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

We are seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Automation Engineer to join our QA Engineering team and maintain scalable automated test frameworks using industry best practices. A QA Automation Engineer applies engineering principles to the design, development, and execution of software tests, with the primary goal of automating testing to identify defects before software reaches end users and to ensure product quality and reliability. This role develops and executes test cases, creates test plans, documents and tracks defects with clear reproduction steps, collaborates with developers and cross-functional teams to verify fixes, and supports bug remediation, system maintenance-including releases, patches, and upgrades-and software deployment. Success in this position requires hands-on automation experience, strong attention to detail, effective communication skills, a commitment to continuous learning, and comfort working in a SAFe Agile environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive the software quality assurance lifecycle within an Agile process, actively participating in sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and other ceremonies.
  • Design, develop, maintain, and execute scalable automated test frameworks and scripts for new and existing features using Selenium, Appium, TypeScript, Gherkin/BDD, and the Page Object Model.
  • Apply appropriate software development and design methodologies, industry best practices, and reusable automation components to continuously improve test efficiency, coverage, performance, and framework stability.
  • Establish test strategies and create test plans, test cases, scripts, and supporting documentation based on product and design requirements.
  • Perform functional, regression, and integration testing; review software components for adherence to design requirements; analyze results; and document outcomes.
  • Identify, report, and track defects in systems such as Jira, provide clear reproduction steps, and collaborate with developers, product managers, and QA and cross-functional teams to define test requirements and verify fixes.
  • Troubleshoot automation issues and update scripts and frameworks as application functionality and technical requirements evolve.
  • Enhance and maintain automated CI/CD workflows by integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team.

Qualifications

4 years with BS/BA; 8 years with HS degree; 6 years with AS Degree.

Skills And Qualifications

  • Web and browser test automation: Playwright, Cypress, Selenium WebDriver, Selenium Grid, LambdaTest, and Sauce Labs.
  • Mobile test automation: Appium, Espresso for Android, XCTest for iOS, LambdaTest Real Device Mobile Cloud, Sauce Labs Government Cloud, and Kobiton.
  • Proficiency with TypeScript and behavior-driven development frameworks and specifications, including Cucumber and Gherkin.
  • Solid understanding of the Page Object Model design pattern and reusable test automation architecture.
  • Experience with Git or other version control systems; GitLab experience is a plus.
  • Experience with defect tracking tools such as Jira and API testing tools such as Postman.
  • Experience working in Agile and Scrum environments.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools and workflows, including Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps.

Requirements

  • 4+ years progressive experience in quality assurance job roles
  • BA/BS (4 year) degree in and IT or math related field/ or equivalent years of experience
  • Primary work locations in Tacoma, WA, Aurora, CO, San Antonio, TX, and Falls Church, VA. (Remote or hybrid work may be considered in special cases when approved by the customer.)
  • Must be a US Citizen
  • Public Trust Clearance/ or ability to obtain one

Experience working within Military Health environments is a plus

Details

Target Salary Range: $51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Our Challenge


We are seeking a Senior QA Automation Engineer with strong experience testing distributed software systems, APIs, data pipelines, and enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will design and maintain automated test frameworks, validate complex integrations and data workflows, and integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.


Key Responsibilities


  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks and test suites covering functional, integration, API, UI, regression, and performance testing.
  • Develop comprehensive test scenarios, edge cases, and validation strategies from business requirements and technical designs.
  • Test microservices, event-driven systems, REST APIs, WebSocket services, and messaging-based integrations.
  • Validate data movement, transformations, reconciliations, and end-to-end workflows across multiple systems.
  • Create SQL queries to validate relational databases, ETL processes, data integration workloads, data warehouses, and reporting solutions.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to improve release quality.
  • Perform performance, load, and reliability testing to identify bottlenecks and assess system behavior.
  • Investigate complex issues across applications, services, integrations, and data pipelines using logs and observability tools.
  • Manage test cases, report defects, and collaborate with stakeholders to drive timely resolution.
  • Build domain knowledge and communicate testing progress, risks, and findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 7 years of professional experience testing distributed software systems, APIs, data pipelines, and enterprise applications.
  • Strong experience designing, developing, and maintaining automated test frameworks and test suites.
  • Proficiency with automation tools such as Cucumber, Selenium, Playwright, Power Automate, Rest Assured, Postman, or equivalent technologies.
  • Strong programming skills in TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, and/or Python.
  • Experience testing microservices-based architectures, event-driven systems, and distributed applications.
  • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, WebSocket services, and messaging-based integrations.
  • Experience validating data transformations, reconciliations, and workflows across multiple systems.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience validating data in databases such as PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
  • Experience testing ETL/data integration workloads, data warehouses, and reporting solutions.
  • Experience with messaging and streaming platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, or similar technologies.
  • Exposure to HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, or Angular, along with UI test automation.
  • Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Proficiency in SDLC, Agile methodologies, and DevOps practices, including integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as PractiTest, Jira, Xray, or Zephyr.
  • Familiarity with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or k6.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or Splunk.
  • Excellent problem-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

descriptionHtml:
About Fora

Fora is the modern travel agency, empowering the next generation of entrepreneurs to build thriving travel advisory businesses. We're modernizing the $100B+ travel industry with AI woven through every part of the advisor's workflow, plus global supplier relationships, personalized training, and a vibrant community, all in one place. That's what lets advisors build businesses that scale, while their taste and service create trips no algorithm alone could plan. At the heart of it all is our mission: to help the next generation of travel entrepreneurs turn their love for travel into a fulfilling career, whether full-time or part-time.

We're mission-driven and obsessed with our customers, and we believe humans and AI are both essential: the best work here comes from people and technology at their best, together. That's not just a philosophy about our product, it's how we build our team. Everyone at Fora gets hands-on with frontier AI tooling as part of the job. At Fora, you'll learn to be AI-fluent, with real experience applying AI to solve problems day to day, wherever you sit in the company.

Founded in 2021, Fora has grown to a team of 250+ full-time employees based in downtown New York City. In 2026, we closed a $60 million Series D led by Forerunner and Tactile Ventures, with continued backing from Thrive Capital, Insight Partners, and Heartcore Capital. We've been named a LinkedIn Top Startup (2024), one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies (2023 and 2025), and one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies (2026).

Come build something that hasn't existed before.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer with 7+ years of experience across the full stack. Your strength is backend QA - integration testing, system-level validation, and data quality across connected services, but you also own frontend and end-to-end testing of the user experience.

This role suits someone who wants to understand how the whole system fits together and why the data looks the way it does. If you are the one who goes looking for the problems that don't show up on the happy path, this is the role for you. You'll work closely with developers, product managers, and designers to test how things behave from the UI through the APIs down to the data: exercising APIs, following data across services, digging into edge cases, and staying involved in quality from planning through release.

Our product changes constantly - new features ship often, and existing ones evolve based on user feedback. You'll make sure those changes hold up and ship at a high bar. Experience working with offshore teams is a plus.

Key Responsibilities

Investigation & Debugging:

  • Own root-cause analysis for complex, cross-layer issues - tracking through UI -> API -> database -> dependent services rather than stopping at the surface.
  • Investigate complex, hard-to-reproduce issues by piecing together information from logs, traces, and monitoring tools like Datadog and Sentry.
  • Distinguish frontend from backend causes through payload, status-code, and data-flow analysis, and always ask "what would I check next?"

API, Integration & Data Validation:

  • Create and execute integration test strategies for backend services and third-party APIs, validating how components interact across systems.
  • Use tools like Postman to explore, document, and validate APIs against functional, performance, and edge-case requirements.
  • Comfortable reading and querying the database (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) to verify the application behaves correctly — understanding how data is structured across tables and confirming it matches what the system should have done.
  • Get involved early in design discussions to ensure testability and reliability across the stack.

Collaboration & Communication:

  • Partner with engineering, product, and design teams to fully understand business logic, technical architecture, and domain-specific use cases.
  • Provide thoughtful, detailed bug reports with clear steps to reproduce and meaningful business context.
  • Participate in sprint ceremonies (planning, grooming, retrospectives) and serve as a quality advocate throughout the development cycle.
  • Ask questions, challenge assumptions, and promote a culture of continuous improvement in testing and delivery processes.

Quality Mindset & Domain Awareness:

  • Approach testing with high attention to detail, proactively identifying edge cases, data anomalies, and system-level inconsistencies before they reach production.
  • Demonstrate a creative and curious mindset - not just validating requirements, but actively looking for what might break or be missed.
  • Embrace AI as part of the job - open to integrating AI tools into day-to-day QA workflows to test faster, dig deeper, and work smarter.
  • Develop a strong understanding of the workflows across the pods you support to better anticipate risk areas and ensure domain-appropriate validation.
  • Own quality end to end, from requirements through post-release validation, and keep raising the bar on how thoroughly we test.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in backend quality assurance with strong focus on integration testing, system behavior, and data validation.
  • Proficiency in API testing tools such as Postman or REST clients; able to design and execute exploratory and regression test plans.
  • Strong SQL skills; experience querying relational databases and validating data across interconnected tables.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous systems and contract testing concepts.
  • Strong analytical thinking and debugging skills, especially in complex data-driven workflows.
  • Proven ability to root-cause ambiguous failures using logs and observability tools.
  • Openness to working with AI and integrating AI-assisted tools into everyday testing workflows.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
  • Experience working with remote or offshore teams is a plus.

Compensation

Compensation for this role varies based on experience, with an indicative range of $110K–$140K + equity. Final compensation will depend on the level at which the candidate is hired, as we are considering multiple levels for this role.

  • Unlimited vacation
  • Health Insurance (including an option completely covered by Fora HQ)
  • Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Wellhub Memberships
  • 401k plan with company match
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Supplemental Life Insurance
  • Stock Options

This role is based in New York City with a hybrid WFH & office schedule (Monday, Tuesday and Thursday are our FiDi in-office days, with flexibility for Wednesday and Friday at your preference).

Our Values

We’re forging our own path

Fora has always been about driving change within the industry. We’re not interested in maintaining the status quo.

We’re stronger together

Community is our cornerstone and collective power is our strength. We believe we can all go further when we operate together, using our combined leverage to unlock better opportunities and outcomes for our advisors, partners, and travelers.

We believe in technology

We believe technology is an answer to some of the most fundamental challenges the travel industry faces. We believe advancements in AI, bold investments in our platforms, and a world-class data infrastructure will transform the work of our advisors and our partners, while creating better travel experiences for travelers.

We’re here to serve

We operate in service of our community and believe that when they’re empowered to focus on what they do best, we all win. It’s why we relentlessly advocate for our advisors and prioritize their best interest every step of the way.

We mean business

Fora is equal parts fun, meaningful work and serious travel business. We’re unlocking opportunities for thousands of travel entrepreneurs, delivering a stream of high-quality guests at scale for our partners, and providing a superior travel experience for our travelers. It’s a better equation for the future of our industry.

WORK AUTHORIZATION

Authorization to work in the United States is required for full-time roles based in our New York City office. Fora is unable to sponsor or assist with U.S. work authorization. Roles based outside of the United States are not subject to this requirement.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Fora is committed to an equitable hiring process and an inclusive work environment. BIPOC and traditionally underrepresented candidates are strongly encouraged to apply. We will not discriminate and will take action to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, upgrading, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the bases of race, color, gender, national origin, age, religion, creed, disability, veteran's status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression or any other characteristic protected by law.

descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We’re hiring a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Core Video & Data team, where quality work supports the platform athletes and coaches rely on to train, compete and improve. You’ll work at the intersection of video, data and AI, and you’ll have a real voice in how we define “done.”

As a Senior QA Engineer, You’ll

  • Lead quality in your squad: As an integral part of a cross-functional team across Engineering, Product, Design, and Scrum, you will guide quality-focused conversations in sprint ceremonies. You will partner with stakeholders to explain how defects affect users and advocate for the right priority on backlog defects before they enter a sprint.
  • Shape our quality strategy: You will use your customer and system understanding to build a risk-based testing approach tailored to our video and data platform architecture. You will measure quality to help define when a project is truly complete and validate your improvements with real, data-backed results.
  • Test at scale and automate: Aligning our processes with development speed, you will make informed decisions on what, how, and when to automate versus when to rely on manual testing. You will lead large testing efforts, bringing your knowledge of our users into every test plan.
  • Own it from day one: Your squad will count on you to set the quality bar for the work you’re part of, not simply to maintain someone else’s checklist. You will drive measurable improvements in both product quality and delivery velocity.
  • Coach and elevate the team: You will use your technical and quality expertise to guide others and raise the team's overall bar. As the quality point person, you will influence and challenge teams to incorporate best practices in everything they do.

Location

While local candidates in Lincoln, Nebraska are prioritized, we’re open to remote applicants who reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, North Carolina, Nevada, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Wisconsin, Wyoming.

Must-Haves

  • Technical Expertise: You have at least four years of full-stack testing experience alongside an in-depth knowledge of automation tooling and frameworks.
  • A quality leader. You’ve led quality initiatives and projects, and you know what success looks like at the project level.
  • A skilled investigator. You dig into the root cause of problems, back your findings with data and measure the results.
  • Analytical Investigation: You are a skilled investigator who digs into the root causes of problems, backs findings with data, and measures the results.
  • Risk Awareness: You can design a testing approach that effectively reduces risk, and you possess the extreme attention to detail necessary to catch what others miss.
  • Quality Leadership: You understand quality in the big picture. You have successfully led quality initiatives and projects, and you know exactly what success looks like at the project level.
  • Customer Focus: You think critically about the user experience, ensuring our testing approach adapts seamlessly to match user workflows and exceed expectations.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Educational Background: A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Video Testing Expertise: Experience with video testing is a significant advantage. This includes a strong working knowledge of video encoding and decoding, ffmpeg usage, video diagnostics, and AWS storage and distribution.
  • Playwright Experience: Previous experience with Playwright is a major plus, as this is one of our core frameworks.
  • Sports knowledge. Passion for or experience in sports — whether as an athlete, coach, or fan — and an appreciation for the unique challenges of sports technology.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We're always investing in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.
  • Take care of your mental and physical health. Medical plans tailored for you and your family—including vision, dental, and fertility benefits—and stay supported with our EAP and Employee Resource Groups.
  • Contribute to your 401(K). Yep, that’s free money. We’ll match up to 4% of your own contribution.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

Base Salary Range

$82,000 - $137,000 USD

descriptionHtml:
Senior QA Engineer -AI & Engineering

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to business. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models-traditional teams, pools, or pods-are tailored to each client's needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Work You'll Do

As an SDET III, you will bring considerable technical expertise to deliver effective solutions to clients including the following:

  • Acting as the lead, interfacing between clients and our Deloitte teams.
  • Helping to create testing solutions to meet our clients' business needs.
  • Leading the testing of custom technology solutions.

Required Qualifications And Experience

  • 6+ years' relevant consulting or industry experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field.
  • 4+ years hands-on experience defining the testing strategy for large scale programs and ensuring requirements traceability throughout the system development lifecycle. Experience should include leading the testing efforts, including experience with all phases of testing: system integration, user acceptance, and performance testing.
  • Experience with at least two of the following: TCOE, TMO, mobile testing, automation testing, SAP/Oracle testing, data testing in a client-facing or industry role.
  • 4+ years' experience driving the quality assurance processes and gaining delivery and buy-in from executive leadership.
  • 2+ years' experience leading teams - onshore, offshore and nearshore.
  • Experience with Test and Defect Management tools - MicroFocus, ALM, JIRA.
  • 4+ years' experience working in a testing role in different environments including the following: client server, service-oriented architecture, web-based, mainframe-based and three-tier architectures.
  • Experience with the following: MicroFocus UFT, Rational Tooling, and Open Source Automation Tools such as Selenium, Cucumber, OpSoapUI, PostMan, RESTAssured, Mockito.
  • Experience in at least one Scripting language - Shell, VBScript, Perl or Python.
  • Experience with Source Control Systems - SVN or GIT.
  • Experience with Build tools - Maven, CircleCI.
  • Experience with Automated Reporting.
  • Experience with Cloud testing, API testing
  • Experience with CI/CD/CT tools - Jenkins, Bamboo, Quickbuild.
  • Experience applying prompt engineering techniques to generate, refine, or debug automated test scripts and test data.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred Qualifications And Experience

  • Experience working in Cloud, Web and Mobile Testing platforms - Saucelabs, Browerstack are preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning models.
  • Experience in Python NLTK or similar natural language processing technology.
  • Experience evaluating or testing AI/LLM-based application features (e.g., chatbots, copilots, RAG-based systems), including prompt-response validation and hallucination/edge-case testing.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted defect triage or root-cause analysis tools that reduce manual investigation time.
  • Exposure to self-healing test automation frameworks (AI-driven locator repair, visual AI testing).
  • Understanding of responsible AI/testing governance principles (bias detection, explainability, model validation) as applied to QE.
  • Experience contributing to or influencing AI-adoption roadmaps within a testing/QE organization.
  • Experience implementing testing best practices specific to the test planning and execution processes and gaining buy-in for changes from executives.
  • A deep understanding of testing planning and associated delivery challenges.
  • A strong understanding of the various approaches used in testing techniques - white-box, black-box, load testing, coverage testing and regression testing.

Sponsorship:

  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Wages + Salary

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400 to $207,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer – Mobile with 5–7 Years of experience to design, develop and maintain automation frameworks while ensuring high product quality.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain automation frameworks.
  • Develop automation using Playwright, Cucumber (BDD), JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Execute functional, regression, smoke and API tests.
  • Collaborate with Product, Development and DevOps teams.
  • Analyze failures, report defects and validate fixes.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and Agile delivery.
  • Build Appium Server-based automation for Android and iOS platforms.
  • Work with real devices and device cloud environments.
  • Lead automation strategy and framework enhancements.
  • Manage onshore and offshore teams, acting as the single point of contact (SPOC) to bridge communication and ensure seamless collaboration and delivery.
  • Mentor engineers, perform code reviews and drive estimations.

Required Technical Skills

  • Playwright, Cucumber (BDD), JavaScript, TypeScript, Appium Server, Android Automation, iOS Automation, API Testing, Git, CI/CD, Agile/Scrum

Good to Have

  • Exposure to BrowserStack and related device cloud platforms.

Benefits

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

  • Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

About The Role

As an AI-Augmented Quality Engineer, you will make an impact for our client by designing and executing automation and functional test strategies that improve the reliability of complex property and casualty insurance platforms. You will be a valued member of the Quality Engineering team and work collaboratively with developers, business analysts, product teams, and operations specialists.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design and execute test strategies that combine automation, functional validation, and AI-augmented techniques (such as intelligent test selection and data-driven prioritization) across critical policy, billing, claims, and rating journeys.
  • Build and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Java, JavaScript, Selenium, and TestNG to support regression, smoke, and integration testing.
  • Create and run API test scenarios that validate service behavior, data integrity, error handling, and performance across internal and external integrations.
  • Analyze insurance business rules and requirements to design test scenarios, and investigate defects with development and product teams to drive timely, high-quality fixes.
  • Manage test cases, defects, and traceability in Jira, and report key quality metrics such as defect trends, automation coverage, and test cycle efficiency to guide release readiness and risk decisions.

Work model: Hybrid

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position open to qualified applicants in Naperville, IL. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

Please note: A few of our roles may require in-person interviews at Cognizant offices or client locations, depending on project or client needs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

  • 7+ years of experience in quality engineering or software testing on enterprise-scale systems.
  • Hands-on expertise in API testing, including test design, parameterization, negative scenarios, and performance validation.
  • Advanced proficiency in Java, JavaScript, Selenium, and TestNG, with experience integrating automated suites into build and release pipelines.
  • Extensive use of Jira for requirements traceability, defect lifecycle management, and test execution reporting.
  • Deep property and casualty insurance domain knowledge, including policy administration, endorsements, renewals, claims, and rating.
  • ISTQB Certified Tester Advanced Level and an insurance domain certification such as AINS or equivalent.

These Will Help You Stand Out

  • Familiarity with AI-augmented testing, risk-based testing, and shift-left practices.
  • Experience contributing to large transformation or modernization programs.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to interpret complex insurance workflows and identify quality risks.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills to align stakeholders on quality expectations in a hybrid, distributed team.

Salary And Compensation

The annual salary for this position will be between $60,000 to $100,000 per year depending on the experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program and stock awards, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Applications will be received by November 26th, 2026.

Benefits: Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance.
  • Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off.
  • 401(k) plan and contributions.
  • Long-term/Short-term Disability.
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Job Description

Agilent is seeking an experienced and motivated Advanced Test Engineer to join the Software Quality Engineering organization within the Services Division of the Agilent CrossLab Group (ACG).

The Advanced Test Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for ensuring the delivery of high-quality software solutions across the Services software portfolio. This role partners closely with Product Management, Software Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, and Customer Support teams to define test strategies, implement automated quality solutions, and drive quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

The successful candidate will combine strong testing expertise, technical depth, business understanding, and Agile delivery experience to identify quality risks, improve engineering practices, and ensure reliable software releases. The role is expected to leverage modern test automation, AI-assisted testing techniques, and continuous quality engineering principles to improve product quality and delivery efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own quality planning, test strategy, and validation activities for one or more software products.
  • Participate as an active member of Agile product teams, collaborating with Product Owners, developers, architects, and DevOps engineers.
  • Define and execute risk-based testing strategies focused on business-critical functionality and quality risks.
  • Develop and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory, API, and automated testing.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions that support CI/CD pipelines.
  • Perform backend and data validation testing, including database verification and system integration validation.
  • Review requirements and designs to ensure testability, quality, and customer value.
  • Identify quality risks early and drive preventative quality engineering practices.
  • Perform root cause analysis and partner with engineering teams to improve product quality and reliability.
  • Contribute to test environment management, test data strategy, release readiness assessments, and defect governance.
  • Drive continuous improvement of testing approaches, frameworks, and engineering processes.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across quality initiatives.
  • Support compliance, cybersecurity, and regulatory validation activities where applicable.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical discipline.
  • 4+ years of software testing, quality engineering, or software development experience. 5 years of experience is helpful.
  • Experience working within Agile software development environments.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing comprehensive test strategies and test plans.
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies including functional, integration, system, regression, and exploratory testing.
  • Experience with test automation frameworks and automated testing practices.
  • Experience validating web applications, APIs, microservices, and enterprise software systems.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root cause investigation skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while influencing cross-functional teams and technical decisions.
  • Hands-on experience developing and maintaining automated testing solutions.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and troubleshooting automated tests within CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar platforms.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman, REST API testing, or similar automation technologies.
  • Experience testing cloud-native or SaaS applications.
  • Experience with AI-assisted testing tools, test generation, or intelligent quality engineering approaches.
  • Experience in laboratory informatics, compliance software, scientific software, or regulated environments.
  • Experience with performance, security, and reliability testing.
  • Experience mentoring other engineers or leading quality initiatives across multiple teams.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely. Applications for this job will be accepted until at least November 24, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted.

The full-time equivalent pay range for this position is $119,200.00 - $223,500.00/yr plus eligibility for bonus, stock and benefits. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. How about Kansas City? That’s our home. That’s where Garmin put a stake in the ground in 1989. That’s because we believe it’s possible to light the tech world on fire and still be on a first name basis.

BIG IDEAS, SMALL EGOS

What we do best is make products that let our customers do what they love. To do that, we focus on practical innovation, never losing sight of the benefits our products bring to our customers. Sure, we love bells and whistles. What leading technology company doesn't? But we make sure ours have purpose. It’s not about the things we make. It’s about the things we make possible.

WE’RE GLOBAL, SERIOUSLY.

Yeah, we’re based in Kansas City, but we are truly a global company. With offices throughout Europe, Asia, Middle East, South America and Australia, our products are sold all over the world. At Garmin, we like to encourage dreamers. But at some point it’s nice to wake up and enjoy a fully aware life. We value diversity of backgrounds, experience, and perspectives and strive to foster an inclusive environment that enables all our team members to bring their best selves to work. We are one team committed to building a culture where every teammate has the opportunity to contribute and be recognized. Learn more about our unique culture and history .

Job Opportunity

Berkshire Hathaway Specialty Insurance (BHSI) has an exciting opportunity for a Technology Quality Engineer to join our Boston-based Information Technology Team. BHSI provides commercial property, casualty, healthcare professional liability, surety, executive, and professional lines insurance to global customers. We are creating and supporting multiple complex applications within BHSI and are seeking candidates with Enterprise Application technology experience. An ideal candidate will have hands-on experience testing preferably in commercial P&C insurance. Candidates should be very interested in solving hard problems and providing testing solutions, enjoy a multicultural environment, and bring creative energy to their work.

The Quality Engineering role is accountable for engaging business users and Technology team members throughout the lifecycle of projects and supporting releases to production. In this role, you will actively engage and work with onsite and offshore consulting partners in executing our automation engineering activities.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Play a hands-on role in testing of all primary Policy and supplementary applications, including critical third-party integrations such as Hyland OnBase Workflow.
  • Design, write, and maintain automated test scripts.
  • Run automated test cases and analyze the results to ensure the application meets the requirements.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with offshore and onsite teammates to develop and execute effective long-term automation test plans and regression suites.
  • Participate in the overall test planning & execution of Policy team testing objectives (test planning, design, execution, defect management, and reporting).
  • Collaborate with onsite engineers and offshore testing partners to develop and execute test scenarios to determine data quality and integrity.
  • Engage directly with business users during User Acceptance Testing to facilitate validation and troubleshoot user feedback.
  • Collaborate with peers and management to develop process standards and/or enhancements to prevent the recurrence of defects/bugs.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to ensure quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Participate in troubleshooting sessions with development teams for timely turnaround of critical issues.
  • Understanding quality metrics and implementing measurements to determine test effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Adhering to best practices in analysis & documentation.

Qualifications, Skills And Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of Technology Quality Engineering experience or experience in a similar field.
  • Experience in Test Automation tools and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong knowledge of at least one programming language.
  • Knowledge of best practices in test automation framework.
  • Experience in QE roles supporting complex systems development or packaged software implementation efforts.
  • Hands-on style with strong problem-solving abilities and a keen attention to detail. Strong conceptual thinking skills, creativity, and flexibility.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to interact professionally with diverse executives, subject matter experts, and vendor resources.
  • A strong understanding of the E2E software development process and system development lifecycle, including E2E testing.
  • Highly organized and able to prioritize and track multiple deliverables.
  • Experience working in Agile or waterfall projects.
  • Team collaboration: within QE, the broader Technology team, and internal business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge in creating and maintaining an automated test suite, including UI and API, is a plus.
  • Working experience of Automation Tools, such as Katalon, Cypress, Selenium, NeoLoad, etc
  • Some business background in Commercial P&C Insurance Underwriting or Claims functions is an advantage.
  • Prior experience with the Duck Creek Platform or equivalent P&C system is an advantage.
  • ISO expertise is a plus.
  • Knowledge of defect management tools such as Jira, DevOps, Quality Center, or any other defect tool.

BHSI Offers

  • A competitive package and exciting growth opportunities for career-oriented teammates.
  • A dynamic, action oriented, and thoughtful environment centered on always doing the right thing for our customers, teammates, and our other stakeholders.
  • A purposely non-bureaucratic organization that embraces simplicity over complexity and emphasizes individual excellence in a team framework.
  • Benefits that support your life and well-being, which include:
  • Comprehensive Health, Dental and Vision benefits
  • Disability Insurance (both short-term and long-term)
  • Life Insurance (for you and your family)
  • Accidental Death & Dismemberment Insurance (for you and your family)
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Health Reimbursement Account
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Retirement Savings 401(k) Plan with Company Match
  • Generous holiday and Paid Time Off
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Paid Parental Leave

The base salary range for this position in Boston is $90,000 to $115,000, along with annual bonus eligibility. Total compensation for a candidate is determined by their relevant skills, location, and experience. We value our teammates – both their capabilities and character – as demonstrated by our amazing culture.

NOTE: Compensation will be commensurate with experience. This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Team Member may perform other related duties as negotiated to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

Requisition ID: 67747 Title:Engineer II - QA - SC

Arthrex, Inc. is a global medical device company and a leader in new product development and medical education in orthopedics. We are currently seeking an Engineer II for Quality Assurance on our Pendleton, SC manufacturing campus. Join our talented team at a global medical device company focused on Helping Surgeons Treat Their Patients Better™.

Main Objective

Responsible for supporting the Quality Manager with all quality related support for the life cycle development of Class I, II and III medical devices, including new product development and maintenance of released products.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Review design drawings for tolerance, inspect-ability and quality of design issues.
  • Work with suppliers to improve quality, and assist, where necessary, in supplier process validations.
  • Assist in the training of QC Inspectors on inspection techniques and the use of new equipment.
  • Participate in Internal and External quality audits as directed by the Quality Assurance Manager.
  • Support Risk Management by leading or participating in cross-functional team pFMEA’s and Risk Assessments.
  • Support the AMI Engineering Change Management process by performing tasks as assigned.
  • Lead or Support the internal manufacturing First Article Inspection process, review First Article Inspection Reports and samples (internal and/or supplier).
  • Lead or Support equipment or process validation (IQ, OQ, PQ)
  • Lead or support Metrology with design and development of inspection methods and gages.
  • Create or review inspection method work instructions.
  • Lead or support Metrology with Measurement System Analysis (Gage R&R) studies.
  • Create Inspection Plans Supporting Receiving and In-Process Inspection.
  • Investigate complaints as requested by the Complaints/Reliability team.
  • Lead completion of Nonconformances (NCR’s) as assigned: material disposition plans, evaluations, and action plans.
  • Perform routine Nonconformance and process trending and lead periodic Quality review meetings with the management team.
  • Lead or Support Continuous Improvement projects.
  • Lead or support the Environmental Monitoring program.
  • Complete Root Cause Analysis Investigations and define Corrective/Preventive Action Plans (CAPA’s).
  • Perform Engineering Studies and Design of Experiments (DOE) as needed.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Education And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering required.
  • 2 years experience in a Quality Control or Quality Assurance position required, medical device company preferred.

Knowledge And Skill Requirements/Specialized Courses And/or Training

  • Technical knowledge in development methodologies including: Design Controls, GD&T, DOE, Process Verification and Validation.
  • SPC (Statistical Process Control) knowledge.
  • Working knowledge of process improvement tools (i.e.: Lean - PDCA, Six Sigma - DMAIC) and problem solving (i.e.: Kepner Tregoe, Lean A3, 5 Whys) preferred.
  • Working knowledge of risk assessments, PFMEAs, control plans, quality plans.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical staff.
  • Project management skills preferred.

Machine, Tools, And/or Equipment Skills

  • Proficiency in the use of PC and programs, particularly Excel, Word (or equivalents if changed by the Company), miniTab or similar statistical analysis software, SAP or similar inventory software, Agile or similar design lifecycle software, Pilgrim or similar QMS software.
  • Knowledge of measurement and other inspection equipment.
  • Manufacturing process knowledge

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Company-Provided Life Insurance
