Burford Capital is the leading global finance and asset management firm focused on law. Its businesses include litigation finance and risk management, asset recovery and a wide range of legal finance and advisory activities. Burford is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: BUR) and the London Stock Exchange (LSE: BUR), and it works with companies and law firms around the world from its principal offices in New York, London, Chicago, Washington, Singapore, and Dubai.

Burford Capital is the largest and most experienced provider of commercial finance to the legal sector in the world, with a core expertise in identifying and optimizing the value of legal assets for companies and law firms. Since its founding in 2009, Burford has worked with hundreds of law firms and corporations, including 94 of the AmLaw 100 and 92 of the Global 100 largest law firms. Our team has grown from five people at the end of 2009 to over 160 people today, including over 55 lawyers. Burford possesses the resources and expertise of a large company while retaining the flexibility and creativity of a startup. Team members are smart, creative, collaborative, curious, and confident. Everyone rolls up their sleeves to perform and engage collectively for the overall success of the business. Burford values rigorous thinking, clear communication, and efficient execution.

Burford pays base salaries consistent with the financial services industry and favors incentive compensation to reward performance. Burford provides competitive health care benefits and a 401k matching program. Burford Capital is committed to increasing diversity and maintaining an inclusive workplace culture. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of their ethnicity, race, gender, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, age, marital status, whether or not they have a disability.

The firm seeks to hire a detail-oriented and technically capable QA Engineer to support the quality of complex, data-driven financial applications through a combination of manual testing, test planning, and automation engineering. The ideal candidate will have approximately five years of experience in software quality assurance, including hands-on experience designing test cases, performing exploratory and regression testing, and building maintainable automated test suites.

The role will also use modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate test creation, identify edge cases, support automation development, and improve failure analysis, while applying appropriate engineering judgment and validation. The successful candidate will work closely with developers, quantitative professionals, and business users to ensure that software and data solutions are reliable, accurate, performant, and production-ready.

The QA Engineer will work as part of Burford’s Core Services group and contribute to a variety of software and data projects across the firm’s evolving tools and platforms. The individual will help define acceptance criteria and testing strategies, execute manual and automated tests, develop reusable testing tools, and integrate quality checks into the software development and delivery process. The role will collaborate with developers, business analysts, business stakeholders, and vendors to deliver solutions aligned with company goals and priorities. The ideal candidate will be an energetic, collaborative, and proactive individual who is comfortable working across multiple projects, sharing expertise with others, investigating issues in depth, and taking ownership of results.

The base compensation range for this role is $100,000 - $120,000. Burford also pays a discretionary annual bonus and provides welcome Restricted Stock Units to all full-time employees.

The role will report to the Software Engineering Group Lead and will be based in Burford’s New York office.

Position Requirements

Burford is seeking a hands-on QA Engineer with at least five years of experience to help improve the quality, reliability and release confidence of its data-driven financial applications. This is a blended quality engineering role for someone who can translate requirements into thoughtful test cases, perform manual and exploratory testing, and build maintainable automated test coverage across web applications, APIs, data flows and integrations.

The QA Engineer will work as part of the Core Services group and collaborate with software engineers, data professionals, business analysts, product stakeholders and vendors. The successful candidate will use modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate test design, automation and failure analysis while applying sound engineering judgment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Test planning and design: Review business requirements, user stories and technical designs; define acceptance criteria, test plans, test cases and risk-based coverage for new features, fixes and releases.
  • Manual and exploratory testing: Execute functional, regression, integration, usability and exploratory testing across browser-based applications and complex business workflows.
  • Automation development: Build and maintain reliable automated UI, API and integration tests using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, PyTest or equivalent frameworks.
  • AI-assisted quality engineering: Use approved generative AI and coding assistants to draft test scenarios, generate automation scaffolding, improve coverage, analyze failures and maintain test assets. Review generated output for correctness, security, maintainability and business relevance.
  • API and data validation: Test RESTful services, data pipelines and database integrations; use SQL to validate data accuracy, completeness and consistency across PostgreSQL, Snowflake, SQL Server or similar platforms.
  • CI/CD integration: Incorporate automated tests into Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or comparable pipelines and help define appropriate quality gates for pull requests, deployments and scheduled regression runs.
  • Defect management: Record clear, reproducible defects; partner with engineers to isolate root causes; verify fixes and identify opportunities to prevent recurrence through automation or process improvement.
  • Test environments and data: Help create repeatable test data, fixtures, mocks and environment setup that support parallel development and dependable automated execution.
  • Quality reporting: Communicate test results, release risks, escaped defects, automation health and coverage gaps in a concise and actionable manner.
  • Shift-left collaboration: Participate early in the software development lifecycle, challenge unclear requirements and help teams design applications that are observable, testable and resilient.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Approximately five years of professional experience in software quality assurance, quality engineering or software testing, including meaningful hands-on test automation experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to create test strategies and detailed test cases, perform manual and exploratory testing, and make sound risk-based decisions about what should be automated.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, preferably Python or TypeScript/JavaScript, with an ability to write readable, maintainable test code.
  • Hands-on experience with modern browser automation and API testing tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, PyTest, Postman, REST Assured or equivalent technologies.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and experience validating application data in relational or cloud data platforms.
  • Experience integrating automated tests with CI/CD pipelines and working with Git-based development workflows.
  • Understanding of smoke, functional, regression, integration, end-to-end and performance testing approaches, including the strengths and limitations of each layer.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development or testing tools to improve productivity, together with the judgment to validate generated tests and avoid exposing confidential or regulated information.
  • Strong analytical, debugging and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and nontechnical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing financial, legal, quantitative or other data-intensive enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with Azure, Docker, cloud-hosted applications and test execution in containerized environments.
  • Exposure to accessibility, performance, security or model-output validation testing.
  • Experience improving flaky test suites, test data management or cross-application end-to-end coverage.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers’ most pressing national security requirements.

About The Job

We are seeking a Software QA Engineer to join our rapidly growing team in Reston, Virginia. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and executing test plans, identifying software defects, and ensuring the overall quality of our products

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and execute manual and automated test plans, test cases, and test scripts for software & firmware products
  • Perform thorough functional, regression, and user acceptance testing with hardware-in-the-loop
  • Identify, document, and track software/firmware defects
  • Collaborate with developers to debug issues and verify fixes
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of testing methodologies
  • Create comprehensive validation plans to include clear pass/fail criteria and adherence to relevant industry standards, ensuring precise traceability from design requirements to specific test procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in software quality assurance
  • Testing in Linux and Windows environments
  • Strong understanding of core networking principles and basic IP networking protocols
  • Proficiency in using network analysis tools, such as Wireshark.
  • Attention to detail and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience with Git and common platforms like Gitlab, Github or Bitbucket
  • Experience with bug tracking systems (e.g., JIRA, Bugzilla)
  • Strong debugging, analytical and creative problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
  • Aptitude for learning
  • Good documentation skills
  • Ability to adapt & contribute to changing priorities
  • Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active secret security clearance (at a minimum)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Basic proficiency in Python or other coding languages
  • Familiarity of automated testing frameworks such as Pytest
  • Automated UI testing tools like Playwright or Selenium is a plus
  • Experience validating designs intended for harsh or deployed environments (ruggedized, airborne, or space).

US Salary Range

$166,000—$220,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

  • Lead or support Metrology with design and development of inspection methods and gages.

Knowledge of measurement and other inspection equipment.

Manufacturing process knowledge

Reasoning Ability

Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

Ability to comprehend and apply mathematical principles to the degree required to perform the job based upon job requirements. Prefer working knowledge and application of Statistics.

Language And Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and apply language skills to the degree required to perform the job based upon the job requirements listed above. Visual acuity necessary to do the job safely and effectively.

descriptionHtml:
ON.energy is setting the standard for large load interconnection. ON’s patented AI UPS™ is a medium-voltage UPS that serves as a firewall, protecting the data center from the grid, and the grid from the data center. With multiple gigawatts currently under construction, we are enabling grid-safe data centers. 

ROLE SUMMARY

We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer to validate our AWS cloud infrastructure, data platforms and operational tooling. You'll make sure that access controls, deployments, pipelines, security fixes and data products work correctly, securely and reliably before they reach production. You'll work closely with the DevOps, Cyber Security, Data Engineering and Data Science teams in a multi-account AWS environment.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Validate AWS access management (IAM, SSO, cross-account access, SCP guardrails).
  • Test deployments, configuration changes and environment consistency.
  • Validate network and firewall changes (Transit Gateway, VPN, Route 53, WAF).
  • Verify remediation of security findings and retest to confirm closure.
  • Validate CI/CD pipeline adoption, quality gates and rollback.
  • Test alerts, alarms and Grafana dashboards for accuracy and correct routing.
  • Perform database checks and performance testing.
  • Test data lake and ETL pipelines, including the Data Catalog and Data Quality Dashboard.
  • Validate legacy asset management data and track related bugs to resolution.
  • Support AWS service upgrades and migration testing as needed.
  • Maintain test plans, test cases, reports and runbooks.

 

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years of experience in QA or test engineering, ideally for cloud infrastructure and data platforms.
  • 3+ years of experience in writing Python scripts
  • Cloud management: Hands-on experience with AWS Organizations in a multi-account setup, including IAM and Service Control Policies (SCPs).
  • Compute: Experience testing workloads on AWS Lambda, ECS on EC2 and ECS on Fargate.
  • Networking: Working knowledge of AWS Transit Gateway, Site-to-Site VPN, Client VPN, Route 53, AWS WAF, Route 53 DNS Firewall and AWS Network Firewall.
  • Security: Familiarity with GuardDuty, Security Hub, Inspector, Detective, AWS Config and CloudTrail, and how findings are remediated.
  • Databases: Strong SQL skills with RDS PostgreSQL and Aurora PostgreSQL.
  • CI/CD and tooling: Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) Pipelines, Repos and Boards, or similar tools such as Bitbucket and Jira.
  • Observability: Experience with monitoring tools and CloudWatch.
  • FinOps: Understanding of tagging strategies and tag enforcement through SCPs.
  • Scripting skills in Python, Bash or PowerShell for test automation, with experience using the AWS CLI or SDK (boto3).
  • Strong documentation and communication skills.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation or CDK).
  • Experience with data testing frameworks
  • Experience with performance testing tools (JMeter, k6, Locust).
  • Experience validating legacy-to-cloud migrations.
  • AWS certification (Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator or Security Specialty).

Note: This position may include 20% annual business travel

 

For US-based roles - What you’ll get:

  • Competitive salary + annual performance-based bonus eligibility
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and company holidays 

For Mexico-based roles - What you’ll get:

  • Competitive salary + annual performance bonus eligibility
  • Christmas Bonus (Aguinaldo): 30 days
  • Major medical expenses and life insurance
  • Paid time off and holidays (per local policy)

For all roles:

  • Professional development and growth opportunities
  • Opportunity to grow with a mission-driven team shaping the future of clean energy
  • Equal Opportunity: ON.energy is committed to equal employment opportunity and to maintaining a work environment free of harassment, discrimination, or retaliation.
  • Benefits vary by role and location and are subject to change.

Agency Notice: ON.energy does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or third-party recruiters. Resumes submitted without a fully executed Master Services Agreement (MSA) and a written request from an authorized member of our Talent Acquisition team will be considered the property of ON.energy. No placement fees or compensation will be paid for unsolicited candidate submissions.

About The Position

Job description:

Position: Quality Assurance Engineer

Full Time

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:

Under the supervision of the Director of Operations, as a Quality Assurance Engineer you will be on the front line in Ranger's efforts to continue to deliver world class products to our customers. Located in our Webster, NY manufacturing facility, you will be responsible for the following:

Product Quality Planning:

  • Collaborate with the product development & OEM team to understand the product's design, specifications, and intended use.
  • Participate in the early stages of product development to provide input on design for manufacturability and quality considerations.

Quality Standards and Procedures:

  • Continuously maintains clear quality standards, acceptance criteria, and inspection procedures based on industry regulations, customer specifications, and internal quality guidelines.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate and comprehensive quality records, including inspection reports, non-conformances, and corrective actions.
  • Generate regular reports on quality performance, highlighting trends, and recommending measures to address any recurring issues.
  • Review and Maintain Supplier Production Part Approvals
  • Complete Customer Production Part Approvals

Testing and Validation:

  • Develop and execute test plans and procedures to verify manufacturing capability, product performance, reliability and durability is done by Engineering
  • Use various testing methods and equipment to validate purchased product functionality and adherence to specifications.

Process Improvement:

  • Continuously evaluate manufacturing processes and inspection report to identify areas for improvement and efficiency gains, including 8D analysis.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement corrective / preventive actions, including 6 Sigma workshops aiming to enhance product quality and streamline production workflows.

Compliance and Standards:

  • Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety guidelines, and quality management system standards.
  • Stay up-to-date with relevant quality assurance practices, industry advancements, and best practices.

Non-Conformance Management:

  • When defects or non-conforming products are identified either internally or from customers, work with the manufacturing team to isolate the affected products, determine the root cause of the issues, and implement corrective and preventive actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Process customer material returns, working with the manufacturing team to identify material that is conforming and eligible for reuse.

Training and Education:

  • Provide training and support to manufacturing and operations teams on quality assurance principles, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Foster a culture of quality and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a Quality Assurance Engineer or similar role in a manufacturing environment.
  • In-depth knowledge of quality assurance methodologies, tools, and best practices.
  • Familiarity with quality management systems and regulatory requirements.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, managing multiple priorities effectively.
  • Demonstrate effective collaboration with various departments, promoting a culture of quality and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and quality control methods.

If you have the above-mentioned qualifications and are interested in this position, please send your resume (mentioning the job title) to [email protected].

All requests will be treated confidentially.

Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

Schedule:

  • 8 hour shift
  • Monday to Friday

Work Location: In person - Webster, NY

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field required or equivalent years of experience.
  • 3-6 years experience in software testing or test automation.
  • Hands-on experience building and running automated UI and API tests using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Postman.
  • Working knowledge of at least one modern programming language (JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or Java).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) for automation execution and reporting.
  • Good understanding of QA fundamentals, including functional, regression, and integration testing.
  • Exposure to BDD frameworks such as Cucumber, SpecFlow, or Gauge is a plus.
  • Understanding of RESTful APIs, JSON structures, and basic API validation principles.
  • Experience using Git for version control and collaboration.
  • Ability to debug issues across environments and communicate findings clearly.
  • Strong attention to detail, ownership, and curiosity to learn new automation techniques.
  • Familiarity with microservices testing, mock servers, or contract testing.
  • Awareness of performance testing tools (k6, JMeter) or accessibility testing (axe-core, Lighthouse).
  • Interest in AI-assisted testing or intelligent test optimization tools.

  • Generous store discounts

  • 401(k), HSA, FSA, Pre-tax commuter benefits
  • Disability & life insurance coverage
  • Paid parental leave
  • Pet insurance

  • Discounted home and auto insurance
  • College tuition assistance
  • Career development & product training

Job Description

Under the direction of the Quality Assurance Manager, ensures compliance with company Quality Management Systems and customer requirements in accordance with ISO 13485, and provide quality engineering support to manufacturing.

What You Get To Do

  • Assisting with process validations (IQ, OQ, & PQ) and product validations as per customer requirements
  • Support manufacturing units with analyzing failures, preventive and corrective action processes related to both internal and external issues
  • Facilitate Failure Mode and Effect Analysis (FMEA)
  • Perform Design of Experiments (DOE)
  • Track, trend and report quality metrics
  • Responsible for continual improvement activities to enhance the quality system, such as 5S, Kaizen lean methods, etc.
  • Provide support for the implementation and sustaining of statistical process controls (SPC)
  • Provide support to engineering change order process
  • Assist Quality manager in establishing, implementing and maintaining the quality management system.
  • Conduct audits, including closing out audit findings, creating audits finding reports and determine proper corrective and preventive actions
  • Ability to effectively develop and perform: Validations, FMEA, Root Cause Analysis, Gauge R&R, and DOE

What We Value

  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Process Engineering, Operations and Product Development departments
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • Must be results oriented, multi-tasking, and be able to respond to urgent needs and meeting deadlines
  • Must have excellent organizational skills and the ability to work well both independently and as a member of a team
  • Strong statistical background and working knowledge of SPC software (Minitab preferred)
  • PC Oriented (MS Office)
  • Must have working knowledge of ISO-13485 or ISO 9001 QMSR and FDA Medical Devices Regulations

What We Want From You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Science
  • Two or more years of Quality Engineering Experience (medical or food flexible packaging preferred)
  • Six Sigma Green or Black Belt certification (preferred) or willingness to pursue

Our Expectations

We Expect Our People To Be Guided By The Amcor Way And Demonstrate Our Values Every Day To Enable The Business To Win. We Are Winning When

  • Our people are engaged and developing as part of a high-performing Amcor team
  • Our customers grow and prosper from Amcor’s quality, service, and innovation
  • Our investors benefit from Amcor’s consistent growth and superior returns
  • The environment is better off because of Amcor’s leadership and products

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please call 224-313-7000 and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

E-Verify

We verify the identity and employment authorization of individuals hired for employment in the United States.

Benefits

When you join Amcor, you will have access to a comprehensive benefits and compensation package that includes:

  • Medical, dental and vision plans
  • Flexible time off, starting at 80 hours paid time per year for full-time salaried employees
  • Company-paid holidays starting at 8 days per year and may vary by location
  • Wellbeing program & Employee Assistance Program

Description

Job Title: Quality Engineer

Job Summary

The Quality Engineer is responsible for managing the process of maintaining all documents within the Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure that documents are accurate, up-to-date, and compliant with company requirements and regulations. Additionally, this position is responsible for ensuring that products and services meet the required standards and specifications. This position will work closely with development teams to improve product quality and prevent defects with the goal of maintaining high-quality standards throughout the production process.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Organize, track, and maintain all documents related to projects, products, or operations.
  • Supervise, train and mentor junior QA’s and staff.
  • Implement and enforce document control processes, procedures, and standards.
  • Ensure that all project documents are reviewed, approved, and stored in a centralized document management system.
  • Manage the document's lifecycle, including creation, revision, distribution, and archiving.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory and industry standards (e.g., ISO 9001, FDA regulations).
  • Coordinate with project managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to ensure timely submission of documents.
  • Conduct regular audits of documents to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with internal and external standards.
  • Support audits and inspections by providing relevant documentation and reports.
  • Train and assist employees in proper document management procedures.
  • Maintain and update document control databases and systems.
  • Develop and implement quality assurance strategies, policies, and procedures.
  • Design, execute, and maintain test plans and cases based on product requirements.
  • Perform manual and automated testing of software applications and systems.
  • Identify, report, and track software defects, and work with the development team to resolve them.
  • Perform root cause analysis of issues and provide feedback for process improvements.
  • Review product documentation to ensure completeness, accuracy, and clarity.
  • Collaborate with product managers and developers to ensure quality during the development process.
  • Conduct regression testing to ensure that previously developed and tested software still works after changes.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory and industry standards (such as ISO, FDA, or CMMI).
  • All other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education Requirements/Work Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field from an accredited college or university or equivalent experience of 2 to 4 years in the field of Quality.
  • Manufacturing industry experience preferred.

Computer Skills

  • To perform this job successfully, an individual should be proficient with Microsoft Office -- MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and experience with Quality Management System administration.

Core Values

Our core values define how we work and what we expect from every associate. The ideal candidate will consistently demonstrate these values in performing the responsibilities of this role. Each core value represents essential behaviors and competencies aligned with the duties and qualifications of the position.

  • Accountability – We take full responsibility for our actions and outcomes, ensuring transparency and trust with our stakeholders, customers, associates, and the environment. Competencies: Problem Solving, Decision Making, Planning & Organizing, Resilience, Time Management/Prioritization and Learning Agility
  • Innovation – We champion creativity and collaboration, continually striving to deliver groundbreaking solutions that transform our industry and exceed expectations. Competencies: Creativity & Curiosity, Continuous Improvement, Vision & Strategic Thinking, and Collaboration & Teamwork
  • Integrity – We uphold the highest ethical standards of honesty, transparency, and ethical behavior in every decision and action, fostering trust at all levels in our organization. Competencies: Honesty, Consistency & Dependability and Commitment to Excellence
  • Adaptability – We embrace change agility and resilience, staying flexible and proactive in a constantly evolving world. Competencies: Communication, Results Oriented and Flexibility
  • Caring – We prioritize the well-being of our people, communities, and business partners, recognizing that their success and happiness are vital to our own. Competencies: Organizational Savvy, Risk Management, Compliance, Diversity, and Empathy
  • Passion – We are driven by a relentless pursuit of excellence, demonstrating determination to succeed while maintaining humility and respect for others. Competencies: Commitment, Persistence & Tenacity, Humility and Respect

Physical Demands

Associate Must Be Able To Do The Following

  • verbally communicate, listen to others, and take directions
  • frequently sit, stand, or walk
  • frequently crouch/stoop, bend or twist
  • frequently reach with hands and arms (both above and below shoulder level)
  • use hands, fingers, and wrists with dexterity
  • must be able to work in/with/ near machinery
  • must be able to work with hand tools

Max lift for one person shall be 40 lbs. (non-repetitive)

  • Less than 40 lbs. require 2 person lift up to 70 lbs.
  • Greater than 70 lbs. require mechanical assistance

Push/pull up to 50 lbs.

Specific vision abilities: must be able to read production tags, labels, inspect parts and identify defects if present.

Ability to wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) including hearing protection, safety glasses and steel/composite toe shoes, gloves, etc... Hearing protection and PPE are based on job assignment/tasks/work area.

Apply critical thinking to perform complex tasks.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment

Moderate exposure to heat, cold, and noise.

Heat/Cold exposure is subject to change depending on external weather temperatures and work location.

At times, some work areas might have wet or damp conditions.

Work in close proximity with other production associates, materials, and machinery.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Disclaimer

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by those assigned to a particular position. This document in no way states or implies that this is an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required, and personnel may be required to perform duties outside their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. The Company reserves the right to change, modify, amend, add to or delete from, any section of this document as it deems, in its judgment, to be proper.

Description

RAM Aerospace is a leader in aerospace innovation, powering flight and space exploration with precision solenoids, valves, and actuators. Since 1975, we’ve supported missions like the Space Shuttle and continue to deliver mission-critical components for commercial, defense, and satellite systems. As one of Southern Utah’s largest employers, we drive economic growth and offer high-skilled careers in engineering and manufacturing. From our advanced facility in St. George, we build the future of aerospace—on time, with excellence, and as a team. Join us to work on groundbreaking technology and help shape the future of flight and space exploration. Your career takes off here!

As our Quality Engineer I, you are the architect of operational excellence. You don't just find errors; you engineer the systems and processes that prevent them from ever occurring. Reporting to the Quality Manager, you will lead high-level root cause investigations, drive continuous improvement using Lean and Six Sigma tools, and serve as the technical authority on our quality standards for both customers and suppliers. From facilitating APQP activities during new product development to analyzing complex statistical data to predict reliability, your work ensures that every flight-critical component we ship is "right the first time." If you are a data-driven engineer who thrives at the intersection of technical precision and process optimization, we want you on our team.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Root Cause & CAPA Leadership: Initiate and follow up on Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) and Non-Conformance (NC) reports. You will lead cross-functional teams through rigorous problem-solving exercises (5-Whys, Fishbone, 8D) to resolve system malfunctions and prevent recurrence.
  • APQP & Preventative Quality: Support and facilitate APQP and PPAP activities to improve new product development. You will attend design reviews as the quality representative, ensuring that all 100% of design characteristics are accounted for in internal Quality Plans.
  • Statistical Analysis & SPC: Develop and analyze statistical data to establish process standards and reliability expectancies. You will utilize Lean and Six Sigma tools to reduce in-line defects, minimize scrap, and optimize manufacturing yield.
  • Audit & Compliance Management: Perform production and quality systems audits to maintain AS9100 compliance. You will prepare for and host customer and third-party auditors, ensuring all technical documentation and quality specifications are accurate and up to date.
  • Supplier & Customer Interface: Act as the technical liaison for quality concerns and initiatives. You will work directly with suppliers to improve supply chain quality and establish strong rapport with customers by driving technical solutions that meet their specific mission needs.
  • Design for Quality: Research and analyze design proposals and blueprints to evaluate feasibility and maintenance requirements. You will provide critical feedback to design engineers on customer needs and potential manufacturing difficulties to ensure a seamless transition to the shop floor.

Requirements

  • Legal: Must be able to pass a comprehensive criminal background check and drug screening.
  • ITAR: Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum (due to ITAR requirements).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree (BS) in an engineering-related discipline is required.
  • Experience: General knowledge of manufacturing processes and familiarity with Quality Assurance principles (inspection techniques, testing procedures, and statistical analysis).
  • Technical Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook). Strong familiarity with PPAP, APQP, and MSA is required. Experience with data collection and analysis methods leading to demonstrated improvements is strongly preferred.
  • Certifications: ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) and/or Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt certifications are strongly desired.
  • Soft Skills: Ability to communicate diplomatically and effectively at all levels. You must be a self-starter with strong analytical research skills and the ability to manage multiple high-priority tasks to completion.

Why You’ll Love Working At RAM – Our Benefits

At RAM Aerospace, we believe our people are our greatest asset. That’s why we offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your well-being, work-life balance, and long-term success.

Our Benefits Include

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance - Comprehensive coverage to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Short-Term Disability & Voluntary Benefits - Additional protection and peace of mind when you need it most.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Confidential support for personal, financial, and emotional well-being.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) & Paid Holidays - Generous time off to relax, travel, and spend time with loved ones.
  • Paid Parental Leave - Time to bond with your new addition and transition smoothly back to work.
  • 401(K) Retirement Account - Plan for your future with our 401(K) retirement account, complete with an employer match.
  • Tuition Assistance - Invest in your education and future growth with our tuition assistance program.
  • Flexible Work Schedule - Balance your work and personal life with a flexible work schedule.

We are committed to creating an environment where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally.

EEO (Equal Employment Opportunity)

RAM Aerospace is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. Thank you for your interest in joining W.C. Bradley Co.!

We're excited you're here. Our application system is intuitive and easy to use, and we look forward to learning more about you as you complete your profile and submit your application.

Good luck, and thank you again for applying!

Job Summary

Lamplight Farms, home of the TIKI® Brand, is seeking a motivated, hands-on Quality Engineer to play an integral role in driving a culture of continuous improvement and learning. This position will be a critical team member on our New Product Development (NPD) team, playing a key role supporting Production, Warehousing, and Distribution, and have the opportunity to make a global impact through interaction with our international team and supply chain.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Quality representative on the New Product Development (NPD) Team to own and manage new product qualifications through the Production Part Approval Process (PPAP).
  • Conduct and monitor product and component testing, document procedures, test results, and relevant quality data.
  • Lead key risk mitigation activities such as FMEA and Product Integrity Committee reviews.
  • Capture and analyze product complaints, customer field data, and reported defects to identify emerging risks, determine root causes, and deploy corrective and preventive actions.
  • Lead and support domestic and global quality initiatives, ensuring alignment with internal standards and customer expectations.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and global team to identify and resolve non-conformance issues and monitor preventive and corrective actions through Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), Deviations, and Corrective Action Preventive Action (CAPA) processes.
  • Maintain product documentation, including test methods, inspection plans, and work instructions.
  • Track and report on key quality metrics to identify trends and opportunities for process or product improvements that impact overall Cost of Quality.
  • Continuously collect and report quality measures to monitor and improve production processes, products, and service performance; maintain records and statistical models.
  • Provide quality support to production and warehouse operations, including process troubleshooting and improvement implementation.
  • Drive global quality initiatives by coordinating quality projects across domestic and international teams, facilitating effective communication with global teams, suppliers, and technical partners.
  • Gatekeeper of document control process and records for procedures, test methods, inspection plans, forms, work instructions, and others.
  • Other duties as deemed necessary to support the business.

Minimum Education: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline preferred.

descriptionHtml:
Join our growing technology team as a Quality Assurance Software Development Engineer, where you'll help ensure the delivery of high-quality software that supports critical business operations. This role provides the opportunity to develop technical and testing expertise while working alongside cross-functional teams to validate requirements, execute test plans, identify defects, and support automation initiatives. You'll contribute to a culture of quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement by partnering with developers, analysts, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable solutions and exceptional user experiences. If you are a proactive problem-solver with a passion for technology and a commitment to learning, we encourage you to apply.

Modern Woodmen of America is one of the nation’s largest fraternal benefit societies, with over $18 billion assets. Fraternals are unique membership organizations that pair the “member-owned” characteristic of a mutual insurance company with the “social mission” characteristic of a service organization. They unite individuals with common bonds, provide a variety of life insurance and investment products, and form one of the nation’s most effective volunteer networks.

Responsibilities:

  • Execute manual, regression, API, and data validation tests for assigned work items and maintain accurate, comprehensive test documentation.
  • Create and maintain test cases, test data, defect details, and basic supporting test documentation.
  • Collaborate in person and virtually with team members to clarify requirements, confirm expected behavior, and communicate quality risks.
  • Contribute to basic automation, scripting, SQL validation, and repeatable testing practices as assigned.
  • Use approved AI tools responsibly to support test design, documentation, analysis, and summaries while validating outputs.
  • Analyze requirements, designs, data, and defects to identify quality risks, gaps, dependencies, and testing priorities.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute SQL queries, API tests, data validation processes, scripts, and automated test solutions, while continuously enhancing testing assets, frameworks, and overall test efficiency.

What we need:

  • Associate’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Quality, or a related technical field required, bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Willing to pursue a foundational software quality certification and working toward LOMA level 1 designation.
  • 1+ years of experience in quality assurance, software testing, technical support, business systems, programming, or a related technology field preferred.
  • Exposure to software development and testing tools and technologies, including:
    • C#
    • PowerShell
    • Visual Studio
    • SQL
    • Selenium
    • Git
    • Playwright
  • Experience supporting the development, testing, implementation, or maintenance of software applications preferred.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly document and communicate issues.
  • Ability to learn and apply test automation concepts and tools.
  • Foundational knowledge of SQL databases, APIs, Agile practices, and test management tools.

What we offer:

  • Pay: The annual pay for this position is $57,000 - $91,000. The specific rate will depend on the successful candidate’s qualifications and prior experience. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employment-based sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time, nor can we guarantee future sponsorship.
  • Work Arrangements: This is a full-time hybrid, hourly position: 37.5 hours per week (7.5 hours per day), Monday- Friday, with flexible start time between 7 a.m.-9 a.m. Hybrid positions work at least four days in office each week.  Employees beginning to work in a new hybrid role will be expected to work on-site (five days a week) during the initial training period which may be up to one year. Hybrid work arrangements are subject to change at any time based on business needs.
  • Stability: Modern Woodmen has been Modern Since 1883® and exists for our members. We make long-term decisions that provide stability for our employees, financial representatives, and members.
  • Respect for personal time: We offer vacation, sick leave and 11 paid holidays. We value your time outside of work and offer careers that blend work and life well.
  • Professional growth: Benefit from our commitment to employee development which includes educational offerings to enhance your knowledge of our industry.
  • Great culture: We build strong working relationships across our organization through collaborative work and volunteer opportunities.
  • A beautiful office: Enjoy a beautiful view! Our home office, located in downtown Rock Island, IL, has a lovely plaza overlooking the Mississippi River.
  • On-site Café: Our employees can purchase a variety of breakfast, lunch, and beverage options at Café 1883.
  • A thriving local community: Not from the Quad Cities and hesitant to consider relocation? Give it some thought. The Quad Cities offers an idyllic Midwestern lifestyle along the mighty Mississippi and consistently ranks at the top of the list for quality of life and cost of living. It is home to more than our share of artists, festivals, and fun in every season.
  • Exceptional benefits: Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support your health and financial well-being. Benefits include:
    • Company-paid retirement plan
    • Matching 401(k) plan
    • Employee Impact Bonus
    • Medical, Dental and Prescription Drug Insurance. We pay 100% of employees’ health insurance premiums and 50% of employee dependents’ premiums.
    • Group term life insurance.
    • Long-term and short-term disability.
    • Voluntary benefits: vision, flexible savings accounts (FSA), accident insurance

Modern Woodmen is an equal opportunity employer. Modern Woodmen is committed to providing a respectful environment where each person’s diverse opinions, attitudes, attributes, and feelings are respected.

Equal Opportunity Employer

This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws.
For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

Responsibilities
The USDS Core Business Quality Team owns end-to-end quality across TikTok's core products and services in the US. We are looking for a forward-thinking Quality Engineer who takes deep ownership of product quality and engineering efficiency. In this role, you will partner closely with cross-functional teams to identify quality risks, drive continuous improvements, build scalable quality solutions, and leverage AI-driven technologies to enhance product quality and engineering practices.

Responsibilities
- Have a deep understanding of business logic, and product functionality.
- Champion end-to-end quality practices and management across project testing, regression suites, and app validation. Drive production issue triage, defect pattern and root-cause analysis to proactively mitigate risk and continuously improve release stability
- Develop scalable automation tests, CI/CD validation pipelines, and internal engineering tools to increase test coverage, and elevate product reliability
- Apply LLMs and AI agents to real-world engineering challenges, such as automated test generation, self-healing scripts, root-cause analysis, and triaging to transform quality engineering practices

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- BS in Computer Science or related fields
- Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Java, etc.).
- Experience with web and mobile tests
- Proven experience building scalable test automation, or productivity tools.
- Experience with AI tools, with an understanding of practical use to improve testing efficiency
- Strong problem solving skills and self-driven mindset with effective collaboration skills

Preferred Qualifications
- Strong grasp of complex business logic and workflows, with the ability to design precise and comprehensive test strategies and use cases
- Experience with integrating AI agents into testing workflow or engineering pipelines
- Background in benchmarking and evaluating AI agents for effectiveness, reliability, and output quality
- Experience with building AI testing frameworks, autonomous testing agents or intelligent automation solutions
- Working knowledge of large-scale distributed systems architecture

About USDS
TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​


USDS Reasonable Accommodation
USDS is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/USDS-RA​


Job Information
【For Pay Transparency】Compensation Description (Annually)
The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $142880 - $252700 annually.​
Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.​
Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure).​
The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.​
For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:​
Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment:​
1. Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues;​
2. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and​
3. Exercising sound judgment.​

Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

McKesson is transforming healthcare through technology, data, and innovation. Within Macro Helix, part of Connected Care & Analytics, we help hospitals and health systems optimize pharmacy operations, improve financial performance, and maintain regulatory compliance.

As a Software Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our software solutions. This role combines hands-on manual testing with test automation, SQL validation, and quality engineering practices to support the successful delivery of healthcare technology products. We're looking for a self-starter who can quickly learn complex applications, contribute to automation initiatives, and collaborate effectively within Agile development teams.

What You'll Do

  • Execute functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing for complex healthcare applications.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and reusable test frameworks.
  • Write and execute SQL queries to validate application functionality, business logic, and data integrity.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, product owners, and QA team members throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Create automated UI, API, and integration tests that run within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify, document, and track defects through resolution.
  • Analyze requirements and user stories to develop comprehensive test coverage.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to quality engineering best practices.
  • Monitor test results, regression coverage, and quality metrics to support continuous improvement.
  • Support adoption of automation-first testing practices and emerging AI-assisted testing capabilities.


Basic Requirements

Minimum Education & Typical Experience or Equivalent Combination:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field and typically 4+ years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 4+ years of software testing or quality assurance experience.
  • Strong SQL skills with experience writing queries for testing and data validation.
  • Experience building or maintaining automated test frameworks and test suites.
  • Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Tosca, Selenium, or similar platforms.
  • Experience testing APIs, integrations, and end-to-end workflows.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, source control tools, and Agile teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve defects.


Preferred Skills/Experience

  • Experience designing and implementing scalable test automation frameworks.
  • Experience with C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar programming languages.
  • Experience testing cloud-based applications, including Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Experience with API testing tools such as SoapUI or Postman.
  • Experience with Jira, qTest, or similar Agile testing tools.
  • Experience with behavior-driven development tools such as Cucumber or JUnit.
  • Exposure to AI-enabled testing tools and automation practices.
  • Healthcare technology, pharmacy, revenue cycle, or healthcare software experience


Work Environment & Travel

  • Preferred location: Atlanta, GA or Las Colinas, TX.
  • Hybrid work arrangement available based on business needs.
  • Team members in the Las Colinas office may be expected to work onsite a minimum of two days per week.
  • Atlanta-based employees may periodically attend onsite team meetings.
  • Limited travel may be required for team collaboration and business meetings.
